title: IMLE-VLA: Fast Single-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Project page: https://kianhk6.github.io/IMLE-VLA/
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language backbones to achieve strong cross-task generalization. A leading design couples this backbone with a dedicated continuous action head trained via diffusion or flow matching. However, such heads rely on iterative multi-step sampling, for example 10 Euler steps in $π_{0.5}$. This creates an inference bottleneck that produces stop-and-go movement in the robot and slower task completion. We introduce IMLE-VLA, which replaces the iterative action head with a single-step conditional generator trained via conditional Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (cIMLE). The cIMLE objective promotes multimodal action coverage, avoiding the mode collapse of naive regression heads while eliminating multi-step sampling entirely. When IMLE-VLA is applied to $π_{0.5}$, it increases inference frequency 3.67x (55 Hz vs. 15 Hz), enabling up to 11x higher action throughput. On the 40-task LIBERO benchmark, IMLE-VLA achieves the highest average success rate (98.0%) among all baselines while leading in inference frequency. Under the test-time perturbations of LIBERO-plus, IMLE-VLA retains $π_{0.5}$'s robustness while other baselines degrade sharply, confirming that the cIMLE head preserves generalization. Real-world experiments on a Franka Emika Panda across four tasks demonstrate smoother motion (2.2x to 3.0x lower jerk) and faster task completion, with IMLE-VLA outperforming $π_{0.5}$ on every task and reducing average VLA inference time per episode by 3.9x to 6.6x. Videos and code are available at https://kianhk6.github.io/IMLE-VLA/

AI.tldr: IMLE-VLA用单步条件生成器（cIMLE）替换迭代式扩散/流匹配动作头，消除多步采样瓶颈，推理频率提升3.67倍，LIBERO 40任务平均成功率98.0%且保持鲁棒性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略将预训练视觉-语言骨干与连续动作头（扩散或流匹配）耦合，但动作头依赖迭代多步采样（如π0.5需10步Euler采样），造成推理瓶颈，导致机器人运动"走走停停"、任务完成变慢。
AI.method: 提出IMLE-VLA：以单步条件生成器替代迭代动作头，通过条件隐式最大似然估计（cIMLE）目标训练。该目标促进多模态动作覆盖，避免朴素回归头的模式崩塌，同时完全省去多步采样。将其应用于π0.5框架。
AI.result: 推理频率提升3.67倍（55 Hz vs 15 Hz），动作吞吐量最高提升11倍；LIBERO 40任务上平均成功率98.0%（基线中最高）且推理频率领先；LIBERO-plus扰动下保持π0.5的鲁棒性，其他基线显著退化。Franka Emika Panda四任务真机实验：jerk降低2.2–3.0倍，任务完成更快，每个episode平均推理时间减少3.9–6.6倍。
AI.conclusion: cIMLE单步动作头能在不损失泛化性与鲁棒性的前提下大幅提升VLA推理速度与运动平滑度，是替代迭代式扩散/流匹配动作头的有效方案。

authors: João Pedro C. A. de Sá
title: HiPerViT: A Hierarchical Perceiver-Vision Transformer Architecture for Multi-Scale Texture Recognition
summary: Texture recognition remains challenging for modern vision models because discriminative evidence is often carried by higher-order spatial statistics rather than by object shape alone. While Vision Transformers provide strong long-range modeling capacity, their standard object-centric representations do not explicitly expose such statistical structure, which limits texture sensitivity in fine-grained recognition settings. We present HiPerViT, a compact vision-only architecture that injects an explicit second-order statistical prior into a transformer-based recognition pipeline. The method combines global and local image views with a compact bilinear descriptor encoded as a statistical token, and integrates this token with first-order spatial representations through Perceiver-style latent distillation. This design enables direct interaction between spatial tokens and second-order feature co-occurrence statistics, providing the model with explicit access to texture-relevant information without requiring multimodal pretraining or ensemble construction. Across six texture recognition benchmarks, HiPerViT achieves consistent improvements over strong vision-only baselines under the reported evaluation protocols, including gains of +3.05 percentage points on DTD, +10.48 on GTOS-Mobile, and +10.10 on 1200Tex. Beyond benchmark performance, our analyses show that these gains are largely invariant to the backbone depth used to extract second-order statistics and to the ordering of interaction and distillation stages. This pattern suggests that the primary source of improvement is not a specific fusion topology, but the explicit availability of second-order statistical information as a first-class representational signal. These results support explicit statistical tokenization as an effective and robust design principle for texture-centric visual recognition.

AI.tldr: HiPerViT：在纯视觉Transformer识别流程中显式注入二阶统计先验，将紧凑双线性描述子编码为"统计token"，经Perceiver式潜变量蒸馏与一阶空间表征交互，在六个纹理识别基准上稳定超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 纹理识别的判别证据常来自高阶空间统计量而非物体形状；ViT虽有强长程建模能力，但标准以物体为中心的表示未显式暴露此类统计结构，限制了细粒度纹理识别中的纹理敏感性，且现有方案多依赖多模态预训练或集成。
AI.method: 提出HiPerViT紧凑纯视觉架构：融合全局与局部图像视图，用紧凑双线性描述子编码为统计token；通过Perceiver风格潜变量蒸馏，将该统计token与一阶空间表示整合，实现空间token与二阶特征共现统计的直接交互，无需多模态预训练或集成构造。
AI.result: 在六个纹理识别基准上按所报评测协议一致优于强纯视觉基线：DTD +3.05个百分点，GTOS-Mobile +10.48，1200Tex +10.10。分析显示增益对提取二阶统计的骨干深度及交互与蒸馏阶段顺序基本不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 主要提升来源并非特定融合拓扑，而是二阶统计信息作为一阶表征信号被显式可用；显式统计token化是纹理中心视觉识别中有效且稳健的设计原则。

title: Auto-RecSys: Harnessing Autonomous Research Agents for Industry-Scale Recommender System
summary: Auto-research agents have shown the potential to automate hypothesis generation, experiment execution, and iterative refinement. However, scaling this paradigm to industry-scale recommendation models introduces two challenges: (1) long feedback loops, where model training can take days, making serial iteration prohibitively slow and requiring parallel exploration across multiple research directions; and (2) system complexity, where large configurations, fragile infrastructure dependencies, and multi-day GPU jobs require robust and recoverable execution. We present Auto-RecSys, an autonomous research system for long-horizon experimentation on industry-scale recommendation models. Auto-RecSys addresses these challenges through three harness designs: (1) distributed asynchronous execution for running multiple experiments in parallel across servers, (2) centralized cross-server memory for persistent and recoverable execution across sessions and failures, and (3) cognitive-procedural separation, where natural-language skill files guide LLM reasoning while deterministic scripts enforce operational correctness. Auto-RecSys further employs a dual-loop self-evolving architecture: an Execution Evolution Loop in which model-specific playbooks accumulate operational knowledge by recording failed attempts and crystallizing successful pipelines, and an Idea Evolution Loop in which experimental outcomes inform subsequent ideation. Evaluated on recommendation models, Auto-RecSys significantly reduces the human time required per experiment cycle and improves execution reliability as its playbooks mature.

AI.tldr: 提出Auto-RecSys，一个面向工业级推荐模型长周期实验的自主研究系统，通过三项harness设计与双环自演化架构，显著缩短每轮实验的人力耗时并提升执行可靠性。
AI.motivation: 将自动研究智能体范式扩展到工业级推荐模型时面临两大挑战：(1) 反馈回路长——模型训练可能耗时数天，串行迭代过慢，需跨多个研究方向并行探索；(2) 系统复杂度高——大规模配置、脆弱的基础设施依赖与多日GPU任务，要求执行过程稳健且可恢复。
AI.method: Auto-RecSys采用三项harness设计：(1) 分布式异步执行，跨服务器并行运行多个实验；(2) 集中式跨服务器记忆，实现跨会话与故障的持久化、可恢复执行；(3) 认知—流程分离，由自然语言技能文件引导LLM推理，确定性脚本保障操作正确性。系统进一步采用双环自演化架构：执行演化环中，模型专属playbook记录失败尝试并固化成功流水线以积累操作知识；想法演化环中，实验结果反馈指导后续构思。
AI.result: 在推荐模型上评测，Auto-RecSys显著降低了每个实验周期所需的人力时间，并随着playbook逐步成熟而提升执行可靠性。
AI.conclusion: Auto-RecSys验证了面向工业级推荐模型长周期实验的自主研究系统可行性，其分布式异步执行、集中式记忆与认知—流程分离设计，结合双环自演化架构，可有效应对长反馈回路与高系统复杂度，实现人力成本下降与执行可靠性随经验积累而改善。

title: Is Bash All You Need? An Empirical Study of Tool Interfaces for Enterprise Digital Worker Agents
summary: In this study, we examine whether a general shell can outperform specialized tools on enterprise tasks. Shell-based agents have shown strong results in coding, but enterprise work also involves moving between applications and services, coordinating with coworkers, and performing professional analysis. We compare five tool interfaces on TheAgentCompany and APEX-Agents using Opus-4.8 and GPT-5.5: typed tools, typed tools plus bash, bash alone, bash with persistent agent-synthesized tools, and programmatic tool calling (PTC), which runs programs whose actions are restricted to a typed tool catalog. Bash alone outperforms typed tools on both benchmarks, improving score by 21.8-24.5 pp on TheAgentCompany and 4.8-7.4 pp on APEX-Agents while using 19-72% fewer total tokens. Adding typed tools or persistent tool synthesis to bash produces no detectable pooled score gain. PTC uses fewer tokens than direct typed calls with broadly similar task performance, but generally underperforms bash alone in both quality and cost efficiency. For enterprise practitioners, these results favor bash alone when arbitrary execution can be isolated and PTC when security or compliance policies require a fixed tool catalog.

AI.tldr: 研究比较五种工具接口在企业任务上的表现，发现单独的bash优于结构化工具，PTC适合安全合规受限场景。
AI.motivation: Shell-based agent在编程任务表现优异，但企业工作还涉及跨应用服务切换、与同事协作及专业分析，因此需检验通用shell能否在企业任务上胜过专用工具。
AI.method: 在TheAgentCompany和APEX-Agents两个基准上，使用Opus-4.8与GPT-5.5比较五种工具接口：结构化工具、结构化工具加bash、单独bash、带持久化agent合成工具的bash、以及程序化工具调用（PTC，程序动作受限于结构化工具目录）。
AI.result: 单独bash在两个基准上均优于结构化工具，TheAgentCompany分数提升21.8-24.5个百分点，APEX-Agents提升4.8-7.4个百分点，且总token减少19-72%。在bash上添加结构化工具或持久化工具合成未带来可检测的汇总分数增益。PTC比直接结构化调用token更少、任务表现大致相当，但在质量和成本效率上通常不如单独bash。
AI.conclusion: 对任意执行可被隔离的企业场景，推荐单独bash；当安全或合规政策要求固定工具目录时，推荐PTC。

title: Structurally Speaking: Motif-Oriented Graph Captioning through Bidirectional Graph-Text Translation
summary: Graph captions should help readers understand graph structure, rather than simply translate adjacency matrices into long textual edge lists. A useful graph caption abstracts connectivity into recognizable motifs, such as hubs, paths, cycles, cliques, and bridges, because these motifs provide compact structural units that are easier to read, compare, and recover. In this paper, we study motif-oriented graph captioning as a bidirectional graph-text translation task, where captions must both preserve enough topology for graph recovery and express the graph through concise motif-level descriptions. We show that direct prompting of GPT-5.1 often produces graph-recoverable captions by enumerating node-to-node connections, but these captions are verbose and can contain inconsistent motif interpretations. To address this gap, we introduce Structurally Speaking, a lightweight structured prompting protocol that guides translation between explicit connectivity and motif-level abstraction. Experiments on a synthetic motif-based dataset show that structured prompting produces shorter and more motif-consistent captions while maintaining comparable graph recovery. These results suggest that explicit topology-to-motif reasoning guidance can make LLM-generated graph captions more interpretable without model fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Structurally Speaking"——一种无需微调的结构化提示协议，引导大模型在图谱描述中从"列举边"转向"motif级抽象"，生成更短、motif更一致的图标题，同时保持可比的图恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 图谱标题应帮助读者理解图结构，而非把邻接矩阵翻译成冗长的边列表。将连通性抽象为可识别的motif（hub、path、cycle、clique、bridge）能提供紧凑、易读、易比较和易恢复的结构单元。直接提示GPT-5.1虽常能生成可恢复的标题，但冗长且motif解释不一致，存在明显的表达与一致性的缺口。
AI.method: 将motif导向的图谱描述建模为双向的图-文本翻译任务：标题既要保留足够拓扑以支持图恢复，又要以简洁的motif级描述表达图。提出"Structurally Speaking"轻量结构化提示协议，显式引导模型在显式连通性与motif级抽象之间进行翻译推理，全程不进行模型微调。
AI.result: 在基于合成motif的数据集上，结构化提示生成的标题更短、motif一致性更高，而图恢复性能与直接提示方式相当。
AI.conclusion: 显式的拓扑到motif推理引导可使大模型生成的图标题更具可解释性，且无需模型微调，为motif导向的图谱描述提供了一种低成本、可推广的思路。

title: Using Semantic Uncertainty to Estimate Transition Relevance in Turn-taking
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. 21 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables
summary: Turn-taking is a fundamental mechanism that governs when interlocutors speak and listen. Although Spoken Dialogue Systems (SDS) exploit a range of linguistic, acoustic, and non-verbal cues, they produce ill-timed responses in unscripted interaction. A central challenge is anticipating Transition Relevance Places (TRPs), or opportunities, not obligations, for a listener to take the floor. Human listeners do not wait for turn endings; as an utterance unfolds, they use expectations about its developing meaning to anticipate TRPs and decide whether to take the floor. We examine whether these evolving expectations can be modeled through semantic uncertainty -- an LLM-derived measure of how strongly a turn so far constrains what may plausibly come next. To do so, we sample possible continuations of an ongoing turn and use changes in semantic dispersion to identify TRPs within turns. We evaluate this account on a dataset with TRP labels derived from real-time listener responses, rather than retrospective annotation. Our approach substantially outperforms prompt-based and fine-tuned text-only baselines, providing empirical support for the view that evolving semantic constraints inform perceived turn-taking opportunities in unscripted interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用语义不确定性建模会话中的话轮转换机会(TRP)，通过采样话轮的可能续写并观测语义分散度的变化来预测TRP，效果显著优于基于提示和微调的纯文本基线。
AI.motivation: 口语对话系统虽利用语言、声学和非言语线索，但在非脚本交互中仍产生不合时宜的回应。核心难点在于预判"转换相关位置"(TRP)——即倾听者可接管话轮的机会而非义务。人类听者不等话轮结束，而是在话语展开中依据对其意义发展的预期来预判TRP并决定是否接管，本文欲探究这种演化中的预期能否被建模。
AI.method: 将演化预期操作化为语义不确定性，即以LLM导出的度量衡量当前话轮对其后续可能内容的约束强度。具体做法是采样当前进行中话轮的多种可能续写，并利用语义分散度的变化来识别话轮内部的TRP。评估使用带有真实实时听者反应标注TRP的数据集，而非回溯式标注。
AI.result: 该方法大幅优于基于提示(prompt-based)和微调的纯文本基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了实证支持，表明演化中的语义约束会影响非脚本交互中被感知到的话轮转换机会。

title: Variational Template Matching with Statistical Fusion for Anomaly Detection in Patterned Structures
summary: Anomaly detection in structured images is challenging in small-data settings where deep learning approaches are costly or impractical. Classical template matching is simple and interpretable but lacks robustness to geometric variations such as scale, rotation, and perspective. We propose a variational template matching framework that represents anomaly templates as a family of transformed instances and performs detection via normalized cross-correlation over this transformation space. To further improve robustness, we introduce a density-based statistical anomaly score derived from local intensity distributions using kernel density estimation (KDE). This produces a smooth representation that captures distributional concentration and tail behavior more robustly than histogram-based methods. The structural and statistical signals are integrated through a unified fusion formulation, enabling complementary modeling of geometric similarity and distributional deviation. Experiments on biological cell images demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms classical baselines and achieves competitive performance with ResNet-50 under a fully training-free setting, while providing explicit localization. The approach offers an efficient, interpretable, and practical solution for anomaly detection in structured image domains.

AI.tldr: 提出变分模板匹配框架，结合变换空间归一化互相关与KDE密度统计异常分数并进行统一融合，在生物细胞图像上无训练条件下优于经典基线并与ResNet-50竞争，同时提供显式定位。
AI.motivation: 结构化图像的小样本异常检测中，深度学习方法成本高或不实用；经典模板匹配虽简单可解释，但对尺度、旋转、透视等几何变化缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1）变分模板匹配：将异常模板表示为变换实例族，在变换空间上计算归一化互相关进行检测；2）基于核密度估计（KDE）从局部强度分布导出密度统计异常分数，得到比直方图方法更鲁棒的平滑表示，捕捉分布集中度与尾部特征；3）通过统一融合公式集成结构（几何相似性）与统计（分布偏离）信号。
AI.result: 在生物细胞图像实验中，该方法优于经典基线，在全无训练（training-free）设定下达到与ResNet-50相当的性能，并能提供显式定位。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为结构化图像域的异常检测提供了一种高效、可解释且实用的解决方案，兼顾几何鲁棒性与统计建模的互补优势。

title: Empirical Evaluation of Membership Inference Attacks on NLP Text Classifiers: A Baseline Study on SST-2
comment: Presented at the 58th Midwest Instruction and Computing Symposium (MICS 2026), Eau Claire, WI, March 27 to 28, 2026. 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables
summary: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) try to determine whether a specific record was used to train a model, a privacy risk that matters in natural language processing (NLP), where training data can contain sensitive user text. This paper presents a controlled benchmark of membership inference vulnerability for text classification on the GLUE SST-2 sentiment dataset. A TF-IDF + Logistic Regression pipeline and a fine-tuned DistilBERT classifier are compared under a loss-threshold MIA, with utility measured by development accuracy and macro F1. DistilBERT reached 0.9466 accuracy and 0.9460 macro F1 against 0.8756 and 0.8727 for Logistic Regression, yet both models leaked membership signal (Attack AUC 0.5615 and 0.5800, respectively). Two mitigations were tested. Stronger regularization reduced leakage for Logistic Regression at a visible utility cost, whereas fine-tuning DistilBERT for 2 epochs instead of 3 reduced leakage with negligible accuracy loss. Lightweight training adjustments can improve the privacy-utility trade-off without complex defenses.

AI.tldr: 在 GLUE SST-2 上对 TF-IDF+逻辑回归与微调 DistilBERT 进行损失阈值成员推断攻击基准测试，并比较两种缓解措施。
AI.motivation: NLP 训练数据可能包含敏感用户文本，成员推断攻击（MIA）构成隐私风险，需要在一个受控设定下量化不同文本分类模型的成员泄露程度及缓解手段的隐私-效用权衡。
AI.method: 在 GLUE SST-2 情感数据集上构建受控基准：比较 TF-IDF + 逻辑回归流水线与微调 DistilBERT 分类器；采用损失阈值 MIA 评估成员推断漏洞；效用用开发集准确率和宏 F1 衡量；测试两种缓解措施——更强正则化，以及将 DistilBERT 微调轮数由 3 轮减至 2 轮。
AI.result: DistilBERT 达到 0.9466 准确率和 0.9460 宏 F1，逻辑回归为 0.8756 和 0.8727；但两者均泄露成员信号，攻击 AUC 分别为 0.5615 和 0.5800。更强正则化降低了逻辑回归的泄露，但带来明显效用损失；将 DistilBERT 微调 2 轮而非 3 轮，在准确率损失可忽略的情况下降低了泄露。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级训练调整即可改善隐私-效用权衡，无需复杂防御手段。

title: CamPilot: A Multi-Agent Cinematic Assistant for Camera-Controlled Movie Generation
summary: The integration of large language models (LLMs) into video generation has enabled rapid text-to-video creation and improved visual quality. However, it still falls short of professional filmmaking, where cinematographic language is less refined than human-crafted camera work and multi-shot continuity remains challenging. To address these limitations, we introduce CamPilot, a multi-agent framework that integrates cinematographic planning and camera-work control to produce more coherent, logically structured, and human-aesthetic movies. CamPilot adopts a GRPO-based learning paradigm to learn camera work planning from 14K real-world professional movies, internalizing motion patterns and composition principles that support reasoning over shooting techniques (e.g., camera angle, motion, and focal behavior) and cross-shot relationships for controllable camera-viewpoint generation. Multiple agents further collaborate and evolve to improve overall output quality. To support this work and further studies in this domain, we establish CamEval, a benchmark for evaluating camera work quality and cinematic engagement. Empirical results show that CamPilot outperforms state-of-the-art text-to-movie generation methods on cinematographic control and quality, highlighting the impact of professional camera design on movie generation.

AI.tldr: CamPilot：集成电影摄影规划与运镜控制的多智能体框架，基于GRPO从14K真实专业电影学习运镜规划，并构建CamEval基准，在运镜控制与质量上超越现有文本到电影生成方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的视频生成虽提升了文本到视频的生成速度与视觉质量，但与专业电影制作仍有差距：电影语言（运镜）不如人工拍摄精细，且多镜头连续性难以保证。因此需要引入电影摄影规划与运镜控制，使生成影片更连贯、逻辑结构化并符合人类审美。
AI.method: 提出CamPilot多智能体框架，整合电影摄影规划与运镜控制。采用基于GRPO的学习范式，从14K真实专业电影中学习运镜规划，内化运动模式与构图原则，从而支持对拍摄技术（如机位角度、运动、焦距行为）及跨镜头关系的推理，实现可控视角生成；多个智能体进一步协作与演化以提升整体输出质量。同时建立CamEval基准，用于评估运镜质量与电影参与感。
AI.result: 实证结果显示，CamPilot在运镜控制与质量方面优于当前最先进的文本到电影生成方法，凸显专业运镜设计对电影生成的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过多智能体协作、基于GRPO的专业运镜学习及配套的CamEval评估基准，CamPilot有效弥合了文本到视频生成与专业电影制作之间的差距，证明专业运镜设计是提升电影生成质量的关键因素。

title: Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Modalities via Semantic-aware Completeness based Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to the Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Recent multimodal sentiment analysis studies increasingly adopt text-centric fusion approaches to exploit the rich sentiment information inherent in the textual modality. However, these approaches often suffer from performance degradation during inference due to partially missing or noisy data in real-world scenarios, especially when sentiment-related cues are missing. To address this issue, we introduce a new completeness estimation approach that quantifies the degree of sentiment-relevant information preserved in incomplete data to guide the reconstruction of missing semantics. Furthermore, we propose a training strategy that stabilizes multi-task learning while jointly optimizing sentiment prediction and completeness estimation. Extensive experiments and in-depth analyses on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach enables more accurate semantic reconstruction, leading to more precise sentiment prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出完整性估计方法量化不完整数据中保留的情感相关信息程度，以指导缺失语义重建，并配合稳定多任务学习的训练策略，提升多模态情感分析的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情感分析多采用以文本为中心的融合方法，能利用文本模态丰富的情感信息，但在真实场景中面对部分缺失或噪声数据时性能显著下降，尤其当情感相关线索缺失时问题更为突出。
AI.method: 引入一种新的完整性估计方法，量化不完整数据中保留的情感相关信息程度，用于指导缺失语义的重建；同时提出一种训练策略，在联合优化情感预测与完整性估计的同时稳定多任务学习过程。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上进行的大量实验与深入分析表明，所提方法能够实现更准确的语义重建，从而带来更精确的情感预测。
AI.conclusion: 通过完整性估计引导缺失语义重建并稳定多任务训练，可有效缓解文本中心融合方法在数据不完整或含噪时的性能退化问题，提升情感预测精度。

title: Are We Grading Properly? Understanding Failure Modes in Medical Benchmarks
summary: Medical evaluation is shifting from static option-based questioning to realistic clinical scenarios with open-ended output modes. Grading these at scale naively, however, is expensive, and rubric-based evaluation has become the dominant scalable alternative. We ask what happens when the rubrics themselves are not airtight, and whether such flaws can be detected and corrected. We apply RIFT, a global rubric failure taxonomy, to two clinical benchmarks (HealthBench Professional and LiveMedBench), and find failure modes are meaningful: on HealthBench Professional an LLM judge flags 29.6% of criteria as non-atomic and 65.4% as misaligned/rigid. Then, we show that these flaws are meaningful and not simply cosmetic. As an example, rewriting bundled criteria of the form "at least one of / all of the following" as equally weighted children and regrading identical responses shifts scores by up to 15.9 percentage points on affected conversations, with disjunctive bundles inflating scores and conjunctive bundles deflating them. We also find that RIFT generally under-detects bundling on clinical rubrics, flagging 3.3% of LiveMedBench criteria as non-atomic where surface-form analysis finds structure in 25.8%.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究临床开放式问答自动评分中评分标准（rubric）自身的缺陷问题，将RIFT失败分类法应用于HealthBench Professional与LiveMedBench两个基准，量化了rubric缺陷的普遍性与对分数的影响，并发现RIFT对"捆绑式"准则存在系统性漏检。
AI.motivation: 医学评估正从静态选项式提问转向开放式输出的真实临床情景，但大规模人工评分成本高昂，基于rubric的自动评估因此成为主流替代方案。然而rubric本身可能并不严密，其缺陷是否会产生实质影响、能否被检测和纠正，尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 采用RIFT（一种全局性的rubric失败分类体系）对HealthBench Professional和LiveMedBench两个临床基准进行标注分析，由LLM评判器识别非原子性、错位/僵化等失败模式；并通过改写"at least one of / all of the following"类捆绑准则为等权子项、对相同回答重新评分，进行对照实验以检验缺陷的实质影响，同时用表层形式分析对比RIFT的检测覆盖率。
AI.result: 在HealthBench Professional上，LLM评判器将29.6%的准则标记为非原子性，65.4%为错位/僵化。改写捆绑准则后重新评分，受影响的对话分数变化最高达15.9个百分点：析取式捆绑会虚高分数，合取式捆绑则压低分数。此外RIFT对临床rubric中的捆绑结构普遍漏检，仅将3.3%的LiveMedBench准则标为非原子性，而表层形式分析发现25.8%存在该类结构。
AI.conclusion: rubric缺陷并非表面问题，而是会实质性影响评分结果，因此rubric质量本身应被作为评估可靠性的关键变量加以检验与修正；同时现有失败分类法（如RIFT）对临床rubric的捆绑结构检测不足，需要更敏感的检测方法。

title: Evasion Attacks: How Adversarial Noise Bypasses ML Classifiers
comment: Presented at the 58th Midwest Instruction and Computing Symposium (MICS 2026), Eau Claire, WI, March 27 to 28, 2026. 14 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables
summary: This paper presents a reproducible, educational study of evasion attacks in image classification and text classification. A compact convolutional network trained on MNIST reached 98.63% clean test accuracy and was evaluated under two white-box attacks. Under FGSM, accuracy fell to 60.20% at $ε$ = 0.15 and 1.72% at $ε$ = 0.30; under PGD it fell to 32.47% and 0.41%, and a bit-depth-reduction defense recovered only part of the loss. In the second experiment, DistilBERT fine-tuned on the SMS Spam Collection reached 98.75% accuracy and a 94.96% F1-score, but a controlled sequence of pre-defined perturbations (character substitutions, whitespace noise, and a benign suffix) produced only modest probability shifts in most displayed examples and no flip from spam to ham. Adversarial vulnerability is strongly modality-dependent: the MNIST experiment is a clear evasion demonstration, whereas the text experiment is a controlled robustness evaluation. Robustness must be tested empirically rather than inferred from clean accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过可复现的教学实验，对比图像分类与文本分类中的逃避攻击：MNIST模型在FGSM/PGD下准确率大幅崩溃，而SMS垃圾短信上的DistilBERT对预设扰动表现稳健，说明对抗脆弱性高度依赖模态。
AI.motivation: 清洁准确率高并不意味着模型鲁棒，需通过实证检验对抗脆弱性；同时希望以可复现、教学化的方式对比不同模态下的逃避攻击表现。
AI.method: 实验一：在MNIST上训练紧凑卷积网络，采用FGSM（ε=0.15、0.30）与PGD两种白盒攻击，并尝试位深压缩防御。实验二：在SMS Spam Collection上微调DistilBERT，施加受控的预设扰动序列（字符替换、空白噪声、良性后缀），观察预测概率变化。
AI.result: MNIST清洁准确率98.63%；FGSM下降至60.20%（ε=0.15）与1.72%（ε=0.30），PGD下降至32.47%与0.41%，位深压缩防御仅恢复部分损失。DistilBERT清洁准确率98.75%、F1为94.96%，扰动仅造成多数样本概率的小幅偏移，未出现spam到ham的标签翻转。
AI.conclusion: 对抗脆弱性强烈依赖模态：图像实验是明确的逃避攻击演示，文本实验属于受控鲁棒性评估；鲁棒性必须实证测量，不能由清洁准确率推断。

title: Exponential Pixelating Integral transform with dual fractal features for enhanced chest X-ray abnormality detection
comment: Preprint of the article published in the ELSEVIER journal Computers in Biology and Medicine (CIBM), Vol. 182, November 2024. Final version available at DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compbiomed.2024.109093
summary: The heightened prevalence of respiratory disorders, particularly exacerbated by a significant upswing in fatalities due to the novel coronavirus, underscores the critical need for early detection and timely intervention. This imperative is paramount, possessing the potential to profoundly impact and safeguard numerous lives. Medically, chest radiography stands out as an essential and economically viable medical imaging approach for diagnosing and assessing the severity of diverse Respiratory Disorders. However, their detection in Chest X-Rays is a cumbersome task even for well-trained radiologists owing to low contrast issues, overlapping of the tissue structures, subjective variability, and the presence of noise. To address these issues, a novel analytical model termed Exponential Pixelating Integral is introduced for the automatic detection of infections in Chest X-Rays in this work. Initially, the presented Exponential Pixelating Integral enhances the pixel intensities to overcome the low-contrast issues that are then polar-transformed followed by their representation using the locally invariant Mandelbrot and Julia fractal geometries for effective distinction of structural features. The collated features labeled Exponential Pixelating Integral with dually characterized fractal features are then classified by the non-parametric multivariate adaptive regression splines to establish an ensemble model between each pair of classes for effective diagnosis of diverse diseases. Rigorous analysis of the proposed classification framework on large medical benchmarked datasets showcases its superiority over its peers by registering a higher classification accuracy and F1 scores ranging from 98.46 to 99.45% and 96.53-98.10% respectively, making it a precise and interpretable automated system for diagnosing respiratory disorders.

AI.tldr: 提出指数像素积分(EPI)模型，结合极坐标变换、Mandelbrot/Julia分形特征与MARS分类，实现胸部X光呼吸系统疾病的高精度自动检测。
AI.motivation: 呼吸系统疾病患病率上升，新冠疫情的死亡率激增凸显了早期检测与及时干预的重要性。胸部X光是一种必要且经济可行的诊断影像手段，但由于低对比度、组织结构重叠、主观变异性和噪声，即使训练有素的放射科医生也难以检测。
AI.method: 提出名为"指数像素积分"(Exponential Pixelating Integral, EPI)的新型分析模型：先用EPI增强像素强度以克服低对比度，再进行极坐标变换，随后用局部不变的Mandelbrot与Julia分形几何表示以区分结构特征；将所得特征(EPI与双重分形特征)通过非参数多元自适应回归样条(MARS)分类，在每对类别间建立集成模型进行诊断。
AI.result: 在大型医学基准数据集上，分类准确率为98.46%–99.45%，F1分数为96.53%–98.10%，优于同类方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为呼吸系统疾病的诊断提供了一个精确且可解释的自动化系统。

title: Distribution-aware Language Neuron Identification in Multilingual Large Language Models
summary: Multilingual large language models (mLLMs) contain a small fraction of feed-forward neurons that are sensitive to particular languages, commonly termed language-specific neurons. Existing work measures language specificity using the entropy of each neuron's language-wise probabilities of being active, where a neuron is considered active when its activation value is positive. However, this approach may not fully capture the multilingual nature of mLLMs, where language representations are distributional and mutually related. We propose Distribution-aware Language Neuron selection, which leverages pairwise relationships between per-language activation distributions over the full activation range, including negative values. Specifically, we quantify each neuron's language specificity by clustering languages using pairwise overlap coefficients between their activation distributions. Across two mLLMs and two held-out corpora, our identifier more effectively isolates language-specific causal effects, yielding up to 4.9$\times$ higher on-target language damage per neuron while preserving off-target language performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Distribution-aware Language Neuron选择方法，利用各语言激活分布间的成对重叠系数聚类来量化神经元语言特异性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法基于激活值是否为正来定义神经元活跃，并用语言激活概率的熵衡量语言特异性。但mLLM中语言表征具有分布性和相互关联性，熵方法仅依据阈值化的正激活概率，未能充分刻画语言的多语种本质。
AI.method: Distribution-aware Language Neuron selection：在完整激活范围（含负值）上刻画每种语言的激活分布，计算语言间激活分布的成对重叠系数（pairwise overlap coefficients），据此对语言进行聚类，并以聚类结果量化为每个神经元的语言特异性。
AI.result: 在两个mLLM和两个留出语料上，该方法能更有效地隔离语言特异性的因果效应，每个神经元的同目标语言损伤最高提升4.9倍，同时保持非目标语言性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于激活分布成对关系的神经元识别优于基于熵的阈值化方法，能更精准地定位语言特异性神经元并揭示其因果作用。

title: Rethinking Verbalized Confidence for LLM-as-a-Judge: A Compatibility Shift on Post-2025 Proprietary Models
summary: Verbalized confidence, long dismissed as overconfident, coarse, and prone to round-number clustering, is now the more robust soft-scoring mechanism for LLM-as-a-Judge on top-tier proprietary models. Across SummEval, AggreFact, and HelpSteer2, spanning up to 18 LLMs, we show that the standard advice to prefer log-probabilities no longer holds on post-2025 models, where verbalized confidence is the better signal. We call this a compatibility shift. On top of a standard verbalized-confidence baseline, we introduce two new ingredients: an overconfidence advisory and self-debate. Together they improve calibration, score-distribution spread, and robustness to task subjectivity. We further observe a generation effect: post-2025 models accommodate these two additions with little balanced-accuracy cost, whereas pre-2025 models pay a measurable penalty. Compared with logprob-based G-Eval, verbalized confidence is the more subjectivity-robust soft signal on GPT-family top-tier releases. The shift is invisible under accuracy-only reporting. Rather than defaulting to hard predictions, we recommend broader use of soft scoring in LLM-as-a-Judge. More broadly, verbalized confidence has moved from a weaker substitute for logprobs to a practical soft-scoring mechanism for contemporary LLM judges.

AI.tldr: 在2025年后的顶级专有模型上，口头化置信度（verbalized confidence）已取代对数概率成为更稳健的LLM-as-a-Judge软评分机制，本文称之为"兼容性转移"，并提出"过度自信提示"与"自我辩论"两个新组件以提升校准、分数分布与主观鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 长期以来，学界将口头化置信度视为过于自信、粒度粗糙且易出现整数聚集，因而推荐使用对数概率。本文旨在验证这一传统建议在最新模型上是否仍然成立，并探索提升口头化置信度作为软评分信号的途径。
AI.method: 在SummEval、AggreFact与HelpSteer2三个基准上，覆盖多达18个LLM进行系统评测。以标准口头化置信度为基线，引入两个新组件：过度自信提示（overconfidence advisory）与自我辩论（self-debate）；并与基于对数概率的G-Eval进行对比，同时考察2025年前后模型的代际差异。
AI.result: 在后2025年的模型上，口头化置信度是更优信号，且两组件能同时改善校准、分数分布离散度与对任务主观性的鲁棒性；后2025年模型吸收这两项改进时平衡准确率损失很小，而前2025年模型付出可测量的代价。在GPT系列顶级版本上，口头化置信度比基于对数概率的G-Eval更具主观鲁棒性。该优势在仅报告准确率时不可见。
AI.conclusion: 口头化置信度已从对数概率的弱替代品转变为当代LLM评审的实用软评分机制。建议在LLM-as-a-Judge中更广泛地采用软评分而非默认硬预测，并在评测中纳入校准与分布性指标。

title: K/V-Cache Interventions Dissociate Representation Alignment from Persona Expression in Decoder-Only Language Models
summary: We study K/V-cache interventions -- transplanting a target-conditioned K/V trajectory into a source-persona generation -- as a structured surface for persona control in decoder-only language models. Across 13 intervention configurations applied to Llama-3.1-8B for a fixed source-to-target persona pair, we report two consistent dissociations between representation-level alignment and behavioral expression, plus a common failure under position perturbations. First, all layer-band K/V replacements (early, mid, late) achieve strong local V-space alignment (V-gap 0.91, 0.89, 0.84), but only mid-layer replacement (layers 9-20) combines substantial target-marker expression with preserved lexical diversity. Second, full and mid-layer replacement induce comparable alignment (V-gap 0.94 vs. 0.89) yet produce different lexical-diversity profiles (TTR 0.65 vs. 0.77). Third, position perturbations (lag and shuffle) apply distinct operations yet uniformly suppress target-persona expression -- a common behavioral failure rather than a strict dissociation. Representation-level similarity metrics alone are thus not sufficient predictors of downstream persona expression in the regimes we study; the K/V cache emerges as a controllable but structurally constrained intervention surface. Because the transplanted trajectory carries the target's own generated token history, we characterize the intervention as trajectory-level transplantation rather than isolated persona-representation injection; a same-token-sequence control, decoding an identical token sequence under source vs. target conditioning, reproduces the sign and layer localization of the L28 representational shift, indicating the shift is not explained solely by imported token history. These findings characterize representation-behavior dissociation in a high-signal setting rather than establishing universality across models or persona pairs.

AI.tldr: K/V缓存移植可作为人物角色控制的结构化干预面，但表示层对齐与行为表达存在系统性解离。
AI.motivation: 探索解码器语言模型人物角色控制的可控干预面，检验表示级相似度能否预测下游行为表达。
AI.method: 在Llama-3.1-8B上对固定源-目标人物角色对实施13种K/V缓存干预配置，比较不同层带替换、全层与中层替换、以及位置扰动（滞后与打乱）下的V空间对齐与行为表现，并引入同token序列对照。
AI.result: 1) 早/中/晚层带替换均达强局部V空间对齐（V-gap 0.91/0.89/0.84），仅中层（9-20层）兼具显著目标标记表达与词汇多样性；2) 全层与中层替换对齐相当（0.94 vs 0.89）但TTR差异明显（0.65 vs 0.77）；3) 位置扰动虽操作不同却一致抑制目标人物表达，为共同行为失效。同token序列对照重现L28表示偏移的符号与层定位。
AI.conclusion: 表示级相似度指标不足以预测下游人物表达；K/V缓存是可控但结构受限的干预面。该干预属轨迹级移植而非孤立表示注入。结论限于高信号设定，非跨模型或人物对的普适性结论。

title: 3D Field Data Reduction with Adaptive Sample-Based Gaussian-Encoded Reconstruction
summary: In scientific simulation, regular grids, unstructured meshes, and particle-based formats are chosen to represent field data for computational efficiency, geometry/adaptive flexibility, and following motion/deformation, respectively. Each of these field data formats is often handled through separate data-specific processing pipelines. We present a unified sample-based Gaussian encoding method that represents these data forms under a single fixed-budget formulation. The method initializes and refines Gaussian primitives directly from the input samples while preserving a prescribed primitive count and encoded size to achieve a desired level of data reduction. Across structured, unstructured, and particle data, the sample-based formulation improves reconstruction accuracy with measurably fewer primitives in comparison to prior formulations, achieving up to 4.8 dB higher PSNR with an approximate 44x reduction in primitive count. For time-varying data, warm-starting from the previous timestep reduces the optimization required to reach independently trained reconstruction quality. Together, these results demonstrate a unified fixed-budget Gaussian encoding framework for structured, particle, unstructured, and time-varying scientific data with predictable storage, higher reconstruction accuracy, and improved temporal encoding efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种统一的基于采样的高斯编码方法，将规则网格、非结构网格与粒子三种科学数据格式纳入同一固定预算框架，用更少高斯基元取得更高重建精度。
AI.motivation: 科学仿真中，规则网格、非结构网格与粒子格式分别服务于计算效率、几何/自适应灵活性与运动变形追踪，但通常各自依赖独立的数据专用处理流程，缺乏统一表示。
AI.method: 直接从输入样本初始化并细化高斯基元，保持预设的基元数量与编码尺寸以实现目标数据压缩率；对时变数据采用从上一时间步热启动的策略。
AI.result: 在结构化、非结构化与粒子数据上，相比已有方法以更少基元提升重建精度，PSNR最高提升4.8 dB，基元数约减少44倍；时变数据热启动可降低达到独立训练重建质量所需的优化量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了面向结构化、粒子、非结构及时变科学数据的统一固定预算高斯编码框架，具备可预测存储、更高重建精度与更优时间编码效率。

title: New Evidence, Same Choice: Testing Physical Experiment Selection in Vision Language Models
summary: A model first sees an image from one physical measurement experiment, such as how far a block coasted, and must answer a question about a new trial, such as whether the block will pass a target after a fixed push. The initial experiment may provide enough information to answer, or the model may need another measurement, such as the object's mass, friction, restitution, or spring stiffness. We study whether vision language models can decide when to answer immediately and, when more evidence is needed, which experiment to perform. Current physical reasoning benchmarks usually evaluate only the final answer, so they do not directly measure this decision-making ability. We introduce a controlled evaluation where each problem provides one measurement image and four possible physical worlds created by combining two possible masses and two possible values of another relevant property. The model must either stop and answer or select the cheapest additional experiment that can resolve the question. We construct matched problem pairs where changing either the observed measurement or the question changes the optimal action. Since all possible worlds and experiment costs are known, we can explicitly determine the optimal choice. Across six open models and 144 physical parameter sets, direct responses repeat the same action for 95.1% to 100% of image pairs even when the correct action changes. Brief reasoning improves action switching, but the best model makes both decisions correctly for only 5.9% of image pairs. Additional analysis reveals failures in measurement interpretation, physical reasoning, and response formatting. By evaluating evidence selection separately from final answers, our benchmark reveals limitations in physical reasoning that conventional answer accuracy can overlook.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个受控评测，用以检验视觉语言模型在物理推理中"何时直接作答、何时需追加实验"的证据选择能力，发现模型普遍缺乏该决策能力，常规答案准确率掩盖了这一缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有物理推理基准多只评估最终答案，无法直接衡量模型"是否该立即作答、以及该做哪个实验"的决策能力，导致该能力被最终答案准确率所掩盖。
AI.method: 构建受控评测：每题给出一张测量图像与由两个可能质量及另一个相关属性（摩擦、恢复系数、弹簧刚度等）组合成的四个可能物理世界；模型需选择停止作答或选取能解决问题的最便宜追加实验，且实验成本与真实世界均已知，可显式计算最优选择。并构造匹配问题对，通过改变观测或问题使最优动作发生变化。
AI.result: 在6个开源模型、144组物理参数上，直接回答在95.1%–100%的图像对中重复同一动作，即使正确动作已改变；加入简短推理可提升动作切换，但最优模型仅在5.9%的图像对上两个决策均正确。额外分析揭示了测量解读、物理推理与响应格式三方面的失败。
AI.conclusion: 将证据选择与最终答案分离评估，可揭示传统答案准确率所忽视的物理推理局限，说明现有模型在主动实验决策上仍存在明显不足。

title: Rebalancing Token Importance in Language Models with TF-IDF Weighted Cross-Entropy Loss
summary: Large language models are typically trained under uniform token weighting, which allows frequent and low-information tokens to dominate learning and can increase the tendency to memorize surface-level text spans. To address this, we present an information-weighted cross-entropy loss that rescales token-level contributions using TF-IDF statistics, emphasizing semantically informative tokens while down-weighting ubiquitous ones. Experiments on five decoder-only LLMs ranging from 1.1B to 13B parameters show consistent reductions in memorized substring length while preserving perplexity and downstream task performance. Under LoRA fine-tuning, TF-IDF reduces average substring memorization length by 14% across all five models. Under full-weight fine-tuning on TinyLLaMA 1.1B, the reduction reaches 58%. Our approach is architecture-agnostic and can be incorporated into existing training pipelines with less than 3% computational overhead, offering a lightweight and principled way to mitigate memorization without disrupting standard training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于TF-IDF的信息加权交叉熵损失，通过重新缩放token级权重来抑制LLM的记忆化，在五个1.1B–13B模型上保持困惑度和下游性能的同时显著缩短记忆化子串长度，且计算开销低于3%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型通常采用均匀的token加权训练，导致高频且信息量低的token主导学习过程，并增加模型记忆表层文本片段的倾向，需要一种能突出语义信息丰富token的加权机制来缓解记忆化问题。
AI.method: 提出信息加权交叉熵损失，利用TF-IDF统计量重新缩放token级贡献：提升语义信息丰富token的权重，降低普遍出现token的权重。方法架构无关，可无缝集成到现有训练流程中。
AI.result: 在五个1.1B至13B参数的decoder-only LLM上实验：LoRA微调下，TF-IDF使平均子串记忆化长度降低14%；在TinyLLaMA 1.1B全权重微调下，降幅达58%。困惑度与下游任务性能保持稳定，计算开销低于3%。
AI.conclusion: TF-IDF信息加权交叉熵损失是一种轻量且有原则的记忆化缓解方法，在不破坏标准训练动态的前提下有效减少子串记忆化，具有架构无关性和低开销的优势。

title: Toward Interpretable Multimodal Fusion: Heat Conduction Modeling for Hyperspectral and LiDAR Joint Classification
summary: The fusion of hyperspectral (HS) and Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) data plays a crucial role in enhancing land-cover classification by jointly exploiting spectral, spatial, and structural cues. However, existing multimodal fusion methods still struggle to model long-range dependencies and complex anisotropic interactions while maintaining computational efficiency. This paper introduces M2Heat, a physics-inspired framework that investigates multimodal fusion through the lens of heat conduction. At its core, a physics-driven visual heat conduction module (vHeat) and enhanced Frequency Value Embeddings (FVEs) simulate anisotropic information flow, enabling the capture of global dependencies with sub-quadratic complexity and physical interpretability. This mechanism, combined with a hybrid spatial-frequency fusion strategy named Cross-Frequency Fusion (CFF) module, produces highly discriminative and robust feature representations. M2Heat achieves competitive overall performance on three benchmarks, i.e., Trento, Houston2013, and Augsburg, while providing an interpretable heat-conduction-guided perspective for multimodal feature fusion. These results indicate the potential of heat-conduction-guided neural operators for efficient and interpretable RS multimodal fusion. The source code is publicly available at https: /github.com/Weikan0425/M2Heat_HSI_LiDAR.

AI.tldr: 提出物理启发框架M2Heat，借助热传导视角实现高光谱与LiDAR多模态融合，兼顾长程依赖建模、各向异性交互与计算效率，在三个基准上取得有竞争力的分类性能。
AI.motivation: 高光谱与LiDAR融合对土地覆盖分类意义重大，但现有方法难以在保持计算效率的同时建模长程依赖与复杂各向异性交互。
AI.method: 核心为物理驱动的视觉热传导模块（vHeat）与增强的频率值嵌入（FVEs），模拟各向异性信息流，以亚二次复杂度捕获全局依赖；并结合混合空频融合策略——交叉频率融合（CFF）模块。
AI.result: 在Trento、Houston2013、Augsburg三个基准上取得有竞争力的整体性能，并提供可解释的热传导引导视角。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明热传导引导的神经算子在高光谱-LiDAR多模态融合中兼具高效性与可解释性潜力，代码已开源。

title: Meta-Learning for Classifier Selection in Image Datasets: A Feature-Driven Framework for Accuracy Prediction
summary: No Free Lunch theorem implies that any performance gains achieved by a classifier on a particular image distribution are necessarily offset by a loss of performance over the set of all possible problems; thus, no single model is universally optimal. Selecting the most suitable classifier for image datasets is a critical yet challenging task due to the intrinsic complexity and diversity of images. This paper proposes a meta-learning framework that leverages a comprehensive set of meta-features capturing dataset complexity to predict classifier performance without exhaustive training. By extracting and selecting features using methods such as autoencoders, pre-trained networks, and dimensionality reduction techniques, we train regression models to efficiently estimate classifier accuracies. Additionally, clustering techniques are employed to group classifiers with similar performance patterns, simplifying the recommendation process. The datasets used span a wide range of concepts, including nature, animals, numbers, motorcycles, medical images, and human bodies, to ensure broad generalization. Evaluated on 56 diverse image datasets, our approach achieves an average ranking prediction accuracy exceeding 86%, demonstrating its effectiveness in guiding model selection. This scalable and interpretable framework provides a practical solution to improve classification performance while reducing computational costs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个元学习框架，利用刻画数据集复杂度的元特征，在无需穷尽训练的情况下预测分类器性能，并通过聚类简化推荐过程。
AI.motivation: 受"No Free Lunch"定理启发，不存在普适最优分类器；而图像内在的复杂性与多样性使得为给定图像数据集选择最合适分类器既关键又困难，且穷尽训练所有分类器代价高昂。
AI.method: 构建元学习框架：提取并选择捕捉数据集复杂度的元特征，采用自编码器、预训练网络与降维技术；基于元特征训练回归模型估计各分类器准确率；并利用聚类将性能模式相似的分类器分组，以简化推荐流程。
AI.result: 在56个覆盖自然、动物、数字、摩托车、医学图像与人体等多种概念的图像数据集上评估，平均排名预测准确率超过86%，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可扩展、可解释，能够在降低计算成本的同时指导模型选择、提升分类性能，为图像分类器选择提供了实用的解决方案。

title: The information geometry of large language models is shared, learned, and controllable
summary: Large language models learn similar behaviours, yet it remains unclear what structure they share or how to change one behaviour without disturbing others. The Fisher-Rao geometry of next-token probabilities connects these questions: behaviour determines this geometry up to output-preserving symmetries, whereas activation geometry depends on coordinates. Across transformer, state-space and recurrent models, output geometries agree more strongly than activation geometries, and shared geometry supports semantic-category transfer. Agreement with human word choices increases with predictive accuracy, scale and training, and improves further after model-only calibration. Token probabilities and read-out geometry jointly predict the spectrum and its effective dimension. Controlled language assignments show that geometry follows the language law across architectures. Pretraining corpus statistics predict held-out fact acquisition without recalibration, while randomised experiments show that deeper evidence substantially delays acquisition across every tested architecture and evidence construction. Finally, the geometry prescribes minimum-disturbance local interventions, predicts their relative cost, and supports reusable control: updates learned on donor prompts transfer to unseen prompts while better preserving behaviour on reference prompts than Euclidean control. The same geometric correction improves steering, editing, attribution, dictionary learning and fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文以Fisher-Rao信息几何为工具，研究大语言模型行为共享结构，发现输出几何在架构间高度一致并可用于行为迁移与最小扰动控制。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型学习到相似行为，但其共享结构以及如何在改变某一行为时不干扰其他行为的机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 利用下一词概率的Fisher-Rao几何，比较transformer、状态空间与循环模型的输出几何与激活几何，进行跨架构语言赋值、预训练语料统计与随机化实验，并推导最小扰动局部干预。
AI.result: 输出几何一致性高于激活几何，支持语义类别迁移；与人类词选择的一致性随预测精度、规模与训练提升，模型校准后进一步提高；token概率与读出几何共同预测谱及有效维度；语料统计可预测事实习得，证据增强显著延迟习得；几何可预测干预成本并实现可复用控制与更优行为保持。
AI.conclusion: Fisher-Rao几何刻画了模型行为共享结构，为跨架构行为迁移与最小扰动控制提供统一框架，并改进引导、编辑、归因、字典学习与微调。

title: When Noise Fabricates Bias: The Fragility of LLM-as-a-Judge Bias Measurement under Noisy Text
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at W-NUT 2026. Code: https://github.com/dong4918-skku/Fable
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as judges to measure social bias in text, yet the passages they judge are often noisy, containing typos, informal spelling, and broken punctuation. The consequences of such surface noise for social bias measurement remain unclear. To investigate this question, we apply five realistic noise conditions at multiple intensity levels to 3,822 stereotype-related responses and compare the resulting bias judgments with those on the original text. We find that such surface noise does not degrade bias measurement symmetrically: it is far more likely to turn neutral judgments into biased ones than biased judgments into neutral ones, by up to a 120x margin. We further observe two non-obvious effects across four LLM judges: in the most fragile judge the distortion is at its purest at mild, realistic noise levels, where erasure is scarcest, and as judges grow robust it attenuates toward parity rather than reversing. Bias measured on noisy text is therefore systematically overestimated, most in the categories that matter most for fairness.

AI.tldr: 研究了表层文本噪声（拼写错误、非正式拼写、标点破损）对LLM社会偏见评判的影响。对3822条刻板印象相关回答施加5种现实噪声条件，发现噪声并非对称地破坏偏见测量：把中性判断转为有偏见判断的可能性远高于反向转变，差距最高达120倍。偏见测量因此被系统性高估，且在公平性最关键的类别中最为严重。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作测量文本社会偏见的评判者，但其评判的文本常含拼写错误、非正式拼写和标点破损等噪声。这些表层噪声对偏见测量结果的影响此前尚不清楚，本文旨在量化该影响的方向与大小。
AI.method: 对3822条与刻板印象相关的回答施加5种现实噪声条件，并设置多个强度级别；将含噪文本上的偏见判断与原始文本上的判断进行对比，并跨4个LLM评判者观察效应模式。
AI.result: 表层噪声对偏见测量的破坏是非对称的：将中性判断转为有偏见判断的概率远高于将偏见判断转为中性判断，差距最高达120倍。跨4个评判者观察到两个非直观效应：在最脆弱的评判者中，扭曲在温和、现实的噪声水平下最为纯粹（此时擦除效应最少）；随着评判者更稳健，扭曲趋于均衡而非反转。
AI.conclusion: 基于含噪文本测得的偏见被系统性高估，且在公平性最相关的类别中高估最严重。使用LLM作为偏见评判者时需警惕文本表层噪声带来的测量偏差。

title: TailProp: content-adaptive light- and heavy-tailed propagation for vision
comment: Preprint. Under review at ICLR 2027. 18 pages, main text 9 pages, includes appendix, figures and supplementary analyses
summary: Science-inspired vision models show that explicit propagation dynamics can provide structured and interpretable alternatives to conventional token mixing. Existing formulations, however, typically construct and adapt visual propagation within a particular dynamical family, while visual representations can require substantially different spatial interactions across samples, channels, and network stages. We explore cross-regime adaptive propagation and introduce TailProp, a hierarchical vision backbone built upon the Tail Propagation Operator (TPO). TPO uses Gaussian and Cauchy stable-process propagators as complementary bases with rapidly decaying and heavy-tailed spatial influence, and predicts a content-conditioned channel-wise coefficient to adaptively combine them. Because this coefficient is spatially shared, the two responses are fused directly in the DCT domain with a single DCT/IDCT pair, yielding $O(N^{1.5})$ spatial mixing for square feature maps with $N=HW$ and fixed channel width. Across image classification, object detection, semantic segmentation, robustness, and cross-backbone restoration, TailProp consistently outperforms matched propagation baselines; TailProp-B reaches 84.4% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K, 50.3/44.8 box/mask AP under the 3x Mask R-CNN schedule, and 50.8% mIoU on ADE20K. Controlled ablations further show that these gains are not explained by single-basis propagation, an additional same-family branch, or within-family adaptive order alone, supporting complementary two-basis propagation as an effective design principle for visual representation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出TailProp视觉主干网络，基于尾部传播算子（TPO），用高斯与柯西稳定过程传播器作为互补基，通过内容条件化的通道系数自适应融合，并借助DCT域单次变换实现O(N^1.5)空间混合，在分类、检测、分割等任务上超越同类传播基线。
AI.motivation: 现有科学启发的视觉模型虽能提供结构化、可解释的传播动态替代传统token mixing，但通常局限于单一动态族内构造与自适应视觉传播；而视觉表示在不同样本、通道和网络阶段往往需要差异显著的空间交互模式，故需探索跨动态体系的自适应传播。
AI.method: 构建分层视觉主干TailProp，其核心为尾部传播算子（TPO）：采用高斯与柯西稳定过程传播器作为互补基，分别具有快速衰减与重尾的空间影响；预测内容条件化的通道级系数以自适应组合两者；由于系数在空间上共享，两路响应直接在DCT域以单对DCT/IDCT融合，对N=HW的方形特征图实现O(N^1.5)空间混合。
AI.result: 在图像分类、目标检测、语义分割、鲁棒性及跨主干恢复任务中一致优于匹配的传播基线；TailProp-B在ImageNet-1K达84.4% Top-1，3x Mask R-CNN下50.3/44.8 box/mask AP，ADE20K上50.8% mIoU。消融实验表明增益无法由单基传播、同族额外分支或族内自适应阶数单独解释。
AI.conclusion: 互补双基传播是视觉表示学习的一种有效设计原则，跨动态体系的自适应传播能带来结构化且高效的性能提升。

title: Beyond Solver Verdicts: Generative Reward Models for Autoformalization
summary: Neurosymbolic systems rely on mathematical solvers to guarantee reasoning correctness, yet solvers are fundamentally blind to whether a formal translation maintains strict reference-equivalence to a designated formalization. We formalize this vulnerability as Verdict-Preserving-Unfaithfulness (VPU): a failure mode where an incorrect encoding executes successfully and matches the expected verdict. We theoretically prove that structural, verdict-only verification heuristics are mathematically bounded to chance-level detection on these deceptively valid traces. To resolve this, we introduce Generative Verification (GenV), which distills an offline Z3-equivalence oracle into a reference-free, continuous reference-equivalence score by repurposing the language model's native vocabulary space. Mechanistic analysis via decision-projected logit lenses and sparse autoencoders shows this generative readout natively extracts precise spatial error coordinates without explicit localization training. Empirically, our oracle-mined verifier (GenV+HN) achieves 0.961 AUROC in reference-equivalence verification, generalizes zero-shot across unseen translators and divergent formal styles, and yields an 11.3-point downstream accuracy gain in agentic test-time compute allocation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"判决保持不忠实"(VPU)这一神经符号系统失效模式,证明仅基于结构/判决的验证启发式检测能力受限于随机水平;为此提出生成式验证(GenV),借助语言模型词汇空间将离线Z3等价预言机蒸馏为无参考的连续等价性分数,并实证其高检测性能与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 神经符号系统依赖数学求解器保证推理正确性,但求解器对所有形式化翻译是否严格保持与指定形式化的参考等价性缺乏辨别力——错误编码可能成功执行并给出期望判决,构成潜在失效。作者将这一漏洞形式化为"判决保持不忠实"(VPU),并指出结构性、仅看判决的验证启发式理论上无法有效检测这类"貌似正确"的轨迹,从而引出对更强验证方法的需求。
AI.method: 提出生成式验证(GenV):将离线的Z3等价性预言机蒸馏为一个无参考、连续的参考等价性分数,实现方式为复用语言模型固有的词汇空间(readout)。通过判决投影logit透镜与稀疏自编码器的机制分析,揭示该生成式读出能够原生提取精确的空间错误坐标,无需显式的定位训练;并进一步用预言机挖掘的验证器(GenV+HN)进行验证。
AI.result: 理论上证明结构、仅判决验证启发式在欺骗性有效轨迹上的检测能力被数学地限制在随机水平。实证上,预言机挖掘的验证器(GenV+HN)在参考等价性验证中达到0.961 AUROC,可零样本泛化到未见翻译器与差异较大的形式风格,并在智能体测试时计算分配中带来11.3个百分点的下游准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: GenV通过将求解器等价性知识蒸馏进语言模型的生成式读出,提供了无参考、连续且可迁移的验证信号,克服了结构/判决启发式的根本局限,并在验证准确率与下游任务性能上均取得显著提升。

title: ProMediConv: Benchmarking Proactive Conversational Agents in Legal Dispute Mediation
summary: Dispute mediation is essential for maintaining social harmony and resilience, yet developing skilled mediators is costly and time-consuming. Existing LLM-based mediation research remains limited by unrealistic task formulations, low-fidelity datasets, and coarse evaluation metrics that obscure turn-by-turn dynamics. To address these gaps, we introduce ProMediConv, a novel benchmarking framework that models mediation as a proactive, multi-stage, and party-aware dialogue process incorporating 11 mediation strategies and four party behavior pattern (BP) states. Using 972 complete real-world cases, we construct a high-fidelity mediation dataset with utterance-level annotations of strategies and BP states. Furthermore, to better assess agent impact, we propose MAD (Mean Attribute Difference), a fine-grained metric that captures BP shifts throughout the dialogue. Leveraging this framework, we establish a comprehensive benchmark by evaluating diverse models alongside our tailored baseline ProMediAgent. Extensive empirical analyses reveal critical behavioral phenomena and underscore the persistent challenges current models face in dynamic, multi-party mediation. Ultimately, ProMediConv provides a rigorous foundation and a vital quantitative standard for advancing AI-assisted conflict resolution. Our dataset and codebase are accessible at https://github.com/ZsWei66/ProMediConv_repo.

AI.tldr: 提出ProMediConv调解基准框架，将调解建模为主动、多阶段、分方的对话过程，含11种策略与4种当事方行为模式状态，构建972例真实案例的高保真数据集并提出MAD细粒度指标，配套ProMediAgent基线开展综合评测。
AI.motivation: 调解对维持社会和谐与韧性至关重要，但培养熟练调解员成本高、周期长。现有基于大模型的调解研究存在任务设定不真实、数据保真度低、评估指标粗糙等问题，难以刻画逐轮对话动态，无法评估智能体影响。
AI.method: 1) 将调解形式化为主动式、多阶段、分方感知的对话过程，涵盖11种调解策略与4种当事方行为模式（BP）状态；2) 基于972个完整真实案例构建语句级标注策略与BP状态的高保真数据集；3) 提出MAD（平均属性差异）指标，量化对话过程中BP的迁移；4) 在统一框架下评测多种模型并设置定制基线ProMediAgent。
AI.result: 通过大量实证分析揭示了关键行为现象，并显示当前模型在动态多方调解场景中仍面临持续挑战；框架与指标可有效区分不同模型表现。
AI.conclusion: ProMediConv为AI辅助冲突解决提供了严谨基础与量化标准；数据集与代码已开源（https://github.com/ZsWei66/ProMediConv_repo）。

title: Overview of the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 11: Agent-Based Experiment Reproduction from Scientific Papers
summary: Reproducibility is essential to scientific progress, yet the growing volume and complexity of scientific publications make exhaustive manual verification increasingly impractical. Although recent advances in large language model (LLM) agents enable automated experiment reproduction, existing evaluations largely focus on final repositories and are typically limited to machine learning (ML). We introduce AgentActionBench, a process-oriented benchmark for evaluating agent-based experiment reproduction across ML and AI4Science domains. Our framework uses an MCP-based Action Recorder to capture agents' behaviour throughout the reproduction process and evaluates the resulting traces with paper-specific rubrics. AgentActionBench contains 150 papers, including 120 ML papers and 30 AI4Science papers. A human-annotated subset covering 10% of the benchmark provides validation data, while model-assisted augmentation expands the full benchmark to more than 10,000 rubric items. Experimental results show that current systems remain limited, with execution as the primary bottleneck. Meanwhile, the strong Pearson and Spearman correlations between model-generated and human-annotated rubrics validate the reliability of our scalable rubric-generation approach.

AI.tldr: 提出面向实验复现过程的基准 AgentActionBench，覆盖 ML 与 AI4Science 共 150 篇论文，通过 MCP 动作记录器捕获智能体复现过程轨迹，并以论文级评分规则评估，揭示执行环节为主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 科学复现对科研进展至关重要，但文献数量与复杂度增长使人工验证难以规模化；现有基于 LLM 智能体的自动化复现评估多聚焦最终代码仓库，且局限于机器学习领域，缺乏对复现过程的评估。
AI.method: 构建过程导向基准 AgentActionBench：使用基于 MCP 的 Action Recorder 记录智能体在复现全过程中的行为轨迹，并采用论文特定评分规则（rubric）对其进行评估；基准含 150 篇论文（120 篇 ML、30 篇 AI4Science），其中 10% 由人工标注用于验证，其余通过模型辅助增强扩展至超 10,000 条评分项。
AI.result: 现有系统表现仍有限，执行（execution）是主要瓶颈；模型生成评分规则与人工标注评分规则之间呈强 Pearson 与 Spearman 相关性，验证了可扩展评分规则生成方法的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将复现评估从结果导向扩展为过程导向并覆盖 AI4Science，可更全面衡量智能体复现能力；当前瓶颈在于执行环节，而模型辅助的评分规则生成具备与人工标注高度一致的可靠性，支持大规模基准构建。

title: Beyond Benchmarks: Using VLMs to Reveal Systematic Classification Failures Under Real World Conditions
comment: To be presented at SPIE Sensors + Imaging, Edinburgh, in September 2026
summary: Verification and validation (V&V) of classification models is crucial to enable a wide range of sensor processing applications. Currently, the V&V process relies on time-consuming manual inspection of erroneous samples to find meaningful patterns. This work explores the use of Vision Language Models (VLMs) to speed up this laborious process. VLMs are trained to embed images into a semantically meaningful vector representation, from which human-interpretable systematic errors can be distilled. Deploying such VLM-based methods in a defence context introduces two major challenges: (1) the defence domain is underrepresented in the training data of VLMs, and (2) surroundings and context are less diverse than for other domains. This study provides an initial assessment of the suitability of VLM-based methods for V&V of defence applications. We propose a VLM-based error slice detection (ESD) method that independently groups and labels systematic errors made by a classification model. We demonstrate that this method is able to identify operationally-relevant artificially added perturbations in a non-military dataset. In a military context, our method clusters and describes images based on their surroundings, but also exhibits overlap between cluster descriptions. We further investigate the difference in embedding variation between our military and non-military dataset, which remains a topic of interest. Although the results do not yet warrant fully automated V&V through VLM-based ESD, they show that VLMs could be used to accelerate V&V processes in the future.

AI.tldr: 本文探索用视觉语言模型（VLM）加速分类模型的验证与确认（V&V），提出基于VLM的错误切片检测（ESD）方法，能自动聚类并标注系统性错误；在非军事数据集上可识别操作相关的人为扰动，在军事数据集上能按环境聚类但描述存在重叠，尚不足以全自动V&V，但具备加速潜力。
AI.motivation: 当前分类模型的V&V依赖耗时的人工检查错误样本来发现有意义模式；而将VLM方法用于国防场景面临两大挑战：国防领域在VLM训练数据中代表性不足，且其环境与上下文多样性较低。
AI.method: 提出基于VLM的错误切片检测（ESD）方法，利用VLM将图像嵌入语义化向量表示，独立地对分类模型的系统性错误进行分组与标注。
AI.result: 在非军事数据集上成功识别出具有操作相关性的人为添加扰动；在军事背景下，方法能依据环境对图像聚类并描述，但聚类描述之间存在重叠；同时研究了军事与非军事数据集在嵌入变异上的差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果尚不足以支持基于VLM的ESD实现全自动V&V，但表明VLM有望在未来加速V&V流程。

title: KuaiRP Series Role-playing Models Technical Report
summary: This paper introduces the complete technical solution for the KuaiRP series of role-playing models. We aim to achieve four core objectives for a dedicated role-playing model: simplified prompt engineering, highly stable output quality, built-in domain world knowledge, and high-efficiency deployment with a small parameter size. However, effectively injecting deep domain knowledge often leads to a severe catastrophic forgetting of the model's general agent capabilities. To overcome this trade-off, we propose a multi-stage training pipeline. First, we design a standardized character template and construct an SFT data pipeline based on user behavior simulation and reverse profile filtering. Next, we utilize a rule-based composite reward function during the Reinforcement Learning (RL) phase to eliminate common degradation phenomena like length expansion and repetitive generation. Finally, to recover the general capabilities compromised during SFT and RL, we propose a novel self-distillation paradigm using Two-stage On-Policy Distillation (OPD) equipped with Cumulative-Divergence Decay (CDD). By using the domain-adapted model as the teacher and the original base model as the student, we effectively balance deep domain knowledge injection with the preservation of general agent capabilities. Experimental results demonstrate that the KuaiRP models not only match the current state-of-the-art proprietary models in role-playing fidelity within our target domains, but also successfully recover general agent capabilities, maintaining extremely low deployment costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出快RP系列角色扮演模型完整技术方案，通过多阶段训练管线（模板化SFT、规则复合奖励RL、两阶段在线策略蒸馏OPD结合累积散度衰减CDD）解决领域知识注入与通用能力遗忘之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 角色扮演专用模型需满足四个核心目标：简化提示工程、输出质量高度稳定、内置领域世界知识、小参数量高效部署。然而深度注入领域知识常导致模型通用智能体能力严重灾难性遗忘，本文旨在克服这一权衡。
AI.method: 多阶段训练管线：1）设计标准化角色模板，基于用户行为模拟与反向画像过滤构建SFT数据管线；2）RL阶段采用基于规则的复合奖励函数，消除长度膨胀与重复生成等退化现象；3）提出两阶段在线策略蒸馏（OPD）结合累积散度衰减（CDD）的自蒸馏范式，以领域适配模型为教师、原始基座模型为学生，恢复通用能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，快RP模型在目标领域内的角色扮演保真度与当前最先进专有模型相当，同时成功恢复通用智能体能力，并保持极低的部署成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过多阶段训练管线与自蒸馏策略，快RP实现了深度领域知识注入与通用智能体能力保持的有效平衡，在角色扮演保真度、通用能力和部署成本三方面同时达到优异表现。

title: From Repetition to Recognition: Inductive Discovery of Disinformation Narratives
summary: In disinformation datasets, narratives are often understood as recurring interpretive patterns that group texts under narrative labels. Recent work formalized narrative mining as inductively inferring narrative labels from corpora, but its evaluation stays tied to predefined taxonomies, a closed-world setting that cannot capture narratives absent from the reference labels. We introduce a three-tier evaluation framework for unsupervised narrative label generation: recovery (against a corpus's own taxonomy), mining (against external label sets), and discovery (without predefined labels). Applying it, we compare clustering-based and graph-community-based pipelines across seven disinformation datasets, with human validation of discovery on two. The two families are complementary under automated metrics, but in a corpus with two prominent topics, clustering can reduce one topic to 2% of generated labels while graph-based pipelines stay balanced. Discovery validation also reveals many singletons (narrative labels derived from single claims, 30-62% of graph outputs), which clustering cannot produce. Annotators confirm many as recognizable disinformation narratives, suggesting that in open-world discovery the repetition assumed by narrative mining may be recognized outside the corpus, not within it. We release human-validated narrative candidate labels for the Climate Obstruction and PolyNarrative datasets to support taxonomy development and dataset extension.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出三层无监督叙事标签生成评估框架（recovery、mining、discovery），并在七个虚假信息数据集上比较聚类与图社区两类流水线，结合人工验证，指出两类方法互补、图方法在主题平衡与单例叙事发现上更有优势。
AI.motivation: 现有叙事挖掘工作将叙事标签从语料中归纳推理，但其评估仍绑定于预定义分类体系，属于封闭世界设定，无法捕捉参考标签之外的叙事，因此需要面向开放式叙事发现的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出三层评估框架：recovery（对照语料自身分类体系）、mining（对照外部标签集）、discovery（无预定义标签）；在七个虚假信息数据集上比较基于聚类与基于图社区的流水线，并对其中两个数据集进行discovery的人工验证。
AI.result: 自动化指标下两类方法互补；在含两个显著主题的语料中，聚类会使某一主题仅占生成标签的2%，而图方法保持均衡；discovery验证显示大量单例（由单一主张衍生的叙事标签，占图输出的30%–62%），聚类无法产生；标注者确认其中许多是可识别的虚假信息叙事。
AI.conclusion: 在开放式发现中，叙事挖掘所假设的重复性可能是在语料之外被识别，而非在语料内部；作者发布Climate Obstruction与PolyNarrative数据集的人工验证叙事候选标签，以支持分类体系构建与数据集扩展。

title: ReconPlusGen: Injecting Reconstruction Prior into Multi-view 3D Generation through Noise Inversion and Modulation
summary: Qualitative results and an illustration of our core idea. Top left: reconstruction results on benchmark images. Top right: reconstruction results on real-world images. Bottom: illustration of reconstruction-guided noise initialization and modulation. Given multiple input images, we predict a point cloud in canonical space, deterministically inject the predicted geometry into the diffusion process through noise inversion, and modulate the resulting noise to preserve the generative flexibility required to complete unobserved regions and refine visible geometry.

AI.tldr: 该内容为论文的定性结果展示与核心思想说明，涵盖基准图像与真实图像的3D重建结果，以及以重建为引导的噪声初始化与调制机制。
AI.motivation: 为展示方法在基准与真实场景下的重建效果，并直观说明如何在扩散过程中融入预测几何，以兼顾确定性约束与生成灵活性。
AI.method: 给定多张输入图像，先在规范空间预测点云；通过噪声反演将预测几何确定性地注入扩散过程；再对所得噪声进行调制，以保留补全未观测区域与优化可见几何所需的生成灵活性。
AI.result: 左上展示基准图像上的重建结果，右上展示真实世界图像上的重建结果，底部以示意图说明重建引导的噪声初始化与调制流程。
AI.conclusion: 重建引导的噪声初始化与调制能够将几何先验有效融入扩散过程，在保持生成灵活性的同时提升多视角3D重建的完整性与几何精度。

title: Rubric-Aligned Disentangled Evaluation of Human Simultaneous Interpreting
summary: Human simultaneous interpreting (SI) is commonly assessed with analytic rubrics separating meaning transfer, delivery quality, and temporal synchrony, yet no automatic metric is designed for rubric-aligned segment-level SI evaluation. We construct a professionally annotated corpus of 1,101 SI segments with scores for meaning transfer (LQ), delivery quality (EXP), and perceived latency (LAT). We show that structured LLM prompting and scalar supervision collapse rubric dimensions, yielding near-zero correlation with human ratings and strong cross-dimension coupling. To isolate supervision structure under identical backbone capacity, we introduce dual regression heads on a LoRA-adapted COMET-KIWI encoder. On a held-out talk-level test set, the model achieves Pearson correlations of 0.388 (LQ) and 0.301 (EXP), improving over frozen COMET-KIWI. Given low absolute rater agreement, we interpret results relative to human consistency and target stable ranking signals for formative assessment.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了首个专业标注的同传分段评估语料库（1,101段，含意义传递LQ、表达质量EXP、感知延迟LAT三个维度），发现结构化LLM提示与标量监督会导致评分维度坍缩、与人工评分近乎零相关；提出在LoRA适配的COMET-KIWI编码器上使用双回归头以隔离监督结构，在同源模型容量下于留出测试集取得LQ r=0.388、EXP r=0.301的皮尔逊相关，优于冻结的COMET-KIWI。
AI.motivation: 人工同声传译评估常用分析性量规，将意义传递、表达质量与时间同步性分开打分，但现有自动评估指标并未针对这种量规对齐的分段式同传评估进行设计，缺乏维度可分离的自动度量。
AI.method: 构建含1,101个同传片段、带LQ/EXP/LAT三维评分的人工标注语料库；对比结构化LLM提示与标量监督（会引发维度坍缩与跨维度强耦合）；在相同骨干容量下，采用LoRA适配的COMET-KIWI编码器加双回归头，以隔离监督结构的影响。
AI.result: 结构化LLM提示与标量监督导致评分维度坍缩，与人工评分相关性接近零且跨维度耦合严重。双回归头模型在留出的话语级测试集上取得LQ皮尔逊相关0.388、EXP 0.301，优于冻结的COMET-KIWI。因评分者一致性本身较低，结果需相对人工一致性解读。
AI.conclusion: 面向形成性评估，应追求稳定的排序信号而非绝对分数，多维监督结构对分段同传自动评估至关重要。

title: Adaptive Conformal Redistribution for Inter-class Transitional Uncertainty in Medical Image Classification
summary: Medical image classification is frequently complicated by transitional categories whose feature distributions overlap those of adjacent classes, producing ambiguous decision boundaries. Conformal prediction returns uncertainty-aware prediction sets, but these are not directly actionable in clinical screening, where a single decision is required. This work proposes adaptive conformal redistribution (AdaConRed), a label-free post-conformal decision rule that converts ambiguous prediction sets into refined class assignments. A five-stage pipeline is developed. Vision-language generative augmentation addresses minority-class scarcity; a frozen DermFoundation encoder provides embeddings; a lightweight multi-layer perceptron performs classification; an entropy-modulated, margin-aware nonconformity score constructs adaptive prediction sets; samples predicted as transitional with multi-label sets are reassigned to the most probable alternative class within the set, using only model outputs at inference. Evaluation uses the OSCC oral lesion and ISIC skin lesion benchmarks at a miscoverage level of 0.2. On the 3-class OSCC benchmark, overall accuracy improves from 73.54% to 77.38%, with oral cancer accuracy rising from 64.29% to 82.14% and benign accuracy from 56.57% to 70.20%. Reassignment of transitional samples reduces OPMD accuracy from 84.78% to 80.16%, consistent with the asymmetric cost of missed malignancy. On ISIC, overall accuracy improves from 85.83% to 87.19%, melanoma accuracy rising from 66.04% to 68.34%. AdaConRed outperforms LAC, APS and RAPS under an identical backbone and redistribution rule. Conformal prediction can be extended beyond uncertainty quantification toward actionable decision support where transitional disease categories are present, with gains concentrated in the clinically critical malignant categories. Code repository: https://github.com/saibal436ghosh/AdaConRed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaConRed，一种无标签的保形预测后决策规则，将模糊预测集重分配为细化类别，在OSCC与ISIC基准上提升整体及恶性类别准确率。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分类中过渡类别与相邻类特征分布重叠，决策边界模糊；保形预测虽能给出不确定性预测集，但在需单一决策的临床筛查中无法直接使用。
AI.method: 构建五阶段流程：视觉-语言生成式增强缓解少数类稀缺；冻结DermFoundation编码器提取嵌入；轻量MLP分类；熵调制、边界感知的非一致性分数构建自适应预测集；对多标签过渡样本，仅用推理时模型输出将其重分配至集合中最可能的替代类别（误覆盖率0.2）。
AI.conclusion: 保形预测可超越不确定性量化，在存在过渡疾病类别时提供可执行决策支持，增益集中于临床关键的恶性类别。

title: LAION-Mobile: Evaluating Deepfake Detectors On One Million Smartphone Photos
summary: Most Deepfake detectors report near-perfect AUC scores on their reference benchmarks. However, a recent ICML position paper argues that these evaluations collectively neglect the impact of modern smartphone photography: the widely used on-device neural image-signal processing pipelines (like multi-sensor fusion or noise and motion-blur suppression) increasingly shift the imaging paradigm from simple lens projections towards computational photography. Hence, devices actually generate, rather than record photos. This increases the risk that deepfake detectors may flag ordinary phone photos as fake. Due to the lack of large-scale datasets containing images from modern smartphones, this hypothesis has so far only been tested in small proof-of-concept studies. The aim of this paper is to close this gap. We introduce LAION-Mobile, an open dataset containing about 1 million smartphone images with EXIF metadata distilled from re-LAION-5B. Evaluating twelve state-of-the-art deepfake detectors with their original paper checkpoints on a 9,115-image evaluation sample of this pool (DIRE on 738), we report three key findings: (i) On modern AI content no detector exceeds AUC 0.624, and five of twelve fall below chance. (ii) Real-photo false-alarm rates are an artefact of threshold calibration: thresholds fitted on legacy GAN data make several detectors look deployable (less than 11 percent FPR), yet the same detectors flag 17-91 percent of real photos once the identical criterion is refit on modern content. (iii) Consequently, no detector both beats chance on modern AI content and keeps a deployable real-photo false-alarm rate. Mirroring the device mix of web collections, the corpus probes the first neural-ISP generation (2018-2020); current flagships are essentially absent, leaving the modern-ISP regime as the open gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LAION-Mobile（约 100 万张含 EXIF 的智能手机图像数据集），并对 12 个 SOTA Deepfake 检测器进行评测，发现其在现代 AI 内容上普遍失效，且真实手机照片误报率受阈值标定严重依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有 Deepfake 检测器在参考基准上 AUC 近乎完美，但近期 ICML 立场论文指出这些评测忽略了现代智能手机摄影的影响：设备端神经 ISP 管线（多传感器融合、噪声与运动模糊抑制）使成像范式从简单镜头投影转向计算摄影，设备"生成"而非"记录"照片，从而可能导致检测器将普通手机照片误判为伪造。由于缺乏含现代智能手机图像的大规模数据集，该假设此前仅在小型概念验证研究中被测试，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建 LAION-Mobile 开放数据集，从 re-LAION-5B 中蒸馏约 100 万张含 EXIF 元数据的智能手机图像；在 9,115 张图像评估子集（DIRE 使用 738 张）上，使用 12 个 SOTA Deepfake 检测器及其原始论文 checkpoint 进行评测。
AI.result: 三项关键发现：(i) 面对现代 AI 内容，无检测器 AUC 超过 0.624，12 个中有 5 个低于随机水平；(ii) 真实照片误报率是阈值标定的产物——在传统 GAN 数据上拟合的阈值使若干检测器看似可部署（FPR 低于 11%），但同样标准在现代内容上重新拟合后，相同检测器对真实照片的误报率达 17%–91%；(iii) 因此没有任何检测器既能对现代 AI 内容超越随机水平，又能保持可部署的真实照片误报率。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库镜像了网络集合的设备构成，覆盖第一代神经 ISP（2018–2020），当前旗舰机型基本缺席，现代 ISP 场景仍是待填补的空白。

title: Can LLMs Normalize Databases? A Benchmark and Multi-Agent Framework for Schema Normalization
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate structured outputs, but their reliability remains unclear when those outputs must satisfy database-level constraints. We study this issue through database normalization, involving reasoning about functional dependencies, lossless join decompositions, and inter-table constraints. We introduce a Database Normalization Benchmark (DNBENCH), comprising 3,275 samples for evaluating LLM-driven database normalization from 1NF to BCNF. DNBENCH uses a three-axis protocol to measure semantic equivalence, structural accuracy, and logical validity. Across Single, Complex, and Real World levels, DNBENCH uncovers recurring failures in dependency inference, schema decomposition, and inter-table constraint reconstruction. We further propose Multi-Agent Reasoning for Schemas (MARS), which separates evidence extraction, violation diagnosis, and decomposition planning from schema generation and verification. MARS improves the DNB-SCORE by 82.0% over the single-prompt baseline. All artifacts will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出数据库规范化基准DNBENCH（3,275样本，含三轴协议）评估LLM从1NF到BCNF的规范化能力，发现依赖推断、模式分解与跨表约束重建的系统性失败，并提出多智能体框架MARS，使DNB-SCORE较单提示基线提升82.0%。
AI.motivation: LLM被越来越多用于生成结构化输出，但其在需满足数据库级约束（如函数依赖、无损连接分解、跨表约束）时的可靠性尚不明确，缺乏系统评估手段。
AI.method: 构建DNBENCH基准，包含3,275个样本，覆盖1NF至BCNF，采用语义等价、结构准确性、逻辑有效性三轴协议，分Single、Complex、Real World三个难度层级；同时提出MARS（Multi-Agent Reasoning for Schemas），将证据抽取、违规诊断、分解规划与模式生成、验证相分离。
AI.result: DNBENCH揭示LLM在依赖推断、模式分解和跨表约束重建上的反复失败；MARS相较单提示基线将DNB-SCORE提升82.0%。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的数据库规范化仍不可靠，需专门基准与分解式多智能体推理方法；DNBENCH与MARS为评估和改进提供了工具与方案，全部工件将在录用后发布。

title: Human Agreement and Return Association Are Not Interchangeable Criteria
summary: Financial NLP has a standard workflow: validate a sentiment tool against human labels, then trust it to extract market signal. This assumes the two evaluations measure the same thing. We test that assumption in a setting where both can be measured at once: a corpus of securities class actions (2002-2025) linking 70,500 X messages to abnormal stock returns, with a single-annotator human labelled gold sample. Running five instruments (VADER, Loughran-McDonald, FinBERT, Twitter-RoBERTa, and an LLM annotator) through one identical pipeline, we find that the relationship between construct and predictive validity depends on the sampling convention and score representation. Under conventional method-specific sampling, human agreement aligns more closely with graded same-day associations than with one-day leads. On a fixed-n panel, however, agreement has similar graded rank correlations at both horizons, while the coarse ordering remains weak. Benchmark agreement therefore establishes semantic validity but does not by itself determine predictive rankings. In a conversation that is 17.6% spam, message volume predicts neither market damage nor settlement size.

AI.tldr: 在证券集体诉讼语料上同时检验情感工具的构念效度与预测效度，发现二者的关系取决于抽样约定与分数表征方式：基准一致性只能确立语义效度，不能单独决定预测排序。
AI.motivation: 金融NLP的标准流程假定"与人工标注的一致性"（构念效度）可以外推到"提取市场信号"的能力（预测效度），即认为两种评估测量的是同一事物。本文旨在直接检验这一隐含假设是否成立。
AI.method: 构建证券集体诉讼语料（2002–2025），将70,500条X消息与异常股票收益相关联，并配有单标注者的人工金标样本。在同一流水线下运行五种工具：VADER、Loughran-McDonald、FinBERT、Twitter-RoBERTa以及一个LLM标注器。对比两种抽样约定（工具特异抽样 vs. 固定n面板）与不同分数表征（分级 vs. 粗序）下的一致性-预测性关系。
AI.result: 在传统工具特异抽样下，人工一致性更接近同日分级关联而非提前一日关联；在固定n面板上，一致性在两个时间跨度上的分级秩相关相近，但粗序结果始终偏弱。此外，该对话中垃圾信息占17.6%，消息量与市场损失和和解金额均无预测关系。
AI.conclusion: 基准一致性建立的是语义效度，但本身并不能确定预测性排序；构念效度与预测效度之间的关系依赖于抽样约定与分数表征，金融NLP的"先验证后信任"标准流程需重新审视。

title: A Dominant Supplier Slows Recursive Drift More Than It Steers It
comment: experiments rerun with per-request sampling seeds; substantially revised results and new title
summary: More and more of the text future language models learn from is written by a few of today's models. If one supplier writes most of a shared corpus, does it pull the models trained on it toward its own writing, or change how fast they drift? We retrain eight open models from their base weights on a shared pool of each other's text for five generations, varying the part written by one model, Phi-2, from an equal share to 90%. The models drift together toward a style with fewer function words, and none starts repeating itself. No share of Phi-2 brings the other models closer to its text than the equal share does. We split each ecosystem's separation from the equal-share one into a delay along its route and a departure from that route, both counted beyond the difference between two equal-share runs. With Phi-2 at 90%, delay outweighs departure 72 to 28 and 64 to 36 in two runs, and the ecosystem falls 2.7 and 2.5 generations behind. With Phi-2 at half the pool the two parts are about equal. When SmolLM2 or Qwen3-1.7B writes half instead, the ecosystem slows less or not at all. The departure leans toward Phi-2 more as its share grows, but more than toward every other model only at 90%. Human text filling a quarter or half of the pool slows the models along the same route.

AI.tldr: 在共享语料中，单一模型（Phi-2）写作占比从均等提高到90%会拖慢整个模型生态的演化速度，但不会使其向Phi-2风格靠拢。
AI.motivation: 随着未来语言模型的训练文本越来越多地由少数模型生成，作者想探究：当某一供应方（此处为Phi-2）撰写共享语料的大部分时，是否会将被训练的模型拉向其自身写作风格，或改变模型漂移的速度。
AI.method: 将八个开源模型从基座权重出发，在彼此文本构成的共享池上重训五代，并改变Phi-2撰写比例（从均等到90%）。将每个生态相对均等份额的偏离拆分为沿路径的"延迟"与对路径的"偏离"两部分，均以两次均等份额运行的差异为基准。还测试了SmolLM2或Qwen3-1.7B承担一半，以及人类文本填充四分之一或一半的情况。
AI.result: 模型整体向虚词更少的风格共同漂移，且无模型出现自我重复。任何Phi-2份额都未使其他模型比均等份额时更接近其文本。Phi-2占90%时，两次运行中延迟与偏离之比分别为72:28和64:36，生态落后2.7和2.5代；Phi-2占一半时两部分约相等。当SmolLM2或Qwen3-1.7B写一半时，生态减速更少或完全不减速。偏离随Phi-2份额增加而更偏向Phi-2，但仅在90%时超过其他所有模型。人类文本填充四分之一或一半会沿同一路径拖慢模型。
AI.conclusion: 共享语料中单一模型的主导地位主要产生"减速"效应而非"同化"效应，模型生态整体沿共同路径放慢漂移，而非向主导模型风格收敛。

title: Break Step: Recursive Training Resonates with Replayed Sampling Noise
comment: the diversity loss reported in v1 is traced to a replayed vLLM sampling seed; substantially revised, new title
summary: How fast does a language model degrade when trained on its own outputs? Theory traces it to gradually accumulating errors, while experiments report repeated phrases within ten generations. Under a fixed sampling seed in vLLM, the fast loss of lexical diversity comes from the sampler. When vLLM serves a batch from one seeded sampling configuration, every request receives the same random draws, and a fixed seed replays them every generation. Fine-tuning raises the tokens that won, and the replayed draws let them win by more. Sharing across requests and replay across generations matter only together. Remove either one, by changing the shared seed every generation or by giving each request its own seed that repeats every generation, and the unique-4-gram fraction of two StableLM checkpoints stays near its starting value of about 0.98 through generation 3. Keep both, and the replayed shared seed takes seven checkpoints from five families to between 0.045 and 0.38 by then. Three generations of replay write the favoured phrases into the weights: decoded with one seed per request, the generation-3 weights of the replayed StableLM-2-1.6B chain recover most of their diversity, yet the phrase that filled every sample under the shared seed still opens 46% of them. Without replay, five checkpoints drift slowly, consistent with the gradual accumulation that theory describes, and three turn incoherent though their diversity scores stay high. One peer-reviewed model-collapse pipeline that fine-tunes Gemma-2-27B samples identical prompts under one seeded configuration, and three quarters of the rows it released for one iteration repeat nearly as often as one such batch copies them. A seed per request restores the fresh sample that stability analyses assume.

AI.tldr: 语言模型在自生成数据上微调时的多样性崩塌，主要源于 vLLM 在固定种子下对同一批次所有请求共享且逐代复放的随机采样；共享与复放两者缺一不可，同时存在才会导致词法多样性急速下降。
AI.motivation: 理论上模型退化被归因于误差逐步累积，但实验中却在十代内就出现重复短语，速度与理论不符。作者怀疑快速丧失词法多样性的原因不在训练动态，而在 vLLM 的采样机制，希望区分"共享随机数"与"逐代复放"两个因素的贡献。
AI.method: 在 vLLM 固定采样种子下对批量请求进行服务，控制两个变量：是否为整个批次共享同一组随机抽样、是否在每一代复放同一组抽样。改变共享种子（每代更换）或为每个请求分配各自但每代重复的种子作为对照，令模型在自生成数据上微调多代，并测量 unique-4-gram 比例、样本重复度与生成连贯性。
AI.result: 去掉任一因素（逐代更换共享种子，或每请求独立种子但逐代重复），两个 StableLM 检查点的 unique-4-gram 比例到第3代仍维持在约0.98；两者同时保留时，来自五个家族的七个检查点降到0.045–0.38。三代复放把偏好短语写入权重：第3代权重用每请求独立种子解码可恢复大部分多样性，但在共享种子下填满所有样本的短语仍开启46%的样本。无复放时，五个检查点缓慢漂移，符合理论所述误差累积，其中三个虽多样性分数高却变得不连贯。某同行评审的模型崩塌流程对 Gemma-2-27B 在单一种子配置下采样相同提示，其发布的一轮结果中有四分之三的行重复频率接近单个批次被复制的程度。
AI.conclusion: 快速的语言多样性丧失是 vLLM 共享且复放固定种子的采样伪影，而非纯粹的训练误差累积；共享与复放必须同时发生才显著。为每个请求单独设置种子可恢复稳定性分析所假设的新鲜采样，因此相关模型崩塌实验需重新审视其采样配置。

title: UniH$^3$: Unifying Hierarchical Homogeneity and Heterogeneity for All-in-One Medical Image Restoration
comment: This paper has been accepted by ECCV 2026
summary: All-in-One medical image restoration (MedIR) aims to address diverse tasks across modalities and degradation types using a single universal model. Existing methods typically prioritize modeling inter-task heterogeneity (e.g., distinct data distributions and degradation types).
