However, they largely neglect the inherent homogeneity present in medical images, such as widely shared anatomical structures within and across modalities, which can be leveraged to ease model training and improve generalization. To this end, we propose UniH3, a novel framework that Unifies Hierarchical Homogeneity and Heterogeneity for all-in-one medical image restoration. Specifically, to comprehensively exploit homogeneity, we introduce a Hierarchical Homogeneity Memory (H2M) module that progressively distills intra- and inter-task homogeneity priors from high-quality images during training, and adaptively retrieves the most relevant priors tailored to the input for guided restoration. These retrieved priors are then injected into the restoration pipeline via an efficient Homogeneity-Guided Attention (HGA) mechanism. Furthermore, to comprehensively address heterogeneity, we design a Hierarchical Heterogeneity Balancer (H2B) that mitigates both inter- and intra-task conflicts during optimization, facilitating balanced and effective multi-task learning. Extensive experiments on two large-scale benchmarks, MedIR-2D-500K and MedIR-3D-3K, demonstrate that UniH3 achieves state-of-the-art performance on both all-in-one and single-task medical image restoration. We hope this work establishes a strong benchmark and advances the development of general-purpose medical image restoration models. Code is available at https://github.com/Yaziwel/UniH3.

AI.tldr: 提出UniH3框架，通过统一层级同质性与异质性实现全能医学图像修复，在两大基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有全能医学图像修复方法侧重建模任务间异质性（如不同数据分布与退化类型），却忽略了医学图像固有的同质性（如模态内与跨模态共享的解剖结构），而这些同质性可用于简化训练并提升泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出UniH3框架：1）层级同质性记忆（H2M）模块，在训练中从高质量图像逐步蒸馏任务内与任务间同质性先验，并按输入自适应检索最相关先验引导修复；2）同质性引导注意力（HGA）机制，将检索到的先验高效注入修复流程；3）层级异质性平衡器（H2B），缓解任务间与任务内冲突，实现均衡有效的多任务学习。
AI.result: 在MedIR-2D-500K和MedIR-3D-3K两个大规模基准上，UniH3在全能与单任务医学图像修复上均取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为通用医学图像修复模型建立了强基准并推动其发展，代码已开源。

title: LILA: Calibration-Free Structured Pruning of Large Language Models via Latent Spectral Geometry
summary: Structured pruning of large language models (LLMs) offers hardware-efficient compression, yet existing methods require calibration data, gradient computation, or large auxiliary policy networks at pruning time. LILA (\emph{Latent-Informed Layer Analysis}) scores neuron importance via the Kolmogorov--Smirnov (KS) distance between empirical singular value distributions of the full and neuron-ablated feed-forward network (FFN) weight matrix, providing a closed-form spectral rule requiring no training, calibration data, or auxiliary network. Without any fine-tuning, LILA surpasses PruneNet (45M-parameter RL policy) by 1.57~pp in zero-shot accuracy on LLaMA-2-7B at 25\% sparsity, and outperforms WikiText-2-calibrated SliceGPT by up to 6.0~pp across all sparsity levels, while preserving the original architecture. After one epoch of LoRA recovery fine-tuning, LILA achieves highly competitive performance, matching the heavily calibrated SliceGPT baseline to within a 0.48~pp margin across LLaMA-2-7B and Phi-2, despite using zero calibration data. A Neural Tangent Kernel analysis confirms a 22$\times$ reduction in functional distortion versus random pruning, providing theoretical grounding for the spectral importance criterion. Finally, extending LILA to dynamically allocate sparsity budgets via KS-scores yields state-of-the-art generative preservation at moderate compression, while uncovering fundamental single-layer architectural bottlenecks at higher compression regimes.

AI.tldr: LILA提出一种基于KS距离的无校准结构化剪枝方法，无需训练数据即可评估FFN神经元重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM结构化剪枝依赖校准数据、梯度计算或大型辅助策略网络，成本高且不实用。
AI.method: 通过KS距离比较完整与消融后FFN权重矩阵的经验奇异值分布来给神经元打分，形成闭式谱规则；并基于KS分数动态分配稀疏预算。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-2-7B上25%稀疏度比PruneNet高1.57pp，比SliceGPT最高高6.0pp；LoRA微调后与SliceGPT差距0.48pp内；NTK分析显示功能失真降低22倍。
AI.conclusion: LILA在零校准条件下达到有竞争力甚至领先的剪枝效果，兼具理论支撑，但高压缩率下暴露单层架构瓶颈。

title: Beyond Visual Quality: Evaluating Physical Consistency under Ego-Motion with EgoGenEval
summary: Recent visual generators produce high-fidelity images yet often violate physical consistency under ego-motion, limiting their use for spatial reasoning and embodied planning. Existing benchmarks largely focus on isolated images or single-step quality, leaving this challenge underexplored. We introduce EgoGenEval, a geometry-grounded, pose-free benchmark designed to evaluate the physical consistency of visual generators under ego-motion, and organize our study into two parts. (1) EgoGenEval contains 1,400 cases and 2,360 target views spanning single-step and multi-step ego-motion. It separately measures Camera Motion Grounding (CMG) and Scene State Preservation (SSP), with both metrics validated against blinded human judgments. Evaluating 16 pose-free generators together with two pose-conditioned references reveals that current models struggle to execute camera motion while maintaining scene state, and that no system performs well on both axes at once. (2) To examine whether benchmark-derived data can improve these capabilities, we build EgoGen-Train from the same geometry-grounded pipeline and run controlled SFT studies. These show that pairwise supervision does not reliably improve camera-motion grounding and scene-state preservation together: even at the full training pool and the longest budget, scene preservation gains a fraction of what camera motion does. This points to the pairwise teacher-forced objective itself as the binding constraint, motivating a trajectory-centric paradigm that couples self-conditioned rollouts with explicit pose and visibility supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoGenEval基准，从相机运动接地（CMG）与场景状态保持（SSP）两个维度评估视觉生成器在自我运动下的物理一致性，并揭示现有模型难以同时兼顾两者；进一步构建EgoGen-Train开展SFT研究，指出成对教师强制目标本身是制约瓶颈，进而提出轨迹中心范式。
AI.motivation: 近期视觉生成器虽能生成高保真图像，但在自我运动（ego-motion）下常违反物理一致性，限制了其在空间推理与具身规划中的应用。现有基准多聚焦于孤立图像或单步质量，对该挑战探索不足，因此需要一个几何接地的、无需位姿的评估基准。
AI.method: （1）构建EgoGenEval：包含1,400个案例、2,360个目标视角，覆盖单步与多步自我运动；分别度量相机运动接地（CMG）与场景状态保持（SSP），两项指标均对照盲测人类判断进行验证；评估16个无位姿生成器与2个有位姿条件参考模型。（2）基于同一几何接地流程构建EgoGen-Train，开展受控SFT研究，对比成对监督在两项能力上的提升效果。
AI.result: 当前模型难以在保持场景状态的同时执行相机运动，且没有任何系统能在这两个维度上同时表现良好。在SFT研究中，即使在完整训练池与最长预算下，成对监督也无法可靠地同时提升相机运动接地与场景状态保持：场景保持的提升仅为相机运动提升的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 成对教师强制目标本身构成绑定约束，这促使研究者转向一种轨迹中心的范式，将自条件化回滚（self-conditioned rollouts）与显式的位姿和可见性监督相耦合。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Anti-UAV Detection under Controlled Fog Degradation: Fog-Aware Training and Clear-Sky Tradeoff
summary: Vision-based anti-UAV systems must function in poor visibility, yet most benchmarks use only clear-sky footage, and previous robustness studies treat adverse weather as a simple present/absent condition. As a result, the impact of fog severity on ground-to-air UAV detection remains poorly understood. This work presents the first severity-controlled fog benchmark for this task: synthetic fog at ten severity levels is applied to the RGB modality of the Anti-UAV300 dataset, comparing a clear-trained YOLOv5m baseline to a fog-aware model trained on both clear and foggy images. Detection performance drops sharply and non-linearly: degradation is front-loaded across light-to-moderate fog (beta approximately 0.05-0.10), with a 96% reduction in mAP@0.5:0.95 from clear to thickest fog, mainly due to lost recall and confidence. On the comparable metric (mAP@0.5), this collapse exceeds the most extreme rain degradation reported in the closest prior benchmark. Fog-aware training boosts detection across all severities (up to +0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95) with only a 9.1% drop in clear-sky accuracy, raising the threshold for reliable detection while not preventing collapse under extreme fog. Since reliability is lost within a narrow visibility range, simple clear vs adverse tests underestimate operational risk.

AI.tldr: 该工作构建了首个面向地空无人机检测的"雾浓度受控"基准，将10级合成雾施加于Anti-UAV300数据集的RGB模态，量化了雾浓度对YOLOv5m检测性能的非线性影响及雾感知训练的效果。
AI.motivation: 视觉反无人机系统需在低能见度下工作，但现有基准多采用晴空视频，且以往鲁棒性研究仅把恶劣天气当作"有/无"的二值条件，导致雾浓度严重程度对地空无人机检测的影响缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 在Anti-UAV300数据集的RGB模态上施加10个等级的合成雾，构建严重程度受控的雾基准；对比仅在清晰图像上训练的YOLOv5m基线，与在清晰+雾图像上训练的雾感知模型，并按雾浓度等级评测检测性能。
AI.result: 检测性能随雾浓度急剧且非线性下降：退化集中在轻到中度雾区间（β约0.05–0.10）；从清晰到最浓雾，mAP@0.5:0.95下降96%，主要源于召回与置信度的损失。在mAP@0.5上，该衰减超过最接近的先前基准中最极端的降雨退化。雾感知训练在各雾浓度等级均提升检测（最高+0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95），清晰天准确率仅下降9.1%，提高了可靠检测的阈值，但无法阻止极端雾下的性能崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 可靠检测在很窄的能见度范围内即失效，仅做"清晰 vs 恶劣"的简单测试会低估实际运行风险，需采用严重程度受控的评测方式。

title: A Multi-View and Confusion-Guided Ensemble Framework for Robust Synthetic Image Attribution
summary: Synthetic image attribution (SIA) has become increasingly important with the rapid advancement of text-to-image generation models. However, accurately identifying the source model of a generated image remains challenging due to the growing similarity among modern diffusion-based generators and the presence of diverse post-processing operations. In this report, we present a multi-view and confusion-guided ensemble framework for the Synthetic Image Attribution Challenge of the DLMMDD Workshop at ICANN 2026. Our approach integrates multiple complementary architectures, including FFT-ConvNeXt, DINOv2, CLIP, and Xception, to capture diverse attribution cues from frequency, semantic, and forensic perspectives. To improve robustness against unknown degradations and image manipulations, extensive data augmentation strategies are employed during training, simulating realistic post-processing operations such as compression, resizing, grayscale conversion, and blur. Furthermore, we analyze the confusion patterns of the ensemble model and observe severe ambiguity between Stable Diffusion 3 and Stable Diffusion 3.5. To address this issue, we introduce a dedicated binary expert classifier that is selectively activated under low-confidence conditions. We additionally apply class-adaptive confidence calibration to improve the discrimination of challenging classes such as Tencent Hunyuan. The proposed framework achieved 99.53% on the public leaderboard and 99.20% on the private leaderboard. The source code and implementation details are publicly available at https://github.com/ZOMIN28/SIA.

AI.tldr: 提出多视角、混淆引导的集成框架用于合成图像溯源（SIA），融合FFT-ConvNeXt、DINOv2、CLIP与Xception，结合强数据增强、二分类专家分类器与类自适应置信度校准，在ICANN 2026 DLMMDD Workshop的SIA挑战赛中取得公开榜99.53%、私有榜99.20%的成绩。
AI.motivation: 随着文本到图像生成模型快速发展，合成图像溯源（SIA）日益重要；但现代扩散生成器之间相似度不断提高，且图像常经历多样后处理，导致仅凭单一特征难以准确判定生成源模型，因此需要更鲁棒的溯源方案。
AI.method: 构建多视角、混淆引导的集成框架：1）集成FFT-ConvNeXt、DINOv2、CLIP、Xception等互补架构，分别从频域、语义、取证视角提取溯源线索；2）训练时采用大规模数据增强，模拟压缩、缩放、灰度化、模糊等真实后处理以增强鲁棒性；3）分析集成模型的混淆模式，针对Stable Diffusion 3与3.5之间的严重歧义引入专用二分类专家分类器，在低置信度条件下选择性激活；4）采用类自适应置信度校准，提升Tencent Hunyuan等困难类别的区分度。
AI.result: 在挑战赛公开排行榜上达到99.53%，私有排行榜上达到99.20%；代码与实现细节已开源（https://github.com/ZOMIN28/SIA）。
AI.conclusion: 多视角互补特征集成、混淆引导的专家分类与置信度校准可有效缓解模型间相似性与后处理干扰，显著提升合成图像溯源性能，验证了该类策略在细粒度溯源任务中的有效性。

title: FlexComp: One Model for Every Ratio in Context Compression
summary: Soft context compression condenses a context into a few memory tokens that a frozen LLM consumes in place of the raw text, but existing compressors fix the compression ratio at training and inference: each deployed ratio requires a separately trained model, and the chosen ratio is applied uniformly to all inputs, whose actual needs vary drastically. We propose FlexComp, a method-agnostic framework that decouples the ratio from both training and deployment: Matryoshka-style training samples the memory budget $K$ per instance, turning one model into an any-ratio compressor, and the budget is then chosen per input by: (1) confidence-based cascade routing or (2) a lightweight learned $K$ predictor. Across ICAE, 500xCompressor, and SAC on MRQA, a single FlexComp model matches separately trained fixed-ratio specialists with minimal degradation. Cascade routing preserves over 98% of the mildest ratio's accuracy at up to 266x average compression; the $K$ predictor, in a single compression-decoding pass, reaches 158-236x within 0.7 F1 of the mildest ratio. At serving-scale batch sizes, the $K$ predictor cuts context KV cache by 50% and improves decoding throughput by 47%.

AI.tldr: FlexComp是一个与具体压缩方法无关的框架，通过Matryoshka式训练实现"任意压缩比"的单一模型，并在推理时按输入动态选择内存预算，从而解耦压缩比与训练、部署。
AI.motivation: 现有软上下文压缩器将压缩比固定在训练与推理阶段：每个部署的压缩比都需单独训练模型，且对所有输入统一施加同一压缩比，而不同输入的实际需求差异巨大。因此需要一种能在训练和部署中解耦压缩比的方法。
AI.method: FlexComp采用方法无关设计：1) Matryoshka式训练，对每个实例采样内存预算K，使单一模型成为任意比率压缩器；2) 推理时按输入选择预算，通过(1)基于置信度的级联路由，或(2)轻量级学习型K预测器。方法在ICAE、500xCompressor、SAC三种压缩器及MRQA数据集上验证。
AI.result: 单一FlexComp模型可匹配分别训练的固定比率专家模型，性能下降极小。级联路由在最温和比率下保留超过98%的准确率，平均压缩率达266倍；K预测器在单次压缩-解码过程中达到158-236倍压缩，F1与最温和比率相差0.7以内。在服务规模批大小下，K预测器将上下文KV cache减少50%，解码吞吐量提升47%。
AI.conclusion: FlexComp证明了压缩比可与训练和部署解耦，单一模型即可实现任意比率压缩并按输入自适应选择预算，在保持精度的同时显著提升压缩率与服务效率，具备良好的方法通用性。

title: (Whose defaults?) Is artificial intelligence reorienting archaeological methods?
summary: Generative AI and the practice of "vibe coding" are changing how archaeologists carry out computational research, but their effects on the discipline's range of methods is still understudied. In this paper, we evaluate whether large language models (LLMs) are narrowing the variety of methods archaeologists use. We first analysed approximately 119,000 archaeology abstracts from Scopus, covering publications from 2010 to 2025. Using a locally run LLM, we identified the computational methods reported in each abstract and organised them into 25 broad categories (L2) and 241 finer clusters (L3). A Bayesian Dirichlet-multinomial model of method composition within sub-disciplines found a small but credible shift in method use after 2023. However, this shift was smaller than the variation already present across the full study period. No individual technique showed a significant change, and overall methodological diversity increased rather than declined. We then ran a controlled experiment to see whether LLMs recommend a narrower set of methods than archaeologists have used in practice. Two different open-weight models were asked to suggest methods for 28 archaeological research problems, with prompts providing three levels of methodological guidance: novice, intermediate, and expert. Recommendation diversity was much lower than in the published literature, particularly without methodological guidance. The models also tended to favour methods that were widely used before 2023, and their recommendations more closely resembled the post-2023 literature. Taken together, these results are consistent with LLMs pushing methodological choice towards convergence, although our study cannot establish a causal effect. They raise a broader question: how can archaeology retain methodological diversity as LLMs become more involved in research?

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析约11.9万篇考古学摘要（2010–2025）并开展LLM推荐实验，评估生成式AI是否正在收窄考古学的方法多样性；结果显示2023年后方法构成仅有小幅可信偏移，总体多样性未下降，但LLM推荐的方法多样性明显低于已发表文献，倾向于推动方法趋同。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI与"vibe coding"正在改变考古学的计算研究实践，但其对学科方法谱系的影响仍缺乏系统研究，作者因此检验LLM是否正在缩窄考古学家使用的方法范围。
AI.method: 首先，从Scopus提取约119,000篇2010–2025年考古学摘要，用本地运行的LLM识别其中的计算方法，并归入25个L2大类与241个L3细粒度聚类；随后用贝叶斯Dirichlet-multinomial模型刻画各子学科内方法构成的时序变化。其次开展控制实验，让两个不同的开放权重模型针对28个考古研究问题推荐方法，提示词设置新手、中级、专家三档方法学指导水平，并与实际文献中的方法分布比较。
AI.result: 2023年后方法构成出现小幅但可信的偏移，然而该偏移小于整个研究期内已存在的自然变异；没有任何单项技术呈现显著变化，总体方法多样性反而上升。相比之下，LLM推荐的方法多样性显著低于已发表文献，尤其在缺乏方法学指导时更为明显；模型偏好2023年前广泛使用的方法，其推荐结果更接近2023年后的文献。
AI.conclusion: 结果与"LLM推动方法选择趋同"的假设一致，但研究无法确立因果关系。作者据此提出更广泛的问题：随着LLM更深地介入研究，考古学应如何保持其方法多样性。

title: CEM-TUDASR: Computationally efficient multi-modality transformer based unsupervised domain adaptive super-resolution approach
comment: Published in Biomedical Signal Processing and Control, Volume 129, 2027, Article 111315
summary: Wireless Capsule Endoscopy (WCE) enables non-invasive visualization of the gastrointestinal tract, but its miniaturized optics, sensor limitations, and wireless transmission constraints result in low-resolution images with reduced visibility of diagnostically important structures. This paper proposes CEM-TUDASR, a computationally efficient unsupervised Transformer-based super-resolution framework for WCE image enhancement without paired low-resolution (LR) and high-resolution (HR) training data. A domain-adaptive degradation network synthesizes realistic WCE-like LR images from HR conventional endoscopy images, reducing the domain gap and enabling effective unpaired learning. The SR generator integrates Deep Attention Blocks (DABs) and a Fusion Attention Block (FAB) to capture long-range contextual dependencies and fine local structures while preserving perceptual and structural fidelity. The model is trained on a curated dataset derived from Kvasir Capsule and evaluated on KID and GIANA for cross-dataset generalization. No-reference quality metrics, including BRISQUE, PIQE, NIQE, and the domain-specific EndoQM, show that CEM-TUDASR consistently outperforms existing unsupervised SR methods. Qualitative results further demonstrate improved restoration of mucosal textures, vascular patterns, and clinically relevant anatomical details. Cross-domain experiments on retinal images additionally demonstrate the adaptability of the framework. With only 2.67 million parameters and 169.94 GFLOPs, CEM-TUDASR achieves high-quality reconstruction while maintaining computational efficiency, making it suitable for resource-constrained clinical and embedded endoscopic applications.

AI.tldr: 提出CEM-TUDASR：一种基于无监督Transformer的计算高效超分辨率框架，用于无线胶囊内镜（WCE）图像增强，无需配对LR-HR数据，在多个跨数据集评测中优于现有无监督SR方法，且参数量仅2.67M。
AI.motivation: WCE可实现胃肠道无创可视化，但其微型光学元件、传感器限制及无线传输约束导致图像分辨率低，诊断关键结构可见性下降。同时，配对LR-HR训练数据在WCE场景下难以获取，且模型需满足临床与嵌入式设备的资源约束。
AI.method: CEM-TUDASR为无监督Transformer超分辨率框架：1）域自适应退化网络从常规内镜HR图像合成逼真的WCE类LR图像，缩小域差距以支持无配对学习；2）SR生成器集成深度注意力块（DAB）与融合注意力块（FAB），捕捉长程上下文依赖与精细局部结构，保持感知和结构保真度；3）基于Kvasir Capsule构建数据集训练，并在KID、GIANA上评估跨数据集泛化。
AI.result: 无参考质量指标BRISQUE、PIQE、NIQE及领域专用EndoQM显示CEM-TUDASR一致优于现有无监督SR方法。定性结果显示黏膜纹理、血管模式及临床相关解剖细节恢复更佳；视网膜图像跨域实验验证框架适应性；模型仅2.67M参数、169.94 GFLOPs，兼顾高质量重建与计算效率。
AI.conclusion: CEM-TUDASR在无配对数据条件下有效提升WCE图像质量，具备良好跨数据集与跨域泛化能力，并保持计算高效，适用于资源受限的临床与嵌入式内镜应用。

title: Automated Identification of Competing Narratives in Political Discourse on Social Media
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Published in the proceedings of Text2Story 2025, held with ECIR 2025
summary: Social media platforms have become central to shaping political discourse, serving as arenas where narratives form and evolve, influencing public opinion. Identifying and analyzing these narratives, particularly when they compete across different political ideologies, is crucial for understanding the dynamics of modern political communication. This paper presents an unsupervised framework for identifying and characterizing competing narratives in political discourse on social media, focusing on German politicians' tweets. The framework employs a multi-stage pipeline that integrates natural language processing techniques such as topic modeling, event detection, and event linking. By forming data into coherent stories and uncovering the distinct perspectives of user communities, the system is able to detect the key competing narratives, highlighting the divergent framings and conflicts surrounding trending political topics. Two case studies on polarizing political issues demonstrate the efficacy of the methodology, showcasing its ability to uncover and analyze divergent viewpoints. The findings contribute to the broader understanding of how narratives propagate within the digital public sphere and offer insights for policymakers, social media platforms, and researchers interested in monitoring political discourse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督框架，通过主题建模、事件检测与事件链接的多阶段流水线，从德国政客的推文中识别并刻画相互竞争的政治叙事，两个极化议题案例验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体已成为政治话语的核心场域，叙事在其中形成与演化并影响公众舆论；识别和分析不同政治意识形态间相互竞争的叙事，对理解现代政治传播动态至关重要。
AI.method: 构建无监督框架，采用多阶段流水线，集成主题建模、事件检测和事件链接等自然语言处理技术；将数据组织为连贯的故事（stories），并揭示用户群体的不同视角，从而检测围绕热点政治议题的关键竞争性叙事及其分歧性框架与冲突。研究对象为德国政客的推文。
AI.result: 在两个极化政治议题上开展案例研究，结果表明该方法能够有效揭示并分析相互对立的观点，验证了方法学的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究增进了对叙事在数字公共领域中传播机制的理解，并为政策制定者、社交媒体平台及关注政治话语监测的研究者提供了启示。

title: REVA: Reusable Evidence View Aggregation for Context-Efficient RAG Serving
comment: Author's accepted manuscript. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM)
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves knowledge-intensive large language model (LLM) applications by conditioning generation on retrieved documents, but longer contexts increase latency, key-value (KV) cache memory, and token cost. Post-retrieval compression can reduce this cost, yet existing compressors often operate independently for each query, rely on auxiliary models or rewriting, and introduce online overhead that can offset the benefit of shorter prompts. We revisit RAG compression from a data-mining perspective by aggregating historical query--document--model interactions into reusable evidence views. We first show that modern compressors have unstable gains over simple truncation and can add substantial inference-time latency. We then propose Reusable Evidence View Aggregation (REVA), a framework that mines the target generator's historical attention traces into a document-keyed, budget-agnostic score store. REVA maps token-level attention to readable word units, aggregates importance across repeated document accesses, and renders budget-specific plain-text views that preserve document order and the standard RAG interface. Across four representative benchmarks and modern LLMs, REVA improves generation quality by 1.0--5.8 points over existing advances, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 5.3 to 15.6, adding less than 40 ms of latency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出REVA框架，从数据挖掘视角将历史查询–文档–模型交互聚合为可复用的证据视图，实现预算无关的RAG检索后压缩，在四个基准上质量提升1.0–5.8分，压缩开销降低5.3–15.6倍，额外延迟<40ms。
AI.motivation: RAG通过检索文档改善知识密集型LLM应用，但更长的上下文会带来延迟、KV缓存内存和token成本上升。检索后压缩虽可降低开销，但现有压缩器多为逐查询独立操作、依赖辅助模型或改写，并引入可抵消短提示收益的在线开销。
AI.method: 将RAG压缩重新审视：先把历史query–document–model交互聚合为可复用证据视图。提出Reusable Evidence View Aggregation（REVA）：挖掘目标生成器的历史注意力轨迹，构建以文档为键、预算无关的得分存储；将token级注意力映射为可读词单元，跨重复文档访问聚合重要性，并渲染保留文档顺序与标准RAG接口的预算特定纯文本视图。
AI.result: 现代压缩器相对简单截断收益不稳定且会增加明显推理时延迟；REVA在四个代表性基准和现代LLM上，生成质量比现有先进方法提升1.0–5.8分，压缩开销降低5.3–15.6倍，额外延迟低于40ms。
AI.conclusion: 从数据挖掘视角聚合历史交互可实现可复用、预算无关且低开销的RAG检索后压缩，REVA在质量与效率上同时优于现有方法，并保持标准RAG接口兼容性。

title: Tri-DehazeGS: Scene--Medium Decoupled Gaussian Splatting with Transmittance-Aware Optimization
summary: Recovering clean 3D scenes from hazy multi-view images is challenging because haze attenuates scene radiance and introduces atmospheric scattering. Recent scattering-aware Gaussian Splatting methods introduce physical haze models into reconstruction, but they often apply degradation in image space or bind medium-related variables to Gaussian primitives, which can entangle clean scene radiance with atmospheric effects. Moreover, low-transmittance regions provide weakened supervision for Gaussian optimization, causing distant or dense-haze areas to be under-reconstructed. We argue that clean reconstruction under haze requires both scene--medium disentanglement and transmittance-aware optimization rebalancing. To this end, we propose Tri-DehazeGS, a scene--medium decoupled Gaussian Splatting framework. It represents the clean scene with Gaussian primitives, models the participating medium using an independent view-shared tri-plane field, and composes hazy observations through a physical scattering model. We further introduce Medium-Decoupled Transmittance Gradient Compensation (MD-TGC), which compensates haze-suppressed gradients after medium freezing without altering forward rendering. Experiments on real and synthetic haze benchmarks show that Tri-DehazeGS improves clean novel-view reconstruction. Code is available at https://github.com/aptx46/Tri-DehazeGS.

AI.tldr: 提出Tri-DehazeGS，一种场景-介质解耦的高斯泼溅框架，用独立三平面场建模参与介质，并通过透射率梯度补偿优化，提升雾天多视图重建质量。
AI.motivation: 雾天多视图图像中，雾会衰减场景辐射并引入大气散射。现有散射感知高斯泼溅方法在图像空间施加退化，或将介质变量绑定到高斯基元，导致干净辐射与大气效应纠缠；同时低透射率区域监督减弱，使远景或浓雾区域重建不足。
AI.method: 提出场景-介质解耦的高斯泼溅框架：用高斯基元表示干净场景；用独立的视图共享三平面场建模参与介质；通过物理散射模型合成雾天观测。并引入Medium-Decoupled Transmittance Gradient Compensation (MD-TGC)，在介质冻结后补偿被雾抑制的梯度，且不改变前向渲染。
AI.result: 在真实与合成雾数据集上的实验表明，Tri-DehazeGS改善了干净新视角重建效果。
AI.conclusion: 雾下干净重建需要场景-介质解耦与透射率感知优化重平衡，Tri-DehazeGS验证了该思路的有效性。

title: A Voice-Interactive Multi-Agent System for Smart Operating Rooms: Architecture Design and Key Technologies
comment: The current technical approach is immature and may involve information security concerns. We hereby request the withdrawal of the manuscript
summary: This paper presents SurgicalRoomAgent, a voice-interactive multi-agent system for smart operating rooms based on large language models (LLMs). The system achieves natural language understanding, device control, intraoperative recording, and surgical report generation through a layered architecture comprising a voice interaction pipeline (wake, ASR, turn detection, agent reasoning, TTS) and an agent core (skill registry, task planner, device manager). Three key technologies are investigated: (1) KV Cache prefix warming for low-latency inference, reducing recomputation overhead from approximately 500 ms to tens of milliseconds via byte-level Longest Common Prefix reuse; (2) streaming partial JSON parsing with early parallel task execution, reducing end-to-end latency by approximately 30%; and (3) progressive skill prompt disclosure, which dynamically filters system prompts based on user role, connected devices, and surgical phase to maximize information density within limited context windows. The system is implemented using the Qwen3-27B model with llama.cpp/sglang inference engines. Experimental analysis demonstrates effective operation within a 16,384-token context limit and multi-device parallel control response times meeting OR real-time requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SurgicalRoomAgent，一个基于大语言模型的语音交互多智能体手术室系统，采用分层架构与三项关键技术实现低延迟推理与实时设备控制。
AI.motivation: 手术室场景对系统实时性要求高，而大语言模型推理存在延迟与上下文窗口限制，需针对性优化以支持术中自然语言交互、设备控制与报告生成。
AI.method: 采用分层架构：语音交互流水线（唤醒、ASR、轮次检测、智能体推理、TTS）与智能体内核（技能注册、任务规划、设备管理）。三项关键技术：KV Cache 前缀预热（基于字节级最长公共前缀复用降低重算开销）、流式部分 JSON 解析与早期并行任务执行、渐进式技能提示披露（依据用户角色、设备连接与手术阶段动态筛选系统提示）。实现基于 Qwen3-27B 模型及 llama.cpp/sglang 推理引擎。
AI.result: KV Cache 前缀预热将重算开销从约 500 ms 降至数十毫秒；流式部分 JSON 解析使端到端延迟降低约 30%；系统在 16384 token 上下文限制内有效运行，多设备并行控制响应时间满足手术室实时性要求。
AI.conclusion: 该系统验证了在大语言模型受限上下文与延迟条件下，实现手术室语音交互与多设备实时控制的可行性。

title: When is Test-Time Adaptation Identifiable From Unlabeled Evidence?
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers many ways to update a deployed model without labels, but choosing the wrong update can make a strong source model worse. Recent methods therefore try to predict which adaptation will work from unlabeled test data. We ask a prior question: does the evidence given to the selector contain enough information to determine the best action at all? We show that this is not guaranteed, even with a perfect selector. If an observation channel makes two deployments look the same while their TTA rankings differ, reliable selection is impossible from that channel; richer evidence can restore the decision only when it resolves the relevant ambiguity. We make this boundary exact in a finite-batch Gaussian TTA model, where doing nothing beats mean recentering for small shifts, recentering wins beyond a unique critical shift, and the boundary shrinks as $1/\sqrt n$. Public benchmark studies on CIFAR-100-C and DomainNet-126 show the same failure mode with modern TTA methods: changing only deployment structure can reverse the oracle action while global order-blind evidence remains unchanged. The result is a practical way to separate two failure modes that are usually mixed together: a weak selector versus an information channel that cannot support the desired decision in the first place.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了TTA选择失败的两类原因：选择器弱，或观测通道本身信息不足。作者证明即使有完美选择器，若两个部署在观测通道下不可区分而TTA排序不同，则无法可靠选择；信息更丰富的证据只有在消解相关歧义时才能恢复决策。
AI.motivation: 现有TTA方法尝试从无标签测试数据预测哪种自适应更新有效，但忽略了更前置的问题：给选择器的证据是否足以确定最优动作。作者指出这一可辨识性问题此前未被系统刻画，错误的自适应甚至会让强源模型变差。
AI.method: 在有限批次高斯TTA模型中精确刻画决策边界：比较“不更新”与“均值重中心化”，小偏移时不动更优，超过唯一临界偏移后重中心化更优；并分析边界随样本量n以1/√n收缩。随后在CIFAR-100-C和DomainNet-126上复现该失效模式：仅改变部署结构即可反转oracle动作，而全局无序证据保持不变。
AI.result: 理论上证明存在观测通道歧义时完美选择器也无法保证最优动作，并给出高斯模型下的精确临界偏移；实验上在现代TTA方法中观察到同一失效模式，仅改变部署结构就能反转oracle动作，而全局无序证据无变化，导致选择器无法分辨。
AI.conclusion: 应把“选择器弱”与“信息通道无法支持决策”两类失败模式分开诊断。观测通道的信息充分性是TTA选择的前提，只有消解相关歧义的更丰富证据才能恢复可靠决策；这为设计和评估TTA选择器提供了可操作的判据。

title: HALDETECT at ImageEval 2026 Shared Tasks: Answer-First Contrastive Grounding with QLoRA
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables (including appendices). System description paper for Task 1b (English) of ImageEval 2026 Shared Tasks (Fourth Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference), to appear in the Shared Tasks proceedings
summary: Large multimodal models tend to hallucinate visual detail fluently, which limits their deployment for fine-grained interpretation. We present HALDETECT, our system for the English hallucination-detection track (Task 1b) of ImageEval 2026, in which a system must identify, from an image and three culturally plausible statements, the single visually grounded one. We frame the item as one contrastive decision, emit the answer before its explanation, and structure reasoning around colour/texture, shape/form, and context. Our best submitted adapter fine-tunes Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct with 4-bit QLoRA while freezing the vision encoder and reaches Contrastive Instability (CI) 0.035 on the 1,000-item test set; we placed third of eight teams. Development experiments show that answer order can matter more than model scale and that adaptation beats prompting alone. Retrospective paired analysis of the released gold labels confirms the QLoRA gain over the best prompt but not the small gap between the devtest-selected and best-test adapters, and reseeding all four training sizes shows that the apparent data-scaling curve does not survive a seed change. The 35 residual errors are culturally plausible function, material, and recognition distinctions; naive adapter voting does not help.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍HALDETECT系统，用于ImageEval 2026英语幻觉检测任务（Task 1b）：从图像与三条文化上合理的陈述中选出唯一有视觉依据的一条。系统将题目建模为对比决策，先输出答案再给出解释，推理围绕颜色/纹理、形状/形态与语境展开。最佳方案用4-bit QLoRA微调Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct并冻结视觉编码器，在1,000项测试集上达到对比不稳定性（CI）0.035，八支队伍中排名第三。实验表明答案顺序的影响可超过模型规模，适配优于纯提示；配对分析证实QLoRA相对最佳提示的增益，但未证实开发集选择与最佳测试适配器间的微小差距，且重设随机种子后数据规模曲线不稳健。35个残余错误多为文化上合理的功能、材质与识别区分，朴素适配器投票无效。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型常流畅地产生视觉细节幻觉，限制其细粒度图像解读的部署；因此需要在给定图像与多条文化上合理陈述时，判定哪一条真正有视觉依据。
AI.method: 将任务建模为单一对比决策：先输出答案再输出解释；推理结构化围绕颜色/纹理、形状/形态、语境三方面。微调Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct，采用4-bit QLoRA并冻结视觉编码器；并开展答案顺序、提示与适配对比、数据规模与随机种子稳健性、配对显著性分析及适配器投票等实验。
AI.result: 最佳提交在1,000项测试集上CI为0.035，八队中排名第三。开发实验显示答案顺序可能比模型规模更重要，适配优于单纯提示。对公开金标的回顾性配对分析确认QLoRA相对最佳提示的增益，但未确认开发集所选与最佳测试适配器间的微小差距；四种训练规模重设种子后，表面数据规模曲线不再成立。35个残余错误涉及文化上合理的功能、材质与识别差异，朴素适配器投票无帮助。
AI.conclusion: 对比式建模、冻结视觉编码器的QLoRA适配与结构化推理可有效降低该幻觉检测任务的对比不稳定性；但小差距结论对随机种子与答案顺序敏感，需谨慎解释，残余错误集中于细粒度文化与功能语义，简单集成无法解决。

title: SCINTILLA-SNN: A Spiking Multi-Scale Selective Aggregation Network for Perineural Invasion Prediction
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Youngung Han and Yului Jeong contributed equally to this work. v2: Added equal-contribution statement; scientific content unchanged
summary: Preoperative prediction of perineural invasion (PNI) in cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) is clinically valuable but remains challenging because PNI-related cues on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are subtle, sparse, and spatially localized around the tumor boundary. Standard 3D CNN and transformer architectures process volumetric data in a dense or spatially uniform manner, which can dilute subtle PNI-related evidence while requiring a large number of multiply-accumulate operations over 3D feature grids. To address these limitations, we propose SCINTILLA-SNN, a 3D spiking network composed of a four-stage hierarchical backbone and a Multi-Scale Spike Aggregation (MSSA) module for PNI prediction. The backbone extracts hierarchical volumetric representations through spiking convolutional stages and local spike window modulation stages. Given the resulting stage-wise representations, MSSA maps each spatial token to a learnable content value and modulates it with a spike-dynamics gate derived from firing rate and timestep-wise membrane-potential variability. The resulting score, referred to as the diagnostic token score, is used to selectively aggregate sparse PNI-related evidence. Experiments on a 10-year retrospective cohort of 182 CCA patients show that SCINTILLA-SNN achieves an AUROC of 0.748 under 5-fold cross-validation, while reducing the estimated inference energy by 23.18$\times$ compared with dense MAC-only computation of the same network.

AI.tldr: 提出SCINTILLA-SNN，一种用于胆管癌术前神经周围侵犯（PNI）预测的3D脉冲神经网络，通过分层骨干与多尺度脉冲聚合（MSSA）模块选择性聚合稀疏PNI证据，AUROC达0.748，推理能耗较稠密MAC计算降低23.18倍。
AI.motivation: 胆管癌术前PNI预测具有临床价值，但MRI上PNI相关线索细微、稀疏且局限于肿瘤边界附近。标准3D CNN与Transformer以稠密或空间均匀方式处理体数据，会稀释细微PNI证据，且在3D特征网格上需要大量乘加运算。
AI.method: 提出SCINTILLA-SNN，由四阶段分层骨干与多尺度脉冲聚合（MSSA）模块构成。骨干通过脉冲卷积阶段与局部脉冲窗口调制阶段提取分层体表示；MSSA将每个空间token映射为可学习的内容值，并用由发放率和逐时间步膜电位变异性导出的脉冲动力学门进行调制，得到诊断token分数，用于选择性聚合稀疏PNI证据。
AI.result: 在182例胆管癌患者10年回顾性队列上，5折交叉验证下AUROC为0.748，同时相较同网络稠密MAC计算，估计推理能耗降低23.18倍。
AI.conclusion: SCINTILLA-SNN以脉冲计算方式有效应对PNI线索稀疏、局部化的挑战，在保持竞争性预测性能的同时显著降低推理能耗，为术前PNI预测提供了节能的3D脉冲网络方案。

title: Fast and Accurate Monomodal 3D High Resolution Deep Registration of Drosophila Larval Brain Volumes
summary: The larval stage of Drosophila melanogaster is a compact model system for neuroscience whose genetic toolkit allows fluorescent markers to be expressed in defined neural populations, and comparing the resulting expression patterns across animals requires every brain to be registered into a shared anatomical reference space. Existing pipelines for this task are predominantly based on classical registration methods, which perform a new optimization for each volume, often require per-case parameter tuning, and can take minutes per brain, limiting their use as a routine preprocessing step. We present a trained deep registration pipeline that deformably aligns a larval brain to a reference template in a single forward pass at high spatial resolution, on volumes that hold several times more voxels than those learned 3D registration is normally reported on, together with the preprocessing and anatomy-anchored evaluation pipeline required to apply it. Against eleven classical and seven further learned baselines on a held-out collection acquired with different acquisition and quality strata, the proposed pipeline is the most accurate, improving on the strongest classical baseline by 23 percentage points of anatomical landmark-local mutual information. It registers a volume one to two orders of magnitude faster than the classical deformable pipelines, and it retains more of its accuracy than any other method as acquisition quality degrades. The network, its trained weights and the full pipeline are released as the open-source deep larval brain registration framework: https://github.com/agentdr1/deep-larval-brain-reg

AI.tldr: 本文提出并开源了一个训练好的深度配准流程（deep-larval-brain-reg），可在单次前向传播中将果蝇幼虫脑可变形对齐到标准模板，分辨率高、速度快，并附带预处理与解剖学锚定评估流程。
AI.motivation: 果蝇幼虫脑是比较神经科学的紧凑模型，荧光标记表达模式跨个体比较需将每个脑配准到共享解剖参考空间；现有经典配准流水线逐个体积优化、常需逐例调参、每脑耗时数分钟，难以作为常规预处理步骤。
AI.method: 训练一个深度配准网络，以单次前向传播完成高空间分辨率的可变形配准，处理体积的体素数远多于常规学习的3D配准报道规模；同时构建配套的预处理与解剖学锚定评估流程；与11种经典方法和7种学习型基线在具有不同采集与质量分层的留出数据集上对比。
AI.result: 所提流程最准确，在解剖学标志点局部互信息上较最强经典基线提升23个百分点；配准速度比经典可变形流程快1至2个数量级；在采集质量下降时相比任何其他方法保留更多精度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了可实际用作常规预处理的深度幼虫脑配准方案，网络、训练权重与完整流程均已开源发布。

title: From Evaluation to Enhancement: Benchmarking and Improving Think-with-Video Reasoning for Video Generative Models
summary: Video generation has advanced to produce visually compelling and temporally coherent results. Yet, whether these models can genuinely think with video--executing symbolic rules, respecting physical laws, and pursuing intentional goals--remains an open question. Existing benchmarks only partially address this, often conflating visual quality with cognitive correctness. We introduce VWG-Bench (Video World Generalist Benchmark), a comprehensive benchmark spanning 9 reasoning dimensions and 38 fine-grained tasks. To enable precise diagnosis, we design a three-level VLM-as-Judge protocol that independently assesses video-level fluency, task-level rule adherence, and sample-level goal realization. Evaluations of leading models reveal a striking gap: while models achieve strong rendering scores, they consistently fail on logic-heavy and rule-constrained tasks. To address this, we propose Vid-PRE (Video Prompt Reasoner and Enhancer), a model-agnostic prompt rewriter that offloads the cognitive burden of reasoning to a dedicated VLM. Trained via reinforcement learning with purely text-based rewards, Vid-PRE produces concise, constraint-aware prompts without the instability of video-level reward signals. Experiments show that Vid-PRE yields substantial reasoning improvements across multiple generators without architectural modifications. Together, VWG-Bench and Vid-PRE offer a rigorous diagnostic lens and a scalable path toward true think-with-video capabilities. All data and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/KlingTeam/VWG-Bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VWG-Bench基准（覆盖9个推理维度、38项任务）和三级VLM-as-Judge评估协议，揭示当前视频生成模型"渲染强、推理弱"的差距，并提出模型无关的提示重写器Vid-PRE以提升推理能力。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型在视觉质量和时序连贯性上已取得显著进展，但能否真正"用视频思考"（执行符号规则、遵循物理规律、追求意图目标）仍存疑。现有基准只部分覆盖这一能力，且常将视觉质量与认知正确性混为一谈，缺乏精确诊断工具。
AI.method: 1) 构建VWG-Bench，涵盖9个推理维度、38项细粒度任务；2) 设计三级VLM-as-Judge协议，分别评估视频级流畅度、任务级规则遵循性、样本级目标实现度；3) 提出Vid-PRE，一个模型无关的提示重写器，将推理认知负担转移到专用VLM，并通过纯文本奖励的强化学习训练，生成简洁、约束感知的提示。
AI.result: 对主流模型的评估显示明显差距：模型渲染得分高，但在逻辑密集与规则约束任务上持续失败。Vid-PRE在多个生成器上带来显著的推理提升，且无需对架构做任何修改。
AI.conclusion: VWG-Bench提供了严谨的诊断视角，Vid-PRE提供了可扩展的路径，二者共同推动视频生成模型向真正的"用视频思考"能力发展。数据与代码已公开。

title: OmniHallu: Unified Hallucination Detection for Cross-Modal Comprehension and Generation in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 12 pages, 4 figures
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across diverse tasks, they suffer from hallucinations where generated outputs contradict or misrepresent input semantics. Existing research typically addresses hallucination detection within a single modality or task type, limiting generalizability. We introduce OmniHallu, a unified hallucination detection framework spanning both comprehension and generation tasks across image, video, and audio modalities. We contribute OmniHallu-Bench, a 10,000-sample benchmark with claim-level human annotations covering six cross-modal tasks: image-to-text (I2T), video-to-text (V2T), audio-to-text (A2T), text-to-image (T2I), text-to-video (T2V), and text-to-audio (T2A). Our multi-agent architecture decomposes model outputs into atomic claims, verifies them through modality-specific experts, and aggregates evidence via structured reasoning. We further propose a preference-optimized trainable verifier that approximates the multi-agent decision boundary, reducing expert calls by 66% with minimal performance loss. Extensive experiments reveal a consistent modality-dependent performance gradient and provide fine-grained insights into cross-modal hallucination patterns.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出OmniHallu，一个跨图像、视频、音频模态，覆盖理解与生成任务的统一幻觉检测框架，并构建含1万样本、claim级人工标注的OmniHallu-Bench，采用多智能体架构进行原子claim验证与结构化推理聚合，另提出偏好优化的可训练验证器以近似多智能体决策边界，将专家调用减少66%且性能损失极小。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型虽在多任务上进展显著，但仍存在幻觉，即生成输出与输入语义相矛盾或误表征。已有幻觉检测研究通常局限于单一模态或单一任务类型，泛化性不足，缺乏统一的跨模态检测方案。
AI.method: 提出OmniHallu统一幻觉检测框架，涵盖理解与生成任务，涉及图像、视频、音频三种模态；构建OmniHallu-Bench，包含1万样本、claim级人工标注，覆盖六类跨模态任务：I2T、V2T、A2T、T2I、T2V、T2A。采用多智能体架构，将模型输出分解为原子claim，由模态特定专家进行验证，并通过结构化推理聚合证据；进一步提出经偏好优化的可训练验证器，用于近似多智能体决策边界。
AI.result: 偏好优化的可训练验证器在性能损失极小的情况下将专家调用减少66%；大量实验揭示出一致的模态依赖性性能梯度，并为跨模态幻觉模式提供细粒度洞见。
AI.conclusion: OmniHallu实现了跨模态、跨任务的统一幻觉检测，并通过可训练验证器显著降低专家调用成本，同时揭示了模态相关的幻觉规律，为多模态大模型幻觉检测与理解提供了统一基准与分析框架。

title: Assessing the Reusability of Public Speech Resources for Low-Resource Languages: A Central Kurdish Case Study
summary: Kurdish is spoken by millions of people, but little technology can read it aloud. A recent study released three Kurdish voices, 35 hours of recorded speech, and a paper describing the work, all free to download. This review checks how well those public files match the paper. The research is careful about its limits, but the files contain several problems: a settings file lists equipment that was never used, test recordings are left unlabeled among training data, and a coding fault mishandles long numbers. The download page also claims a stronger result than the paper reports and recommends one voice for general use. That recommendation matters because Kurdish has major regional and written variation, while these voices were built from three people reading prepared texts. The process therefore removes much everyday and regional speech. English and German benefit from long traditions of dictionaries and linguistic description that help identify wrong pronunciations; Kurdish has far less such support, so software choices can go unchecked. The voices sound fluent, but they represent the reading styles of their speakers rather than Kurdish as a whole. Most of these issues can be fixed using information the team already has, without changing the reported results. Better records would mainly make the work easier for others, especially community linguists, to check and reuse. The license is the main exception: whether audiobook owners allow corrected versions to be shared will affect whether future Kurdish voices can build on this work or must start again.

AI.tldr: 该文评述了一项库尔德语语音合成工作：虽然公开发布了三套语音、35小时录音和论文，但数据与文档存在设置文件失真、测试录音未标注、代码缺陷、下载页结论夸大等问题；多数可借现有信息修复，许可证是关键例外。
AI.motivation: 库尔德语使用者众多，但可用的朗读技术极少。近期一项研究公开了三套库尔德语语音、35小时录制的语音数据及论文，供免费下载，因此有必要核查这些公开文件与论文的一致性及可复现性。
AI.method: 对公开数据、配置文件和文档与论文进行对照审查，重点核查资源发布的一致性、标注质量、代码正确性和结果陈述，并结合库尔德语的地区与书写变体背景评估语音的代表性。
AI.result: 研究发现论文对自身局限性较为审慎，但公开文件存在多重问题：设置文件列出从未使用的设备；测试录音未加标注而混入训练数据；编码缺陷导致长数字处理错误。下载页面还宣称了强于论文报告的结果，并推荐某一语音用于通用场景。这些语音由三人朗读预制文本构建，无法代表库尔德语整体，且英文、德文可借词典与语言描写传统发现错误发音，库尔德语缺乏此类支持，软件选择难以被检验。
AI.conclusion: 多数问题可利用团队已有信息修正，且不影响已报告结果；完善记录主要便于他人（尤其是社群语言学家）核查与复用。许可证是主要例外：有声书所有者是否允许共享修正版本，将决定未来库尔德语语音能否在此工作基础上继续，还是必须从头开始。

title: The Illusion of Balanced Multimodal Sentiment Analysis: Beyond the Limits of Optimization-Based Methods
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) remains constrained by modality imbalance, yet the field continues to rely on optimization-based balancing methods that promise more than they deliver. We provide three contributions: 1) a unified evaluation framework testing gradient and loss-based balancing strategies under controlled settings; 2) a theoretical diagnosis explaining why these methods fail, as they conflate fitting speed with discriminative contribution; and 3) a research agenda toward held-out discriminative modality valuation. Experiments on CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI reveal three shortcomings: no strategy reliably outperforms Late Concatenation; performance is sensitive to hyperparameters; and even ratio calibration fails to yield consistent gains. The core issue is fundamental: loss is not utility, and gradients are not importance. Modality imbalance remains unresolved, motivating utility estimation from held-out performance.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有多模态情感分析中的模态不平衡优化方法名不副实，通过统一评测框架与理论分析揭示其失效原因，并提出以留出判别性能估计模态效用的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感分析受限于模态不平衡问题，领域内持续依赖基于优化的平衡方法，但这类方法承诺多于实际效果，缺乏受控且统一的严格评估，其有效性存疑。
AI.method: 1）构建统一评测框架，在受控设置下测试基于梯度和基于损失的平衡策略；2）给出理论诊断，说明这些方法失效的原因在于将拟合速度与判别贡献相混淆；3）提出面向留出判别性模态估值的研究议程。
AI.result: 在 CMU-MOSI 和 CMU-MOSEI 上的实验揭示三点不足：没有任何策略能稳定超越 Late Concatenation；性能对超参数敏感；即使进行比例校准也未能带来一致的增益。
AI.conclusion: 核心问题在于：损失不等于效用，梯度不等于重要性。模态不平衡问题仍未解决，需从留出性能出发进行效用估计。

title: MUtE: A Dual Framework for Concept Erasure and Counterfactual Interventions
summary: Erasing concept-specific information from representations has been proven useful for mitigating bias or interpreting model decisions. The joint objective is to transform the original representations such that the target concept becomes unpredictable, while maximally preserving concept-unrelated information. In this work, we revisit the optimal bounds of concept erasure to derive a novel class of erasure functions that naturally induce a deterministic, dual counterfactual mapping. Bridging the gap between theoretical optimality and practical representation learning, we design an implementation that imposes a translational bias on counterfactual trajectories - a constraint that aligns with how many concepts geometrically manifest in modern language models. Our framework enables seamless navigation between concept erasure and counterfactual generation. We empirically demonstrate its efficacy in improving downstream algorithmic fairness and generating counterfactual texts.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视概念擦除的理论最优界，提出一类能自然诱导确定性对偶反事实映射的擦除函数，并设计带平移偏置的实现，统一了概念擦除与反事实生成。
AI.motivation: 从表示中擦除特定概念信息有助于缓解偏见或解释模型决策，其核心目标是使目标概念不可预测，同时最大限度保留与概念无关的信息。然而理论最优性与实际表示学习之间存在差距，且概念擦除与反事实生成通常被割裂处理。
AI.method: 重新推导概念擦除的最优界，据此构造一类新的擦除函数，该类函数自然诱导出确定性的对偶反事实映射；并设计具体实现，在反事实轨迹上施加平移偏置约束，该约束与现代语言模型中许多概念的几何表现方式相符。
AI.result: 该框架支持在概念擦除与反事实生成之间无缝切换；实验表明其在提升下游算法公平性和生成反事实文本方面均有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过弥合理论最优性与实际表示学习的差距，本文构建了兼具理论保证与实用性的概念擦除与反事实生成统一框架。

title: INDRA: A New AI Tool for Exploring Tobacco, Fossil Fuel, and Chemical Industry Archives
summary: Five decades of litigation have disgorged hundreds of millions of pages of formerly secret business records from the tobacco industry, along with documents from the makers of drugs, chemicals, food, firearms, and fossil fuels. Yet these archives have been effectively inaccessible to general-purpose large language models (LLMs) because they have never been compiled into an LLM-readable corpus. Chatbots may be familiar with some of the materials contained in such archives but, with no direct access to the documents, they are vulnerable to hallucination and other defects. Here we introduce INDRA, a research platform designed to remedy such failures by embedding the conventions of archival historiography into a system-level protocol governing every output. The platform federates UCSF's Industry Documents Library, Columbia and CUNY's ToxicDocs, Stanford's SRITA, and other heretofore siloed collections, and provides three interlinked safeguards: (1) a closed evidentiary sandbox confines the model to a user-selected corpus, blocking retrieval from external sources that could introduce bias; (2) real-time provenance tagging marks the boundary between archival evidence and parametric inference; and (3) a system-level protocol enforced by deterministic scripts guides the structure of every output. Together these safeguards prevent the model from conflating "the documents say X" with "I think X" or "I learned X from prior training." The result is an LLM-powered research partner enabling massive multi-archival investigations, a tool whose outputs are designed to be checked rather than trusted, and whose architecture makes the conditions of knowledge production visible and auditable. Three case studies demonstrate the method's analytical value and limitations, including what we call the Heraclitus effect, the steppingstone dilemma, and the gullibility (or mafia) problem.

AI.tldr: 论文提出INDRA平台，通过证据沙箱、实时溯源标注与系统级协议三重保障，使大语言模型可安全检索并分析烟草等行业诉讼档案，输出可核查、可审计。
AI.motivation: 数十年诉讼公开了海量行业内部秘密档案（烟草、制药、化工、食品、枪支、化石燃料等），但因未被编译为LLM可读语料，通用大模型难以有效访问。模型可能"记得"部分内容却无直接文档依据，易产生幻觉等缺陷，因此需要将档案史学的规范嵌入系统协议以约束输出。
AI.method: INDRA平台联邦整合UCSF行业文献库、哥伦比亚与CUNY的ToxicDocs、斯坦福SRITA等原本孤立的馆藏，提供三项相互关联的保障机制：(1)封闭证据沙箱，将模型限定于用户选定的语料，阻断可能引入偏见的外部检索；(2)实时溯源标注，标记档案证据与参数化推断之间的边界；(3)由确定性脚本执行的系统级协议，约束每次输出的结构。以此防止模型混淆"文件说X""我认为X""我从先前训练中学到X"。
AI.result: 平台成为支持大规模多档案研究的LLM研究伙伴，其输出设计为被核查而非被信任，并使知识生产条件可见、可审计。三个案例研究展示了该方法的分析价值与局限，包括"赫拉克利特效应""垫脚石困境"以及"轻信（或黑手党）问题"。
AI.conclusion: 将档案史学方法论制度化地嵌入LLM系统协议，可有效提升对敏感行业档案研究的可靠性、溯源性与可审计性，同时揭示了此类方法固有的认识论局限。

title: AI-Powered Flare Combustion Efficiency Estimation
comment: Accepted at the 4th International Conference on Machine Learning and Data Engineering (ICMLDE 2025). 5 pages
summary: Achieving high combustion efficiency in flare stacks is crucial for adhering to regulatory standards and controlling the release of hydrocarbons into the environment. Traditional instruments like gas analyzers and hyperspectral cameras are expensive, fragile, and require frequent calibration, which makes them impractical for remote or budget constrained industrial sites. We propose an innovative solution that combines a lightweight vision-language encoder with a compact multi-layer perceptron to predict combustion efficiency directly from low-cost thermal video footage. The fully trained model is integrated into an easy-to-deploy graphical user interface. This interface overlays predicted combustion efficiency values on each video frame, displays real-time trends in combustion efficiency, shows the distribution of combustion efficiency across all frames in the video, and allows users to export CSV reports. Over a six-month period, the system achieved 99% uptime and required less than 15 minutes of maintenance per week.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种低成本方案，将轻量级视觉-语言编码器与紧凑多层感知机结合，从低成本热成像视频中直接预测火炬烟囱的燃烧效率，并集成到易部署的图形界面中，实现实时监测与数据导出。
AI.motivation: 火炬烟囱燃烧效率的监测对于合规和控制烃类排放至关重要，但传统仪器（气体分析仪、高光谱相机）昂贵、易损且需频繁校准，难以适用于偏远或预算受限的工业场景，因此需要一种低成本、易部署的远程监测方案。
AI.method: 方法上融合轻量级视觉-语言编码器与紧凑多层感知机（MLP），直接基于低成本热成像视频预测燃烧效率；训练完成的模型被集成到易于部署的图形用户界面（GUI）中。
AI.result: 在六个月的运行期间，系统实现99%的正常运行时间，每周维护时间不足15分钟；界面可在每帧视频上叠加预测的燃烧效率值，展示实时趋势、全视频帧的燃烧效率分布，并支持导出CSV报告。
AI.conclusion: 该方案证明了以低成本热成像视频结合轻量级视觉-语言模型实现火炬燃烧效率实时监测的可行性，兼具高可靠性、低维护成本与良好部署易用性。

title: Uncertainty DMD: Restoring Diversity in Few-Step Autoregressive Video Distillation
summary: Few-step distillation improves the efficiency of autoregressive (AR) video generation, but often causes diversity collapse: under the same prompt, different noise samples tend to produce highly similar videos with weakened motion dynamics. We analyze this degradation in Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD)-distilled AR video generators and find that, in the autoregressive setting, it takes the form of a structured uncertainty collapse: the mode-seeking bias of DMD maps different noise samples to nearly identical first chunks, and the deterministic AR cache then propagates this collapsed state to all subsequent chunks, turning a local loss of stochasticity at the rollout root into a global suppression of temporal variation. Based on this analysis, we propose Uncertainty DMD, a simple uncertainty-injection framework that restores stochasticity at two key stages of AR generation: a timestep perturbation for the first chunk to increase first-chunk diversity, and a stochastic cache-writing mechanism for later chunks to preserve uncertainty in autoregressive conditioning. The method requires no architectural changes and introduces only lightweight perturbation operations. The same perturbation mechanisms are used during both training and inference. Experiments show that Uncertainty DMD consistently improves diversity and motion dynamics while maintaining comparable per-sample visual quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析DMD蒸馏自回归视频生成器的多样性坍缩问题，提出Uncertainty DMD框架，通过在首块注入时间步扰动、在后续块采用随机缓存写入恢复随机性，从而提升多样性与运动动态。
AI.motivation: 少步蒸馏提升了自回归视频生成效率，但导致多样性坍缩：同一提示下不同噪声样本生成高度相似且运动动态减弱的视频。作者需探究该退化在DMD蒸馏AR生成器中的成因并提出解法。
AI.method: 作者将退化归因于结构化不确定性坍缩：DMD的众数寻求偏置把不同噪声映射到几乎相同的第一块，确定性AR缓存再将此状态传播到后续所有块，使局部随机性丧失变成全局时间变化抑制。基于此提出Uncertainty DMD：对首块进行时间步扰动以增加首块多样性，对后续块采用随机缓存写入机制以在自回归条件中保留不确定性；无需改动架构，仅引入轻量扰动操作，训练与推理阶段使用相同扰动机制。
AI.result: 实验表明，Uncertainty DMD在保持相当的单样本视觉质量的同时，持续提升多样性与运动动态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了DMD蒸馏AR视频生成中由首块众数坍缩经确定性缓存传播引发的结构化不确定性坍缩机制，并证明在训练与推理中一致地注入轻量不确定性即可有效缓解多样性坍缩，且不牺牲视觉质量。

title: Improving Faint Object Detection for Space Situational Awareness with Variational Autoencoders
comment: Accepted at SPAICE 2026: the 3rd European Space Agency Conference on AI in and for Space
summary: We present a deep-learning pipeline for enhancing the detection of faint moving objects in optical space situational awareness (SSA) imagery through automated star removal and background reconstruction. Detecting low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) objects remains extremely challenging in optical observations, particularly in the cislunar (X-GEO) environment, where structured sky backgrounds, dense stellar fields, and scattered moonlight significantly degrade the performance of classical detection algorithms. To address this problem, the proposed pipeline combines a lightweight segmentation network (Tiny-U-Net) to generate stellar masks with a partial-convolution variational autoencoder (astro-VAE), designed to learn the statistical distribution of astronomical backgrounds and perform context-aware inpainting of masked regions. The reconstructed background maps can then be used as a preprocessing step to suppress fixed sources and background inhomogeneities prior to detection. As a proof of concept, the approach is integrated with a shift-and-stack scheme and evaluated on real ground-based telescope observations targeting the X-GEO region. Results demonstrate that the method reconstructs star-free backgrounds with high fidelity, while preserving moving targets and significantly enhancing detectability, thereby providing an effective data-driven preprocessing strategy for faint moving-object detection in optical SSA scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种深度学习流水线，通过自动星体去除与背景重建，提升光学空间态势感知图像中暗弱运动目标的检测能力。
AI.motivation: 低信噪比目标检测在光学观测中极具挑战，尤其在地月空间（X-GEO）环境中，结构化天空背景、密集恒星场与散射月光显著削弱了传统检测算法的性能。
AI.method: 流水线结合轻量级分割网络（Tiny-U-Net）生成恒星掩膜，并使用部分卷积变分自编码器（astro-VAE）学习天文背景的统计分布，对掩膜区域进行上下文感知修复，重建的背景图作为预处理步骤抑制固定源与背景不均匀性；该方法与shift-and-stack方案集成。
AI.result: 在针对X-GEO区域的真实地基望远镜观测数据上进行验证，方法能够高保真地重建无星背景，同时保留运动目标并显著提升可检测性。
AI.conclusion: 该数据驱动的预处理策略为光学SSA场景下的暗弱运动目标检测提供了有效手段。

title: Order-Aware 2.5D Multiple Instance Learning for Preoperative MRI-Based Perineural Invasion Risk Assessment in Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma
summary: Perineural invasion (PNI) is an adverse histopathologic marker in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (ICC), but it is usually confirmed only after resection. Preoperative T2-weighted MRI may provide noninvasive imaging cues predictive of PNI, although labels are available only at the patient level without slice- or voxel-level annotations. We propose Order-Aware Slab Multiple Instance Learning (OAS-MIL), a weakly supervised framework for patient-level PNI prediction. Each tumor-centered MRI crop is represented as an ordered sequence of overlapping 2.5D slabs formed from contiguous axial slices. A shared encoder extracts slab-level features, which are aggregated by a permutation-invariant set-attention branch and a bidirectional sequence-attention branch. Using five-fold label-stratified cross-validation at the patient level, OAS-MIL achieved a mean AUROC of 0.770, outperforming the evaluated volumetric and MIL baselines. These results suggest that axial order provides a useful inductive bias for weakly supervised PNI prediction from MRI.

AI.tldr: 提出OAS-MIL弱监督框架，将肿瘤MRI裁剪表示为有序重叠2.5D薄层序列，用集合注意力与双向序列注意力双分支聚合，实现肝内胆管癌患者级神经周围侵犯预测，平均AUROC达0.770。
AI.motivation: 神经周围侵犯（PNI）是肝内胆管癌（ICC）的不良病理标志物，但通常只能术后确诊。术前T2加权MRI有望无创预测PNI，然而标签仅在患者级别可获得，缺乏切片级或体素级标注，因此需要适配弱监督的建模方法。
AI.method: 提出Order-Aware Slab Multiple Instance Learning（OAS-MIL）：以肿瘤为中心的MRI裁剪表示为由连续轴位切片构成的有序重叠2.5D薄层（slab）序列；共享编码器提取薄层级特征；再由置换不变的集合注意力分支与双向序列注意力分支进行聚合，进行患者级PNI预测。
AI.result: 采用患者级五折标签分层交叉验证，OAS-MIL取得平均AUROC 0.770，优于所评估的体数据（volumetric）与MIL基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，轴位顺序为从MRI进行弱监督PNI预测提供了有效的归纳偏置。

title: Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1 Technical Report
summary: Recently, large language model (LLM) based ASR models have achieved significant progress, yet they generally lack support for multi-speaker scenarios, where the cocktail party problem remains a critical bottleneck for further advancing ASR. Existing TS-ASR methods, including end-to-end architectures with speaker embeddings and latest LLM-based explorations suffer from degraded single-speaker performance and the inability to reject when the target speaker is absent. In this paper, we propose Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1, an LLM-based end-to-end TS-ASR architecture. By utilizing reference speech as voiceprint prompts, it directly transcribes the target speaker's speech without requiring speech separation. Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1 maintains competitive performance in single-speaker scenarios, comparable to mainstream ASR models. It also features a negative sample rejection capability, outputting empty text when the target speaker is absent from the mixed speech. Additionally, Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1 supports a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning mode to provide explicit reasoning steps. Extensive experiments on various synthetic and real-world multispeaker benchmarks demonstrate that Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1 achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively addressing the cocktail party problem through a unified architecture that balances multispeaker and single-speaker recognition accuracy, along with rejection capability.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM的端到端目标说话人ASR架构Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1，以参考语音作为声纹提示直接转写目标说话人语音，兼具单说话人竞争力、负样本拒识与CoT推理，在多说话人基准上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM-based ASR虽进展显著，但普遍不支持多说话人场景，鸡尾酒会问题仍是瓶颈。现有TS-ASR方法（含说话人嵌入的端到端架构及最新LLM方案）存在单说话人性能下降、且无法在目标说话人缺席时进行拒识的问题。
AI.method: 提出LLM-based端到端TS-ASR架构Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1：利用参考语音作为声纹提示（voiceprint prompt），无需语音分离即可直接转写目标说话人语音；支持链式思维（CoT）推理模式以给出显式推理步骤；并具备负样本拒识能力，目标说话人缺席时输出空文本。
AI.result: 在多种合成与真实多说话人基准上的大量实验表明，Xiaomi-CocktailASR-1取得SOTA性能；单说话人场景下保持与主流ASR模型相当的性能；同时实现负样本拒识。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过统一架构有效应对鸡尾酒会问题，兼顾多说话人与单说话人识别准确率及拒识能力，为LLM-based TS-ASR提供了可行方案。

title: SAMV-DUSt3R: Instance-Centric 3D Scene Decoupling from Sparse Multi-Views
summary: With the rising demand to decouple objects from 3D scenes, we propose SAMV-DUSt3R, an end-to-end model that injects SAM2 2D masks into MV-DUSt3R reconstruction. A Cross Flow Mask Block uses these masks to steer the network toward the target instance, jointly improving shape accuracy and achieving object-level disentanglement without multi-stage pipelines. To ensure reconstruction stability, a lightweight Spatial RankGNN selects the optimal reference view with a selection accuracy of 73.5\%. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method boosts average reconstruction precision by 11\% across various metrics compared to state-of-the-art baselines. These results reveal a strong instance-disentanglement capability and clear benefits for driving, robotics, AR/VR, and heritage digitisation.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端模型SAMV-DUSt3R，将SAM2的2D掩码注入MV-DUSt3R重建，通过Cross Flow Mask Block引导网络重建目标实例，并用Spatial RankGNN选择最优参考视图，实现物体级解耦和精度提升。
AI.motivation: 随着将物体从3D场景中解耦的需求日益增长，需要在无需多阶段流程的情况下实现单实例重建与物体级解耦，同时保证重建的稳定性。
AI.method: 将SAM2的2D掩码注入MV-DUSt3R重建流程，构成端到端模型SAMV-DUSt3R；设计Cross Flow Mask Block，利用掩码将网络引导至目标实例；引入轻量级的Spatial RankGNN选择最优参考视图。
AI.result: Spatial RankGNN的参考视图选择准确率达73.5%；与当前最优基线相比，在多种指标上平均重建精度提升11%；展现出较强的实例解耦能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在无需多阶段流程的情况下同时提升形状精度并实现物体级解耦，对自动驾驶、机器人、AR/VR及文化遗产数字化等应用具有明显价值。

title: Automatic Lyric Transcription for Greek Songs: Scaling and Task Composition Effects in Whisper Adaptation
summary: Automatic Lyric Transcription (ALT) remains substantially more challenging than speech recognition due to melodic variability, rhythmic irregularity, and accompaniment interference. This is heightened in low-resource languages like Greek, where no prior benchmark for ALT exists. We present the first controlled study of Whisper adaptation for Greek ALT, investigating model scaling effects, task composition via multitask training in transcribe-translate ratios, and two-stage speech-to-singing adaptation. We also curate a segment-level aligned singing dataset based on the Greek Audio Dataset (GAD) using source separation and CTC forced alignment. Results show that scaling consistently improves performance, while multitask learning acts as a beneficial regularizer primarily for smaller-capacity models. The 2-stage adaptation in Whisper Large-v3 achieves a Word Error Rate (WER) of 27.2%, a significant improvement over zero-shot baselines, establishing the first Greek ALT benchmark.

AI.tldr: 首个希腊语自动歌词转写(ALT)基准研究：基于希腊音频数据集构建段落级对齐歌唱数据集，系统探究Whisper适配策略（模型缩放、多任务转录-翻译配比、两阶段语音到歌唱适配），Large-v3两阶段适配取得27.2% WER。
AI.motivation: ALT因旋律变化、节奏不规则与伴奏干扰而显著难于语音识别；低资源语言（如希腊语）此前缺乏ALT基准，且缺少可控的模型适配研究。
AI.method: 以Whisper为对象进行受控适配研究：考察模型缩放效应、通过转录-翻译比例的多任务训练进行任务组合、以及两阶段语音到歌唱适配；并基于希腊音频数据集(GAD)，利用源分离与CTC强制对齐构建段落级对齐的歌唱数据集。
AI.result: 模型缩放持续提升性能；多任务学习主要对小容量模型起到有益正则化作用；Whisper Large-v3采用两阶段适配后WER降至27.2%，显著优于零样本基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了首个希腊语ALT基准，并表明任务组合与分阶段语音-歌唱适配是低资源ALT场景下有效的迁移策略。

title: Your Model Already Knows Don't Teach It, Learn to Ask It: Soft Prompting for Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary: We address few-shot object detection with vision-language models (VLMs) in out-of-domain settings such as aerial, industrial, and medical imagery, using only ten annotated images for supervision. Existing adaptation methods are discrete prompt optimization and LoRA fine-tuning. We revisit a third option: soft prompting, where a small number of continuous prompt tokens are optimized while the pretrained backbone remains frozen. We identify two key design choices. First, placing prompt tokens at the cross-modal boundary between visual and text tokens outperforms other placements (10.0 vs. 8.4 mAP). Second, initializing prompts from the empty space token outperforms semantic and random initialization. With these choices, one to three learned tokens (7,168 parameters on average) match the best LoRA configuration on Roboflow20-VL (14.2 mAP, 10-shot) while training over 20,000x fewer parameters. Soft prompting remains harder to optimize, exhibiting higher variance across random seeds. Unlike LoRA, however, it causes no forgetting: the LoRA rank matching our accuracy reduces NaturalBench VQA accuracy by 35% relative, rising to 56% at the largest rank, whereas soft prompting leaves pretrained performance unchanged. The learned tokens behave like prompts rather than weights. They transfer to a newer model without retraining (+0.8 mAP on Qwen3.5-9B) and can be verbalized into readable prompts competitive with prompt-search methods (matching DetPO and outperforming GEPA). The approach also extends beyond detection. On RoboCasa manipulation tasks, the frozen $π_{0.5}$ vision-language-action policy benefits from soft prompting, matching the LoRA baseline on two of three tasks when tokens are placed at the gradient bottleneck. These results suggest modern VLMs already encode much of what is needed for specialized domains; the challenge is learning how to ask.

AI.tldr: 本文重访软提示（soft prompting）用于视觉-语言模型的少样本域外目标检测：只需优化1–3个连续提示token（约7168参数），在Roboflow20-VL 10-shot上达14.2 mAP，与最优LoRA配置持平，但训练参数量少逾2万倍，且不造成预训练能力遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有域外少样本目标检测适配方法（离散提示优化、LoRA微调）各有局限；作者希望验证在视觉-语言模型上，仅优化少量连续提示token的软提示方案能否以极低参数代价达到可比性能，并避免微调带来的灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 冻结预训练骨干，仅优化少量连续提示token。关键设计有两点：(1) 将提示token置于视觉与文本token之间的跨模态边界处；(2) 用空空间token（empty space token）初始化提示。在Roboflow20-VL（10-shot）上对比LoRA，并在NaturalBench VQA上评估遗忘；进一步测试提示token向新模型（Qwen3.5-9B）的迁移与可言语化性；最后扩展到RoboCasa操作任务中冻结的π0.5视觉-语言-动作策略（提示置于梯度瓶颈处）。
AI.result: 跨模态边界放置提示优于其他位置（10.0 vs. 8.4 mAP）；空空间token初始化优于语义与随机初始化。1–3个学习token（平均7168参数）在Roboflow20-VL 10-shot上达14.2 mAP，匹配最优LoRA配置，参数训练量少逾20000倍。软提示优化更难、跨随机种子方差更高；但不造成遗忘：同等精度的LoRA使NaturalBench VQA精度相对下降35%（最大rank达56%），软提示则保持预训练性能不变。学习到的token表现为提示而非权重：无需重训即可迁移到Qwen3.5-9B（+0.8 mAP），并可言语化为可读提示，与提示搜索方法相当（匹配DetPO、优于GEPA）。在RoboCasa中，冻结的π0.5策略在三个任务中的两个上匹配LoRA基线。
AI.conclusion: 现代视觉-语言模型已编码了专业领域所需的大部分知识，适配的关键在于"如何提问"而非重塑权重；软提示以极少参数实现可比精度、无遗忘且具备迁移与可解释性，是LoRA之外值得重视的适配路径，但其优化稳定性仍需改进。

title: GRIPNet: Gaussian Radial Intensity Prior Guided Architecture for Pulmonary Nodule Detection in CT
summary: Lung cancer causes more deaths than any other malignancy, and low-dose CT screening is the main pathway to early diagnosis. That pathway hinges on the smallest lesions, yet nodules below six millimeters remain hard to detect, because most methods treat a nodule as a generic object and ignore the imaging physics behind its appearance. We show that this appearance is highly regular. Intensity peaks at the geometric center of a nodule and decays radially in a Gaussian pattern, and a fit to 18,218 annotated lesions from three public benchmarks yields a mean radial coefficient of determination above 0.86 in every dataset and size stratum. A square convolution samples both axes uniformly and is mismatched to this radial signal, most severely for small nodules. Guided by this evidence, we propose GRIPNet (Gaussian Radial Intensity Prior Network), a detector in which every module maps to a measurable property of the intensity distribution. Pinwheel convolutions decompose radial gradients, a dual-frequency module separates boundary detail from structural context, dilated masked attention matches the decay extent, and an adaptive loss reweights samples by conspicuity. GRIPNet raises mAP@0.5 to 95.3, 91.6 and 97.9 percent on KanserSet, LUNA16 and Lung-PET-CT-Dx while sharpening high-IoU localization at real-time speed.

AI.tldr: 本文发现肺结节强度呈高斯径向衰减规律，提出基于该先验的GRIPNet检测器，在三个公开数据集上将mAP@0.5提升至95.3%、91.6%和97.9%。
AI.motivation: 肺癌致死率最高的恶性肿瘤，低剂量CT筛查是实现早期诊断的主要途径，但该路径的关键瓶颈在于微小病灶。6毫米以下结节难以检出，原因是多数方法将结节视为通用目标，忽略了其成像物理特性所决定的表观规律。
AI.method: 作者首先通过拟合18,218个标注病灶验证了肺结节的强度分布规律：强度在几何中心达到峰值，并沿径向呈高斯衰减，在三个公开基准的所有数据集和尺寸分层中平均径向决定系数均超过0.86。同时指出方形卷积在双轴上均匀采样，与这种径向信号不匹配，对小尺寸结节尤为严重。据此提出GRIPNet（高斯径向强度先验网络），其每个模块都对应强度分布的可测属性：风车卷积分解径向梯度，双频模块分离边界细节与结构上下文，膨胀掩码注意力匹配衰减范围，自适应损失按显著性重加权样本。
AI.result: GRIPNet将KanserSet、LUNA16和Lung-PET-CT-Dx上的mAP@0.5分别提升至95.3%、91.6%和97.9%，同时在实时速度下提升了高IoU定位精度。
AI.conclusion: 肺结节的强度分布在统计上高度规则，将这一成像物理先验显式嵌入网络结构比将其视为通用目标更有效，可为低剂量CT筛查中对微小病灶的检测提供新的方向。

title: Mi-Ripple: Restoring Images Degraded by Iterative AI Editing
summary: Iterative reference-conditioned image editing can introduce grid-like and granular textures, commonly described as digital ripple. We present Mi-Ripple, a diagnosis-guided restoration workflow that suppresses this digital ripple while protecting image structure. Mi-Ripple separates periodic lattice artifacts from content-entangled granular texture, then combines selective spectral notching, structure-aware smoothing, and cleaned-reference regeneration. This separation enables low-distortion filtering when artifacts are spectrally isolated and visual reconstruction when filtering would erase legitimate detail. Across fourteen notch-only executions, whole-image residual standard deviation is 0.08--0.44 in CIELAB lightness units. In a paired regeneration example, reference cleaning reduces output debris density by 45\%. Mi-Ripple links measurable artifact reduction to visibly cleaner generated images, rather than optimizing a spectral score alone.

AI.tldr: Mi-Ripple：一种诊断引导的修复流程，用于抑制迭代参考条件图像编辑中的“数字波纹”伪影，同时保护图像结构。
AI.motivation: 迭代参考条件图像编辑会引入网格状与颗粒状纹理（数字波纹），现有方法（如仅优化频谱分数）难以在去伪影的同时保护图像结构与合法细节。
AI.method: 将周期性晶格伪影与内容纠缠的颗粒纹理分离，结合选择性频谱陷波（spectral notching）、结构感知平滑以及干净参考图重建（cleaned-reference regeneration），实现伪影频谱孤立时的低失真滤波与滤波会抹除合法细节时的视觉重建。
AI.result: 十四次仅陷波执行中，全图残差标准差为 0.08–0.44（CIELAB 明度单位）；配对重建示例中，参考图清洗使输出碎屑密度降低 45%。
AI.conclusion: Mi-Ripple 将可测量的伪影抑制与视觉上更干净的生成图像相关联，而非仅优化频谱分数。

title: MultiHuSE: A Multimodal Dataset for Humour Styles and Emotions
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at IEEE CBMI 2025 (International Conference on Content-Based Multimedia Indexing), Dublin, Ireland
summary: Computational recognition of verbal humour remains a challenging task, requiring an understanding of language, delivery style, emotions, and cultural context. Most existing approaches focus on binary classification and lack datasets that capture psychological dimensions of humour alongside variations in expression. We introduce MultiHuSE, a multimodal dataset comprising 2,407 high-definition videos of 50 demographically diverse actors performing 1,463 text samples across four psychological humour styles (affiliative, aggressive, self-enhancing, and self-deprecating), as well as neutral content. A subset is additionally annotated for underlying emotions. The dataset uniquely captures multiple actor interpretations of the same texts, enabling systematic analysis of expressive diversity. Baseline experiments show that multimodal fusion outperforms unimodal approaches (80.1% vs. 77.4% accuracy) in humour style classification, with particularly strong gains for affiliative humour (66% to 74%). While text provides the strongest individual signal, fusion models deliver meaningful improvements. We hope that MultiHuSE provides empirical support for psychological theories linking humour and emotion, while also opening new avenues for research in human communication, well-being, and AI-driven interaction. The dataset is available for academic use under an End-User Licence Agreement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MultiHuSE，一个包含2,407个高清视频、50位演员演绎1,463条文本的多模态幽默风格数据集，覆盖四种心理学幽默风格及中性内容，并验证多模态融合优于单模态基线。
AI.motivation: 言语幽默的计算识别具有挑战性，需综合语言、表达风格、情感与文化语境。现有方法多局限于二分类，且缺乏同时刻画幽默的心理学维度与表达差异的数据集。
AI.method: 构建MultiHuSE多模态数据集：2,407个高清视频，50位人口学多样化的演员表演1,463条文本，涵盖四种心理学幽默风格（亲和型、攻击型、自我增强型、自我贬损型）及中性内容；部分数据额外标注潜在情绪；同一文本由多位演员演绎以捕捉表达多样性；并开展单模态与多模态融合的基线实验。
AI.result: 多模态融合在幽默风格分类上优于单模态（准确率80.1% vs. 77.4%），对亲和型幽默提升尤为显著（66%至74%）。文本是最强的单一信号，但融合模型带来有意义的增益。
AI.conclusion: MultiHuSE为连接幽默与情绪的心理学理论提供经验证据，并为人类沟通、幸福感及AI驱动交互研究开辟新方向；数据集在最终用户许可协议下供学术使用。

title: Rice's Theorem under Self-Modification: Elevation Operators and a Normal Form
comment: v3: journal version. Shortened; neutral terminology; new Proposition 7.12 showing that the class of elevation operators is complete for anchored normal forms; comparison with enforcement by program rewriting (Hamlen, Morrisett and Schneider) added; illustrations moved to an appendix. 35 pages. Companion paper: arXiv:2606.28639 (applied consequences)
summary: We ask whether it can be certified algorithmically that a self-modifying program keeps a behavioural property, a safety property in the motivating case, after its next rewrite (preservation) and along its whole evolution (persistence). When the rewrite depends only on behaviour, preservation is a behavioural property and Rice's theorem applies. When the rewrite reads the code, preservation is no longer behavioural; yet, under a uniform disruption condition, the s-m-n reduction that proves Rice's theorem works inside a single class of behaviourally identical programs, and preservation inherits the degree of the halting problem. One step never exceeds the degree of the property, while persistence can climb one level of the arithmetical hierarchy. We then isolate the mechanism shared by rewriting, supervision and system comparison, the elevation operator, and prove a normal form: the preserving set is determined by a single finite trigger and a polarity, and the Rice-Shapiro theorem restricts the polarity to the arithmetical class of the property. Runtime monitors, consistency supervision, conformance to a reference and observational equivalence are instances, and no sound theory covers the preserving systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究自修改程序在下次重写（保持性）及整个演化过程（持久性）中行为性质（以安全性质为例）的可验证性，借助Rice定理、s-m-n归约、算术层级及Rice-Shapiro定理刻画其不可判定度，并提炼出"提升算子"这一统一机制。
AI.motivation: 自修改程序在安全关键场景中广泛存在，其重写后能否保持安全性质至关重要。核心问题是：能否算法化地证明程序在重写后（及整个演化过程中）保持某一行为性质。当重写仅依赖行为时，保持性本身是行为性质，Rice定理直接适用；但当重写读取代码时，保持性不再是行为性质，经典结论失效，需要新工具刻画其可判定性边界。
AI.method: 作者首先区分重写仅依赖行为与读取代码两种情形。对后者，在一致性扰动条件（uniform disruption condition）下，将证明Rice定理所用的s-m-n归约限制在一个行为完全相同的程序类内部，从而证明保持性继承了停机问题的不可判定度。随后，作者抽取重写、监督与系统比较所共享的机制，定义为"提升算子"（elevation operator），并利用该算子证明一个范式定理：保持集由单一有限触发条件和极性确定，同时用Rice-Shapiro定理将极性限制在性质所属的算术类内。
AI.result: 单步保持性的不可判定度不超过被保持性质本身的度；持久性则可上升一个算术层级。保持集具有范式：由单一有限触发条件与极性决定，且该极性受Rice-Shapiro定理约束，与性质的算术类一致。运行时监控、一致性监督、对参考实现的符合性以及观察等价均被刻画为提升算子的实例。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了自修改程序保持性验证的统一理论框架，表明不存在一个可靠的通用理论能覆盖所有保持系统；各类监督与比较机制本质上都归约为同一提升算子，其可判定度受算术层级与Rice-Shapiro约束的限制。

title: Predictive Multi-Landmark OCT Tracking for Increased Motion Robustness
summary: Optical coherence tomography is a promising modality for markerless motion tracking due to its high spatial resolution and inherent depth perception. However, existing OCT-based tracking approaches are limited in terms of trackable velocity, particularly when multiple landmarks are tracked sequentially for 6D pose estimation. In this work, we present a predictive tracking approach that propagates positional updates between multiple tracked landmarks to obtain a global pose prediction. This enables more robust tracking under high velocities. Our results demonstrate RMSEs below 1 mm for velocities up to 100 mm/s and up to nine consecutively tracked landmarks, highlighting the potential of global motion propagation and prediction for improving the robustness of OCT-based tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于预测的OCT多标志点跟踪方法，通过在多个被跟踪标志点之间传播位置更新来获得全局位姿预测，从而在高速度下实现更稳健的跟踪。结果表明在速度高达100 mm/s、最多连续跟踪九个标志点时，RMSE低于1 mm。
AI.motivation: 光学相干断层扫描（OCT）因高空间分辨率和固有深度感知能力，是无标记运动跟踪的理想模态。但现有基于OCT的跟踪方法可跟踪速度受限，尤其当为进行6D位姿估计而需顺序跟踪多个标志点时，这一问题更为突出。
AI.method: 提出一种预测式跟踪方法：在多个被跟踪标志点之间传播位置更新（global motion propagation），据此得到全局位姿预测，以增强高速度条件下的跟踪稳健性。
AI.result: 在速度高达100 mm/s、且最多连续跟踪九个标志点的条件下，均方根误差（RMSE）低于1 mm。
AI.conclusion: 全局运动传播与预测能够有效提升基于OCT跟踪的稳健性，具有良好应用潜力。

title: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Benchmarks: Arabic Textual Entailment and Natural Inference Datasets
summary: Natural Language Inference processes pairs of sentences to extract their semantic relations. NLI has been a hot research topic, integrated as a main component in other NLP applications. Despite significant advancements in textual inference across various languages all around the world, Arabic language still suffers from limited resources in this domain. To address this gap, this paper introduces E-CONAN benchmarks that are composed of sentences pairs from various sources: (1) automatically-translated pairs, (2) human-validated machine-translated pairs, (3) hand-crafted pairs from teaching Arabic as foreign language books, and (4) headlines pairs from different news channels containing rumors. E-CONAN contains two benchmark datasets, E-CONAN-2, a 2-way dataset (RTE) and E-CONAN-3, a 3-way dataset (NLI). Additionally, we have used E-CONAN benchmarks to evaluate 9 state-of-the-art multilingual pretrained models using zero-shot classification. Models were evaluated across the ArNLI, XNLI, and E-CONAN datasets. Results show that E-CONAN is a potentially valuable resource for evaluating model generalization and even for fine-tuning pre-trained models. Its diverse composition, derived from a combination of sources, offers a broader and more robust assessment compared to XNLI and ArNLI. In addition, we have evaluated 5 LLMs on E-CONAN-3 dataset. Moreover, we incorporated MARBERT as a representative Arabic-specific baseline and conducted performance evaluation comparison to demonstrate how Arabic-specific models scale against cross-lingual and LLM-based approaches on the E-CONAN benchmarks. Furthermore, we conducted detailed qualitative and quantitative error analysis to analyze frequent error patterns. E-CONAN benchmarks will be publicly available, we hope that it will enrich research community in Arabic textual entailment and natural language inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出E-CONAN阿拉伯语自然语言推理（NLI）基准，包含2类（RTE）与3类（NLI）两个数据集，来源多样，并用其评估9个多语言预训练模型、5个大语言模型及MARBERT基线，辅以定性与定量错误分析。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语在文本推理领域资源有限，现有基准（如XNLI、ArNLI）覆盖面不足，亟需更全面、更稳健的评测资源以评估模型泛化能力并支持微调。
AI.method: 构建E-CONAN基准，数据来自四类来源：自动翻译句对、人工校验的机器翻译句对、阿拉伯语外语教学书籍中的人工构造句对、含谣言的新闻标题句对；形成E-CONAN-2（RTE，2类）与E-CONAN-3（NLI，3类）。采用零样本分类评估9个SOTA多语言预训练模型（跨ArNLI、XNLI、E-CONAN），并在E-CONAN-3上评估5个LLM，同时引入MARBERT作为阿拉伯语专用基线进行对比，最后开展定性与定量错误分析。
AI.result: 实验表明E-CONAN可作为评估模型泛化能力乃至微调预训练模型的有价值资源；由于其来源组合多样，相较XNLI和ArNLI能提供更广泛、更稳健的评测。同时给出了多语言模型、LLM与阿拉伯语专用模型（MARBERT）在E-CONAN上的性能对比，并归纳了常见错误模式。
AI.conclusion: E-CONAN将公开释放，旨在丰富阿拉伯语文本蕴含与自然语言推理研究，为社区提供更全面的评测基准。

title: On the Impact of Anonymization on the Performance of Large Language Models
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed in sensitive domains, anonymizing input data to protect personally identifiable information has become a critical practice. However, the impact of this anonymization on model utility is not well understood. This paper presents a systematic empirical study of the trade-off between privacy and performance. We evaluate five prominent language models across eleven diverse benchmarks, comparing their performance on original versus pseudonymized inputs. Our results reveal that while anonymization generally degrades performance, the effect is highly nuanced. We find that more capable models, such as Qwen2.5-72B and GPT-4o mini, suffer the largest performance drops, suggesting a stronger reliance on specific entity information. The impact is also task-dependent: performance on TruthfulQA improves with anonymization, while retrieval-focused tasks like RGB experience a catastrophic decline. Further experiments show that reversible anonymization techniques that preserve entity uniqueness significantly outperform irreversible ones like redaction, and that explicitly prompting models about anonymization offers no discernible benefit. We conclude that anonymization is not a one-size-fits-all solution and must be co-designed with the model and task in mind to balance privacy and utility effectively. Our findings provide a crucial baseline for developing more robust, privacy-aware AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对匿名化与模型效用的权衡进行了系统实证研究，发现匿名化影响高度依懒于模型能力与任务类型，需与模型和任务协同设计。
AI.motivation: 大模型日益部署于敏感领域，对输入数据匿名化以保护个人可识别信息已成关键实践，但匿名化对模型效用的影响尚不清晰。
AI.method: 在11个多样化基准上评测5个主流语言模型，比较其原始输入与伪匿名输入下的表现；并进一步比较可逆匿名化（保留实体唯一性）与不可逆方法（如脱敏遮蔽），以及显式提示模型匿名化信息的效果。
AI.result: 匿名化总体降低性能但影响高度分化：能力更强的模型（如Qwen2.5-72B、GPT-4o mini）性能下降最大，说明其更依赖具体实体信息；任务依赖性明显，TruthfulQA性能提升而RGB等检索类任务出现灾难性下降；可逆匿名化显著优于不可逆方法，显式提示无可见收益。
AI.conclusion: 匿名化并非通用解决方案，必须结合模型与任务进行协同设计以有效平衡隐私与效用，为构建更稳健、隐私感知的AI系统提供了关键基线。

title: SEAR: Segment-Evidence-Aware Routing for Weak-to-Strong Multilingual Speech MCQ
summary: This paper describes our system for Task~2 of the second Multilingual Conversational Speech Language Model (MLC-SLM) Challenge. We adapt Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct with a segment-evidence-aware data and post-training pipeline. A language model converts timestamped ASR into coherent event spans, which are expanded by a boundary margin and cropped from the original recording. We then synthesize complementary semantic MCQs with Qwen3.6-27B and acoustic MCQs with Gemini~3.1 Flash-Lite, followed by structural, grounding, answer-consistency, and target-model trainability checks, yielding 359,825 verified MCQs across 21 language and accent variants. A text-only probe partitions the data into weak, text-answerable items used for supervised fine-tuning and strong, audio-dependent items used for reinforcement learning with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO), stabilized by debiased advantages, sequence-level importance correction, and dynamic filtering. Our system obtains 90.92% accuracy on the final official evaluation set.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向MLC-SLM Challenge Task 2的参赛系统：基于Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct，采用分段证据感知的数据构建与后训练流程，先由语言模型将带时间戳的ASR转成连贯事件片段并裁剪音频，再利用Qwen3.6-27B与Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite合成语义/声学MCQ并多重校验，最终获得359,825条覆盖21种语言与口音变体的验证MCQ；通过文本探针划分数据，弱样本做SFT、强样本做GSPO强化学习，在官方评测集上取得90.92%准确率。
AI.motivation: 多语言会话语音语言模型任务中，参考答案往往可从文本中推断，导致模型依赖文本捷径而忽视声学证据；同时高质量、可验证且覆盖多语言/口音的语音理解训练数据稀缺。因此需要一种能够显式区分"文本可答"与"必须依赖音频"的数据构建与训练策略，以提升会话语音理解能力。
AI.method: 1) 以Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct为基座，构建分段证据感知的数据与后训练流程；2) 语言模型将带时间戳ASR转换为连贯事件跨度，按边界余量扩展并从原始录音裁剪；3) 用Qwen3.6-27B合成语义MCQ、Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite合成声学MCQ，并经结构、接地（grounding）、答案一致性及目标模型可训练性四类校验，得到359,825条验证MCQ，覆盖21种语言与口音变体；4) 用纯文本探针将数据划分为弱（文本可答）与强（依赖音频）两类，弱项用于监督微调（SFT），强项用于GSPO强化学习，并采用去偏优势、序列级重要性校正与动态过滤稳定训练。
AI.result: 在最终官方评测集上取得90.92%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 分段证据感知的数据构建、多源MCQ合成与严格校验，结合文本探针驱动的SFT/GSPO分阶段后训练，可有效抑制文本捷径、强化声学依赖，从而显著提升多语言会话语音理解性能。

title: R4Tun: LLM-guided adaptive segmental tunnel lining segmentation in point clouds
summary: Automated inspection of segmental tunnel linings requires adaptive segmentation from 3D point clouds, yet expert-tuned pipelines often degrade when tunnel conditions vary.
