This paper presents R4Tun, a large language model (LLM)-driven adaptation framework that extends an expert-designed pipeline (SAM4Tun) with bounded parameter tuning informed by structured context: memory ($m$), state ($s$), and knowledge ($k$). Evaluated on 30 selected Seg2Tunnel subsets (13 regular, 17 complex) across three LLMs, the full $m+s+k$ design raised mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) from 0.18 to 0.43--0.48 and overall accuracy (OA) from 0.42 to 0.59--0.65 relative to the static SAM4Tun baseline, with the near-reference regular (staggered) subsets reaching mIoU 0.784--0.796 across LLMs. Across 270 (30 tunnels $\times$ 3 different LLMs $\times$ 3 context settings) runs, the LLMs showed similar parameter-adjustment trends (with overlapping 95\% CIs on mean gains) and consistently adjusted a shared set of critical parameters. These results support R4Tun as a controlled, label-free, cross-LLM adaptation mechanism in the tested SAM4Tun--Seg2Tunnel setting, demonstrating consistent accuracy gains; we position R4Tun as a mechanism contribution rather than a deployable final-inspection system, in which each bounded parameter change is auditable via logged rationales.

AI.tldr: 提出R4Tun——一种由大语言模型驱动的参数自适应框架，在SAM4Tun专家流水线基础上引入记忆、状态与知识结构化上下文进行有界调参，在Seg2Tunnel数据上显著提升分割精度。
AI.motivation: 管片隧道衬砌的自动化检测依赖三维点云的自适应分割，但专家手工调参的流水线在隧道工况变化时性能易退化，缺乏自适应能力。
AI.method: R4Tun以LLM驱动，扩展SAM4Tun专家流水线，通过结构化的记忆(m)、状态(s)、知识(k)上下文引导有界参数调整；在30个Seg2Tunnel子集（13个规则、17个复杂）上，用3种LLM、3种上下文设置共270次运行进行评测。
AI.result: 完整m+s+k设计将mIoU从0.18提升至0.43–0.48，OA从0.42提升至0.59–0.65；近参考的规则（错缝）子集mIoU达0.784–0.796。不同LLM呈现相似的参数调整趋势（平均增益的95%置信区间重叠），且一致调整同一组关键参数。
AI.conclusion: R4Tun在测试的SAM4Tun–Seg2Tunnel场景中是一种受控、免标注、跨LLM的自适应机制，能稳定提升精度；其定位为机制贡献而非可直接部署的最终检测系统，每次有界参数改动均可通过日志化的理由审计。

title: Vision Transformer-Based Multi-Level Feature Fusion for Multi-Label Sewer Defect Classification
summary: Automated classification of sewer defects is essential for infrastructure condition assessment and maintenance decision-making, but existing deep learning methods struggle to balance classification accuracy and computational complexity in large-scale multi-label scenarios. This study develops Sewer-Transformer-ML, a hierarchical vision Transformer with multi-level feature fusion, together with two lightweight architectures, Sewer-MobileNet-ML and Sewer-Mobile-TransNet, for resource-constrained inspection scenarios. On the Sewer-ML test set, Sewer-Transformer-ML-Base achieved an $F2_{\text{CIW}}$ of 65.68% and an $F1_{\text{Normal}}$ of 92.68%, ranking first on the public leaderboard and exceeding the second-ranked method by 7.6 percentage points in $F2_{\text{CIW}}$. Sewer-MobileNet-ML achieved an $F2_{\text{CIW}}$ of 65.73% with only 17 M parameters, representing an approximately 95% parameter reduction relative to the base model. Under the standard Sewer-Capsule data split, Sewer-Mobile-TransNet achieved 96.43% classification accuracy. When the training set was reduced to 1,177 images, pretraining on Sewer-ML consistently improved model performance. Ablation experiments further showed that direct concatenation was more effective for Transformer features, whereas attention-based fusion better supported multiscale CNN features. These findings provide a computational basis for automated sewer inspection, lightweight model design, and adaptation across civil infrastructure inspection platforms.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出层级视觉Transformer（Sewer-Transformer-ML）及两种轻量模型，在Sewer-ML上取得领先的多标签缺陷分类性能并大幅降低参数量。
AI.motivation: 下水道缺陷自动分类对基础设施状态评估与维护决策至关重要，但现有深度学习方法在大规模多标签场景下难以兼顾分类精度与计算复杂度。
AI.method: 开发带多级特征融合的层级视觉Transformer（Sewer-Transformer-ML），并设计两种面向资源受限巡检场景的轻量架构：Sewer-MobileNet-ML与Sewer-Mobile-TransNet；通过消融实验比较Transformer特征直接拼接与基于注意力的多尺度CNN特征融合效果。
AI.result: Sewer-ML测试集上，Sewer-Transformer-ML-Base取得F2_CIW=65.68%、F1_Normal=92.68%，公开排行榜第一，F2_CIW领先第二名7.6个百分点；Sewer-MobileNet-ML仅17M参数即达F2_CIW=65.73%，较基础模型参数量减少约95%；在Sewer-Capsule标准划分下，Sewer-Mobile-TransNet分类准确率达96.43%；训练集缩减至1,177张时，Sewer-ML预训练可稳定提升性能。
AI.conclusion: Transformer特征直接拼接更优，注意力融合更适配多尺度CNN特征；研究为下水道自动巡检、轻量模型设计及跨土木基础设施巡检平台适配提供算力依据。

authors: for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
title: Brain-PACE: A Deep Siamese MRI Framework for Modelling Longitudinal Brain Acceleration
summary: Brain age estimation has become a popular research proxy for assessing brain health and disease, yet longitudinal trajectories of brain ageing are still poorly defined, and clinical use is limited. Building on existing Siamese longitudinal frameworks, we develop Brain-Predicted Age Acceleration (Brain-PACE) to directly estimate the pace of structural brain ageing from paired T1-weighted MRI. Brain-PACE identified accelerated ageing in $42.6$% of participants with mild cognitive impairment. Faster Brain-PACE was associated with greater functional and cognitive impairment (FAQ; $r=0.35$, ADAS13; $r=0.30$, CDR-SB; $r=0.32$) and greater regional tau burden in the posterior cingulate ($r=0.59$), precuneus ($r=0.47$), and entorhinal cortex ($r=0.37$). These associations were stronger than those observed when pace was calculated indirectly from repeated cross-sectional brain age estimates, suggesting that direct longitudinal modelling captures complementary information relevant to ongoing pathological change. Methodologically, Brain-PACE extends the LILAC framework by combining spatial attention with soft label distribution learning and a Cramér distance objective, improving probabilistic performance and reducing prediction bias while providing measures of predictive uncertainty. Together, these findings support Brain-PACE as a complementary longitudinal imaging phenotype with sensitivity to relevant clinical and biological changes in early neurodegeneration.

AI.tldr: 提出Brain-PACE，一种基于配对纵向T1加权MRI直接估计结构性脑老化速度的方法；在MCI人群中识别出42.6%的加速老化者，且其与功能、认知损害及区域tau负荷的相关性优于由重复横截面脑龄间接计算的速率，方法上通过空间注意力、软标签分布学习与Cramér距离目标扩展LILAC框架。
AI.motivation: 脑龄估计已成为评估脑健康与疾病的热门替代指标，但脑老化的纵向轨迹仍定义不清，临床实用性受限；且现有的速率计算多依赖重复横截面脑龄估计的间接差分，可能遗漏与持续病理变化相关的信息。
AI.method: 在既有Siamese纵向框架基础上提出Brain-PACE，从配对T1加权MRI直接估计结构性脑老化速度；方法学上扩展LILAC框架，结合空间注意力、软标签分布学习与Cramér距离目标函数，以提升概率预测性能、降低预测偏差并提供预测不确定性度量。
AI.result: Brain-PACE在42.6%的轻度认知障碍（MCI）参与者中识别出加速老化；更快的Brain-PACE与更严重的功能与认知损害相关（FAQ r=0.35；ADAS13 r=0.30；CDR-SB r=0.32），并与后扣带（r=0.59）、楔前叶（r=0.47）和内嗅皮层（r=0.37）更大的区域tau负荷相关；这些关联强于由重复横截面脑龄估计间接计算的速率。
AI.conclusion: Brain-PACE可作为一种补充性的纵向影像表型，对早期神经退行性变中相关的临床与生物学变化具有敏感性；直接纵向建模可捕获与持续病理改变相关的互补信息。

title: DINO-Med: A Unified Patch-Based Adaptation Framework for Multi-Modal Medical Image Analysis Applied to Liver Fibrosis Staging
summary: Adapting natural-image foundation models like DINOv3 to multi-modal medical imaging is challenging due to the significant domain gap between natural color images and multi-channel medical scans. We present a unified, patch-based framework that processes raw multimodal imaging through training-free registration, automated localization, and mask-filtered patch extraction. This architecture culminates in a hierarchical strategy that aggregates patch-level insights into subject-level diagnostics. Using liver fibrosis staging as a case study, we evaluate four patch-level feature representations: handcrafted Radiomics features, learned ResNet features, pre-trained foundation model SAM-Med2D features, and frozen DINOv3 features. To ensure a controlled comparison, all models utilize the same lightweight MLP head and are evaluated across both rigid and deformable registration settings. Our training protocol focuses on mild fibrosis (S1) and cirrhosis (S4) classes only, enabling a single classifier to address both substantial fibrosis detection and cirrhosis staging. Evaluated via 10 random train (90%)/ test (10%) splits on 360 subjects from the CARE 2025 Liver Track 4 cohort, our DINOv3-based framework significantly outperforms all baselines, achieving the best classification accuracy of 78.4% for S1 and 75.8% for S4.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的patch级框架，将自然图像基础模型DINOv3适配至多模态医学影像，以肝纤维化分期为例，DINOv3特征显著优于Radiomics、ResNet及SAM-Med2D基线。
AI.motivation: 自然彩色图像与多通道医学扫描之间存在显著域差异，使DINOv3等自然图像基础模型难以直接适配多模态医学影像，且缺乏跨特征表示与配准方式的受控比较。
AI.method: 构建统一的patch级框架：免训练配准、自动定位、掩膜过滤patch提取，并以层级策略将patch级信息聚合为受试者级诊断；在肝纤维化分期任务中，采用相同的轻量MLP头，对比手工Radiomics、ResNet、SAM-Med2D与冻结DINOv3四种patch特征，并在刚性/形变配准两种设置下评估；训练仅用轻度纤维化(S1)与肝硬化(S4)两类。
AI.result: 在CARE 2025 Liver Track 4队列360名受试者上进行10次随机训练(90%)/测试(10%)划分，DINOv3框架显著优于所有基线，S1最佳准确率78.4%，S4为75.8%。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的自然图像基础模型DINOv3经统一patch级框架适配后，可有效迁移至多模态医学影像，单分类器即可兼顾显著纤维化检测与肝硬化分期。

title: VikingRAG: Accurate and Token-efficient Retrieval-augmented Generation over Structured Documents
summary: State-of-the-art retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods exploit document structures to acquire sufficient evidence, but often incur substantial token costs. To reduce structural-context tokens without compromising high RAG accuracy, we present {\sf VikingRAG}, a directory-aware semantic data management system that tightly integrates semantic and structural access to support structural-context-efficient, evidence-gap-driven multi-round retrieval. To further reduce token overhead of multi-round interaction, we materialize agentic multi-round retrieval traces as experience edges, and reuse these edges for similar queries, avoiding repeated multi-round exploration. To additionally reduce token costs when agentic multi-round retrieval is unnecessary, we introduce an adaptive escalation strategy that answers from one-round experience-augmented retrieval when the evidence is sufficient, and invokes agentic multi-round retrieval only otherwise. Experiments on real datasets show that the base system {\sf VikingRAG} matches high accuracy of state-of-the-art methods while consuming only 11.6\%--51.9\% of their tokens. With retrieval-trace reuse and adaptive escalation, token costs drop to 5.1\%--32.5\% while maintaining competitive accuracy and practical document-storage performance, showing the utility of this work for emerging AI knowledge bases.

AI.tldr: VikingRAG是一种目录感知的语义数据管理系统，通过整合语义与结构访问、物化多轮检索经验边以及自适应升级策略，在大幅降低token开销的同时保持高RAG准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的RAG方法利用文档结构获取充分证据，但会带来巨大的token成本。作者希望在降低结构上下文token的同时不损害RAG准确率。
AI.method: 提出VikingRAG系统：(1)紧密整合语义与结构访问，支持结构上下文高效、由证据缺口驱动的多轮检索；(2)将智能体多轮检索轨迹物化为经验边，并对相似查询复用，避免重复多轮探索；(3)引入自适应升级策略，当证据充分时仅用一轮经验增强检索回答，否则才启用智能体多轮检索。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上，基础系统VikingRAG在达到现有最先进方法高准确率的同时仅消耗其11.6%–51.9%的token；结合检索轨迹复用和自适应升级后，token成本降至5.1%–32.5%，并保持有竞争力的准确率和实用的文档存储性能。
AI.conclusion: VikingRAG通过结构与语义整合、经验复用和自适应升级有效降低token开销并保持准确率，对新兴AI知识库具有实用价值。

title: TransClean: A Benchmark for Detecting and Extracting Clean Translations from Large Language Model Outputs
comment: Accepted to the Eleventh Conference on Machine Translation (WMT26)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for machine translation, yet their outputs often contain additional text beyond the translation itself, such as language labels, explanations or bilingual repetitions, which we term translation noise. Despite its prevalence, this problem lacks dedicated benchmarks and systematic study. We analyze over 790,000 translation outputs from 12 LLMs across 22 language pairs (LPs) and identify 12 recurring noise patterns, which we group into formatting and content noise. Building on the observed patterns, we construct TransClean, a controlled benchmark of 9,900 pairs of noisy and clean translation outputs, comprising 8,800 synthetically generated instances and 1,100 manually curated authentic instances. We evaluate two extraction approaches on the TransClean benchmark: 1) a span-based extraction method leveraging translation quality estimation models for span detection, and 2) an LLM-based extraction method that prompts an LLM to isolate the translation. Our benchmark and analysis provide the first systematic framework to evaluate and improve the cleanliness of LLM translation outputs.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了LLM翻译输出中的"翻译噪声"问题，构建了TransClean基准并提出两种提取方法进行评测。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于机器翻译，但其输出常包含翻译本身之外的多余文本（语言标签、解释、双语重复等），即"翻译噪声"。该问题普遍存在却缺乏专门的基准与系统性研究。
AI.method: 分析12个LLM、22个语言对共79万余条翻译输出，归纳出12种反复出现的噪声模式，划分为格式噪声与内容噪声两类。据此构建TransClean基准，含9,900对噪声-干净译文（8,800条合成实例+1,100条人工整理的真实实例）。并在该基准上评测两种提取方法：1）基于片段的提取方法，利用翻译质量估计模型进行片段检测；2）基于LLM的提取方法，通过提示LLM分离出译文。
AI.result: 识别出12种噪声模式并归纳为格式与内容两大类；构建了包含9,900对样本的TransClean基准；对两种提取方法进行了对比评测。
AI.conclusion: 该基准与分析提供了首个系统化框架，用于评估并改进LLM翻译输出的干净程度。

title: SWRouter: Similarity-Contractive Window Routing for Multi-Turn Large Language Model Conversations
summary: Large language models exhibit complementary strengths, motivating routing methods that dispatch each query to the most suitable model. Although existing routers are effective in single-turn settings, they do not directly transfer to multi-turn dialogue, where routing performance critically depends on how historical context is segmented, retained, and incorporated into the current prompt. This introduces two fundamental challenges: preventing information loss and information confusion during context construction, and evaluating routing quality without conflating model selection with prompt construction quality. In this paper, we propose SWRouter, a Similarity-Contractive Window Router for multi-turn large language model routing. SWRouter combines a similarity-based context segmentation mechanism for prompt construction with a dual-metric evaluation framework that decouples construction accuracy from router performance. Experiments on multi-turn dialogue benchmarks demonstrate that SWRouter consistently surpasses strong baselines, achieving a 16.26% improvement in evaluation accuracy over the best individual large language model and an additional 8.22% gain over the Conv-ID Context baseline. Our results highlight that multi-turn large language model routing requires a joint design of context construction and evaluation, rather than a direct extension of single-turn routing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SWRouter（相似性收缩窗口路由器），通过相似性上下文分割机制与双指标评估框架，解决多轮对话中大模型路由的上下文构建与评估难题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型各具互补优势，需要路由方法将查询分派给最合适的模型。现有多数路由器在单轮场景有效，但难以直接迁移到多轮对话：多轮场景下路由性能关键取决于历史上下文如何被切分、保留并融入当前提示。这带来两大挑战：（1）上下文构建过程中如何避免信息丢失与信息混淆；（2）如何在评估路由质量时不将模型选择质量与提示构建质量相混淆。
AI.method: 提出SWRouter——面向多轮大模型路由的相似性收缩窗口路由器（Similarity-Contractive Window Router）。方法包含两部分：（1）基于相似性的上下文分割机制，用于提示构建；（2）双指标评估框架，将构建准确率与路由器性能解耦评估。
AI.result: 在多轮对话基准上，SWRouter持续优于强基线：相比最佳单个大模型，评估准确率提升16.26%；相比Conv-ID Context基线，额外提升8.22%。
AI.conclusion: 多轮大模型路由需要上下文构建与评估的联合设计，而非单轮路由方法的简单扩展。

title: Hologram Representation via Quadratic Phase Gaussian Splatting
summary: We introduce Complex-Valued Quadratic Phase Gaussian (CVQPG), a novel hologram representation method that augments each 2D Gaussian primitive with a quadratic phase profile controlled by a learnable curvature parameter. Against the planar Gaussian baseline, CVQPG improves the average PSNR of holographic reconstructions by 0.19 dB (RGB) and 0.33 dB (grayscale) at equal primitive counts, and by 0.05 dB (RGB) and 0.08 dB (grayscale) at equal parameter counts, where it still leads in all visual quality metrics. Our frequency-domain analysis shows that CVQPG better preserves the mid-to-high frequency band of natural images, where the reconstruction MSE drops by up to 11% (RGB) and 22% (grayscale), indicating that modulating primitive wavefronts is an effective and lightweight enhancement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出复数二次相位高斯(CVQPG)全息表示方法,在2D高斯基元上引入可学习的二次相位曲率参数,在等参数量和等基元数条件下均提升重建质量,并更好地保留中高频信息。
AI.motivation: 现有基于平面高斯基元的全息表示受限于恒定相位波前,难以精确刻画自然图像的中高频细节,且提升重建质量往往需要增加参数量或基元数量,成本较高。作者希望以轻量方式增强基元的波前建模能力。
AI.method: 为每个2D高斯基元附加一个由可学习曲率参数控制的二次相位轮廓,构成复数二次相位高斯(CVQPG)表示,并对其重建结果开展频域分析。
AI.result: 相比平面高斯基线,等基元数下平均PSNR提升0.19 dB(RGB)与0.33 dB(灰度);等参数量下提升0.05 dB(RGB)与0.08 dB(灰度),且所有视觉质量指标均领先。中高频段重建MSE最多下降11%(RGB)与22%(灰度)。
AI.conclusion: 调制基元波前是一种有效且轻量的全息表示增强策略,CVQPG在几乎不增加开销的前提下改善了重建保真度,尤其利于中高频细节的恢复。

title: Multi-Modal Controlled Coherent Motion Generation
summary: It is natural for humans to walk and talk simultaneously. This paper tackles the challenge of replicating such natural behaviors in 3D avatar motion generation driven by concurrent multimodal inputs, such as a text description of a man walking alongside speech audio. Existing methods, constrained by the scarcity of aligned multimodal data, typically combine motions from individual modalities sequentially or through weighted sums. However, they often result in mismatched or unrealistic movements. To overcome these limitations, we propose MOCO, a novel diffusion-based framework capable of processing multiple simultaneous inputs, including speech audio, text descriptions, and trajectory data, to generate coherent and lifelike motions without requiring aligned multimodal data. Our key innovation lies in decoupling the motion generation process. During each denoising step, the diffusion model independently generates motions for each modality from the input noise and assembles the body parts according to predefined spatial rules. The resulting combined motion is then diffused and serves as the input noise for the subsequent denoising step. This iterative approach enables each modality to refine its contribution within the context of the overall motion, progressively harmonizing movements across modalities. Consequently, the generated motions become increasingly natural and fluid with each iteration, achieving coherent and synchronized behaviors. We evaluate our approach using a purpose-built multimodal benchmark. Experimental results demonstrate that MOCO outperforms existing baselines, advancing the field of multimodal motion generation for 3D avatars.

AI.tldr: 提出MOCO，一种基于扩散的框架，可在无对齐多模态数据条件下处理语音、文本与轨迹的并发输入，通过解耦式迭代去噪生成连贯自然的3D虚拟人动作。
AI.motivation: 人类能自然地同时行走与交谈，但现有3D虚拟人动作生成方法受限于对齐多模态数据稀缺，通常采用顺序组合或加权求和的方式融合各模态动作，导致生成动作不匹配、不真实。
AI.method: MOCO为核心创新在于解耦动作生成过程：在每个去噪步骤中，扩散模型基于输入噪声为每个模态独立生成动作，并依据预设的空间规则组装身体部位；组合后的动作再被加噪，作为下一步去噪的输入噪声。该迭代机制使各模态在整体动作语境中不断精炼自身贡献，逐步协调跨模态运动。
AI.result: 在专门构建的多模态基准上进行评估，实验结果表明MOCO优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: MOCO无需对齐多模态数据即可实现连贯同步的多模态动作生成，推动了3D虚拟人多模态动作生成领域的发展。

title: Cross-Lingual Clinical Annotation Projection as Constrained Text Generation: A Six-Language Study
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, submitted to journal
summary: Background: To determine whether cross-lingual clinical annotation projection can be formulated as a text-preserving, document-level generative task that produces verifiable character-level annotations for multilingual clinical corpus construction, and to characterize its robustness and computational trade-offs relative to candidate-based projection pipelines. Methods: We developed a constrained LLM projection workflow that inserts entity tags directly into immutable target-language text, followed by deterministic validation and character-offset reconstruction. We evaluated it alongside supervised candidate-span projection and hybrid ML-LLM refinement for transferring Spanish Disease, Symptom, and Procedure annotations into six languages. Evaluation used MultiClinAI gold standard with strict span matching and character-overlap F1 Results: Direct LLM projection achieved the strongest and most consistent performance. GLM 5.2 obtained a mean Strict F1 of 0.9201 across 18 language-entity combinations, while locally deployable Gemma4:31B achieved 0.9133. The best LLM configuration improved Strict F1 over the previous state of the art in all 18 settings, by 0.0564-0.1512, yielding 55,416 grounded mentions with reconstructed offsets. Conclusions: Direct LLM-based projection enables high-quality multilingual clinical annotation transfer and provides a practical approach for extending clinical NLP resources to languages with fewer annotated datasets and language-specific tools. Combined with local inference and deterministic validation, it can substantially reduce expert time and cost for multilingual clinical corpus construction.

AI.tldr: 本文将跨语言临床标注投影建模为保文本、文档级生成任务，通过约束式LLM直接在不可变目标语文本中插入实体标签，并经确定性验证与字符偏移重建，在18个语言-实体组合上取得最优Strict F1（GLM 5.2均值0.9201，本地Gemma4:31B为0.9133），较此前SOTA提升0.0564-0.1512。
AI.motivation: 多语言临床语料构建依赖昂贵的人工标注，且许多语言缺乏标注数据与语言特定工具。作者希望验证：跨语言临床标注投影能否被形式化为一种保文本（text-preserving）、文档级生成任务，从而产出可验证的字符级标注，并刻画其相对候选跨度投影流程的鲁棒性与计算权衡。
AI.method: 提出受约束的LLM投影工作流：将实体标签直接插入不可变的目标语文本，随后进行确定性验证与字符偏移重建。与两种基线并列评测——有监督候选跨度投影、ML-LLM混合精化。任务为把西班牙语的Disease、Symptom、Procedure标注迁移到6种语言；评测采用MultiClinAI金标准，指标为严格跨度匹配与字符重叠F1。
AI.result: 直接LLM投影表现最强且最稳定。GLM 5.2在18个语言-实体组合上平均Strict F1为0.9201，可本地部署的Gemma4:31B为0.9133。最优LLM配置在全部18个设置上均超越此前SOTA，提升幅度0.0564-0.1512，共产出55,416条带重建偏移的落地提及（grounded mentions）。
AI.conclusion: 直接基于LLM的投影能够实现高质量的多语言临床标注迁移，为向标注数据少、语言工具匮乏的语言扩展临床NLP资源提供了可行路径。结合本地推理与确定性验证，可显著降低多语言临床语料构建的专家时间与成本。

title: ReGround: Grounding Reviewer Comments in Multimodal Evidence
summary: Reviewer comments naturally relate to specific parts of the reviewed paper, yet grounding these comments to the underlying evidence is difficult due to long multimodal documents. Existing benchmarks do not capture this setting and largely focus on explicit, information-seeking queries. We introduce ReGround, a large-scale dataset for reviewer comment grounding that links 10,267 reviewer comments to 16,274 evidence in the original anonymous submission of 3,656 papers. We build on a simple observation: author rebuttals often include explicit references to content of the submission used to address reviewer comments, providing a high-precision annotation source. We cast grounding as a retrieval task and evaluate a wide range of retrieval methods. Results show that retrieval over the entire paper content performs poorly, evidence-type inference is a major bottleneck, and multimodal evidence provides complementary signals that text alone misses. Our dataset exposes grounding reviewer comments as a difficult and practically important problem for scientific document understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReGround，一个大规模审稿意见定位数据集，将 10,267 条审稿意见关联到 3,656 篇论文匿名投稿中的 16,274 条证据，并基于作者 rebuttal 中的显式引用进行高精度标注，将定位任务建模为检索并系统性评测多种检索方法。
AI.motivation: 审稿意见通常针对被审论文的具体部分，但在长篇多模态文档中将这些意见定位到对应证据十分困难；现有基准未能捕捉这一场景，且多聚焦于显式、寻求信息类的查询。
AI.method: 作者利用一个简单观察：作者 rebuttal 常显式引用投稿内容以回应审稿意见，从而提供高精度标注来源。据此构建 ReGround 数据集，将 10,267 条审稿意见与 3,656 篇匿名投稿中的 16,274 条证据相连；并将定位任务建模为检索任务，评测多种检索方法。
AI.result: 实验显示，在全篇论文内容上直接检索效果很差；证据类型推断是主要瓶颈；多模态证据可提供纯文本所缺失的互补信号。
AI.conclusion: ReGround 揭示了审稿意见定位是科学文档理解中一个困难且具有实际重要性的问题，为后续研究提供了大规模基准与明确的挑战方向。

title: BruNet: A Cross-Domain Transfer Framework for Bruise Segmentation
summary: Segmenting bruises is a challenging task in medical imaging due to limited data and annotations, diffuse boundaries, and highly variable appearance. In this work, we propose BruNet, a segmentation framework that combines a ViT-based visual encoder (a self-supervised DINOv3 or a pretrained LingBot-Vision backbone) with a SAM-based mask decoder. BruNet is trained on the HAM10000 skin lesion dataset and evaluated on a separate bruise dataset without additional fine-tuning. Although a small number of prior studies have explored machine learning and computer vision for bruise analysis, existing work has primarily focused on detection, classification, or colour analysis rather than pixel-level localisation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to address automatic bruise segmentation. Our results show that BruNet outperforms CNN-based models, state-of-the-art segmentation models, ChatGPT-4o/5-assisted SAM2 zero-shot baselines, and the medical-oriented MedSAM model, demonstrating strong cross-domain generalisation to bruise segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出 BruNet 淤伤分割框架，融合 ViT 视觉编码器与 SAM 掩码解码器，在 HAM10000 上训练、在独立淤伤数据集上零微调评估，性能优于 CNN、SOTA 分割模型、GPT 辅助 SAM2 零样本基线及 MedSAM，是首个自动淤伤分割研究。
AI.motivation: 淤伤分割面临数据与标注稀缺、边界弥散、外观高度多变等困难。既有研究多聚焦淤伤检测、分类或颜色分析，缺乏像素级定位，尚属空白。
AI.method: BruNet 采用 ViT 视觉编码器（自监督 DINOv3 或预训练 LingBot-Vision 主干）结合 SAM 掩码解码器；在 HAM10000 皮肤病变数据集上训练，直接在独立淤伤数据集上推理，无需额外微调。
AI.result: BruNet 优于 CNN 模型、当前最先进分割模型、ChatGPT-4o/5 辅助的 SAM2 零样本基线以及医学导向的 MedSAM，展现出强跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次实现自动淤伤分割，验证了 ViT+SAM 框架在缺乏目标域标注条件下的跨域迁移潜力，为淤伤像素级定位提供了可行方案。

title: BridgeMatch: Conditional Transport Bridges in Matching Matrix Space for 3D Deformable Registration
summary: Reliable matching between partially observed, deforming point clouds requires global context and fine geometric detail. Coarse candidate selection can exclude correct fine-level correspondences. We present \paper, a unified conditional transport framework with the matching matrix itself as the evolving state. Coarse diffusion establishes global matching hypotheses; hierarchy-preserving lifting expands them into a structured high-resolution source. Geometry-conditioned ODE and SDE bridges continue refinement in the complete fine-level candidate space, allowing coarse errors to be corrected. The deterministic endpoint-parameterized conditional flow matching (CFM) design improves matching through iteration, while the SDE forward drift enables effective few-step refinement. Experiments on 4DMatch and 4DLoMatch demonstrate competitive matching and non-rigid registration, with transfer to CAPE and DeepDeform without target-domain training.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的条件传输框架，以匹配矩阵为演化状态，结合粗到细扩散与ODE/SDE桥进行变形点云匹配。
AI.motivation: 部分观测且形变的点云匹配需要全局上下文与精细几何细节，而粗粒度候选选择会排除正确的细粒度对应关系。
AI.method: 以匹配矩阵本身作为演化状态的统一条件传输框架：粗扩散建立全局匹配假设；层级保持提升将其扩展为结构化高分辨率源；几何条件化的ODE与SDE桥在完整细粒度候选空间中继续细化，以修正粗层错误。确定性端点参数化CFM设计通过迭代改进匹配，SDE前向漂移实现少步细化。
AI.result: 在4DMatch与4DLoMatch上展现了有竞争力的匹配与非刚性配准性能，并可无需目标域训练迁移到CAPE与DeepDeform。
AI.conclusion: 该条件传输框架通过粗细协同与桥式细化，兼顾全局假设与细粒度修正，具备良好的泛化迁移能力。

title: Pre- and Post-Treatment Brain Metastases Segmentation Using nnU-Net with Post-Processing for BraTS 2026
summary: Brain metastases exhibit high inter-lesion variability in size, enhancement pattern, and post-treatment appearance, making volumetric segmentation of both pre- and post-treatment cases the central challenge of the BraTS 2026 Task 1 (Brain Metastases). We build a pragmatic pipeline on a 5-fold nnU-Net ResEnc-L ensemble, in which each fold is trained independently for 1,000 epochs with the standard Dice + cross-entropy loss on 1,296 four-modality training cases. This ensemble is followed by a rule-based post-processing cascade tuned for the lesion-wise Dice similarity coefficient (LW-DSC), a detection-oriented metric that behaves very differently from the traditional global Dice. The final pipeline reaches an LW-DSC of 0.733 / 0.751 / 0.713 / 0.549 on the enhancing tumour (ET), tumour core (TC), whole tumour (WT), and resection cavity (RC) sub-regions on the official validation leaderboard. Rather than trusting these leaderboard gains, we audit every post-processing stage with a five-fold out-of-fold (OOF) analysis with no model-training leakage over all 1,296 training cases, scored with the official BraTS evaluation code (BraTS_evaluation): it confirms two stages as robust, per-fold-consistent improvements while the third improves only the leaderboard and does not reproduce out-of-fold. We further provide a mechanistic analysis of the LW-DSC metric that explains why recall-recovering post-processing carries low risk whereas component deletion does not, and we report thirteen negative results spanning loss engineering, alternative backbones, and inference-time settings, several of which run counter to widely held intuitions. Source code is released under Apache-2.0 at https://github.com/hornbeamliu/brats2026-met.

AI.tldr: 基于5折nnU-Net ResEnc-L集成与规则式后处理级联，在BraTS 2026 Task 1脑转移瘤分割中获得LW-DSC 0.733/0.751/0.713/0.549，并通过五折OOF审计甄别稳健改进，同时给出LW-DSC机理分析与十三项负面结果。
AI.motivation: 脑转移瘤在病灶大小、强化模式及治疗后表现上存在高度病灶间异质性，治疗前与治疗后病例的体积分割成为BraTS 2026 Task 1的核心挑战；同时领域内普遍存在仅依据排行榜增益判断方法有效性的做法，缺乏对后处理阶段稳健性的严格验证。
AI.method: 构建务实流水线：5折nnU-Net ResEnc-L集成，每折独立训练1,000个epoch，使用标准Dice+交叉熵损失，训练集为1,296例四模态数据；随后接规则式后处理级联，针对病灶级Dice相似系数（LW-DSC）调优；并用无模型训练泄漏的五折OOF分析（官方BraTS_evaluation代码）审计每个后处理阶段。
AI.result: 官方验证排行榜上，ET/TC/WT/RC子区域LW-DSC分别为0.733/0.751/0.713/0.549；OOF审计确认两个后处理阶段为逐折一致的稳健改进，第三个阶段仅提升排行榜成绩而无法在OOF中复现；此外报告十三项负面结果，涵盖损失函数设计、替代骨干网络与推理时设置，其中多项与普遍直觉相悖。
AI.conclusion: 排行榜增益不可直接采信，需通过无泄漏的OOF审计区分真实稳健改进与偶然提升；对LW-DSC的机理分析表明，恢复召回的后处理风险低，而删除连通分量的操作风险高，为脑转移瘤分割后处理设计提供了可推广的验证范式与经验依据。

title: HGSQ: Heatmap-Guided Sparse Query Detector for Real-Time Aerial Small Object Detection
summary: Real-time aerial small object detection is an important visual signal and image processing problem, requiring a detector to preserve fine-grained localization while avoiding redundant computation on large background regions. This paper focuses on this deployment-oriented aerial/UAV setting rather than claiming a universal detector for all object detection scenarios. Existing Transformer-based detectors provide strong global modeling, but their dense query initialization and multi-layer decoder still spend substantial computation on background tokens, which is inefficient when small objects occupy only sparse image regions. To address this problem, this paper proposes HGSQ, a Heatmap-Guided Sparse Query Detector for real-time aerial small object detection. HGSQ uses a lightweight Heatmap Budget Predictor (HBP) to predict a foreground budget map in a single forward pass. The predicted heatmap is then used by three fixed components: Heatmap-Guided Sparse Query Selection (HSQS), which initializes decoder queries from high-confidence foreground positions; Heatmap-Gated Lite Snake Convolution (HGLSConv), which performs local shape refinement only on heatmap-activated small-object regions; and Adaptive Query-Decoder Budgeting (AQDB), which adjusts the query budget and decoder depth according to the estimated object density. Unlike post-hoc heatmap generation, HGSQ treats the heatmap as a real-time computation budget rather than a visualization map during deployment. Experiments on NWPU VHR-10 and VisDrone2019 show that HGSQ achieves 95.10 mAP50 on NWPU VHR-10 and 54.8 mAP50 on VisDrone2019, while reducing GFLOPs to 48.6 and running at 96.0 FPS on an RTX 4070 under our TensorRT FP16 deployment protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HGSQ，一种热力图引导的稀疏查询检测器，用于实时航拍小目标检测。它通过轻量热力图预算预测器将热力图作为实时计算预算，指导查询初始化、局部形变卷积细化与自适应解码器预算，在 NWPU VHR-10 与 VisDrone2019 上实现高精度与高速度。
AI.motivation: 实时航拍小目标检测需兼顾细粒度定位与避免在大背景区域上的冗余计算。现有 Transformer 检测器的稠密查询初始化与多层解码器会在背景 token 上消耗大量计算，而小目标仅占据稀疏图像区域，导致效率低下。
AI.method: 提出 HGSQ 检测器：使用轻量 Heatmap Budget Predictor（HBP）单次前向预测前景预算热力图；热力图驱动三个固定组件：Heatmap-Guided Sparse Query Selection（HSQS）从高置信前景位置初始化解码器查询；Heatmap-Gated Lite Snake Convolution（HGLSConv）仅在热力图激活的小目标区域进行局部形状细化；Adaptive Query-Decoder Budgeting（AQDB）根据估计目标密度调整查询预算与解码器深度。核心在于将热力图作为实时计算预算而非部署中的可视化图。
AI.result: 在 NWPU VHR-10 上达到 95.10 mAP50，在 VisDrone2019 上达到 54.8 mAP50；GFLOPs 降至 48.6，在 RTX 4070 上按 TensorRT FP16 部署协议达到 96.0 FPS。
AI.conclusion: HGSQ 面向航拍/UAV 部署场景，验证了以热力图引导稀疏查询与自适应计算预算的有效性，在保证检测精度的同时显著降低计算量并实现实时推理。

title: FreeFlow: A Bias-free Hierarchical Transformer for Optical Flow Estimation
summary: Optical flow methods typically rely on task-specific inductive biases, such as correlation volumes, feature warping, and iterative refinement, among others, to reach high accuracy. While effective, such biases constrain the model to predefined heuristics, which can limit its expressivity and lead to more complex pipelines and additional computational cost. We present FreeFlow, a hierarchical transformer built without any flow-specific components, using instead a single feed-forward encoder--decoder. FreeFlow combines three attention variants: window attention for local processing, shifted-window attention for cross-window information exchange, and a global attention operating at a reduced resolution. The resulting architecture scales naturally with model capacity, enabling a consistent accuracy gain from small to large variants. Despite the absence of standard inductive biases, FreeFlow achieves state-of-the-art results on major benchmarks, including Sintel (0.68/1.48 EPE on Clean/Final), KITTI-2015 (3.23 Fl-all), and Spring (3.192 1px), while remaining memory efficient at 1080p inference.

AI.tldr: FreeFlow 提出一种不含光流专用组件的层级式 Transformer 编解码器，通过窗口/移位窗口/降分辨率全局注意力组合，在主要基准上达到 SOTA，并保持 1080p 内存高效。
AI.motivation: 现有光流方法依赖相关性体积、特征 warp、迭代细化等任务特定归纳偏置，虽有效但限制模型表达能力，并导致流程复杂、计算开销增加。作者希望去除这些预设启发式，验证纯前馈层级 Transformer 能否在保持性能的同时简化流程。
AI.method: FreeFlow 采用单一前馈编码器-解码器结构的层级 Transformer，不包含任何光流专用组件；其注意力由三部分组成：窗口注意力用于局部处理，移位窗口注意力实现跨窗口信息交换，降分辨率全局注意力用于全局建模。该架构可随模型容量自然扩展，从较小到较大变体均带来一致的精度提升。
AI.result: 在 Sintel 上达到 0.68/1.48 EPE（Clean/Final），KITTI-2015 上 3.23 Fl-all，Spring 上 3.192 1px；在 1080p 推理下仍保持内存高效，取得主要基准的 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 即使在缺少标准光流归纳偏置的情况下，FreeFlow 仍能取得领先精度，表明任务特定归纳偏置并非实现 SOTA 光流的必要条件；该设计在精度、可扩展性与内存效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Recursive Code World Models: Building Complex Worlds through Recursive Scene Programs
summary: Code world models represent worlds as executable programs, but this representation alone does not determine how to construct a complex world. We introduce Recursive Code World Models (RCWM), a framework for reconstructing complex 3D worlds in code from a single reference image. RCWM couples a Recursive Scene Program (RSP) representation with a construction solver that recursively calls itself. An RSP represents the executable world as compositional scene code, while each solver call follows the same complete process: establish the whole, recursively reconstruct unresolved parts, and revisit the whole to refine their composition. This global-local-global recursion gives fine-scale structures their own perception-and-editing loops while preserving scene-wide geometry and relationships. Reference-aligned views propagate a shared camera projection across levels, while parent revisitation addresses boundaries, spatial relations, and shared errors that emerge after local refinement. A vision-language coding agent directly compares reference images with scene renders to guide refinement, recursive descent, and return. Across complex scenes, RCWM outperforms prior code-based image-to-scene reconstruction methods. Ablation studies further support the benefits of recursive construction and suggest that deeper calls can improve finer-scale reconstruction. RCWM provides a recursive construction principle for building complex executable worlds from visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出递归代码世界模型（RCWM），通过递归调用同一构造求解器，从单张参考图像重建复杂3D可执行场景代码，性能优于既有方法。
AI.motivation: 代码世界模型将世界表示为可执行程序，但仅有该表示无法确定如何构造复杂世界；需解决从单张参考图像重建含细粒度结构与整体几何关系的复杂3D场景的问题。
AI.method: RCWM将递归场景程序（RSP）表示与递归调用自身的构造求解器结合。RSP以组合式场景代码表示可执行世界；每次求解器调用遵循"整体建立—递归重建未解部分—回到整体精修组合"的全局-局部-全局流程。采用参考对齐视图在层级间传播共享相机投影，父级重访处理局部精修后出现的边界、空间关系与共享错误；由视觉-语言编码智能体直接比较参考图像与场景渲染，指导精修、递归下降与返回。
AI.result: 在复杂场景上，RCWM优于先前的基于代码的图像到场景重建方法；消融实验支持递归构造的增益，并表明更深的调用可改善更细尺度的重建。
AI.conclusion: RCWM为从视觉证据构建复杂可执行世界提供了一种递归构造原则。

title: Structural priors for data-efficient language learning
summary: Efficient language learning requires methods to reduce the reliance on large data and computational resources. We investigate structural transfer: First training models on non-language data to induce useful priors for natural language. This approach is a form of weight initialization for multilingual language modeling. We evaluate transfer via next-token-prediction loss, weight shifts in the model, and downstream linguistic benchmarks. Several symbolic data types - notably music, probabilistic grammars, and cellular automata - yield lower language-modeling loss than random initialization. These gains coincide with smaller weight shifts during subsequent language training, suggesting that structural transfer positions models in a more favorable region of the parameter space. However, a lower loss does not translate consistently into better downstream linguistic performance, and transfer from non-language data is less efficient than additional language data. We conclude that non-language data can serve as a partial substitute for language data for the training objective of next-token prediction but does not reliably support broader linguistic generalization.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索"结构迁移"：先用非语言数据（如音乐、概率文法、元胞自动机）预训练模型以诱导有用先验，再迁移到语言建模。结果表明非语言数据能降低下一词预测损失并减小权重漂移，但不稳定地提升下游语言任务表现，且效率低于直接增加语言数据。
AI.motivation: 高效的语言学习需要减少对大规模数据和计算资源的依赖，作者希望探究是否可以用非语言数据作为额外语言数据的部分替代。
AI.method: 采用结构迁移方法：先在非语言数据上训练模型以诱导先验，相当于多语言语言建模的权重初始化策略。通过下一词预测损失、模型权重变化量以及下游语言基准测试来评估迁移效果。
AI.result: 多种符号数据类型——尤其是音乐、概率文法和元胞自动机——带来的语言建模损失低于随机初始化。这些增益伴随后续语言训练中更小的权重漂移，说明结构迁移将模型置于参数空间中更有利的区域。但更低的损失并未稳定转化为更好的下游语言表现，且非语言数据的迁移效率低于额外语言数据。
AI.conclusion: 非语言数据可作为下一词预测训练目标下语言数据的部分替代，但不能可靠地支持更广泛的语言泛化能力。

title: UBone3D: Physics-Rectified Conditional Flow Matching for Anatomical 3D Shape Completion from Ultrasound
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Camera-ready Author Version
summary: Three-dimensional ultrasound (US) is a safe, radiation-free complementary modality to CT and X-rays for longitudinal monitoring, yet its segmentation-derived partial point clouds are extremely artifact-laden. Consequently, it is challenging to recover a clean and complete anatomical structure from such US point clouds. In this paper, we present UBone3D, a novel framework based on physics-rectified conditional flow matching (CFM) that performs point cloud completion directly from partial US observations. UBone3D models deterministic physics artifacts (e.g., surface thickening, streaking, dropouts) via a simulated physics proxy, and introduces test-time physics rectification to steer the shape completion. At inference, the completion is jointly steered by two decoupled forces: (1) anatomical plausibility enforced by a CT-trained generative shape prior, BoneFM, and (2) physics consistency enforced by USimNet in the ultrasound formation space. Extensive experiments on simulated and in-vivo data demonstrate significant improvements in reconstruction accuracy and anatomical fidelity over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出UBone3D框架，基于物理校正的条件流匹配（CFM），直接从部分超声点云完成骨骼解剖结构重建。
AI.motivation: 三维超声是安全、无辐射的纵向监测模态，可作为CT和X射线的补充；但其分割得到的部分点云伪影严重，难以恢复干净完整的解剖结构，因此需要专门的点云补全方法。
AI.method: UBone3D将确定性物理伪影（表面增厚、条纹、缺失）通过模拟物理代理建模，并引入测试时物理校正引导形状补全；推理阶段由两个解耦力共同引导：一是CT训练的生成式形状先验BoneFM所约束的解剖合理性，二是USimNet在超声成像空间中约束的物理一致性。
AI.result: 在模拟数据和活体数据上的大量实验表明，该方法在重建精度和解剖保真度上相较现有基线有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 物理校正的条件流匹配与解耦式双重引导（解剖先验+物理一致性）能有效应对超声点云伪影，实现高质量骨骼点云补全。

title: Harnessing Intrinsic Subject-Aware Attention for Controllable Multi-Subject Video Generation
summary: Multi-subject video generation faces two key challenges: uncontrollable fidelity strength and potential semantic drift. We address these by analyzing the internal mechanisms of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). We found that certain attention blocks naturally form an Intrinsic Spatial Grounding Map (ISGM) that precisely locates reference subjects. Building on this insight, we propose Dual-phase Intrinsic Attention Leveraging (DIAL), a framework that uses these internal signals for both training and inference. In low-noise stages, we use ISGM to guide the attention mechanism, allowing precise control over fidelity strength during inference without retraining. In high-noise stages, we use these same maps to automatically build preference pairs at no additional cost for Reinforcement Learning (RL). This RL procedure effectively anchors the model's attention to reference subjects and mitigates semantic drift. Extensive experiments show that DIAL significantly outperforms baseline models on the OpenS2V-Eval benchmark, consistently improving identity consistency and enabling controllable fidelity strength.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DIAL框架，利用DiT中内在的空间定位图（ISGM）在训练与推理两阶段调控注意力，实现可控保真度强度并缓解语义漂移，在多主体视频生成任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 多主体视频生成存在两大挑战：一是保真度强度不可控，二是潜在语义漂移。作者希望从Diffusion Transformers（DiT）的内部机制出发，寻找可利用的固有信号来同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 作者发现DiT中某些注意力模块会自然形成Intrinsic Spatial Grounding Map（ISGM），可精确定位参考主体。基于此提出Dual-phase Intrinsic Attention Leveraging（DIAL）：在低噪声阶段，用ISGM引导注意力机制，实现推理时无需重训练即可精确控制保真度强度；在高噪声阶段，用相同的图自动构建偏好对，以零额外成本用于强化学习（RL），从而将模型注意力锚定到参考主体，缓解语义漂移。
AI.result: 在OpenS2V-Eval基准上，DIAL显著优于基线模型，一致地提升身份一致性，并实现了可控的保真度强度。
AI.conclusion: 通过挖掘DiT内在注意力信号，DIAL在无需重训练的情况下同时实现了保真度强度可控与语义漂移抑制，验证了利用模型内部机制进行训练与推理协同调控的有效性。

title: Prototype Matters: Modality-unified Prototype Self-distillation for Unsupervised Visible-infrared Person Re-identification
summary: Estimating reliable cross-modality association is crucial to unsupervised visible-infrared person re-ID. While optimal transport is shown to be a practical solution for cross-modality association, it suffers from the rigidness of hard label assignment without considering the impact of cluster noise. Moreover, enforcing only cross-modality contrast is also suboptimal, as it fails to jointly optimize the similarity relation within and across modality. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for cross-modality learning by well exploitation of prototypes: First, instead of contrasting with cross-modality prototypes, we show that modality-unified prototypical contrast facilitates better modality invariance by jointly and simultaneously optimizing similarity relation within and across-modality. Taking self-prototype as a steady teacher, we further refine the instance-prototype online relation through prototype-guided self-distillation. The two components are optimized in a unified framework, leading to a simple yet effective model. On standard VI-ReID benchmarks, we perform extensive comparison and analysis, validating the effectiveness of our proposed method. Code is available at: https://github.com/Terminator8758/PoSeD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PoSeD框架，通过模态统一原型对比与原型引导自蒸馏，联合优化模态内与跨模态相似性关系，提升无监督可见光-红外行人重识别性能。
AI.motivation: 无监督可见光-红外行人重识别依赖可靠的跨模态关联。现有最优传输方法采用硬标签分配，缺乏对聚类噪声的考量，过于刚性；同时仅施加跨模态对比忽略了模态内相似性关系的联合优化，导致性能次优。
AI.method: 提出原型驱动的跨模态学习框架：（1）用模态统一原型对比替代跨模态原型对比，同时联合优化模态内与跨模态相似性关系以增强模态不变性；（2）以自原型作为稳定教师，通过原型引导的自蒸馏在线精炼实例-原型关系；（3）两组件统一优化。
AI.result: 在标准VI-ReID基准上进行大量对比与分析实验，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 模态统一原型对比与原型引导自蒸馏的统一框架简单且有效，为无监督可见光-红外行人重识别提供了新思路。

title: LoopVAE: Recurrent Depth Across Scales for Visual Tokenization
summary: Hierarchical visual tokenizers typically allocate different processing blocks to different spatial scales. We ask how much of this computation can use the same parameters. LoopVAE reuses a scale- and loop-conditioned core within and across scales, while keeping resolution-changing transitions independent. A four-block core executes 28 block applications per encoder or decoder. On ImageNet-256, the 29M-parameter convolutional model reaches 0.28 rFID and 32.54 dB PSNR under an approximately 30-epoch two-stage training budget, using approximately 65% fewer parameters than the 84M reference VAEs. A non-adversarial Transformer ablation with the same execution graph finds competitive PSNR and SSIM under global sharing, although unshared blocks improve LPIPS. Targeted loop interventions show that completing the trained recurrence improves reconstruction and that even small feature updates can have substantial downstream effects. Truncation also exposes output-range errors, distinguishing useful recurrent computation from reliable early exit. Runtime profiling reveals the execution tradeoff: fewer stored weights require more arithmetic and longer runtime in the tested configurations. With convolutional and Transformer operators and single- or multi-resolution latent interfaces, LoopVAE establishes recurrent depth across scales as a parameter-sharing design axis for visual tokenization.

AI.tldr: LoopVAE 提出以“循环共享”为核心的视觉 tokenizer，在尺度内与跨尺度复用同一套尺度-循环条件化核心参数，仅让分辨率变换层独立，用约29M参数在ImageNet-256上达到0.28 rFID与32.54 dB PSNR，参数比84M参考VAE少约65%。
AI.motivation: 分层视觉 tokenizer 通常为不同空间尺度分配不同处理模块，参数量随尺度增长。作者追问：这类计算中有多少可以复用同一组参数，从而在保持重建质量的同时显著压缩参数。
AI.method: 设计 LoopVAE：一个四块（four-block）的尺度与循环条件化核心，在编码器/解码器内按尺度循环复用，每个编码器或解码器执行28次块应用；仅分辨率变化所需的过渡模块保持独立。采用卷积与 Transformer 两种算子、单分辨率与多分辨率潜在接口进行验证，并做非对抗 Transformer 消融与循环干预（完整递归、微小特征更新、截断）实验。
AI.result: ImageNet-256 上 29M 卷积模型在两阶段约30 epoch预算下取得 0.28 rFID 与 32.54 dB PSNR，参数较 84M 参考 VAE 少约65%。非对抗 Transformer 消融在全局共享下 PSNR/SSIM 具竞争力，不共享块则 LPIPS 更好。循环干预显示完成训练递归可提升重建，微小特征更新也会带来显著下游影响；截断会暴露输出范围误差，可区分有效递归计算与可靠的提前退出。运行时剖析表明：存储权重更少但算术量更大、运行时间更长。
AI.conclusion: LoopVAE 在卷积与 Transformer 算子、单/多分辨率潜在接口下均验证有效，确立了“跨尺度循环深度”作为视觉 tokenization 的参数共享设计轴。

title: Breaking the Central Bias: Spatially Partitioned Experts for Coordinate-Based Neuroevolution
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Author's accepted manuscript, accepted at the BIOMAP workshop (BIO-inspired Methods for Pattern Recognition) of ICPR 2026, Lyon, France
summary: Evolvable-Substrate HyperNEAT (ES-HyperNEAT), a bio-inspired indirect encoding that determines neuron placement and connection weights from spatial coordinates, exhibits a failure mode on MNIST as a diagnostic benchmark. Because input pixels map to a coordinate space centered at the origin, evolved networks converge on a small central cluster of input pixels, a spatial-concentration bias; prior work observed only 21% mean accuracy in this regime. Is this bias an optimization artifact or an architectural ceiling? Inspired by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) principles, we partition the input into non-overlapping spatial segments, each assigned to a separately evolved specialist network. With 13 such experts, this design reaches 43% mean accuracy, a 106% relative improvement over the baseline. The architectural gain does not depend on data-driven aggregation: equal-weighted averaging, which uses no validation data, already yields a 70% improvement; the gain comes from partitioning, not the weighting. Receptive-field analysis shows the mechanism: partitioning forces evolution to discover features across the entire image, expanding active pixel coverage from 4% to 79%. Absolute accuracy stays below gradient-trained baselines, but the relative gain points to central bias, not the evolutionary search. Two tools are designed to generalize beyond MNIST: a receptive-field diagnostic for silent input-coverage collapse, and a spatial-partitioning remedy that restores coverage.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究ES-HyperNEAT在MNIST上的失败模式，发现其存在空间集中偏置，并通过空间分区多专家架构缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: ES-HyperNEAT因输入像素映射到以原点为中心的坐标空间，演化网络会收敛到中心的小输入像素簇，产生空间集中偏置，先验工作在此情形下仅得21%平均准确率。作者旨在判断该偏置是优化伪影还是架构上限，并寻找可推广的解决思路。
AI.method: 受混合专家（MoE）原理启发，将输入划分为互不重叠的空间片段，每个片段交由单独演化的专家网络处理；采用13个专家，并对比等权平均与数据驱动聚合；同时进行感受野分析，设计感受野诊断工具与空间分区补救工具。
AI.result: 13专家设计达到43%平均准确率，相对基线提升106%；等权平均（不使用验证数据）即可带来70%提升，说明增益来自分区而非加权；感受野分析显示活跃像素覆盖率从4%提升到79%。绝对准确率仍低于梯度训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 空间集中偏置主要不是演化搜索的问题，而是架构性天花板；空间分区可强制演化发现全图特征并恢复输入覆盖。作者提出可推广到MNIST之外的两项工具：用于检测静默输入覆盖崩溃的感受野诊断，以及恢复覆盖的空间分区补救方案。

title: Learning Interaction between Image and Layout Priors for Joint Image-Layout Generation in Design Templates
comment: Main paper with supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
summary: In this paper, we address the problem of graphic design template creation, which generates a background image and a layout of foreground elements over the background to form a harmonious composition from an input text. Prior work on graphic design generation mostly adopts a sequential paradigm, where design elements are generated sequentially. We argue that such a sequential scheme falls short of faithfully capturing the dependency between the background and layout (and thus the joint image-layout distribution), which limits the quality of generated design templates. To overcome this limitation, we propose a model, InterIL, which jointly generates the two modalities, background image and layout, in a single generative process. The novel design of our joint model connects the backbones of pretrained image and layout diffusion models with a learnable communication module to explicitly model bidirectional image-layout interaction. During training, the image and layout backbones are frozen to maintain and leverage the vast pretrained single-modality prior knowledge, while only the communication module is updated, so that the model can focus on learning image-layout interaction and thereby better capture the joint image-layout distribution for improved composition harmony. Our model has no design-specific inductive bias, which allows it to better preserve the original characteristics of realistic designs. We further introduce a test-time guidance strategy to enable users to impose their specific preferences on generated results. Our experiments show that, compared with prior approaches, our model can generate significantly better results in terms of image, layout and image-layout harmonization, producing outputs closer to real samples. We also demonstrate the flexibility of our model in enforcing user preferences at inference without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 InterIL，一个将背景图像与前景布局在单一生成过程中联合生成的模型，通过可学习通信模块连接冻结的预训练图像和布局扩散骨干，显式建模双向图文布局交互。
AI.motivation: 现有图形设计生成多采用顺序范式，逐次生成设计元素，难以忠实捕捉背景与布局之间的依赖关系（即联合图像-布局分布），限制了生成模板质量。同时，现有方法常引入设计特定的归纳偏置，损害真实设计的原有特征。
AI.method: InterIL 在单次生成过程中联合生成背景图像与布局。核心设计是用可学习通信模块连接预训练图像扩散模型和布局扩散模型的骨干，显式建模图像与布局的双向交互。训练时冻结两个骨干以保留并利用大规模预训练单模态先验知识，仅更新通信模块，使模型专注学习跨模态交互。模型不含设计特定归纳偏置。此外引入测试时引导策略，允许用户在推理阶段施加偏好且无需重训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，与先前方法相比，InterIL 在图像、布局及图像-布局协调性方面均生成显著更优的结果，输出更接近真实样本；并验证了在推理时无需重训练即可灵活施加用户偏好。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模背景与布局的单次生成范式优于顺序范式，能更好地捕捉联合图像-布局分布，从而提升模板构图和谐度并保持真实设计特征。

title: Enabling Vision and Cross-Modal Learning for Multimodal Stroke Recurrence Prediction: An Interpretable Two-Step Framework
comment: ML-CDS 2026: Multimodal Learning and Fusion Across Scales for Clinical Decision Support, MICCAI 2026, Strasbourg, France
summary: Multimodal stroke recurrence prediction requires effective integration of heterogeneous clinical and imaging data, yet modality imbalance often causes models to over-rely on dominant modalities and underutilize complementary information. While self-supervised pretraining and selective parameter freezing are commonly employed to improve representation learning and fine-tuning stability, their effect on modality contributions and cross-modal behavior in multimodal medical models remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate whether image pretraining on 3D CTA scans reduces modality imbalance and improves cross-modal integration for stroke recurrence prediction, a clinically critical task we recently addressed. To this end, two multimodal neural networks are pretrained in a self-supervised manner and subsequently fine-tuned using two distinct freezing strategies. Their performance and modality utilization are compared against both the baseline model from our previous work and models trained entirely from scratch in this study. Our results demonstrate that self-supervised pretraining enables more effective utilization of the multimodal image-tabular dataset, outperforming both the prior baseline and all non-pretrained models. Notably, the best-performing Vision Transformer based neural network successfully overcomes unimodal collapse. Synergy analysis reveals significant interactions between vision and both gender and CHD, suggesting clinically relevant patterns for stroke recurrence. Overall, our findings demonstrate that self-supervised pretraining and strategic fine-tuning support more balanced modality utilization and enable meaningful cross-modal interactions. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/ChristianGappGit/SSL_Pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨自监督图像预训练与选择性参数冻结能否缓解多模态卒中复发预测中的模态失衡，并提升跨模态整合。基于3D CTA与表格数据的多模态网络在两种冻结策略下微调，结果显示预训练模型优于既往基线与全部从头训练模型，最佳ViT克服了单模态坍塌，且视觉与性别、CHD存在显著交互。
AI.motivation: 多模态卒中复发预测需整合异构的临床与影像数据，但模态失衡使模型过度依赖主导模态、忽视互补信息。自监督预训练与选择性参数冻结虽常用于提升表征学习与微调稳定性，但其对多模态医学模型中模态贡献与跨模态行为的影响尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 对两个多模态神经网络在3D CTA影像上进行自监督预训练，随后采用两种不同的参数冻结策略进行微调；将其性能与模态利用情况同既往工作的基线模型及本研究完全从头训练的模型进行对比，并通过协同分析考察视觉与临床变量的交互作用。
AI.result: 自监督预训练使模型能更有效利用多模态影像-表格数据集，性能优于既往基线与全部非预训练模型；表现最佳的Vision Transformer成功克服单模态坍塌；协同分析显示视觉与性别、CHD之间存在显著交互，提示与卒中复发相关的临床意义模式。
AI.conclusion: 自监督预训练结合策略性微调可促进更均衡的模态利用，并促成有意义的跨模态交互。代码已开源于 https://github.com/ChristianGappGit/SSL_Pretraining。

title: Complex-Text Robustness Evaluation and Failure Diagnosis for Low-Resource Multilingual Text-to-Speech
summary: Low-resource multilingual text-to-speech (TTS) systems have expanded language coverage, but their robustness under complex text inputs remains insufficiently diagnosed. Existing evaluations mainly focus on naturalness, speaker similarity, and content consistency using regular test sentences, while providing limited insight into how multilingual TTS systems fail when handling challenging inputs such as numbers, dates, named entities, long sentences, code-switched expressions, and punctuation-related structures. This paper proposes a complex-text robustness diagnosis framework for low-resource multilingual TTS. We evaluate robustness from three dimensions: content consistency, language consistency, and generation stability. A multilingual robustness testing scheme is designed for Thai, Vietnamese, Swahili, and Indonesian, covering ordinary sentences and multiple types of complex text inputs. We further introduce automatic diagnostic metrics, including character error rate, language identification accuracy, and duration abnormal rate. To support input-level risk analysis before speech generation, we propose a lightweight Text Risk Score (TRS), which estimates synthesis risk from interpretable text features without manual annotation or model training. Experiments on three representative multilingual TTS systems, including OmniVoice, VoxCPM2, and MMS-TTS, show that complex text inputs expose systematic failure patterns that are not fully reflected by ordinary short-sentence evaluation. Different systems exhibit distinct vulnerabilities in number normalization, named entity handling, long-text generation, and code-switched input processing. Furthermore, TRS shows a positive correlation with content errors and duration abnormalities, demonstrating its usefulness as a low-cost pre-synthesis indicator for complex-text risk diagnosis in low-resource multilingual TTS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向低资源多语言TTS的复杂文本鲁棒性诊断框架，从内容一致性、语种一致性、生成稳定性三个维度评估，并设计泰语、越南语、斯瓦希里语、印尼语的多语言测试方案与自动诊断指标（CER、语种识别准确率、时长异常率），同时提出无需标注与训练的轻量级文本风险分（TRS）。在OmniVoice、VoxCPM2、MMS-TTS上的实验表明，复杂文本会暴露常规短句评测无法反映的系统性失效模式，且TRS与内容错误和时长异常呈正相关。
AI.motivation: 低资源多语言TTS虽扩展了语种覆盖，但其在复杂文本输入下的鲁棒性诊断不足。现有评测多聚焦自然度、说话人相似度和常规测试句的内容一致性，难以揭示系统在数字、日期、命名实体、长句、语码切换及标点结构等挑战性输入上的失效方式，因此需要专门的复杂文本鲁棒性诊断框架与低成本的预合成风险指示方法。
AI.method: 构建三维度鲁棒性诊断框架（内容一致性、语种一致性、生成稳定性）；针对泰语、越南语、斯瓦希里语、印尼语设计多语言鲁棒性测试方案，覆盖普通句与多类复杂文本输入；引入自动诊断指标，包括字符错误率（CER）、语种识别准确率和时长异常率；提出轻量级文本风险分（TRS），基于可解释文本特征在语音生成前估计合成风险，无需人工标注或模型训练；在三种代表性多语言TTS系统（OmniVoice、VoxCPM2、MMS-TTS）上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，复杂文本输入会暴露系统性失效模式，这些模式未被普通短句评测充分反映；不同系统在数字规范化、命名实体处理、长文本生成和语码切换输入处理上表现出各自不同的脆弱点；TRS与内容错误和时长异常呈正相关，可作为低资源多语言TTS复杂文本风险诊断的低成本预合成指标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低资源多语言TTS提供了面向复杂文本的鲁棒性诊断框架、覆盖四种语言的多语言测试方案、自动诊断指标以及无需训练的轻量级预合成风险指标TRS，揭示并量化了现有系统在复杂输入下的差异化脆弱性，说明仅依赖常规短句评测不足以刻画真实应用中的鲁棒性风险。

title: World in World: Explore the World with World Models
summary: Autoregressive video world models enable interactive, long-horizon exploration, but flexible control remains challenging. Exploring a source video from new viewpoints requires the generated rollout to remain synchronised with the recorded event, place observed content in the requested view, plausibly complete newly exposed regions, and recover previously generated appearance on revisits. Existing methods typically address these requirements through task-specific modules or additional training. We present World in World, a training-free inference-time interface that converts heterogeneous control evidence into camera- and time-labelled clean visual states, which are read through the native self attention of a frozen causal video model. The evidence comprises source-video observations, target-view scene projections, geometry renderings that guide completion of newly exposed subject regions, and retrieved generated states beyond the rolling cache. Each evidence source carries token-level support and its own availability schedule. A correspondence router combines persistent point identities with geometry to establish token correspondences, guiding supported queries towards matching source-video tokens. Evidence-wise attention CFG (EWA) then independently regulates each auxiliary channel's additional contribution using attention responses from the same denoising forward pass. The shared interface supports camera-controlled rerendering, long-horizon revisiting, and human-motion transfer with the same frozen backbone. We evaluate World in World on camera-controlled video rerendering under diverse viewpoint changes, assessing perceptual quality, temporal consistency, and camera-following accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 World in World：一种无需训练的推理时接口，把多源异构控制证据转为相机与时间标注的干净视觉状态，并借冻结因果视频模型的原生自注意力读取，实现相机重渲染、长时程回访与动作迁移。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频世界模型支持交互式长时程探索，但灵活控制困难：新视角生成需与源视频事件同步、把观测内容放到目标视角、合理补全新暴露区域、并在回访时恢复已生成外观。现有方法依赖任务专用模块或额外训练，缺乏统一且免训练的控制界面。
AI.method: 1) 训练无关的推理时接口：将异构控制证据转换为带相机与时间标签的干净视觉状态，经冻结因果视频模型的原生自注意力读取。2) 证据源包括源视频观测、目标视角场景投影、引导新暴露主体区域补全的几何渲染、以及滚动缓存之外的检索生成状态；每源带 token 级支持度与可用性调度。3) 对应关系路由器结合持久点身份与几何建立 token 对应，引导受支持查询匹配源视频 token。4) 证据级注意力 CFG（EWA）利用同一次去噪前向的注意力响应，独立调节各辅助通道的额外贡献。
AI.result: 在相机控制视频重渲染任务、多视角变化下评估，考察感知质量、时序一致性与相机跟随精度；同一冻结骨干支持相机控制重渲染、长时程回访与人体动作迁移。
AI.conclusion: World in World 以统一的免训练推理接口，将多源控制证据注入冻结自回归视频世界模型，实现灵活视角控制与长时程一致性，避免任务专用模块与再训练。

title: A Comparative Evaluation of Pre-trained Convolutional Neural Networks for Melanoma Detection
summary: Early diagnosis of melanoma is critical for improving patient survival rates. However, accurately distinguishing melanoma from other skin lesions remains a significant clinical challenge due to the high visual similarity among lesion types and variability in image acquisition conditions. Artificial intelligence, particularly machine learning, has emerged as a promising tool to support dermatological diagnosis by automating feature extraction from medical images. Among the available approaches, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have demonstrated strong performance in image classification tasks, making them well-suited for analyzing both dermatoscopic and histopathological images, given their ability to capture hierarchical visual patterns relevant to lesion characterization. Nevertheless, despite numerous pre-trained CNN architectures having been proposed, selecting the most appropriate one for a given imaging modality remains an open challenge. In this study, we evaluate pre-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for skin lesion classification using dermatoscopic and histopathological image datasets. Experiments were conducted on the HAM10000, ISIC 2018, and CR-AI4SkIN datasets, evaluating the ResNet50, VGG16, VGG19, MobileNet, and InceptionV3 architectures under the same training protocol. The experimental evaluation showed that the models achieved accuracies ranging from 71% (InceptionV3 on ISIC 2018) to 84% (ResNet50 on HAM10000) on dermatoscopic images. For histopathological images, accuracies ranged from 72% (VGG19) to 83% (ResNet50) on the CR-AI4SkIN dataset. The results demonstrate that model performance differs between dermatoscopic and histopathological image modalities, showing that architectures exhibiting similar performance on dermatoscopic images exhibit different performance on histopathological data.

AI.tldr: 评估五种预训练CNN在皮肤病变分类上（皮肤镜与组织病理图像）的表现，发现模型性能随成像模态不同而变化。
AI.motivation: 黑色素瘤早期诊断对提高患者生存率至关重要，但不同皮肤病变在视觉上高度相似且图像采集条件多变，准确区分仍是临床难题。CNN可自动提取医学图像特征辅助诊断，但预训练架构众多，针对特定成像模态如何选择最合适的模型尚无定论。
AI.method: 在HAM10000、ISIC 2018与CR-AI4SkIN三个数据集上，采用统一训练协议，评估ResNet50、VGG16、VGG19、MobileNet和InceptionV3五种预训练CNN的皮肤病变分类性能，覆盖皮肤镜与组织病理两种成像模态。
AI.result: 皮肤镜图像上准确率为71%（InceptionV3，ISIC 2018）至84%（ResNet50，HAM10000）；组织病理图像上准确率为72%（VGG19）至83%（ResNet50，CR-AI4SkIN）。
AI.conclusion: 模型性能在皮肤镜与组织病理两种模态间存在差异；在皮肤镜图像上表现相近的架构，在组织病理数据上表现不同，说明模型选择需结合具体成像模态。

title: PRISMA-LLM: An Empirical Reporting Framework for AI-Assisted Systematic Reviews
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and AI-enabled software increasingly participate in systematic-review decisions, yet the information needed to audit these workflows is reported inconsistently. We analyze SciLitBench, a corpus of 888 review-automation papers with 14,726 annotations, to characterize changes in methods, review-stage use, evaluation and reported limitations. Automation has shifted toward LLM- and software-facing workflows, including stages that can alter the evidence base. Since 2023, 38.0% of software/product papers reported no evaluation, compared with 9.3% of LLM papers. Reporting coverage increased with LLM workflow complexity, yet 52% of positive-only LLM evaluations still reported an unmet reliability or performance requirement. From these patterns, we introduce PRISMA-LLM, an empirically grounded framework separating implementation disclosure from consequence-sensitive evaluation and limitation reporting.

AI.tldr: 该文基于SciLitBench（888篇综述自动化论文、14,726条标注），刻画方法、评审阶段使用、评估与局限性报告的变化，发现自动化正转向LLM与软件化工作流，软件/产品类论文评估缺失率高，并提出PRISMA-LLM框架以区分实现披露与后果敏感型评估及局限性报告。
AI.motivation: LLM与AI软件日益参与系统性综述决策，但审计这些工作流所需的信息报告不一致，缺乏可比、可审计的报告规范，因此需要刻画现状并建立规范化框架。
AI.method: 构建并分析SciLitBench语料库：888篇综述自动化论文、14,726条标注，刻画方法学、评审阶段应用、评估方式与所报告局限性的历时变化；据此提出PRISMA-LLM框架，将实现披露与后果敏感型评估及局限性报告相分离。
AI.result: 自动化已转向面向LLM与软件的工作流，并覆盖可能改变证据基础的评审阶段；自2023年起，38.0%的软件/产品类论文未报告任何评估，而LLM论文仅9.3%；报告覆盖率随LLM工作流复杂度上升，但仍有52%的“仅报告正面结果”的LLM评估未满足某项可靠性或性能要求。
AI.conclusion: 报告实践随技术路线与工作流复杂度显著分化，软件/产品类工具评估披露严重不足，正面结论常掩盖未达标的可靠性或性能；PRISMA-LLM通过区分实现披露与后果敏感型评估及局限性报告，为可审计的综述自动化研究提供经验性规范基础。

title: Learn the Solid, Not the File: Canonical Inputs for Neural Networks on CAD Boundary Representations
summary: Boundary representation (B-rep) is the standard format used by modern CAD systems for parametric 3D models. It turns out, the exact same solid can be represented by different B-reps: for example, two engineers using different operations, a geometry kernel rebuilding the file, and an export setting repartitioning faces will lead to different B-reps even though the underlying solid remains the same. We show that existing B-rep encoders are not robust to variation in the B-rep with the same solid on perturbations applied to standard benchmarks, naturally occurring variations inherent to CAD software, and differences in how designers model the same part via a human dataset we created in FreeCAD. The performance of popular B-rep encoders often collapses catastrophically. We propose the canonical region graph, an input representation whose nodes, features and coordinate frame are derived from the solid itself and show theoretical invariance guarantees on repartitioning and rigid motions. It matches the strongest baseline on standard benchmarks, and is stable under every perturbation we test.

AI.tldr: B-rep编码器对同一实体的不同B-rep表示不鲁棒，作者提出canonical region graph以实现重划分与刚体运动的理论不变性。
AI.motivation: 现代CAD系统以B-rep作为参数化3D模型的标准格式，但同一实体可由不同B-rep表示（不同操作、几何内核重建、导出设置重新划分面等）。现有B-rep编码器对这种固有变化不鲁棒，性能常出现灾难性下降，这威胁了基于B-rep的深度学习的可靠性。
AI.method: 作者在标准基准上施加扰动、利用CAD软件自然产生的变化，并自建FreeCAD人工数据集（同一零件由不同设计师建模）来揭示现有编码器的脆弱性。随后提出canonical region graph：其节点、特征与坐标系均从实体本身导出，而非依赖B-rep的划分方式，并给出重划分与刚体运动下的理论不变性保证。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，canonical region graph达到最强基线水平；在作者测试的每一种扰动下均保持稳定，而现有流行B-rep编码器的性能往往大幅崩溃。
AI.conclusion: B-rep表示的不唯一性是现有编码器的关键缺陷；从实体本身导出表示（canonical region graph）可在不损失标准基准性能的前提下实现鲁棒性与不变性，为CAD几何深度学习提供了更可靠的表征方向。

title: OmniKVQuant: KV Cache Quantization for Omni-LLMs
summary: As Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) take in audio, video and text together, their KV cache memory cost grows. KV cache quantization is the de facto approach in text-only LLMs, but its application to Omni-LLMs remains unexplored. In this paper, we analyze how TurboQuant, a representative rotation-based KV cache quantization method, behaves on multimodal caches and identify two critical issues: temporal key drift and heterogeneous value geometry. To address these, we propose OmniKVQuant, a training-free framework that (i) sets the key quantization range over each short window of the input stream; and (ii) rotates values separately per modality. On Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni, OmniKVQuant enables 2-bit KV caches while substantially preserving performance across seven audio-visual benchmarks. We further provide a fused Triton decode kernel that unpacks the 2-bit cache during attention, so no dense FP16 cache is ever built. Code: https://github.com/kaistmm/OmniKVQuant

AI.tldr: OmniKVQuant：面向全模态大模型的无训练2-bit KV cache量化框架，通过短窗口键范围与按模态分组的旋转解决多模态缓存量化问题。
AI.motivation: 全模态大模型同时接收音频、视频与文本输入，KV cache 显存开销显著增长。KV cache 量化在纯文本 LLM 中已是主流方案，但其在多模态缓存上的适用性尚未被探索，直接沿用代表方法 TurboQuant（基于旋转的量化）会出现退化。
AI.method: 分析发现两个关键问题：时间维度的键漂移（temporal key drift）与异构的值分布几何（heterogeneous value geometry）。据此提出 OmniKVQuant：(i) 在输入流的每个短窗口上设定键的量化范围；(ii) 按模态分别对 value 做旋转。方法无需训练，并配套融合 Triton 解码核，在注意力计算中即时解包 2-bit 缓存，避免构建密集 FP16 cache。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-Omni 与 Qwen3-Omni 上实现 2-bit KV cache，在七个音视频基准上大幅保持性能。
AI.conclusion: 将 KV cache 量化迁移到全模态场景需针对多模态缓存的时序与模态异质性做专门设计；短窗口键量化与按模态值旋转是有效且免训练的方案。

title: MMGait: Benchmarking and Unifying Gait Recognition across Heterogeneous Modalities
summary: Gait recognition is commonly studied using RGB videos or their derived silhouettes and poses. Yet human walking produces heterogeneous photometric, geometric, and motion cues that cannot be systematically examined with RGB-centered benchmarks. We present MMGait, a large-scale multi-sensor benchmark that brings visible, infrared, depth, LiDAR, and radar observations into sequence-level correspondence. It provides diverse modalities spanning appearance, contours, geometry, motion, and body structure. Under a shared impostor-augmented protocol, we evaluate single-modal recognition, cross-modal recognition via directed retrieval, and multi-modal recognition using task-specific experts. Across settings, modality rankings vary with probe conditions, cross-modal alignment remains difficult, and fusion often provides complementary gains. This analysis exposes a scalability problem: individual modalities, modality pairs, and fusion configurations are typically handled by separately trained experts. We formulate Omni-Modal Gait Recognition, which unifies single-modal, cross-modal, and multi-modal recognition within a shared identity space. OmniGait++ uses modality-specific front ends followed by a shared identity encoder to preserve modality-dependent cues while learning comparable identity descriptors. An anchor-guided fusion module aggregates modality subsets of varying size without frame-level synchronization. A jointly trained checkpoint covers all three recognition settings and accommodates modality subsets of different compositions and cardinalities. Experiments show OmniGait++ remains competitive with task-specific experts in many shared settings and extends to higher-cardinality fusion unavailable to fixed-pair models. The results establish MMGait as a common testbed for heterogeneous gait sensing and demonstrate the feasibility of unified recognition under varying modality availability.

AI.tldr: 提出多传感器步态基准MMGait及统一模型OmniGait++，实现单模态、跨模态与多模态识别的统一。
AI.motivation: 现有步态识别多基于RGB视频或其衍生的轮廓与姿态，无法系统考察人类行走产生的异构光度、几何与运动线索，缺乏以RGB为中心之外的统一评测基准。
AI.method: 构建MMGait大规模多传感器基准，涵盖可见光、红外、深度、LiDAR与雷达，并按序列级对齐，覆盖外观、轮廓、几何、运动与体结构等模态；在统一冒充者增强协议下评测单模态、跨模态（有向检索）与多模态识别。针对每种模态、模态对与融合配置需分别训练专家导致的可扩展性问题，提出Omni-Modal Gait Recognition任务，并用OmniGait++实现：模态特定前端＋共享身份编码器，锚点引导融合模块支持任意子集聚合且无需帧级同步，单一联合训练权重覆盖三种设置。
AI.result: 模态排名随探测条件变化，跨模态对齐仍具挑战，融合常带来互补增益；OmniGait++在多数共享设置下与任务专用专家相当，并可扩展至固定模态对模型无法支持的高基数融合。
AI.conclusion: MMGait可作为异构步态感知的共同测试平台，验证了在模态可用性变化下统一识别的可行性。

title: LangStreet: Persistent Language Fields for Anchor-Decoded Street Gaussians
summary: Language Gaussian fields implicitly assume that the primitive carrying semantics remains identifiable across views. This assumption breaks in scalable anchor-decoded representations, where persistent anchors generate view-conditioned child Gaussians whose geometry and appearance vary with the camera. We introduce Ours, a persistent language field for such structured Gaussian scenes. Our key idea is semantic ownership: transient children route observations, while persistent decoder slots and their parent anchors own the language field. We use alpha-compositing responsibilities to accumulate additive directional evidence at slots; these statistics marginalize exactly to anchors. We then complete weakly supported slots with anchor-aligned evidence while preserving the anchor direction, and represent slot detail through low-rank residuals in anchor-relative semantic coordinates. Our primary model, Ours (base), stores anchor features together with compact slot residuals. Ours (light) retains only anchor features, whereas Ours (max) stores the full-dimensional completed slot features explicitly. Without scene-specific semantic optimization, Ours (base) nearly matches Ours (max) across KITTI, Virtual KITTI, and Waymo. On KITTI, it achieves 34.19 2D mIoU with a 2.72 GiB effective feature footprint, compared with 34.20 mIoU and 12.90 GiB for Ours (max). The same accuracy-storage trend holds on Virtual KITTI and Waymo. These results show that language fields on view-conditioned splats require persistent semantic ownership, conserved evidence, and a hierarchy that balances stability, detail, and representation cost. Our code, checkpoints, and benchmark suite will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出持久化语言场（Ours），通过"语义所有权"机制解决anchor-decoded高斯表示中语义跨视角不可识别的问题，在KITTI等数据集上以极低特征存储实现高精度2D mIoU。
AI.motivation: 语言高斯场隐含假设：承载语义的基元在各视角下保持可识别。但在可扩展的anchor-decoded表示中，persistent anchors生成受视角调节的子高斯（child Gaussians），其几何与外观随相机变化，导致该假设失效。因此需要为这类结构化高斯场景设计一种持久化的语言场。
AI.method: 核心思想是"语义所有权"：瞬态子节点负责路由观测，而持久化的decoder slots及其父anchors拥有语言场。利用alpha-compositing responsibility在slots上累积加性方向证据，这些统计量可精确边缘化到anchors；随后用anchor对齐的证据补全弱支撑slots并保持anchor方向，通过anchor相对语义坐标中的低秩残差表示slot细节。模型分三档：base存anchor特征+紧凑slot残差；light仅存anchor特征；max显式存储全维补全slot特征。
AI.result: 在KITTI上，Ours(base)达到34.19 2D mIoU，有效特征占用仅2.72 GiB；而Ours(max)为34.20 mIoU，占用12.90 GiB。base在无需场景特定语义优化的情况下几乎追平max，且该精度-存储趋势在Virtual KITTI和Waymo上同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 面向view-conditioned splats的语言场需要三点：持久化语义所有权、守恒的证据累积，以及兼顾稳定性、细节与表示成本的层级结构。

title: A Training-Free, Alignment-Free Approach to Corporate Intelligence: Application to SEC Filings
summary: High-dimensional dense text embeddings and large language models face real obstacles in financial-disclosure analysis: context-window limits, hallucination risk, high computational cost, and the arbitrary rotation of vector spaces across independently trained models. We present a training-free, alignment-free framework for corporate intelligence built on deterministic sparse seed vectors. Hashing word strings into a fixed high-dimensional basis places all documents and all temporal epochs in a common coordinate system by construction, removing any need for training or alignment. Accumulating these seed vectors across sentence contexts yields corpus-specific semantic signatures that compose linearly, supporting sub-second document comparison, issuer fingerprinting, tracking of how an issuer's vocabulary shifts between filings, and thematic sentence extraction, all on ordinary CPU hardware. Demonstrating the approach on a multi-year corpus of SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), we show how material corporate events, among them Boeing's 737 MAX crisis, Intel's supply-chain disruptions, and Bunge's acquisition of Viterra, emerge as distinct, interpretable semantic profiles, each traceable to the exact source sentences that produced it, with no domain-specific training and no LLM inference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练、免对齐的确定性稀疏种子向量框架，用哈希将词串映射到固定高维基，使所有文档与时间期处于同一坐标系，通过跨句累加形成可线性组合的语料级语义签名，在普通CPU上实现文件比对、发行人指纹、词汇漂移追踪与主题句抽取。
AI.motivation: 高维稠密文本嵌入与大模型在金融披露分析中面临上下文窗口限制、幻觉风险、算力成本高，以及独立训练模型间向量空间任意旋转、无法直接对齐等现实障碍。
AI.method: 以确定性稀疏种子向量为基础的免训练、免对齐框架：将词串哈希到固定高维基，按构造把全部文档与时间期置于共同坐标系；在句子语境中累加种子向量，得到语料特有的语义签名，并支持线性组合，从而完成亚秒级文档比较、发行人指纹、发行人间词汇迁移追踪与主题句抽取，仅需普通CPU硬件。
AI.result: 在多年SEC申报文件语料（10-K、10-Q、8-K）上验证，波音737 MAX危机、英特尔供应链中断、邦吉收购维特拉等重大公司事件均呈现为独特且可解释的语义画像，且每个画像可追溯到产生它的确切源句，全程无需领域特定训练与LLM推理。
AI.conclusion: 确定性稀疏种子向量可在不训练、不对齐、不用LLM的前提下，为金融披露提供可解释、可溯源、低成本且可线性组合的语义分析路径。

title: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
summary: We present Vidu S2, which comprises Vidu S2-Avatar, a real-time interactive digital-character model, and Vidu S2-Editing, a real-time video editing model. Moreover, we explore the feasibility of real-time spatial video generation for both Vidu S2-Avatar and Vidu S2-Editing. Compared with Vidu S1, Vidu S2-Avatar supports real-time 720p video generation, generation with dynamic references that can be updated at any moment, and stronger instruction following, such as dancing. Vidu S2-Editing supports editing a video stream in real time, including style rendering, clothing replacement, character replacement, and background replacement. Experiments show that Vidu S2 outperforms all baselines. A playable online demo is available at https://vidu.com/vidu-stream.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Vidu S2 系统，包含实时交互数字人模型 Vidu S2-Avatar 与实时视频编辑模型 Vidu S2-Editing，并探索了二者的实时空间视频生成可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有系统（如 Vidu S1）在实时性、动态参考更新和指令跟随能力上存在不足，且实时视频编辑与空间视频生成的需求尚未被充分满足。
AI.method: 提出 Vidu S2，由 Vidu S2-Avatar（实时交互数字人）和 Vidu S2-Editing（实时视频编辑）两个模型构成，并探索两者的实时空间视频生成方案。
AI.result: Vidu S2-Avatar 支持实时 720p 视频生成、可随时更新的动态参考生成以及更强的指令跟随（如跳舞）；Vidu S2-Editing 支持实时视频流编辑，涵盖风格渲染、服装替换、角色替换和背景替换。实验表明 Vidu S2 优于所有基线。
AI.conclusion: Vidu S2 在实时数字人与实时视频编辑任务上全面超越基线，并验证了实时空间视频生成的可行性。

title: GroundBench: A Factorized, Counterfactual Benchmark for Locating VLM Affordance Failures
summary: A companion evaluation found that naming the target part in a manipulation prompt increased action accuracy by 0.32-0.63 across eight vision-language models, with no model outperforming a constant baseline until the part was named. However, naming the part supplies information that a real system must infer, confounding visual grounding, mechanical reasoning, and category-to-action association. We introduce GroundBench, a diagnostic benchmark that separates these explanations through six branch-and-merge conditions, each adding a controlled information bundle, and a counterfactual re-ask targeting a real alternate part visible in the same image. Across three OpenAI models and 1,068 predictions, supplying the target region without its identity leaves action accuracy at or below the 0.53 majority baseline (0.26, 0.26, and 0.53), although the models largely reproduce the supplied region. Supplying identity without location instead yields 0.74, 0.68, and 0.68. Every above-baseline gain in this curated set occurs where the supplied part category itself determines the action. A no-vision control leaves GPT-5's scores unchanged or improved, providing evidence consistent with substantial category-to-action association. GPT-4o mini declines on one condition, so this interpretation is not universal. Adding joint type and motion axis does not improve accuracy across six model-stratum comparisons. On 74 counterfactual pairs from 32 objects, GPT-5 achieves 0.86 pair-weighted compliance with a 0.07 shortcut rate but fails all observed push-to-lift-vertical cases. GroundBench identifies which supplied information changes affordance behavior and tests whether apparently grounded performance can be reproduced through textual shortcuts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GroundBench 诊断基准，通过分支-合并条件设计分离视觉定位、机械推理与类别-动作关联，发现模型性能提升主要来自部件类别与动作的文本关联，而非真正的视觉接地。
AI.motivation: 已有研究发现，在操作提示中命名目标部件可使八个视觉-语言模型的动作准确率提升 0.32–0.63，但命名部件提供了真实系统本应自行推断的信息，从而混淆了视觉接地、机械推理和类别-动作关联三种可能解释，需加以区分。
AI.method: 构建 GroundBench 诊断基准，设计六种分支-合并条件，每种条件只增加一组受控信息包，并加入针对同图中真实备选部件的反事实重问；在三个 OpenAI 模型上共收集 1,068 条预测，并设置无视觉对照与联合类型-运动轴条件进行测试。
AI.result: 仅提供目标区域而不给身份时，动作准确率处于或低于 0.53 多数基线（0.26、0.26、0.53），尽管模型大多能复现所给区域；仅提供身份而不给位置则达到 0.74、0.68、0.68。所有高于基线的增益均出现在所给部件类别本身决定动作的情形。无视觉对照下 GPT-5 分数不变或提高，支持类别-动作关联解释，但 GPT-4o mini 在某一条件下下降，说明该解释并非普遍适用。加入联合类型与运动轴在六个模型-分层比较中均未提升准确率。在来自 32 个物体的 74 对反事实中，GPT-5 达到 0.86 的成对加权合规率与 0.07 的捷径率，但在所有观察到的推-提-竖直案例中均失败。
AI.conclusion: GroundBench 能够识别哪些供给信息真正改变可供性行为，并检验表面上的接地表现是否可通过文本捷径复现，表明现有模型的可供性判断在很大程度上依赖类别-动作关联而非视觉接地。

title: Self-Supervised Cardiac Phase Detection via Single-Parameter Latent Orbits
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the ASMUS workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: Accurate identification of end-diastole (ED) and end-systole (ES) in echocardiography underpins the quantification of ventricular function, yet manual selection of these key frames is subjective and introduces clinically significant inter-operator variability. Recent self-supervised methods either prescribe strict periodic trajectories or learn an unconstrained low-dimensional motion subspace from reconstruction or registration objectives. The former offers interpretability but imposes restrictive assumptions on temporal progression, whereas the latter leaves cardiac phase implicit and ED/ES must be recovered through post-hoc geometric processing of the learned trajectory. We translate the physiological observation that cardiac phase is a one-dimensional signal into a prior by constraining the latent motion component to a single-parameter latent orbit, i.e., a global linear trajectory in latent space indexed by a bounded scalar phase variable. Mapping this variable through a sinusoidal nonlinearity yields an oscillatory motion signal with consistent temporal ordering, enabling direct identification of ED and ES from the learned phase signal. This inductive bias allows the model to capture an interpretable representation of the cardiac cycle, while maintaining flexibility to capture irregular heartbeats. Trained on EchoNet-Dynamic without annotations, our minimal single-parameter cardiac phase model learns an effective latent orbit, significantly improves upon the previous state of the art in ED localisation and matches it in ES localisation while using a more constrained representation and fewer training epochs. This demonstrates that a principled physiological inductive bias can match or exceed the performance of more complex representations. Code is available at: https://github.com/BonniciJ/OrbitalEcho/

AI.tldr: 本文将"心动周期是一维信号"这一生理观察转化为先验，把潜空间运动分量约束为单参数潜轨道，通过学习到的相位信号直接识别ED/ES，在无标注EchoNet-Dynamic上以更简洁表示和更少训练轮次取得优于或匹配SOTA的定位性能。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图中ED和ES的准确识别是心室功能量化的基础，但人工选择关键帧具有主观性并带来显著的观察者间差异。现有自监督方法存在两难：一类规定严格的周期轨迹，可解释性强但对时间进程施加限制性假设；另一类从重建或配准目标学习无约束的低维运动子空间，导致心相位隐含，需通过事后几何处理才能恢复ED/ES。
AI.method: 将心脏相位为一维信号的生理观察转化为归纳偏置：把潜运动分量约束为单参数潜轨道，即潜空间中由有界标量相位变量索引的全局线性轨迹；再将该变量通过正弦非线性映射，得到具有一致时间顺序的振荡运动信号，从而可直接从学习到的相位信号识别ED与ES。该偏置在提供可解释表示的同时保留捕捉不规则心跳的灵活性。在EchoNet-Dynamic上无标注训练。
AI.result: 极简的单参数心相位模型学到了有效的潜轨道，在ED定位上显著优于此前最先进方法，在ES定位上与之持平，同时使用了更受约束的表示和更少的训练轮次。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，有原则的生理归纳偏置能够匹配甚至超越更复杂表示的性能。代码见 https://github.com/BonniciJ/OrbitalEcho/。

title: Task-Based CT Protocol Optimization Using Reinforcement Learning and Virtual Imaging Trials
summary: Protocol optimization in computed tomography (CT) aims to improve diagnostic image quality while reducing radiation dose, but the interdependence of acquisition and reconstruction parameters makes exhaustive testing impractical. We propose a virtual imaging trial framework with reinforcement learning for efficient CT protocol optimization. Sixty-three computational human models with liver lesions were imaged using a validated CT simulator across 468 combinations of acquisition and reconstruction parameters, including tube voltage, tube current, reconstruction kernel, slice thickness, and pixel size. The optimization objective balanced liver lesion detectability, quantified by detectability index d-prime, against radiation dose. A Proximal Policy Optimization agent was trained and conditioned on patient-specific CT localizer embeddings derived from a pretrained vision transformer. On held-out patients, evaluating only 8 protocols per patient, about 2% of exhaustive testing, recovered 98.2% of the exhaustive-search oracle objective. With no patient-specific simulation, surrogate scoring alone achieved 89.7% recovery. Conditioning on the localizer improved zero-simulation recovery by 10.7 percentage points over the localizer-blind policy (paired 95% CI 2.9-19.5; p=0.02). These results show that the proposed framework can substantially reduce exhaustive protocol testing while enabling task-based, dose-aware protocol selection before the diagnostic scan.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出结合虚拟成像试验与强化学习的CT协议优化框架，在63个人体模型和468种参数组合上训练PPO智能体，仅评估约2%的协议即可恢复98.2%的穷举搜索最优目标值。
AI.motivation: CT协议优化需在提升诊断图像质量的同时降低辐射剂量，但采集参数与重建参数相互依赖，导致穷举测试在实际中不可行，亟需高效的协议搜索方法。
