AI.method: 构建虚拟成像试验框架：使用经验证的CT模拟器对63个带肝脏病灶的计算人体模型，在468种采集与重建参数组合（管电压、管电流、重建核、层厚、像素尺寸）下成像；优化目标为病灶可检测性（可检测性指数d-prime）与辐射剂量的平衡；训练以预训练视觉Transformer提取的患者特异性CT定位像嵌入为条件的PPO智能体。
AI.result: 在留出患者上，每例仅评估8种协议（约为穷举测试的2%）即恢复穷举搜索oracle目标的98.2%；无患者特异性模拟时，仅靠代理评分恢复89.7%；以定位像为条件相较盲策略将零模拟恢复率提升10.7个百分点（配对95% CI 2.9–19.5；p=0.02）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可大幅减少穷举协议测试，并支持在诊断扫描前进行基于任务、剂量感知的协议选择。

title: Multimodal Taxonomic Conditioning for Generative Plankton Imagery
comment: European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2nd Workshop on Marine Vision
summary: Automated plankton imaging produces severely long-tailed datasets, where the rare taxa of greatest ecological interest have too few images to train or evaluate classifiers reliably. We generate synthetic plankton imagery conditioned on taxonomy: a CLIP encoder is adapted on a large plankton corpus with a ranked contrastive objective extended to deep, ragged taxonomies, then frozen to condition a parameter-efficient diffusion transformer. We evaluate synthetic sample quality on distributional fidelity and downstream classifier utility.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自动浮游生物成像数据的长尾分布问题，提出基于分类学条件生成合成图像的方法：先用排序对比目标在大型语料上适配CLIP编码器（支持深层不规则分类体系）并冻结，再以之条件化参数高效扩散Transformer生成合成浮游生物图像；从分布保真度和下游分类器效用两方面评估合成样本质量。
AI.motivation: 自动浮游生物成像数据集呈现严重长尾分布，生态学上最受关注的稀有类群图像过少，无法可靠训练或评估分类器。因此需要生成以分类学为条件的合成浮游生物图像，以缓解稀有类样本稀缺问题。
AI.method: 1）将CLIP编码器在大型浮游生物语料上进行适配，采用扩展至深层、不规则（ragged）分类体系的排序对比目标（ranked contrastive objective）；2）冻结该编码器，用于条件化一个参数高效的扩散Transformer（diffusion transformer），生成以分类学为条件的合成浮游生物图像。
AI.result: 从两个维度评估合成样本质量：分布保真度（distributional fidelity）与下游分类器效用（downstream classifier utility）。
AI.conclusion: 以分类学为条件的生成式方法可生成用于浮游生物长尾数据集的合成图像，其质量通过分布保真度和下游分类效用进行评估，为稀有类群分类器的训练与评估提供数据补充途径。

title: Single-Stream Multi-Feature Fusion with Temporal Robustness for Gait Emotion Recognition
comment: Accepted at the 35th International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks (ICANN 2026)
summary: 3D skeleton-based gait emotion recognition faces high annotation costs, data scarcity, and poor generalization on heterogeneous data. This paper proposes SV-GCN, a single-stream multi-feature fusion framework with temporal invariance. We introduce intra-frame relative motion features to eliminate frame-rate sensitivity and embed heterogeneous cues at shallow layers, enabling early fusion without multi-stream complexity. For variable-length sequences, we design a global mask-guided valid-frame spatio-temporal graph convolution module, introducing frame-rate insensitivity for the first time in this domain. On the E-Gait dataset, our method achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art while demonstrating strong generalization across varying sequence lengths and frame rates, offering a viable pathway for pre-training on large-scale skeleton-based action recognition datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出SV-GCN单流多特征融合框架，引入帧内相对运动特征与全局掩码引导的有效帧时空图卷积模块，实现步态情感识别的时序不变性与强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 3D骨架步态情感识别面临标注成本高、数据稀缺，且在异构数据上泛化能力差的问题；同时现有方法多依赖多流结构与固定长度输入，对帧率和序列长度变化敏感。
AI.method: 提出单流多特征融合框架SV-GCN：(1) 设计帧内相对运动特征以消除帧率敏感性；(2) 在浅层嵌入异构线索，实现早期融合，规避多流复杂度；(3) 针对变长序列设计全局掩码引导的有效帧时空图卷积模块，首次在该领域引入帧率不敏感性。
AI.result: 在E-Gait数据集上取得与当前最优方法相当的性能，并在不同序列长度与帧率下展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SV-GCN为在大规模骨架动作识别数据集上进行预训练提供了可行路径，有望缓解步态情感识别领域标注成本高与数据稀缺的问题。

title: Structured Transforms for Low-Overhead Quantization of Language Models
summary: We revisit Kashin-decomposition-based weight quantization for large language models and propose an improved algorithm with stronger convergence properties and structured, efficient orthogonal transforms. The method retains the core factorization of each weight into two components -- one with bounded infinity norm and the other with bounded infinity norm after an orthogonal transformation -- but replaces the dense random orthogonal matrix with a sign-randomized Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), reducing the per-iteration cost from $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ to $\mathcal{O}(N \log N)$. The proposed greedy algorithm with alternating updates guarantees the four-peak distribution required for stable 2-bit clustering of each factor and admits closed-form initialization of cluster centers, removing the multi-restart k-means bottleneck of prior work. Composed with OPTQ-style sequential error compensation and QuIP-style incoherence preprocessing, the resulting JAX pipeline is competitive with OPTQ, QuIP, QuIP-RG and a fine-tuning- and vector-quantization-free variant of QuIP# at 4-bit per channel on OPT, Llama-2 and Pythia, with favorable wall-clock scaling. The bounded-$\ell_\infty$ factorization is also notably robust: on stress configurations where QuIP variants diverge to four-digit perplexity (Pythia-6.9B) or abort with NaNs in LDL back-substitution (Mistral-7B), Kashin-DCT remains numerically stable and stays close to FP16 baseline. At inference time, each weight decomposes into two 2-bit factor codes per channel that are structurally suited to native-2-bit hardware.

AI.tldr: 该论文改进Kashin分解权重量化，用符号随机DCT替换稠密正交矩阵，将每迭代代价从O(N²)降至O(N log N)，并消除k-means多重重启瓶颈，实现稳定高效的2-bit量化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Kashin分解的LLM权重量化方法存在两个主要问题：稠密随机正交矩阵导致每迭代计算代价高达O(N²)，以及依赖多重重启k-means聚类造成瓶颈。因此作者希望提出收敛性更强、变换结构更高效的改进算法。
AI.method: 保留将权重分解为两个分量（一个无穷范数有界，另一个经正交变换后无穷范数有界）的核心框架，但用符号随机化的离散余弦变换(DCT)替代稠密随机正交矩阵，把每迭代代价从O(N²)降到O(N log N)。采用交替更新的贪心算法，保证稳定2-bit聚类所需的四峰分布，并给出聚类中心的闭式初始化，从而去掉k-means多重重启瓶颈。再结合OPTQ式顺序误差补偿与QuIP式非相干预处理，形成JAX流水线。
AI.result: 在OPT、Llama-2和Pythia上以4-bit每通道配置下，该流水线与OPTQ、QuIP、QuIP-RG以及无微调和无矢量量化的QuIP#变体具有竞争力，且墙钟时间扩展性更优。在压力配置下表现稳健：QuIP变体在Pythia-6.9B上困惑度发散至四位数、在Mistral-7B上LDL回代出现NaN而中止，而Kashin-DCT保持数值稳定并接近FP16基线。
AI.conclusion: Kashin-DCT通过结构化高效正交变换与闭式聚类初始化，在保持量化精度的同时显著降低计算开销并提升数值稳定性。推理时每个权重按通道分解为两个2-bit因子编码，结构上适配原生2-bit硬件。

title: Negative Self-Distillation: Learning to Reason by Avoiding Flaws
summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a popular paradigm for large language model (LLM) self-improvement, allowing models to act as their own teachers by leveraging privileged information such as ground-truth solutions. However, recent findings indicate that OPSD can severely degrade the performance of LLMs on complex reasoning tasks: By forcing the student to imitate an artificially confident reasoning trace conditioned on privileged information, OPSD inadvertently suppresses expressions of uncertainty and penalizes the exploratory, self-corrective behaviors required to solve challenging problems. To address this, we introduce Negative Self-Distillation (NSD), a new framework that optimizes LLMs by diverging from flawed reasoning rather than imitating privileged solutions. Instead of relying on ground-truth answers or external supervision, NSD uses the model itself to generate a question-specific negative condition (eg, acting as a ``careless reasoner'') and pushes the student's distribution away from this self-generated negative teacher. Naively applying unlearning objectives to achieve this divergence is problematic, as flawed reasoning tokens are confounded with basic linguistic tokens; indiscriminately penalizing both risks catastrophically degrading the model's foundational language capabilities. We resolve this by designing a dynamic gating mechanism that automatically identifies and isolates reasoning-critical tokens, ensuring gradient updates target only behavioral flaws while preserving the model's linguistic priors. Empirically, NSD consistently outperforms OPSD and other label-free, self-bootstrapping reinforcement learning (RL) baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Negative Self-Distillation（NSD）框架，通过让模型远离自生成的"负向教师"（如"粗心的推理者"）来优化LLM，并用动态门控机制隔离推理关键token，避免损害基础语言能力，在复杂推理任务上优于OPSD及无标签自举RL基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 On-Policy Self-Distillation（OPSD）范式让模型以特权信息（如标准答案）充当自身教师，但在复杂推理任务上会严重退化性能：强制学生模仿基于特权信息构建的"人为自信"推理轨迹，会抑制不确定性的表达，并惩罚解决难题所需的探索性与自我纠错行为。
AI.method: 提出 NSD：不依赖标准答案或外部监督，而是用模型自身生成问题特定的负向条件（如扮演"粗心的推理者"），并将学生分布推离该自生成负向教师。针对直接套用遗忘目标会将缺陷推理token与基础语言token混淆、从而破坏语言能力的问题，设计了动态门控机制，自动识别并隔离推理关键token，使梯度更新仅针对行为缺陷。
AI.result: 实验表明，NSD 一致优于 OPSD 以及其他无标签、自举式强化学习（RL）基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过"远离缺陷推理"而非"模仿特权解"的自蒸馏范式，并借助动态门控保护语言先验，NSD 为LLM自我改进提供了一种更稳健的路径。

title: Spectral Adapters for Segment Anything Model-based Segmentation of Colorectal Liver Metastases in Computed Tomography
summary: Accurate segmentation of colorectal liver metastases (CRLM) in contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) is important for response assessment, surgical planning, and follow-up. We propose two parameter-efficient spectral adapters for the Segment Anything Model (SAM): the Directional Spectral Adapter (DiSECT) and Spectral Instance-Guided Adapter (SiGA). DiSECT uses singular value decomposition of frozen weights to constrain residual updates to leading spectral directions, while SiGA adds global and input-conditioned gating through a multilayer perceptron. We evaluate these methods on 446 contrast-enhanced CT volumes (355 training, 91 testing) and compare them with LoRA, QLoRA, convolutional adapters (CAD), and a 3D nnU-Net baseline. Experiments consider single-point, three-point, bounding-box, and no-prompt regimes. SiGA achieves the best single-point performance with a Dice score of 0.77, IoU of 0.69, and HD95 of 35.39 mm. Under no-prompt inference, SiGA reaches 0.76 Dice, 0.68 IoU, and 46.76 mm HD95, comparable to the nnU-Net baseline (0.758 Dice). DiSECT uses only 0.14 million trainable parameters. These results show that spectral adapters can efficiently adapt SAM for CRLM segmentation while retaining strong accuracy with limited trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种参数高效的光谱适配器DiSECT与SiGA，用于将SAM适配于结直肠癌肝转移（CRLM）CT分割，在单点与无提示设定下取得与nnU-Net相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 对比增强CT中CRLM的精确分割对疗效评估、手术规划与随访至关重要；但直接微调SAM成本高，需在有限可训练参数下实现高效适配。
AI.method: 提出DiSECT与SiGA两种光谱适配器：DiSECT对冻结权重做奇异值分解，将残差更新约束到主导光谱方向；SiGA在此基础上通过多层感知机加入全局与输入条件门控。在446例增强CT（355训练/91测试）上评估，对比LoRA、QLoRA、卷积适配器（CAD）及3D nnU-Net，考察单点、三点、边界框与无提示四种提示模式。
AI.result: SiGA单点提示表现最佳：Dice 0.77、IoU 0.69、HD95 35.39 mm；无提示推理下Dice 0.76、IoU 0.68、HD95 46.76 mm，与nnU-Net（0.758 Dice）相当。DiSECT仅需0.14M可训练参数。
AI.conclusion: 光谱适配器能以极少可训练参数高效地将SAM适配于CRLM分割，并在多种提示设定下保持强精度，为参数高效医学图像分割提供可行方案。

title: Language-Augmented Semantic Priors for B-Spline Surface Fitting
summary: The use of B-splines and Non-Uniform Rational B-Splines surfaces constitutes the mathematical foundation of contemporary computer-aided design (CAD) systems. Despite long-term progress, geometric kernels in traditional CAD still rely heavily on predetermined heuristic initialization for surface fitting and parameterization. Meanwhile, the procedural semantics and design intent encoded in modeling histories are largely ignored during geometry generation. This disconnect creates a gap between high-level design intent and solver-executable geometric configuration, often leading to suboptimal and semantically inconsistent fitting results. To bridge this gap, we introduce LASP, a Language-Augmented Semantic Priors framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to infer structured, solver-usable B-spline priors from procedural modeling histories. Rather than modifying the geometric kernel itself, LASP operates as a semantic reasoning layer above existing solvers. It first translates modeling histories into rich textual descriptions that capture design intent, geometric context, and functional relationships, and then uses a fine-tuned LLM to predict structured B-spline prior parameters. LASP is trained through a two-stage scheme that combines local geometric regularities with long-range contextual dependencies, producing priors that are both interpretable and semantically coherent. This approach furnishes inductive signals that direct the conventional B-spline fitting process toward solutions that more accurately encapsulate the intended design objectives and demonstrate heightened semantic coherence. Compared to traditional machine learning schemes, the experiments demonstrate that language-driven reasoning can serve as a powerful inductive bias for geometric solving, establishing a new paradigm of language-guided geometric optimization in modern CAD systems.

AI.tldr: 提出LASP框架，用大语言模型从建模历史中推断结构化B样条先验，作为几何求解的语义推理层，提升拟合的语义一致性与设计意图表达。
AI.motivation: 传统CAD几何内核的曲面拟合与参数化高度依赖预设的启发式初始化，且建模历史中编码的过程语义与设计意图在几何生成时被忽视，导致高层设计意图与求解器可执行的几何配置之间存在鸿沟，拟合结果次优且语义不一致。
AI.method: LASP作为位于现有求解器之上的语义推理层，不修改几何内核。首先将建模历史转译为富含设计意图、几何语境与功能关系的文本描述，再用微调后的大语言模型预测结构化的B样条先验参数；采用两阶段训练方案，融合局部几何规律与长程上下文依赖，使先验兼具可解释性与语义连贯性。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比传统机器学习方案，语言驱动的推理可作为几何求解的强大归纳偏置，使传统B样条拟合过程更准确地体现预期设计目标，并展现更高的语义连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了语言引导的几何优化新范式，为现代CAD系统中弥合设计意图与几何求解之间的鸿沟提供了可行路径。

title: Why Does Post-Training Quantization Work?
summary: Post-training quantization compresses large language models (LLMs) by storing their weights at reduced precision, and each quantized weight introduces an error into the hidden states. Naively, these errors should accumulate with depth and corrupt next-token prediction; randomly initialized models accumulate these discrepancies rapidly, whereas quantized pretrained models accumulate much less hidden-state error and largely maintain downstream task performance, even though they were never trained with quantization noise. This raises the question we address: why does post-training quantization work? Comparing full-precision and quantized forward passes, we identify two mechanisms that characterize pretrained quantization robustness. First, the error a layer newly introduces tends to oppose the error it inherits from the layer's input. The two cancel partially such that the discrepancy between full-precision and quantized passes grows slowly. This counteracting residual interaction develops during pretraining. Our quantitative analysis identifies it as a major factor slowing hidden-error growth. Second, LM-head geometry preferentially preserves the scores and probabilities of high-ranked tokens, which typically represent the model's most confident predictions. Together, these mechanisms explain why quantization error that passes through numerous layers can still produce only small output changes, and we verify the findings across models and quantization settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究并解释了一个反直觉现象：训练后量化（PTQ）虽向每层权重注入误差，但量化后的预训练LLM仍能保持下游任务性能。作者识别出两个机制来解释这种鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 训练后量化会在每层引入权重误差，直觉上这些误差应随深度累积并破坏下一词预测。但实验观察相反：随机初始化模型误差快速累积，而量化后的预训练模型隐藏状态误差增长缓慢、性能基本保持，尽管它们从未在量化噪声下训练过。这一矛盾促使作者追问：为什么训练后量化有效？
AI.method: 通过对比全精度与量化前向传播，作者分析预训练模型的量化鲁棒性来源：(1) 逐层分析新引入误差与继承误差之间的关系；(2) 分析LM-head的几何结构对输出分布的影响；并在多个模型和量化设置下验证。
AI.result: 发现两个机制：其一，某层新引入的误差倾向于对抗其从输入继承的误差，二者部分抵消，使全精度与量化传播间的差异增长缓慢；该"反作用残差交互"在预训练过程中形成，定量分析表明它是减缓隐藏误差增长的主要因素。其二，LM-head的几何结构优先保留高排名token的分数与概率，而这些通常代表模型最有信心的预测。
AI.conclusion: 这两个机制共同解释了为何经过多层传播的量化误差仍只产生很小的输出变化，且该结论在多种模型和量化设置下得到验证。

title: MC-DeTra: Motion-Consistent Joint Object Detection and Socially-Aware Trajectory Forecasting in Bird's-Eye-View Images
summary: Unified models for object detection and trajectory forecasting aim to merge perception and prediction for autonomous driving, refining actor trajectories directly over shared bird's-eye-view (BEV) images rasterized from LiDAR and high-definition maps. Their accuracy on dynamic, moving actors, however, remains the hardest part of the task, and the strongest such model, DeTra, has no public implementation. We contribute an openly released DeTra reimplementation with documented approximations, and on top of it MC-DeTra: a family of motion-consistency mechanisms that add supervision through two annotation-derived auxiliary signals -- each actor's observed past motion and the occupancy of the surrounding traffic that forms its social context -- and one inter-output consistency constraint that aligns an actor's predicted heading with its predicted direction of motion. Every proposed loss is train-only and inference-safe: it shapes the shared BEV representation during training and is removed at test time, adding no inference latency. On the Waymo Open Dataset, evaluated under a strict, detection-conditioned forecasting protocol, MC-DeTra improves dynamic, socially-situated trajectory forecasting while preserving or improving detection accuracy; a gradient-based loss-calibration analysis exposes how the auxiliary objectives compete at the shared backbone, and our ablation identifies which signals contribute most. We release code, configurations, and evaluation tooling at https://github.com/diuzhevVlad/MC-DeTra.

AI.tldr: 该论文公开复现了DeTra（统一检测与轨迹预测模型），并提出MC-DeTra：一组训练期运动一致性机制，通过辅助损失监督共享BEV表征，在不增加推理延迟的前提下提升动态目标轨迹预测。
AI.motivation: 统一检测与轨迹预测模型直接在共享BEV图像上优化目标轨迹，但动态运动目标的精度最难提升，且最强模型DeTra未公开实现，阻碍了可复现与后续研究。
AI.method: 贡献一个公开复现的DeTra实现（记录近似之处），并在此基础上提出MC-DeTra：引入两类由标注导出的辅助监督信号——目标观测到的历史运动、周围交通占据形成的社会语境——以及一个输出间一致性约束（预测朝向与预测运动方向对齐）。所有损失仅训练期使用，测试时移除，不增加推理延迟。
AI.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上，采用严格的检测条件化预测协议评估，MC-DeTra提升了动态且具社会情境的轨迹预测，同时保持或改善检测精度；基于梯度的损失校准分析揭示了辅助目标在共享骨干上的竞争关系，消融实验识别出贡献最大的信号。
AI.conclusion: 训练期一致性监督可有效增强统一BEV模型对动态目标的预测能力，且无推理代价；公开的代码、配置与评测工具为后续研究提供了可复现基线。

title: Revisiting Avatar-As-Image: High-Fidelity Registration is All You Need
summary: The representation of 3D clothed humans as standardized 2D UV texture and displacement maps over an underlying body model has long been studied. This compact representation is enticing as it enables pretrained image networks to process, generate, and edit 3D avatars, but is only useful if scans are accurately aligned and brought into correspondence via high-fidelity registration. This prerequisite has never been met, which we argue explains the limited quality of prior UV-based methods for clothed humans. Despite its significance, no public method produces high-fidelity SMPL(-X)+D registrations with UV texture from arbitrary clothed scans. We present AvaImg, a multi-stage optimization pipeline, to close this gap: it enforces body-inside-clothing constraint via signed winding numbers, made viable by a three-level efficiency cascade (~10x runtime reduced, ~95% storage saved), and recovers fine surface detail using coarse-to-fine displacement optimization. AvaImg outperforms all baselines in body fitting, shape estimation, and surface registration across six datasets, yielding textured registrations near-indistinguishable from scans (PSNR=34.48dB). For validation of AvaImg's Avatar-as-Image representation as imminently compatible with image foundation models, we auto-encode our UV maps via the frozen FLUX VAE. This achieves only 0.76mm added Chamfer error relative to scan and shows that the resulting maps lie within natural-image distributions, supporting the use of 2D generative priors for 3D avatar generation. Code, data, and Singularity containers will be at https://yuxuan-xue.com/avaimg.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AvaImg，一个多阶段优化管线，用于从任意着装三维扫描中生成高保真 SMPL(-X)+D（含UV纹理）配准结果，并通过实验验证其作为“Avatar-as-Image”表示可与图像基础模型兼容。
AI.motivation: 将三维着装人体表示为标准化的二维 UV 纹理与位移贴图（基于底层人体模型）长期被研究，该紧凑表示可借助预训练图像网络处理、生成和编辑三维虚拟形象；但前提是扫描需通过高保真配准实现准确对齐与对应。然而这一前提从未被满足，作者认为这正是以往基于 UV 的方法质量受限的原因。目前尚无公开方法能从任意着装扫描生成高保真且带 UV 纹理的 SMPL(-X)+D 配准结果。
AI.method: AvaImg 采用多阶段优化管线：通过有符号环绕数（signed winding numbers）施加“人体位于衣物内部”约束，并借助三级效率级联使其可行（运行时间约减少 10 倍，存储节省约 95%）；使用由粗到细的位移优化恢复精细表面细节。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上，AvaImg 在人体拟合、形状估计与表面配准方面均优于所有基线，生成的带纹理配准结果与扫描几乎难以区分（PSNR=34.48dB）。为验证 “Avatar-as-Image” 表示与图像基础模型的兼容性，作者通过冻结的 FLUX VAE 自动编码其 UV 贴图：相对扫描仅增加 0.76mm 的 Chamfer 误差，并表明所得贴图落在自然图像分布内，支持将二维生成先验用于三维虚拟形象生成。
AI.conclusion: AvaImg 弥补了从任意着装扫描获得高保真 SMPL(-X)+D 配准及 UV 纹理的空白，在多项任务与数据集上取得领先性能；其 UV 表示与图像基础模型兼容，为利用二维生成先验进行三维虚拟形象生成提供了支持。代码、数据与 Singularity 容器将公开。

title: The Eloquence submission for Task 2 of the Interspeech 2026 MLC-SLM challenge
summary: This paper details the Eloquence team's approach to Task 2 of the 2nd MLC-SLM challenge at Interspeech 2026, which involves multilingual Multiple-Choice Question Answering (MCQA) across 21 languages. Three approaches are explored. First, we fine-tune Voxtral-Mini-3B via LoRA with cross-lingual data augmentation, ASR transcript augmentation and timestamp-aware audio cropping, achieving 0.72 macro-accuracy on evaluation Phase 2. Second, we apply multimodal in-context learning (ICL) to the frozen Voxtral-24B model to correct a strong label bias, reaching 0.81, our best result. Third, a training-free retrieval system based on a three-layer voice-anchored memory combining acoustic identity, semantic content, and a knowledge graph achieves 0.68. All three systems substantially outperform the official baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Eloquence团队参加Interspeech 2026第二届MLC-SLM挑战赛Task 2的方案，该任务为覆盖21种语言的多语言选择题问答（MCQA）。团队探索了三种方法，最优方案在多模态上下文学习下取得0.81宏平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 多语言语音-语言模型场景下的MCQA面临跨语言迁移、标签偏置以及声学与语义信息对齐等挑战，需探索能有效利用语音与语言模态的建模与推理方案。论文旨在通过多种技术路线提升多语言MCQA性能并超越官方基线。
AI.method: 三种方法：(1) 基于LoRA对Voxtral-Mini-3B微调，结合跨语言数据增强、ASR转写增强与时间戳感知音频裁剪；(2) 对冻结的Voxtral-24B进行多模态上下文学习（ICL），并纠正强标签偏置；(3) 免训练检索系统，采用三层语音锚定记忆，融合声学身份、语义内容与知识图谱。
AI.result: 方法一在评测Phase 2取得0.72宏平均准确率；方法二（多模态ICL）达0.81，为最佳结果；方法三免训练检索系统取得0.68。三种系统均显著优于官方基线。
AI.conclusion: 多模态上下文学习配合标签偏置纠正在多语言MCQA中效果最佳，微调与免训练检索亦具竞争力；整体方案验证了语音-语言多模态建模在多语言MCQA任务上的有效性。

title: LOCUS: Task-Aware Low-Rank Post-Training for Token-Efficient Language Generation
summary: Large language model serving costs scale directly with output sequence length, yet standard preference alignment often inflates response verbosity without improving utility. We study whether the parameterization of post-training updates affects generation length: low-rank subspaces alter sequence length without modifying the alignment loss. We present LOCUS, a method that selects a task-aware low-rank adaptation subspace to minimize output-token cost subject to a utility constraint. Within this subspace, post-training retains the native preference objective with a frozen backbone. Across Anthropic HH-RLHF dialogue preferences, we evaluate two $\sim$3B decoder backbones, Pythia-2.8B and Qwen2.5-3B, against protocol-matched full-parameter DPO and DrDPO branches and the released SamPO checkpoint. LOCUS reduces continuation length by up to 39.84\% on Pythia-2.8B and by 14.87--17.58\% on Qwen2.5-3B while updating only 0.24--0.28\% of model parameters, with no material change in the internal preference diagnostic.

AI.tldr: 提出 LOCUS，通过选择任务感知的低秩子空间，在保持偏好对齐目标的前提下压缩输出序列长度，大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 大模型服务成本随输出序列长度线性增长，而标准偏好对齐常使回复变啰嗦却不提升效用，因此需要在不损害对齐效用的情况下控制生成长度。
AI.method: 研究后训练更新的参数化方式对生成长度的影响：在冻结骨干网络下，选取任务感知的低秩适配子空间，在该子空间内最小化输出 token 成本并施加效用约束，同时保留原生偏好目标。
AI.result: 在 Anthropic HH-RLHF 对话偏好数据上，对 Pythia-2.8B 与 Qwen2.5-3B 两个约 3B 解码器骨干，与协议匹配的全参数 DPO、DrDPO 及已发布的 SamPO 检查点对比：LOCUS 在 Pythia-2.8B 上最多缩短续写长度 39.84%，在 Qwen2.5-3B 上缩短 14.87–17.58%，且仅更新 0.24–0.28% 的参数，内部偏好诊断指标无实质变化。
AI.conclusion: 后训练更新的低秩参数化可独立调控输出长度；LOCUS 以极小参数开销实现显著的生成成本削减，同时保持偏好对齐质量。

title: SIRF: A Spec-Internalized Risk Foundation Model for Industrial Content Risk Control
comment: 14 pages, 12 figures. Accepted at the Industry Track of EMNLP 2026
summary: For industrial content risk control, the real deployment constraint is not average accuracy but how much risk can be auto-handled under high precision and second-level latency. We present SIRF (Spec-Internalized Risk Foundation Model), which internalizes a platform's complex policies, synthesized without additional human annotation via EntiGraph, MAGA rewriting and account-level chain-of-thought (CoT), into the weights via continued pretraining (CPT), so rules are applied at high precision under an ultra-low-latency, verdict-only deployment. A controlled same-source comparison (Qwen3-8B-SFT vs. SIRF-8B-SFT, identical policy injection and verdict-only output form, differing only in policy-grounded CPT) attributes the gain to internalization: SIRF-8B-SFT reaches 71.3% Black Recall@P95, +15.1pp over the baseline, using only ~70M CPT tokens without harming general ability, and among included, logprob-available models under this interface it matches or exceeds far larger systems. SIRF is deployed as a tree-model adjudication layer (20% more mis-penalized samples recovered) and transfers to a freezing scenario at low cost (~70% relative mis-penalization reduction).

AI.tldr: SIRF 通过继续预训练将平台风险政策内化进模型权重，在仅输出判定结果的极低延迟部署下实现高精度自动风险处置，8B 模型在 P95 精度下黑样本召回达 71.3%，较同源 SFT 基线提升 15.1pp，且无通用能力损失。
AI.motivation: 工业内容风控的真实部署约束不是平均准确率，而是在高精度与秒级延迟下能自动处置多少风险。规则化政策复杂且缺乏人工标注，如何低成本注入政策并保持低延迟是核心痛点。
AI.method: 提出 SIRF（Spec-Internalized Risk Foundation Model）：用 EntiGraph、MAGA 改写与账号级思维链（CoT）合成政策数据，无需额外人工标注；再通过继续预训练（CPT）将政策内化到权重中，实现仅输出判定的超低延迟部署。并以 Qwen3-8B-SFT 与 SIRF-8B-SFT 做同源对照（政策注入与输出形式一致，仅差政策接地 CPT）来归因增益。
AI.result: SIRF-8B-SFT 在 P95 精度下黑样本召回达 71.3%，较基线提升 15.1pp，仅用约 70M CPT token 且不损害通用能力；在此接口下与可获取 logprob 的模型相比，可匹配或超越更大规模系统。落地为树模型裁定层，多恢复 20% 被误罚样本，并以低成本迁移到冻结场景（误罚相对下降约 70%）。
AI.conclusion: 政策内化式 CPT 是工业风控中兼顾高精度、低延迟与低标注成本的有效路径，小模型可媲美大模型，并具备跨场景可迁移性。

title: RAG-Safety-Bench: Reliable Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented LLM Safety
summary: Allowing large language models (LLMs) to retrieve information from a set of trusted documents can increase reliability and reduce hallucination. However, recent work has demonstrated that retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can have unintended side effects on the overall safety of the generated responses, when prompted for harmful or dangerous content. A clearer understanding of the mechanisms leading to this result is needed, as increasing numbers of end users turn to RAG to incorporate corporate documents and knowledge bases into LLM-based systems. We introduce RAG-Safety-Bench, a benchmark to measure the safety impact of RAG on LLM models. By removing the confounding effect of retriever quality, and cleanly separating the problem into four conditions -- non-RAG, RAG with an oracle document containing the answer to the harmful request, RAG with documents related to the harmful request but without the specific answer, and RAG with random, safe documents -- the benchmark isolates the impacts of different factors in the observed safety degradation. We report results across five open-source LLMs, showing an inverse relationship between benign and unsafe capability, strong evidence that baseline safety guardrails do not lead to downstream safety guarantees in the RAG case, and model-specific support for previous findings that even benign documents can lead to unsafe generation in retrieval-enabled systems.

AI.tldr: 提出RAG-Safety-Bench基准，通过控制检索文档类型（四类条件）剥离检索质量干扰，量化RAG对LLM生成安全性的影响，揭示RAG会削弱原有安全护栏。
AI.motivation: RAG被广泛用于提升LLM可靠性与减少幻觉，但有研究表明其在面对有害请求时可能带来意外的安全副作用。随着越来越多用户把企业文档与知识库接入LLM系统，亟需厘清导致安全退化的机制。
AI.method: 构建RAG-Safety-Bench基准。通过排除检索器质量这一混淆因素，将问题划分为四种条件：非RAG、RAG+包含有害请求答案的oracle文档、RAG+与有害请求相关但无具体答案的文档、RAG+随机安全文档。在五个开源LLM上进行评估。
AI.result: 结果显示：模型的有益能力与不安全能力之间呈反向关系；基线安全护栏并不能为RAG场景提供下游安全保障；并佐证了此前发现——即便文档本身无害，在检索增强系统中也可能导致不安全生成（该效应具有模型特异性）。
AI.conclusion: RAG的安全性不能简单依赖原有安全对齐，需在检索增强流程中单独设计安全机制；该基准为解构RAG安全退化因素提供了可控实验框架。

title: Component-Aware Differential Privacy for Federated Multilingual Speech-LLMs
summary: Per-layer differential privacy (DP) clipping improves gradient fidelity in federated learning by allocating per-matrix clipping budgets proportional to parameter count. We show that this recipe breaks for speech large language models (speech-LLMs), when the acoustic encoder and the language decoder differ by an order of magnitude in update norm. Single-pool per-layer methods suffer \emph{cross-component budget collapse}, dragging word error rate (WER) far from flat global clipping or collapsing training entirely. When the norm imbalance is milder, adaptive single-pool methods partially recover, confirming that collapse severity scales with the inter-component norm ratio. We empirically diagnose the root cause across six per-layer methods and three speech-LLM architectures. We then propose \emph{$α$-split}, a two-pool allocation that normalises encoder and LLM parameters into independent pools, and show that joint $\ell_2$ sensitivity and the original $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP guarantee are unchanged. At architecture-calibrated $α$, our method recovers WER utility compared to flat DP, while granting the encoder $4.47{\times}$ tighter per-component noise protection against speaker voice-based gradient-inversion attacks at only $+2.6\%$ LLM noise overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文指出按参数量分配裁剪预算的逐层差分隐私方法在语音大语言模型上失效，原因是声学编码器与语言解码器的更新范数相差一个数量级，导致"跨组件预算塌缩"；作者提出 α-split 双池分配方案，在保持整体 ℓ2 敏感度与 (ε,δ)-DP 保证不变的前提下恢复 WER 效用，并对编码器提供更紧的噪声保护。
AI.motivation: 逐层差分隐私裁剪按参数数量比例分配每个矩阵的裁剪预算，本意是提升梯度保真度。但语音大语言模型中声学编码器与语言解码器的更新范数存在数量级差异，该假设被破坏：单池逐层方法出现跨组件预算塌缩，WER 显著劣化甚至训练崩溃。作者希望在不牺牲 DP 保证的条件下修复这一失衡。
AI.method: 1) 在六种逐层方法与三种语音大语言模型架构上经验性诊断塌缩成因，确认塌缩严重程度与组件间范数比正相关；2) 提出 α-split：将编码器与 LLM 参数归一化到两个独立池进行预算分配，并证明联合 ℓ2 敏感度与原 (ε,δ)-DP 保证不变；3) 在架构校准的 α 下评估效用与隐私。
AI.result: 在架构校准的 α 下，α-split 相比 flat DP 恢复了 WER 效用；同时对编码器提供 4.47× 更紧的逐组件噪声保护，用以抵御基于说话人音色的梯度反演攻击，而 LLM 侧噪声开销仅增加 2.6%。当范数失衡较轻时，自适应单池方法可部分恢复，进一步印证塌缩随范数比加重。
AI.conclusion: 逐层 DP 裁剪的"按参数量分配预算"配方在组件更新范数严重失衡的语音大语言模型上不成立。α-split 通过双池归一化分配，在不改变敏感度与 DP 保证的前提下同时改善效用与组件级隐私保护，说明 DP 预算分配需按组件范数结构而非仅按参数量进行设计。

title: A Unified Per-Token Gating Family for On-Policy Distillation: FKL/RKL Mixing with Multi-Channel and Bias Coefficients
comment: Accepted at the Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026 Findings)
summary: Per-token gating of forward/reverse KL losses has become a standard technique for on-policy knowledge distillation (OPD), but existing methods such as EOPD (Jin et al., 2026) and ToDi (Jung et al., 2025) each fix a single gating signal and a single gating direction, and the two have never been compared directly. We introduce a four-coefficient parameterization lambda_t = sigma(a * h_t + b * u(x) + c + d * gap_t) in which direction-aligned proxies of EOPD and ToDi appear as one-dimensional (1D) restrictions, and which adds multi-channel composition and an explicit bias as further degrees of freedom. On TweetEval (Barbieri et al., 2020) emotion and hate, with a Qwen3-32B teacher and a Qwen3-4B student, configurations in the full family reach higher accuracy than the matched-magnitude single-channel (entropy-only / gap-only) 1D restrictions in 33 of 36 comparable cells, and a 26-cell mean-match isolation experiment places dynamic gating ahead of effective-KL-matched static baselines in 19 of 26 cells. Because cells share training data, models, and parameter substructure, we report both counts as exploratory aggregate directional evidence rather than as independent hypothesis tests. Targeted three-seed paired replications of the nine headline comparisons singled out by that sweep -- including a third task, offensive -- are directionally consistent, but individually smaller than the single-seed estimates and not significant at n=3. We therefore present the parameterization primarily as a shared coordinate system for comparing per-token gating designs in short-output classification OPD.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个四系数逐token门控参数化 λ_t = σ(a·h_t + b·u(x) + c + d·gap_t)，将 EOPD 与 ToDi 统一为其中的一维特例，并在短输出分类式在线知识蒸馏中作为比较门控设计的共享坐标系。
AI.motivation: 现有在线知识蒸馏（OPD）的逐token前向/反向 KL 门控技术（如 EOPD、ToDi）各自固定单一门控信号与门控方向，二者从未被直接比较，且缺乏统一的分析框架。
AI.method: 提出四系数参数化 λ_t = σ(a·h_t + b·u(x) + c + d·gap_t)，其中 EOPD 与 ToDi 的方向对齐代理成为一维限制，同时引入多通道组合与显式偏置。在 TweetEval 情感与仇恨任务上，以 Qwen3-32B 为教师、Qwen3-4B 为学生进行实验，并开展 26 单元均值匹配隔离实验及 9 项头部比较的三随机种子配对复现。
AI.result: 完整族配置在 36 个可比单元中的 33 个取得高于匹配幅度的单通道（仅熵/仅 gap）一维限制的准确率；均值匹配隔离实验中动态门控在 26 个单元中的 19 个优于有效 KL 匹配的静态基线。三随机种子配对复现方向一致但增幅小于单种子估计，且在 n=3 时不显著。
AI.conclusion: 作者将结果定位为探索性聚合方向性证据而非独立假设检验，并把该参数化主要作为短输出分类 OPD 中逐token门控设计比较的共享坐标系。

title: Recognizing Is Not Reversing: A Controlled Inversion Test of Fact-Preserving News Framing
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to analyze and rewrite news, yet current framing studies mainly evaluate generation, detection, or whether rewritten text appears more neutral. They do not directly show whether a model can undo a known framing transformation while keeping the facts fixed. We introduce a controlled inversion test over three established textual realizations of framing: evaluative lexis, agency realization, and information salience. Across 60 news articles and three intervention strengths, this yields 540 paired variants with preserved atomic facts and recorded edits. Across Qwen, DeepSeek, and Kimi, factual preservation remains near 0.84, whereas intervention reversal is 0.044--0.068. Even when both framing type and direction are recognized correctly, pooled reversal reaches 0.071. These results reveal a clear separation between factual fidelity, framing recognition, and framing inversion: recognizing how an article is framed does not imply that the framing can be undone.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出受控反转测试，检验LLM能否撤销已知的框架化变换：在保留原子事实前提下，事实保真度约0.84，但框架反转率仅0.044–0.068，即使正确识别框架类型与方向，反转率也仅0.071，说明事实保真、框架识别与框架反转三者相互分离。
AI.motivation: 现有框架研究主要评估生成、检测或重写文本是否更中性，无法直接说明模型能否在固定事实的条件下撤销已知的框架变换，因此需要引入受控反转测试来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 以三种经典框架文本实现（评价性词汇、施事实现、信息显著性）为基础，构建受控反转测试；使用60篇新闻文章与三种干预强度，生成540个配对变体，并保证原子事实保留与编辑记录可追踪；在Qwen、DeepSeek、Kimi上评估事实保真度与干预反转率。
AI.result: 事实保真度接近0.84，而干预反转率仅为0.044–0.068；即使框架类型与方向均被正确识别，汇总反转率也仅为0.071。事实保真、框架识别与框架反转之间存在明显分离。
AI.conclusion: 识别文章如何被框架化，并不意味着模型能够撤销该框架；事实保真与框架反转是不同能力维度，当前LLM在框架反转方面能力显著不足。

title: The widening evaluation gap in medical large language model research 2023 to 2026
summary: Large language models are superseded every few quarters; clinical evidence takes years. We asked whether medical research is keeping pace with the systems it evaluates. PubMed returned 11,628 records for January 2023 to June 2026 across fourteen clinical domains, growing 45-fold; 2.5% used a randomised, controlled or prospective design. Evaluation lag, from a study's newest named model release to its own publication, widened from 1.33 to 6.08 quarters. Because discontinued models age mechanically, we benchmarked this against a counterfactual holding model composition fixed: migration to newer systems offset only 56% of the drift (95% CI 50-65). Randomised trials evaluated models a median 4.6 quarters older than other designs (P = 3 x 10^-19), yet among studies naming a model still under development no design differed from any other; 62% of randomised trials evaluated a discontinued family. Rigour and currency are in tension, and that tension reflects model selection rather than research timelines.

AI.tldr: 对2023年1月至2026年6月PubMed收录的14个临床领域11,628篇LLM医学研究进行文献计量分析，发现研究数量激增45倍但仅2.5%采用随机对照或前瞻性设计，评估滞后从1.33个季度扩大至6.08个季度，且61%的随机试验评估的是已停用的模型家族。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型每隔几个季度就被新一代系统取代，而临床证据的产生往往需要数年。作者由此提出核心问题：医学研究是否跟得上它所评估的模型系统的迭代速度。研究旨在量化模型迭代与研究发表之间的"评估滞后"，并检验评估严谨性与模型时效性之间是否存在权衡。
AI.method: 检索PubMed 2023年1月至2026年6月共11,628条记录，覆盖14个临床领域;按研究设计分类，统计随机、对照或前瞻性设计的比例;计算"评估滞后"——从研究中所命名的最新模型发布到该研究发表之间的季度数;由于停用模型会机械性老化，构建保持模型组成不变的反正事实基准，估计向新系统迁移所抵消的漂移比例;并比较随机试验与其他设计在所评估模型年龄上的差异。
AI.result: 文献量增长45倍，但仅2.5%采用随机、对照或前瞻性设计。评估滞后由1.33个季度扩大至6.08个季度。相对于模型组成固定的反正事实，向新系统的迁移仅抵消56%的漂移(95% CI 50-65)。随机试验评估的模型中位年龄比其他设计老4.6个季度(P = 3 x 10^-19)，且62%的随机试验评估的是已停用的模型家族;但在所命名模型仍处于开发中的研究中，各设计间无差异。
AI.conclusion: 评估的严谨性与模型的时效性之间存在张力，而这种张力主要源于模型选择而非研究时间线。医学证据的生产周期难以匹配模型的迭代速度，随机试验尤其倾向于评估较旧甚至已停用的模型。

title: Whisper-Based Speech Transcription from Videos Across Multiple Languages for Cross-Cultural Understanding
summary: Cross-cultural understanding has become increasingly important in today's highly connected, cross-national world. The success of LLM-based technologies is now driving the development of automated tools to aid understanding for nonnative people trying to succeed in cross-cultural environments. Building such automated tools is often done by leveraging in-thewild text, audio, and video data. This paper presents techniques for improving speech recognition-based transcript creation in multiple languages from videos to better train these automated tools. The focus is on processes and speech tools that can easily be used by cross-cultural tool builders without requiring deep speech processing expertise. Using publicly available videos from YouTube and Whisper-based tools, average transcription error rate across seven languages (Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Turkish, Russian, and Hebrew) of 30% are observed. With a modest amount of fine-tuning data, the average error rate can be reduced to 20% making such output much more usable for downstream processing. Speech and metadata associated with these videos that can be used by the community to further refine these experiments are released as well.

AI.tldr: 本文针对跨文化理解场景下非母语者辅助工具的构建需求，提出利用公开YouTube视频与Whisper工具改进多语言转录生成的方法，通过少量微调数据将七种语言的平均转录错误率从30%降至20%，并公开相关语音与元数据。
AI.motivation: 跨文化理解在高度互联的跨国家环境中日益重要，基于LLM的技术推动了面向非母语者的自动化辅助工具发展。这类工具通常依赖真实场景（in-the-wild）的文本、音频和视频数据，但跨文化工具构建者往往缺乏深入的语音处理专业知识，且多语言转录质量不足会制约下游处理效果。
AI.method: 采用公开可得的YouTube视频作为数据来源，基于Whisper工具构建多语言转录流程，聚焦于无需深厚语音处理专业知识即可使用的流程与语音工具；在西班牙语、日语、韩语、普通话、土耳其语、俄语和希伯来语七种语言上评估转录错误率，并使用少量微调数据对模型进行微调以降低错误率。
AI.result: 在七种语言上，Whisper-based工具的初始平均转录错误率为30%；引入适度规模的微调数据后，平均错误率降至20%，显著提升了转录输出对下游处理的可用性。此外，作者还公开了与这些视频相关的语音及元数据，供社区进一步改进实验。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，即使缺乏专业语音处理知识，跨文化工具构建者也可借助公开视频与Whisper类工具构建多语言转录流程；少量微调即可显著降低转录错误率，提升下游任务可用性，并通过公开语音与元数据促进社区后续研究。

title: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Switch Aware Evaluation of ASR and Audio Language Models on English Yoruba Code-Switched Speech
comment: Accepted to IEEE Speech Language Tecnology
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems and audio language models (audio LMs) now report low error rates on monolingual benchmarks, but their behavior on code switched speech in low resource, diacritic rich languages remains poorly characterized. We present a switch aware evaluation of eleven modern systems (six ASR models and five audio LMs) on English Yoruba code-switched speech, using a deterministic 2000 utterance evaluation set and a shared scoring pipeline. Beyond word error rate (WER), we report switch localized diagnostics: a switch entry token error rate (SETER), windowed switch point error rates, language specific error rates, and a diacritic insensitive WER. Our central finding is that aggregate WER hides code switching behavior. The best system by WER (an ASR model) is statistically indistinguishable from a leading audio LM on WER, yet the audio LM is significantly better on every switch localized metric. Across faithful systems, Yoruba token recognition collapses (error 0.97 for almost all systems) while English tokens are recognized far better, and errors concentrate sharply at switches into Yoruba. Several generative audio LMs fail as exact transcribers, producing translation, verbosity, and prompt leakage that are strongly prompt dependent. We release manifests, metric implementations, and evaluation scripts to support reproducible, switch aware benchmarking for African code switched speech.

AI.tldr: 该论文对11个现代语音系统在英语-约鲁巴语码 switching 语音上进行切换感知评测，发现聚合WER会掩盖码 switching 行为：WER最优的ASR模型与领先音频LM在WER上无显著差异，但后者在所有切换局部指标上显著更优；忠实系统中约鲁巴语token识别近乎崩溃且错误集中于切入约鲁巴语处。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR系统与音频语言模型在单语基准上错误率已很低，但它们在低资源、带变音符号语言的码 switching 语音上的行为仍缺乏刻画。仅用聚合WER评估会掩盖切换相关错误，因此需要切换感知的评测方法与诊断指标。
AI.method: 构建确定性的2000条话语评测集与统一评分流程，对6个ASR模型和5个音频LM共11个系统进行英语-约鲁巴语码 switching 评测。除WER外，提出切换局部诊断指标：切换进入token错误率（SETER）、窗口化切换点错误率、语言特定错误率以及变音符号不敏感WER（diacritic insensitive WER）。并发布清单、指标实现与评测脚本以支持可复现基准。
AI.result: 聚合WER掩盖了码 switching 行为：WER最优系统（ASR模型）与领先音频LM在WER上统计不可区分，但音频LM在所有切换局部指标上显著更优。在忠实系统中，约鲁巴语token识别崩溃（几乎所有系统错误率达0.97），英语token识别明显更好，错误急剧集中在切入约鲁巴语的位置。若干生成式音频LM无法作为精确转写器，出现翻译、冗长输出和提示泄漏，且强烈依赖提示。
AI.conclusion: 聚合WER不足以评估码 switching 语音识别，需采用切换局部指标进行切换感知基准测试。音频LM在切换位置表现优于传统ASR，但生成式LM存在忠实转写失效问题。作者发布可复现资源，推动非洲码 switching 语音的切换感知评测。

title: SpecGuard: Inference-Time Backdoor Detection For Free
summary: Large language models are often fine-tuned, shared, or downloaded from third parties, so a deployed model may carry a hidden backdoor that behaves normally on benign inputs but switches to attacker-controlled behavior when a secret trigger appears. While backdoors can be audited before deployment, runtime monitoring remains important for models that are frequently updated. The challenge is that LLM serving is latency-sensitive: existing inference-time detectors either rely on assumptions about the trigger form, which can fail on stealthy attacks, or require extra model computation, such as input perturbations or an additional generation pass. We introduce SpecGuard, an inference-time backdoor detector that repurposes speculative decoding at zero added model-computation cost. Speculative decoding speeds up inference by using a small draft model to propose tokens and a target model to verify them. We observe that this verification process already exposes a useful signal: when a backdoor is triggered, the target model shifts toward the attacker's behavior, while a clean draft model does not predict this shift, causing the draft-token acceptance rate to change. We formalize when this signal appears and show that an attacker who suppresses it must also weaken the backdoor. Across diverse backdoor types and model families, SpecGuard reliably detects triggered behavior, including stealthy cases where input-level filters are blind, while avoiding the extra generation cost of existing runtime detectors. Speculative decoding therefore doubles as a free, always-on signal for detecting backdoored LLM behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出SpecGuard，利用推测解码的验证过程作为零额外模型计算成本的推理时后门检测信号。
AI.motivation: 大模型常被微调、共享或从第三方下载，部署模型可能携带隐藏后门；部署前审计不够，频繁更新的模型需要运行时监控。但LLM服务延迟敏感，现有推理时检测器要么依赖对触发形式的假设（对隐蔽攻击失效），要么需要额外模型计算（如输入扰动或额外生成）。
AI.method: SpecGuard复用推测解码：小草稿模型提议token、目标模型验证。观察后门触发时目标模型偏向攻击者行为，而干净的草稿模型无法预测该偏移，导致草稿token接受率发生变化。作者形式化了该信号出现的条件，并证明攻击者若要抑制该信号必须削弱后门本身。
AI.result: 在多种后门类型和模型家族上，SpecGuard能可靠检测触发行为，包括输入级过滤器失效的隐蔽案例，同时避免现有运行时检测器的额外生成开销。
AI.conclusion: 推测解码可兼作检测后门LLM行为的免费、常开信号。

title: Logit Refiner: Improving Visual Autoregressive Models via Intra-Scale Dependency Modeling
summary: Visual Autoregressive Models (VAR) generate images through next-scale prediction, producing all tokens within each scale in parallel. We show that this parallel decoding constitutes a mean-field-style approximation that discards spatial dependencies among same-scale tokens, causing locally incoherent samples regardless of backbone capacity -- a limitation of the decoding rule. Addressing this limitation, we introduce the Logit Refiner, a lightweight autoregressive module that restores intra-scale dependencies by sequentially sampling tokens conditioned on frozen backbone features. Adding only ~10% parameters and less than 5% of the base model's training compute, it plugs into any pretrained VAR checkpoint without retraining. Controlled ablations isolate joint intra-scale sampling -- rather than additional capacity or training -- as the critical ingredient. Across backbones from 310M to 2B parameters on class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, the refiner consistently improves generation quality, enabling a 1.1B-parameter model to surpass one twice its size. The approach further generalizes to text-to-image generation, confirming that the mean-field bottleneck persists across VAR variants and is effectively alleviated by our method. Project page: https://compvis.github.io/logit-refiner/

AI.tldr: 该论文指出VAR的下一尺度并行解码是一种平均场式近似，丢弃了同尺度token间的空间依赖，导致局部不连贯；提出轻量级Logit Refiner恢复尺度内依赖，仅加约10%参数即可即插即用地提升任意预训练VAR，并泛化到文生图。
AI.motivation: VAR通过下一尺度预测并行生成同一尺度内的所有token。作者认为这种并行解码等价于平均场式近似，忽略了同尺度token之间的空间依赖，因此无论主干容量多大都会产生局部不连贯的样本——这是解码规则本身的缺陷，而非模型能力问题。
AI.method: Logit Refiner：一个轻量级自回归模块，在冻结的主干特征条件下顺序采样token，从而恢复尺度内的依赖关系。它只增加约10%的参数和不到基础模型5%的训练算力，可插入任意预训练VAR检查点而无需重训。通过受控消融实验，验证联合尺度内采样（而非额外容量或训练）是关键因素。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256类条件生成上，跨310M至2B参数的主干，Refiner一致提升生成质量，使1.1B参数模型超越两倍于其大小的模型；方法还可推广到文生图任务。
AI.conclusion: 平均场瓶颈在各类VAR变体中普遍存在，所提方法能有效缓解这一问题，说明尺度内依赖的恢复是提升VAR生成质量的关键。

title: Target leakage, not model class, explains reported accuracy in survey-based cardiovascular screening: a leakage-tiered audit of glass-box and tabular foundation models
summary: Cardiovascular screening models trained on national health surveys routinely report areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) near 0.89. We asked whether that accuracy reflects learning or target leakage, whether tabular foundation models change the answer, and whether the properties deployment requires survive joint examination. We benchmarked ten classifiers spanning linear, tree-ensemble, neural, glass-box, and tabular foundation classes for prevalent myocardial infarction in 442,067 respondents of the 2022 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System across five feature tiers of decreasing leakage risk. Each was audited for discrimination, calibration, fairness at an explicit screening threshold, conformal coverage, explanation faithfulness, and inference cost, then applied -- models and thresholds frozen -- to 430,755 respondents of 2023. Removing two post-diagnostic features cost every model 0.049-0.051 AUROC, collapsing the field into a 0.0045-wide band. The glass-box explainable boosting machine was non-inferior to every alternative within a pre-specified 0.005 margin while scoring the cohort roughly 104 times faster than the strongest foundation model. One threshold detected 75.4% of women's infarctions against 89.0% of men's; editing the model's shape functions reduced the gap to 0.010. Marginal conformal prediction gave 0.86 coverage to men and 0.82 to adults over 60; Mondrian calibration repaired every stratum. Frozen models transported within 0.002 AUROC. Reported headroom in this literature is a property of the feature set, not the learner. Transparency cost nothing measurable and made fairness repair and uncertainty conditioning directly auditable. Evaluation practice, not model capacity, is the binding constraint.

AI.tldr: 心血管筛查模型报告的AUROC≈0.89主要源于特征集而非学习器能力；剔除两个诊断后特征即令所有模型下降0.049–0.051 AUROC并压缩至0.0045宽带，玻璃盒模型在0.005非劣边际内不逊于任何替代方案且快约104倍。
AI.motivation: 国家健康调查训练的心血管筛查模型常报告AUROC接近0.89，作者质疑该精度是真实学习还是目标泄漏；并检验表格基础模型是否改变结论，以及部署所需性质（校准、公平、共形覆盖、解释忠实性、推理成本）能否在联合审查下成立。
AI.method: 在2022年BRFSS的442,067名受访者上，针对流行性心肌梗死，按五个泄漏风险递减的特征层级，基准测试十类分类器（线性、树集成、神经网络、玻璃盒、表格基础模型）；对每个模型审计判别力、校准、显式筛查阈值下的公平性、共形覆盖、解释忠实性与推理成本；随后冻结模型与阈值，迁移至2023年430,755名受访者。
AI.result: 移除两个诊断后特征使每个模型损失0.049–0.051 AUROC，全场压缩为0.0045宽带；可解释提升机（EBM）在预设0.005边际内非劣于所有替代方案，评分速度约为最强基础模型的104倍。单一阈值检出女性梗死75.4%、男性89.0%；编辑模型形状函数将差距降至0.010。边际共形预测对男性覆盖0.86、对60岁以上成人0.82；Mondrian校准修复了所有分层。冻结模型迁移AUROC差异在0.002以内。
AI.conclusion: 该文献报告的精度余量是特征集属性而非学习器属性；透明性未带来可测代价，并使公平性修复与不确定性条件化可直接审计。约束瓶颈是评估实践而非模型容量。

title: IndicTriMix: Developing Language Identification Datasets and Models for Tri-Language Code-Mixing
summary: Language identification in code-mixed text, largely observed in social media, is highly essential when users frequently switch between multiple languages within a single utterance. Accurately identifying the languages of code-mixed tokens becomes an urgent necessity. Traditional language identification models, designed for monolingual text, are not well suited for token-level language identification in code-mixed settings. We formulate the task as a sequence labeling problem and fine-tune contextual transformer-based models MuRIL and XLM-RoBERTa best suited for Indian languages. We evaluate these systems on three different data configurations (Hindi, Gujarati, and Bengali) to predict language labels for individual tokens. We release a benchmark for language identification in code-mixed tokens with manually annotated test sets. We propose two approaches of code-mixed generation using parallel sentences of three languages. The trained models demonstrate the effectiveness of contextual embeddings for token-level language identification in multilingual social media text. For reproducibility and to facilitate future research, we publicly release our fine-tuned models.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对社交媒体中语码混合文本的token级语言识别任务，将其建模为序列标注问题，微调MuRIL与XLM-RoBERTa，在印地语、古吉拉特语、孟加拉语三种数据配置上评估，并发布标注基准与微调模型。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体中用户常在单句内频繁切换多种语言，语码混合文本的语言识别需求迫切；而面向单语文本的传统语言识别模型不适合语码混合场景下的token级语言识别。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为序列标注问题；针对印度语言微调上下文Transformer模型MuRIL与XLM-RoBERTa；提出两种基于三种语言平行句的语码混合生成方法；在三种数据配置（印地语、古吉拉特语、孟加拉语）上评估，并构建人工标注测试集基准。
AI.result: 所训练模型验证了上下文嵌入在多语言社交媒体文本token级语言识别中的有效性；发布了人工标注测试集基准及微调模型以支持复现与后续研究。
AI.conclusion: 上下文Transformer模型可有效完成语码混合文本的token级语言识别，作者公开基准数据与微调模型以促进可复现研究与未来工作。

title: How Robust Are Neural Audio Codecs for African Speech? A Multi-Task Benchmark and the Limits of Perceptual Quality
comment: Accepted to IEEE Speech Language Technology
summary: Neural audio codecs enable low-bitrate speech compression and tokenization, yet their robustness on accented and multilingual speech remains under-evaluated. We benchmark seven open-source neural codecs (DAC, EnCodec, FocalCodec, LanguageCodec, SemantiCodec, UniCodec, WavTokenizer) on three African speech datasets afrinames, afrispeech dialog, afrispeech multilingual, reporting signal-level quality (NISQA, UTMOS, ViSQOL, STOI, F0-RMSE) alongside two downstream tasks: automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speaker verification (ASV). Our analysis yields four findings. First, signal metrics differ sharply in downstream validity: reference-based structural/intelligibility measures (ViSQOL, STOI) and prosodic error (F0-RMSE) track ASR and ASV degradation far more reliably than neural mean-opinion-score predictors (NISQA, UTMOS). Second, intelligibility and speaker-identity preservation diverge sharply across architectures, and the apparent identity ranking itself depends on the ASV backend. Third, degradation is strongly domain-dependent and largest for conversational dialog. Fourth, the resulting degradation is partly recoverable: parameter-efficient \emph{codec} adaptation (LoRA, $\sim$1--3\% of parameters) on roughly 35 hours of African speech reduces the compression-induced word-error-rate gap, recovering recognition toward the uncompressed baseline (developed in companion work). These results motivate task-aware, domain-representative, and adaptation-aware evaluation of speech codecs as a prerequisite for inclusive deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测了7种开源神经音频编解码器在3个非洲语音数据集上的鲁棒性，涵盖信号级指标与ASR/ASV下游任务，并证明参数高效适配可部分恢复性能损失。
AI.motivation: 神经音频编解码器虽能实现低码率语音压缩与离散化，但其在带口音及多语种语音上的鲁棒性评估不足，缺乏对包容性部署的可靠性依据。
AI.method: 在afrinames、afrispeech dialog、afrispeech multilingual三个非洲语音数据集上，对DAC、EnCodec、FocalCodec、LanguageCodec、SemantiCodec、UniCodec、WavTokenizer七种开源编解码器进行基准测试；报告NISQA、UTMOS、ViSQOL、STOI、F0-RMSE等信号级质量指标，并结合ASR与ASV两项下游任务；同时采用LoRA（约1–3%参数）在约35小时非洲语音上进行编解码器适配。
AI.result: 四项发现：一是信号指标在下游有效性上差异显著，ViSQOL、STOI等参考型结构/可懂度指标与F0-RMSE比NISQA、UTMOS等神经MOS预测器更能可靠反映ASR/ASV退化；二是可懂度与说话人身份保持在不同架构间明显分化，身份排序本身依赖ASV后端；三是退化强依赖领域，会话对话场景最严重；四是退化部分可恢复，LoRA适配可缩小压缩引起的WER差距，使识别性能接近未压缩基线。
AI.conclusion: 应开展任务感知、领域代表性且考虑适配的语音编解码器评估，这是实现包容性部署的前提。

title: RetroThinker: Enabling Retrospective Thinking in Speech LLMs
summary: Speech large language models (SpeechLLMs) offer reduced latency and retain paralinguistic nuances that are typically lost in cascaded automatic speech recognition (ASR) and text-based LM architectures. However, they continue to lag behind text-only LLMs on complex reasoning tasks, while real-time spoken interaction imposes strict latency constraints. Although prior works employ Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and concurrent reasoning to enhance reasoning capabilities without inducing prohibitive delays, an inherent accuracy-latency trade-off persists. In this paper, we investigate whether a streaming SpeechLLM can dynamically revise its reasoning traces on the fly. We introduce RetroThinker, a multi-stage post-training framework that equips the Moshi model to self-verify and forward-correct CoT steps during inference. RetroThinker combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated retrospective thinking data with length-based direct preference optimization (DPO) to optimize retrospective during early reasoning (i.e., reasoning concurrently while the user speaks). Evaluated on the GSM8K benchmark, RetroThinker significantly improves the accuracy-latency trade-off over non-retrospective baselines, achieving an 11% absolute accuracy gain at a comparable latency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RetroThinker，一个多阶段后训练框架，使流式SpeechLLM（Moshi）能够在推理过程中动态自我验证并前向修正思维链（CoT），从而改善准确率与时延的权衡。
AI.motivation: SpeechLLM相比级联式ASR+文本LM架构具有更低时延并能保留副语言信息，但在复杂推理任务上仍落后于纯文本LLM；而实时语音交互又对时延有严格约束。已有工作采用CoT与并发推理来提升推理能力而不引入过高延迟，但仍然存在准确率-时延之间的固有折衷。因此本文探究流式SpeechLLM能否在推理过程中动态修正其推理轨迹。
AI.method: 提出RetroThinker，一个多阶段后训练框架：结合在精选的回顾式思维（retrospective thinking）数据上的监督微调（SFT），以及基于长度的直接偏好优化（DPO），以优化早期推理阶段的回顾行为（即在用户说话时并发推理），使模型能在推理期间自我验证并前向修正CoT步骤。
AI.result: 在GSM8K基准上评估，RetroThinker相较于非回顾式基线显著改善了准确率-时延权衡，在相当延迟下取得11%的绝对准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 流式SpeechLLM可通过多阶段后训练获得动态修正推理轨迹的能力，从而在保持实时性的同时有效提升复杂推理准确率。

title: Epistemic orientation predicts legislative effectiveness among members of the US Congress
summary: Truth and evidence-based communication provide important foundations for democratic governance, accountability, and collective decision-making. Prior work shows that evidence-oriented language in US congressional floor speeches has declined since the mid-1970s, alongside broader changes in legislative productivity and polarization. This study shifts the analysis from congressional sessions to individual members of Congress to examine whether epistemic orientation varies systematically across legislators and whether it relates to political behavior and legislative effectiveness. Using the Evidence-Minus-Intuition (EMI) score, we measure the relative prevalence of evidence-oriented versus intuition-oriented language in congressional floor speeches and Twitter posts. We link these measures to legislator-level data on ideology, institutional position, communication context, and Legislative Effectiveness Score (LES). The results show that more ideologically extreme members use less evidence-oriented language on the congressional floor. EMI also exhibits cross-platform consistency with members who use more evidence-oriented language in floor speeches also being more evidence-oriented on Twitter, although EMI is lower on Twitter overall. Finally, EMI in congressional speeches is positively associated with individual legislative effectiveness, even after accounting for ideology and extensive political, institutional, demographic, topical, and communication volume controls. These findings suggest that evidence-oriented language is not only an aggregate feature of congressional discourse but also a meaningful attribute of individual-level legislative communication and effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本研究将证据导向语言的测量从国会会期层面转向议员个体，用EMI分数衡量议员演讲和推文中证据导向与直觉导向语言的相对比例，发现意识形态越极端的议员证据导向语言越少，EMI在跨平台间保持一致（推特整体更低），且演讲中的EMI与个体立法效能正相关。
AI.motivation: 真实与基于证据的沟通是民主治理、问责和集体决策的重要基础。既有研究表明自20世纪70年代中期以来美国国会演讲中的证据导向语言有所下降，但这些分析停留在国会会期层面，未探讨议员个体间是否存在系统性差异，以及这种差异是否与政治行为和立法效能相关。
AI.method: 采用"证据减去直觉"（EMI）分数，测量国会演讲和Twitter帖子中证据导向语言相对于直觉导向语言的流行程度；将EMI指标与议员层面的意识形态、机构职位、沟通情境以及立法效能分数（LES）数据相链接，进行跨平台一致性和回归分析，并控制政治、机构、人口、议题和沟通量等变量。
AI.result: 意识形态越极端的议员在国会发言中使用证据导向语言越少；EMI在跨平台间具有一致性，即在演讲中更证据导向的议员在Twitter上也更证据导向，但Twitter上的EMI整体更低；国会演讲中的EMI与个体立法效能正相关，且在控制意识形态及大量政治、机构、人口、议题和沟通量变量后依然显著。
AI.conclusion: 证据导向语言不仅是国会话语的总体特征，也是议员个体层面立法沟通与立法效能的一项有意义的属性，说明认知取向（证据vs直觉）可作为衡量立法者行为与效能的个体化指标。

title: Augustinian BabyLM: What Ostensive Definition Can and Cannot Teach a Small Language Model
summary: A language model normally begins training with random word embeddings: whatever 'banana' means must be learned from training corpora. I implement St. Augustine's picture of word learning, meaning by ostension, for a small masked language model (DeBERTa) trained on 10M words: before training, visually grounded tokens receive embeddings derived from the image regions they label; other tokens start random. Visual initialization leaves a measurable imprint that lasts until the end of training. At the same time, the effect remains invisible under most BabyLM benchmarks, which probe abstract grammatical knowledge: visual initialization does not affect performance there. The only zero-shot exception is object-property knowledge (COMPS), where seeding helps in every configuration. To follow up on this result, I build a corpus-tailored version of the Visual-Property Swap benchmark, which tests color, material, size, and shape knowledge, with per-item training frequency and seeded status. Here, vision-seeded models have a persistent, seed-replicated advantage. Function words and abstract vocabulary also receive strong visual seeds and retain them throughout training, and the training objective draws on them: held-out mask-prediction loss falls for these words in every seed. However, no benchmark I run registers this. What evaluation would pick this up remains an open question.

AI.tldr: 本文在小规模掩码语言模型（DeBERTa，1000万词）上实现了"以指称学词"的视觉初始 化：训练前为有视觉基础的词赋予来自图像区域的嵌入，其余词随机初始化。视觉种子留下可测量的持久印记，但在多数BabyLM基准（抽象语法知识）上不可见；唯一零样本例外是物体属性知识（COMPS）。作者构建了语料定制的Visual-Property Swap基准，发现在颜色、材料、大小、形状知识上视觉种子有稳定且可复现的优势；功能词与抽象词也获得强视觉种子并在整个训练中保留，掩码预测损失下降，但现有基准均未捕捉到这一效应。
AI.motivation: 语言模型通常从随机词嵌入开始训练，词义完全从语料中习得。本文想检验圣奥古斯丁式的"指称学习"假设：若部分词在训练前就通过视觉指称获得有意义的嵌入，这会带来什么可测量的影响，以及现有评测能否察觉这种影响。
AI.method: 在1000万词语料上训练小型掩码语言模型DeBERTa；训练前，将有视觉基础（grounded）的token赋予源自其标注图像区域的嵌入，其余token保持随机初始化。通过对比不同随机种子下的视觉播种与随机初始化模型，评估其在BabyLM基准、COMPS零样本任务以及作者自建的语料定制版Visual-Property Swap基准（覆盖颜色、材料、大小、形状知识，并标注每项的训练频率与播种状态）上的表现，同时追踪掩码预测损失。
AI.result: 视觉初始化留下可测量的印记并持续到训练结束；在多数BabyLM基准（抽象语法知识）上无显著影响，唯一零样本例外为COMPS（物体属性知识），播种在所有配置下均有帮助。在自建Visual-Property Swap基准上，视觉播种模型在颜色、材料、大小、形状上均有持久且跨种子可复现的优势。功能词和抽象词也获得强视觉种子并全程保留，其held-out掩码预测损失在所有种子下均下降，但没有任何现有基准记录到这一效应。
AI.conclusion: 视觉指称式初始化对语言模型具有真实且可测量、可复现的持久影响，尤其体现在物体属性知识上，并延伸到功能词与抽象词的损失下降。然而，现有主流评测（BabyLM基准）对此基本不敏感，如何设计能捕捉这类效应的评测仍是一个待解问题。

title: The Last AI Built by Humans: Toward Genuine Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables AI systems to turn experience and feedback into persistent changes that improve both their capabilities and the process of future improvement. We first use the Headroom-Closed Index (HCI) to reveal the problems of existing LLMs, then introduce the RSI concept and its development roadmap: from improvement-execution autonomy, improvement-strategy autonomy, experience-acquisition autonomy, and environment-adaptation autonomy, to recursive meta-improvement. Next we examine RSI across scenarios (e.g., scientific discovery, embodied intelligence, software engineering), highlighting their distinct requirements and development speeds. Drawing on diverse industry practices and preliminary empirical evidence, we connect RSI research with practical systems and identify key challenges to achieving genuine RSI.

AI.tldr: 论文提出递归自我改进（RSI）概念，用HCI指数揭示现有LLM问题，并给出从执行自主到递归元改进的发展路线图，结合多场景与产业实践分析关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM缺乏将经验与反馈转化为持久改进的能力，需明确RSI的内涵、发展路径及其在真实系统中的落地障碍。
AI.method: 以Headroom-Closed Index（HCI）诊断现有LLM问题，提出RSI概念及其五阶段路线图（改进-执行自主、改进-策略自主、经验获取自主、环境适应自主、递归元改进），并跨场景（科学发现、具身智能、软件工程）与产业实践进行对照分析。
AI.result: 揭示了现有LLM在RSI能力上的不足，界定了RSI的分级发展框架，并归纳不同应用场景的差异化需求与发展速度，建立RSI研究与实际系统的联系。
AI.conclusion: 实现真正的RSI仍面临关键挑战，需结合产业实践与初步实证证据推进，RSI是提升AI持续自主改进能力的核心方向。

title: Biology-in-the-loop: Amortized Adaptive Hit Discovery in CRISPR Screens
summary: Many biological discovery problems require experiments to be selected sequentially under constrained budgets. CRISPR screening is a prominent example, as exhaustive perturbation testing is often infeasible and candidate perturbations must instead be prioritized over multiple experimental rounds. Despite the importance of this problem, existing benchmarks for adaptive hit discovery remain limited in scale and diversity. Here, we introduce AssayBench-Loop, a large-scale benchmark for adaptive hit discovery comprising 1,389 CRISPR screens across five phenotype categories. Beyond enabling systematic evaluation, its scale makes it possible to learn acquisition strategies across historical experiments. Building on this resource, we introduce AssayLoop, a sequential experimental design framework combining AssayFormer, a transformer-based amortized acquisition policy trained across historical screens to adapt from experimental feedback, with LLM-derived biological priors through an adaptive handoff. In this view, completed experiments become training data for learning how accumulated evidence should guide what to test next, while LLMs provide prior biological knowledge to seed the search. We further introduce AssayLLM, showing that the same principle can be extended directly to an LLM through task-specific post-training. On temporally held-out screens, AssayLoop achieves a 5.67-fold enrichment over random selection and recovers 27.7% of hits after assaying approximately 5% of the candidate library, outperforming existing adaptive-design methods and standalone LLMs, and AssayFormer alone. Performance improves with increasing historical training data and transfers to phenotype categories excluded from training. These results demonstrate the value of learning acquisition policies across historical experiments and combining them with broad biological priors for efficient adaptive hit discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大规模自适应命中发现基准AssayBench-Loop（1,389个CRISPR筛选），并基于此提出AssayLoop框架，结合Transformer摊销采集策略AssayFormer与LLM生物学先验，在时序留出筛选上实现5.67倍富集，约5%库覆盖回收27.7%命中。
AI.motivation: 许多生物学发现需在预算约束下序贯选择实验，CRISPR筛选为典型场景：穷举扰动不可行，需多轮优先排序候选扰动。然而现有自适应命中发现基准在规模与多样性上受限，缺乏系统性评估平台，也阻碍了从历史实验中学习采集策略。
AI.method: 1）构建AssayBench-Loop基准，涵盖五大表型类别共1,389个CRISPR筛选；2）提出AssayLoop序贯实验设计框架，将基于Transformer的摊销采集策略AssayFormer（跨历史筛选训练、依据实验反馈自适应）与LLM衍生生物学先验通过自适应交接机制结合；3）提出AssayLLM，将同一原则通过任务特定后训练直接扩展到LLM。
AI.result: 在时序留出筛选上，AssayLoop相对随机选择取得5.67倍富集，在检测约5%候选库后回收27.7%的命中，优于现有自适应设计方法、独立LLM及单独的AssayFormer；性能随历史训练数据增加而提升，并可迁移到训练中排除的表型类别。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明跨历史实验学习采集策略并与广泛生物学先验相结合，对高效自适应命中发现具有重要价值；AssayBench-Loop的规模使策略学习成为可能，且该范式可扩展至LLM本身。

title: Domain-Specific Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models generate fluent text that can contain unfaithful claims -- a phenomenon known as hallucination. We present a multi-signal detection pipeline combining fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3 classification, Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout uncertainty quantification, and temperature-scaled calibration for response-level hallucination detection. Evaluated on the HaluEval benchmark, our pipeline achieves F1=0.915 and AUROC=0.977 on general-domain tasks, with per-task F1 scores of 0.97 (QA), 0.96 (Summarization), and 0.82 (Dialogue). MC Dropout inference further improves accuracy to 93.2%. A context ablation study confirms the model performs genuine entailment reasoning rather than exploiting surface patterns, with summarization F1 dropping 24% when knowledge context is removed. Learning curve analysis reveals that 25% of training data captures 77% of full-data performance. Beyond detection, we apply Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to a Qwen2.5-0.5B generator, reducing its hallucination rate from 85.5% to 37.7% (55.9% relative reduction) as measured by our detector. Cross-domain evaluation on the SciFact biomedical benchmark shows that general-domain training transfers poorly (F1=0.52), motivating domain-specific fine-tuning. PubMedBERT fine-tuned on SciFact achieves F1=0.63 and AUROC=0.81, demonstrating that domain-matched pre-training is the strongest adaptation strategy. Code and models are available at https://github.com/varunteja99/hallucination-detection-nlp

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多信号幻觉检测流水线（DeBERTa-v3微调分类 + MC Dropout不确定性量化 + 温度缩放校准），在HaluEval上取得F1=0.915、AUROC=0.977，并用DPO将生成器幻觉率从85.5%降至37.7%，同时验证了领域自适应预训练的优势。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽能生成流畅文本，但常包含不忠实的断言，即幻觉现象，这会削弱其可靠性。现有检测方法多依赖单一信号，缺乏对不确定性建模与校准的系统整合，且跨领域泛化能力不足，因此需要一个融合多信号、可迁移且能验证真实推理能力的检测框架。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：（1）检测端：结合微调DeBERTa-v3分类、Monte Carlo Dropout不确定性量化与温度缩放校准，构成响应级幻觉检测流水线；（2）缓解端：对Qwen2.5-0.5B生成器应用Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）以降低幻觉；（3）验证端：通过上下文消融实验检验模型是否进行真实蕴含推理，并用学习曲线分析数据效率，同时在SciFact生物医学基准上开展跨领域评估，比较通用域训练与领域匹配预训练（PubMedBERT）的效果。
AI.result: 在HaluEval上，通用域任务F1=0.915、AUROC=0.977；各任务F1为QA 0.97、摘要0.96、对话0.82。MC Dropout推理将准确率提升至93.2%。上下文消融显示移除知识上下文后摘要F1下降24%，证明模型进行的是真实蕴含推理。学习曲线表明25%训练数据即可达到全量性能的77%。DPO将生成器幻觉率从85.5%降至37.7%（相对降低55.9%）。SciFact跨域评估中通用域训练迁移效果差（F1=0.52），而领域匹配的PubMedBERT微调取得F1=0.63、AUROC=0.81。
AI.conclusion: 多信号检测流水线在同域幻觉检测上表现优异，且MC Dropout与校准能进一步提升性能；上下文消融与学习曲线验证了模型的真实推理能力和数据高效性。DPO可有效降低生成端幻觉。跨域结果表明通用域训练迁移能力有限，领域匹配的预训练是当前最强的自适应策略，领域特定微调对提升泛化至关重要。

title: CoRA-NAS: Coarse Ranking and Anchor-Residual Refinement for Neural Architecture Search
summary: Zero-cost proxies rank architectures cheaply, but their reliability varies across search spaces. We introduce CoRA-NAS (COarse Ranking + Anchor-residual), a two-stage framework combining a static ranking prior with low-cost learning-curve refinement. CoRA-Rank aggregates capacity and structure-at-initialization proxies through an equal-weight log-rank consensus and a target-free consensus gate. CoRA-Refine samples anchors across this prior, extrapolates their early validation curves, and propagates a learned residual correction with an ExtraTrees model. The refinement uses approximately 1% of the cost of fully training the candidate set. Fully trained architecture-accuracy labels are not used to fit the ranker. One configuration is used across spaces, with space-specific architecture encodings. Across NAS-Bench-201, NAS-Bench-101, TransNAS-Bench-101, and NATS-SSS, CoRA-Refine achieves mean Spearman correlations of 0.946, 0.715, 0.786, and 0.894, respectively. Its worst-space correlation of 0.715 is the highest among the compared methods. On NAS-Bench-201/CIFAR-100, its selected architecture reaches 73.32% accuracy, near the reported ground-truth best of 73.37%. On the pure size space, refinement recovers the static prior's shortfall relative to parameter count, while remaining tied with the strongest capacity proxies within noise. The resulting framework combines cross-space ranking robustness with low-cost architecture selection.

AI.tldr: CoRA-NAS是一个两阶段框架，结合静态排序先验与低成本学习曲线校正，实现跨搜索空间的鲁棒且低成本架构排序。
AI.motivation: 零成本代理（zero-cost proxies）能廉价地对架构进行排序，但其可靠性在不同搜索空间之间差异较大，缺乏跨空间的稳定性。
AI.method: CoRA-NAS分为两阶段：CoRA-Rank通过等权对数秩共识（equal-weight log-rank consensus）聚合容量与初始化结构代理，并使用无目标共识门（target-free consensus gate）；CoRA-Refine在该先验上采样锚点，外推其早期验证曲线，并用ExtraTrees模型传播学习到的残差校正。校正成本约为完全训练候选集成本的1%，且不使用完全训练的架构-准确率标签来拟合排序器。仅用一套配置配合各空间特有的架构编码。
AI.result: 在NAS-Bench-201、NAS-Bench-101、TransNAS-Bench-101和NATS-SSS上，CoRA-Refine的平均Spearman相关性分别为0.946、0.715、0.786、0.894，其最差空间相关性0.715为对比方法中最高。在NAS-Bench-201/CIFAR-100上，所选架构达到73.32%准确率，接近报告的真值最优73.37%。在纯尺寸空间上，校正弥补了静态先验相对于参数量指标的不足，同时与最强容量代理在噪声范围内持平。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将跨空间排序鲁棒性与低成本架构选择相结合，在多个基准上取得领先且稳定的排序表现。

title: Guided Super-Resolution of Digital Elevation Models with Diffusion-Based Image Generators
summary: High-resolution digital surface models (DSMs) play an important role in urban analysis, 3D building reconstruction, and infrastructure monitoring, yet their availability remains limited due to the high cost and complexity of data acquisition. In contrast, coarse DSMs from commercial satellite missions are widely accessible, and high-resolution optical imagery is increasingly available from aerial and satellite platforms. We address the resulting mismatch in spatial resolution and propose a DSM superresolution approach that enhances 5 m DSMs to 0.5 m resolution, using guidance from high-resolution spectral images. Our method employs denoising diffusion to transfer information that is visible only in the image, like crisp outlines and detailed roof structures, into the elevation maps. In this way, surface details are reconstructed more accurately than with conventional interpolation or filtering techniques. Experiments on several cities in Central Europe demonstrate that the proposed approach produces high-quality DSMs with improved structural detail and accurate surface geometry. Our results highlight the potential of guided super-resolution with foundational image priors as a means of reconstructing high-resolution surface models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于去噪扩散模型的引导式超分辨率方法，利用高分辨率光谱影像将5 m DSM提升至0.5 m，在多个中欧城市验证了其重建结构细节与表面几何的优越性。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率DSM在城市分析、三维建筑重建和基础设施监测中至关重要，但获取成本高、流程复杂，导致数据稀缺；而商用卫星可提供广泛可得的低分辨率DSM，航空与卫星平台的高分辨率光学影像也日益丰富，二者存在空间分辨率不匹配的问题，亟需有效的超分辨率手段。
AI.method: 采用去噪扩散（denoising diffusion）框架，以高分辨率光谱影像为引导，将仅见于影像的清晰轮廓与屋顶结构等信息迁移到高程图中，实现从5 m到0.5 m的DSM引导式超分辨率，克服了传统插值与滤波方法的局限。
AI.result: 在中欧多个城市开展实验，所提方法生成的DSM质量高，结构细节更丰富，表面几何更准确，优于传统方法的表现。
AI.conclusion: 基于基础图像先验的引导式超分辨率具备重建高分辨率地表模型的潜力，为缓解高分辨率DSM数据稀缺问题提供了有效途径。

title: Nuha-Speech: Building General-Purpose Arabic Speech-LLMs
summary: As Speech Large Language Models (speech-LLMs) become increasingly multilingual, Arabic remains significantly underrepresented, highlighting the need for dedicated infrastructure to train and evaluate Arabic speech-LLMs. To address this gap, we introduce Nuha-Speech, a comprehensive initiative to develop general-purpose Arabic speech-LLMs spanning dataset construction, model training, and systematic evaluation. Specifically, we constructed a large-scale Arabic Speech Question-Answering (SQA) corpus comprising over 1.5 million training samples to allow instruction tuning over a broad range of core speech tasks. Then, the corpus was used for supervised fine-tuning based on Qwen-Omni model variants at different scales. Finally, we designed an evaluation framework featuring diverse tasks and tailored metrics. Through this work, we aim to establish foundational infrastructures for Arabic Speech-LLMs under constraints imposed by limited Arabic speech resources.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Nuha-Speech，面向阿拉伯语语音大模型的全栈基础设施，涵盖数据集构建、模型训练与系统评估。
AI.motivation: 随着语音大模型（speech-LLMs）日益多语言化，阿拉伯语仍严重代表性不足，亟需专门的基础设施来训练与评估阿拉伯语语音大模型。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模阿拉伯语语音问答（SQA）语料库，包含超过150万条训练样本，覆盖广泛核心语音任务以支持指令微调；2) 基于Qwen-Omni模型不同规模变体，利用该语料库进行监督微调（SFT）；3) 设计涵盖多样任务与定制化指标的评价框架。
AI.result: 构建了超150万条样本的阿拉伯语SQA语料库，并完成了Qwen-Omni多规模变体的监督微调，同时建立了一套多任务、定制化指标的评价框架。
AI.conclusion: 在阿拉伯语语音资源受限的约束下，为阿拉伯语语音大模型建立基础性基础设施。

title: 3D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Novel View Synthesis
summary: Solving novel view synthesis (NVS) for millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar requires a renderer that is physically faithful, complex-valued, and multi-viewpoint-tractable. No prior method achieves these three properties simultaneously. Differentiable Monte Carlo (MC) ray tracers implement the radar forward model directly with explicit material modeling and complex outputs, but do not scale to the multi-view optimization NVS demands. Optical-NVS ports of NeRF, hash grids, and 3D Gaussians train fast but discard phase and replace explicit material modeling with opaque learned features, restricting them to power-only range-azimuth (RA) magnitudes. We propose 3D Point Splatting (3DPS), the first differentiable point renderer for radar, derived directly from the standard solid-angle form of the radar equation. Each oriented 3D point carries an ITU-R P.2040 material model, evaluated in closed form, with the resulting complex phasor splatted into range bins through a precomputed point spread function (PSF). The complex-valued output makes the renderer product-agnostic. The same optimized scene yields analog-to-digital converter (ADC), complex range profile (CRP), and RA outputs through standard fast Fourier transform (FFT) pipelines without retraining for each format. On six outdoor ColoRadar scenes, 3DPS reaches 0.587 mean Pearson correlation on held-out RA images. This is between 1.7x and 5.2x the three optical-NVS baselines (RadarSplat, Radar Fields, DART). Training takes approximately 3 minutes per scene on a single RTX 4090.

AI.tldr: 本文提出3D Point Splatting (3DPS)，首个用于毫米波雷达的可微点渲染器，直接由雷达方程立体角形式推导，兼具物理保真、复数输出与多视角可训练性，在ColoRadar场景上取得显著优于光学NVS基线的结果。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达新视角合成需要同时满足三个属性的渲染器：物理保真、复数输出、多视角可优化。然而现有方法无法兼顾：可微蒙特卡洛光线追踪虽物理忠实、支持显式材质与复数输出，但难以扩展到NVS所需的多视角优化；而NeRF、哈希网格、3D高斯等光学NVS移植方法训练快，却丢弃相位并用不透明学习特征替代显式材质，只能输出功率域的RA幅度。
AI.method: 提出3D Point Splatting (3DPS)，从雷达方程的标准立体角形式直接推导的可微点渲染器。每个有向3D点携带ITU-R P.2040材质模型并以闭式求解，所得复数相量通过预计算的点扩散函数(PSF)泼溅到距离bin中。复数输出使渲染器与下游产品格式无关，同一优化场景经标准FFT流水线即可生成ADC、CRP与RA输出，无需针对每种格式重新训练。
AI.result: 在六个室外ColoRadar场景上，3DPS在留出RA图像上达到0.587的平均Pearson相关系数，约为三个光学NVS基线（RadarSplat、Radar Fields、DART）的1.7倍至5.2倍。单张RTX 4090上每场景训练约3分钟。
AI.conclusion: 3DPS是首个同时具备物理保真、复数输出与多视角可训练性的雷达可微渲染器，从雷达方程出发实现显式材质建模与产品无关的复数输出，在精度上大幅超越光学NVS基线，同时保持高效训练，为雷达新视角合成提供了统一且实用的渲染框架。

title: Caption-once, Frames-on-Demand: Visual-Need Routing for Budget-Aware Agentic Long Video Understanding
summary: Long-video understanding on edge devices must reason over hours of content under tight compute and bandwidth budgets. Subsampling visual tokens loses temporal structure, while text-only video memories lose fine-grained visual attributes. We observe a visual-textual duality: language memories carry long-range temporal structure better than dense frames, while pixels remain decisive for attribute-level perception. Building on this insight, we propose Caption-once, Frames-onDemand (CFD), a budget-aware edge-cloud agentic framework. The edge runs a single offline captioning pass that builds a dual-track narrative index, an event-level story skeleton plus a clip-level micro-log, cached and reused across queries without re-captioning. At query time, a cloud-side MLLM reasons over the index in a story-first loop centered on a lightweight Visual-Need Router: a per-query gating module that triggers bounded keyframe retrieval only for perceptual questions (appearance, on-screen text, attribute disambiguation) and keeps temporal-structural questions in language space. The router turns visual access into a first-class, query-conditioned cost, capping per-query frame consumption regardless of video length. Experiments on long-video benchmarks demonstrate strong accuracy-efficiency trade-offs while substantially reducing online visual processing.

AI.tldr: 提出CFD框架，利用视觉-文本对偶性，边缘端离线构建双层叙事索引，云端以Visual-Need Router按查询条件触发有限关键帧检索，实现长视频理解的高精度-高效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上的长视频理解需要在严格的计算与带宽预算下推理数小时的内容。视觉token下采样会破坏时间结构，而纯文本视频记忆会丢失细粒度视觉属性。作者观察到视觉-文本对偶性：语言记忆在长程时间结构上优于密集帧，而像素对属性级感知仍具决定性。
AI.method: 提出Caption-once, Frames-on-Demand（CFD），一种预算感知的边缘-云智能体框架。边缘端执行单次离线字幕生成，构建双轨叙事索引（事件级故事骨架+片段级微观日志），缓存并跨查询复用，无需重复生成字幕。查询时，云端MLLM以故事优先循环在索引上推理，核心是轻量级Visual-Need Router：逐查询门控模块，仅对感知类问题（外观、屏上文字、属性消歧）触发有界关键帧检索，时间-结构类问题保留在语言空间。该路由器将视觉访问转化为一等的、查询条件化的成本，无论视频长度如何都限制每查询的帧消耗。
AI.result: 在长视频基准上的实验表明，该方法实现了强精度-效率权衡，同时大幅减少在线视觉处理。
AI.conclusion: CFD通过解耦视觉与语言记忆并在查询时按需检索关键帧，有效解决了边缘长视频理解中的计算与带宽瓶颈。

title: MindTopo: Can Foundation Models Reason in Topological Space?
summary: Spatial reasoning depends not only on metric properties such as distance, angle, and shape, but also on topological relations that remain invariant under continuous deformation. Cognitive science identifies these relations as foundational to spatial understanding, yet foundation-model evaluations largely focus on metric or viewpoint-dependent relations. We introduce MindTopo, a benchmark of topological intuition across five properties grounded in cognitive science and formal topology: continuity, separation, order, enclosure, and knots. MindTopo evaluates each property at two cognitive levels. Reasoning asks a model to identify topological relations or infer how they change. Planning instantiates a foundation model as a closed-loop agent whose policy selects environment actions. MindTopo contains 11,030 instances across 13 procedurally generated task types with controllable difficulty. We benchmark 14 MLLMs and study agent configurations augmented with image and video generation, including 3 video generative models in planning settings. Every MLLM performs better on reasoning than on planning, and the best-performing model remains far below observed human performance. On Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning improve reasoning more than planning. Generated observations retain local cues and reach plausible endpoints, but audited rollouts do not reliably follow environment dynamics or preserve topology across transitions. Our website is at https://mind-topo.github.io/

AI.tldr: MindTopo：面向拓扑直觉的多模态大模型基准，涵盖连续性、分离性、序、包围、纽结五类性质，分推理与规划两个认知层级，含11,030实例、13类任务。评测14个MLLM显示推理普遍优于规划，最佳模型仍远低于人类水平。
AI.motivation: 空间推理不仅依赖距离、角度、形状等度量性质，还依赖在连续变形下保持不变的拓扑关系；认知科学视拓扑关系为空间理解的基础，而现有基础模型评测多聚焦度量或视角依赖关系，拓扑直觉评估缺失。
AI.method: 构建MindTopo基准，基于认知科学与形式拓扑的五个性质（连续性、分离性、序、包围、纽结），每个性质设两个认知层级：推理（识别拓扑关系或推断其变化）与规划（将基础模型实例化为闭环智能体，由策略选择环境动作）。包含13类程序化生成任务、共11,030个实例，难度可控。评测14个MLLM，并研究引入图像与视频生成增强的智能体配置（含3个视频生成模型用于规划）。
AI.result: 所有MLLM在推理任务上均优于规划任务；最佳模型性能仍远低于人类观测水平。在Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct上，监督微调与强化学习对推理的提升大于对规划的提升。生成观测能保留局部线索并到达看似合理的终点，但审计的轨迹无法可靠遵循环境动力学，也难以在状态转移中保持拓扑性质。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑直觉是当前多模态基础模型的系统性短板，推理与规划之间存在显著能力落差，生成式观测的合理性不等于动力学与拓扑一致性；MindTopo为诊断与改进模型的拓扑空间智能提供了可控评测平台。

title: Distance generalization in transformers: why bother with positional encoding?
summary: Out-of-distribution length generalization, namely to extrapolate a task from short to longer context, has been studied intensively for transformers. Here we focus on distance generalization, which probes performance when inter-token distances are changed between training and inference, while keeping a fixed context length. We construct two synthetic delay copy tasks, both involving finite distances between source and recall, where tokens are copied either fully or selectively, and test models on delays unseen during training. We address three questions: (A) Do positional encoding schemes such as RoPE and ALiBi improve distance resolution relative to no positional encoding (NoPE)? (B) How does data diversity, the number of inter-token distances seen in training, affect performance? (C) When is distance transfer learning positive or negative? We present a thorough investigation, finding that it is paramount to improve our understanding of the underlying mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该文研究Transformer的"距离泛化"：在上下文长度固定的前提下，考察训练与推理时token间距离变化对性能的影响，并构建两个合成延迟复制任务，系统探究位置编码方案、训练数据距离多样性以及距离迁移学习的作用。
AI.motivation: 已有研究多聚焦于"长度泛化"（从短上下文外推到更长上下文），而对"距离泛化"——即固定上下文长度但改变token间距离——的机制理解不足。论文希望厘清位置编码、数据多样性及迁移学习在距离泛化中的作用，从而推动对其底层机制的深入理解。
AI.method: 构建两个合成延迟复制任务，涉及源与召回之间的有限距离，token被完整或选择性复制，并在训练中未见过的延迟上测试模型。围绕三个问题展开：(A) RoPE、ALiBi等位置编码方案相比无位置编码(NoPE)是否提升距离分辨率；(B) 训练中出现的token间距离数量（数据多样性）如何影响性能；(C) 距离迁移学习在何种情况下为正或负。
AI.result: 论文进行了一项全面研究，系统考察了上述三个问题（位置编码方案、数据多样性、距离迁移学习的正负效应），但摘要未给出具体量化结论。
AI.conclusion: 最重要的是加深对距离泛化底层机制的理解；该研究提供了全面的实证调查，为理解Transformer的距离泛化行为奠定基础。

title: Data Scarcity and Model Sparsity: Mixtures-of-Experts Overfit More to Repeated Data
summary: As the supply of human-written text is exhausted, it has become standard practice to repeat language model training data. Prior work has studied data repetition for densely activated Transformers, but the effects of data repetition remains largely unexplored for recently dominant sparse architectures such as Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), despite their increased compute efficiency. We vary data repetition rates across single- and multi-domain data mixes, and across MoE settings, including expert count and granularity. We consistently find, for models ranging from 80M to 1B active (8.5B total) parameters, that MoEs degrade more rapidly under data repetition. This effect increases with sparsity, dictated by total rather than active parameters. While 80M dense models can repeat data over 8x with minimal degradation, MoEs instead begin to suffer at 4x, and deteriorate rapidly, ceding their performance benefits in all-unique data settings to underperform dense models after 32x. We experiment with existing regularization methods as a potential remedy. We find that some methods, such as dropout, can mitigate overfitting. In particular, with strong masking-based regularization, MoEs are able to outperform dense models even when data is repeated more than 64 times. However, no method fully matches the performance of all-unique training data. Finally, we analyze internal mechanisms correlated with MoE overfitting in high repetition regimes, and find that MoE routing universally stabilizes early in training, and that expert specialization correlates with overfitting to repeated data. In sum, our work addresses the adverse interactions between sparsity and data repetition: we present evidence for the core mechanisms of overfitting and its potential remediation, and suggest promising avenues for future methods to reduce over-specialization in model parameters by disrupting memorization patterns.

AI.tldr: 研究发现MoE在数据重复下比稠密模型退化更快，且随稀疏度加剧；部分正则化可缓解，但无法完全匹敌全唯一数据训练。
AI.motivation: 人类文本数据耗尽，重复训练语料已成常态。已有工作研究了稠密Transformer的数据重复效应，但对当前主流的稀疏架构（如MoE）尚缺乏探索，尽管其计算效率更高。
AI.method: 在单域与多域数据混合、不同重复率下，跨MoE设置（专家数量、粒度）进行实验；模型规模80M至1B激活参数（8.5B总参数）；并测试现有正则化方法（如dropout、强掩码正则）作为补救手段；进一步分析MoE过拟合的内部机制（路由、专家特化）。
