AI.result: MoE在数据重复下退化更快，效应随稀疏度增加，由总参数而非激活参数决定；80M稠密模型可重复超8x仍轻微退化，而MoE在4x即受损，32x后性能低于稠密模型；强掩码正则可让MoE在重复超64x时仍优于稠密模型，但无法匹配全唯一数据表现；MoE路由普遍在训练早期稳定，专家特化与对重复数据的过拟合相关。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了稀疏性与数据重复的不良交互及其过拟合核心机制，提供潜在补救手段，并指出通过打破记忆模式减少参数过度特化是未来方法的方向。

title: SenseNova-U1.5: Towards Native Unified Visual Intelligence
summary: We launch SenseNova-U1.5, an 8B-MoT native unified multimodal model that understands, reasons about, and generates visual content within an encoder-free and VAE-free architecture. We strengthen its visual interface through spatially coherent patch reconstruction and scale its training with carefully curated generation and editing data, improved task formulation, structural prompt enhancement, and native resolutions of up to 4K. For post-training, we optimize specialized experts for visual aesthetics, bilingual text rendering, infographic generation, and image editing, and consolidate their capabilities through multi-expert on-policy distillation. Across extensive evaluations, SenseNova-U1.5 largely advances image fidelity, text rendering, complex composition, multi-reference editing, and interleaved generation, while improving instruction following and preserving subject identity, geometry, and unmodified regions. Despite limited exposure to structured formats in its generation data, SenseNova-U1.5 generalizes effectively to long, complex, and structured visual instructions, further proving that multimodal understanding can transfer to visual planning and creation. Together, these findings position native unified modelling as a promising path towards systems that perceive, reason and create within a fully end-to-end framework. We will open-source training code, including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出8B-MoT原生统一多模态模型SenseNova-U1.5，在无编码器、无VAE架构下实现视觉理解、推理与生成，通过数据与训练优化及多专家在线策略蒸馏，显著提升图像保真、文字渲染、复杂构图与编辑能力。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型多依赖外部视觉编码器或VAE，架构不够端到端；同时视觉生成在保真度、文字渲染、复杂指令遵循与主体一致性方面仍有不足。作者旨在探索完全端到端的原生统一建模范式。
AI.method: 1) 采用无编码器、无VAE的8B-MoT原生统一架构；2) 通过空间一致的patch重建强化视觉接口；3) 用精选生成与编辑数据、改进任务表述、结构化提示增强及最高4K原生分辨率扩展训练；4) 后训练阶段为视觉美学、双语文字渲染、信息图生成和图像编辑分别优化专用专家，并用多专家在线策略蒸馏整合能力。
AI.result: 在广泛评测中，SenseNova-U1.5大幅提升图像保真度、文字渲染、复杂构图、多参考编辑与交错生成，同时改善指令遵循并保持主体身份、几何结构和未修改区域；尽管生成数据中结构化格式曝光有限，仍能有效泛化到长、复杂、结构化的视觉指令。
AI.conclusion: 多模态理解能力可迁移至视觉规划与创作，原生统一建模是通向在完全端到端框架内感知、推理与创造系统的可行路径；作者将开源训练代码，包括监督微调、强化学习与在线策略蒸馏。

title: Feature Recovery for Object Understanding After Irreversible Fire Damage
summary: Objects in post-fire environments often undergo irreversible physical transformations that change their geometry, material state, and visual appearance. Detecting and identifying these remnants is critical for locating hazards, reconstructing pre-incident contents, and inventorying losses. Unlike standard image corruptions, these degradations affect the physical structure of the object itself. To study this setting, we introduce TRACE, a transformation-aware benchmark for post-fire object understanding. TRACE contains 21.4K real-image-grounded synthetic scenes and paired object-level pristine-to-degraded progressions spanning 499 object identities across 189 categories. We define five tasks targeting localization and pre-degradation understanding: degraded-object detection, pristine-state recovery and retrieval, original material recovery, pristine description generation, and functional reasoning. Existing models degrade sharply with severity. From the least to the most severe level, RF-DETR mAP decreases by 71% relative, while InternVL3.5 retrieval R@1 falls from 93.85 to 28.11. To address this, we propose the Feature Recovery Module (FRM), a plug-and-play module that maps degraded encoder features to pristine-aligned representations while keeping the host frozen. Trained only with paired feature supervision, FRM improves scene-level detection, CLIP/SigLIP2 feature recovery, and all four object-level VLM tasks, with larger gains under more severe degradation. Across VLM hosts and severity levels, relative gains average 12.5% for retrieval, 20.1% for material recovery, 13.2% for description generation, and 12.4% for functional reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向火灾后物体理解的基准 TRACE 及即插即用特征恢复模块 FRM，用于解决物体在火后发生不可逆物理退化导致检测与识别性能骤降的问题。
AI.motivation: 火灾后物体发生几何、材料状态与视觉外观的不可逆物理变化，检测与识别这些残留物对定位危险、重建灾前内容与损失清点至关重要。与标准图像损坏不同，此类退化改变了物体自身的物理结构，现有模型在退化加剧时性能急剧下降，且缺乏针对性基准。
AI.method: 构建 TRACE 基准：包含 21.4K 真实图像驱动的合成场景，覆盖 189 类、499 个物体身份，并提供成对的物体级“原始—退化”渐进序列；定义五项任务（退化物体检测、原始状态恢复与检索、原始材料恢复、原始描述生成、功能推理）。提出 Feature Recovery Module (FRM)，即插即用，在冻结宿主模型的前提下将退化编码器特征映射为原始对齐表示，仅使用成对特征监督训练。
AI.result: 现有模型随退化严重程度性能显著下降：RF-DETR 的 mAP 相对下降 71%，InternVL3.5 检索 R@1 从 93.85 降至 28.11。FRM 在场景级检测、CLIP/SigLIP2 特征恢复以及四项物体级 VLM 任务上均有提升，退化越严重增益越大；跨 VLM 宿主与严重程度平均相对增益为检索 12.5%、材料恢复 20.1%、描述生成 13.2%、功能推理 12.4%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE 为火灾后物体理解提供了系统化评测基准，揭示现有模型在物理退化下的脆弱性；FRM 以冻结宿主的轻量方式有效恢复原始对齐特征，显著提升多任务性能，验证了特征级恢复思路的有效性与可扩展性。

title: MoPA: Coordinated Mobile Manipulation via Subsystem-Specific Perception Alignment
summary: Mobile manipulation requires perceptual evidence at different spatial scales for base motion and arm control, while the two action modalities remain kinematically coupled. Existing policies often employ specialized action generation for different subsystems but condition heterogeneous action branches on a shared perceptual representation, leaving subsystem-specific perception-action correspondence implicit. We present MoPA, a framework that aligns perceptual conditioning with mobility and manipulation while preserving coordination at the action level. Dual Perceptual Streams employ two mutually masked query banks to extract separate perceptual representations from a shared vision-language context. Perception2Action Adaptation jointly updates each query bank and its corresponding action stream at every layer of a structured Mixture-of-Transformers decoder, while enabling information exchange between the two action streams. Coupled conditional flow matching learns a joint vector field for coordinated generation of both action chunks. On the ManiSkill-HAB benchmark, MoPA achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three task suites. Across four real-world tasks, MoPA achieves a mean full-task success rate of 76.3%, outperforming the best baseline by 12.5 percentage points. Ablation studies and further analyses validate the effectiveness of the proposed design. Website is available at: https://mopa-policy.github.io/.

AI.tldr: MoPA 通过双感知流与感知到动作的自适应对齐，使移动与操作子系统各自获得专属的感知条件，同时在动作层保持耦合协调，在 ManiSkill-HAB 与真实任务上均取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 移动操作需要不同空间尺度的感知证据来分别支持底盘运动与机械臂控制，但两类动作在运动学上相互耦合。现有策略虽为不同子系统设计专门的动作生成分支，却让异构动作分支共享同一感知表征，使子系统专属的"感知—动作"对应关系隐含不明，限制了性能。
AI.method: 提出 MoPA 框架：1) 双感知流（Dual Perceptual Streams）：用两个相互掩蔽的查询库从共享的视觉-语言上下文中提取彼此独立的感知表征；2) 感知到动作自适应（Perception2Action Adaptation）：在结构化 Mixture-of-Transformers 解码器的每一层，联合更新每个查询库及其对应动作流，并允许两条动作流之间进行信息交换；3) 耦合条件流匹配（Coupled Conditional Flow Matching）：学习一个联合向量场，协同生成两类动作块。
AI.result: 在 ManiSkill-HAB 基准上，MoPA 在全部三个任务套件中均达到 state-of-the-art 性能；在四个真实世界任务中，平均全任务成功率为 76.3%，比最优基线高出 12.5 个百分点。消融实验与进一步分析验证了所提设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MoPA 表明，将感知条件与移动、操作子系统显式对齐、同时在动作层保持耦合协调，是一种有效的移动操作策略设计范式，兼具仿真与真实场景的优越表现。

title: What Counts as a Mistake? Annotating Recitation Events in Quran Memorization Transcripts
summary: Checking Quran recitation from an ASR transcript requires distinguishing unresolved mistakes from repetitions, repairs, opening formulas and accepted spelling differences. We report a completed human annotation of 100 production recording cases: 348 scored units and 162 localized events across ten combined labels. An executable evaluator scores labels and word positions together. A plain diff reaches label-aware F1 0.525 and localization F1 0.826; adapted production cleaner/alignment components reach 0.518 and 0.786, with exact-span F1 0.505 for both. Correcting the adapter's word coordinates recovers all five annotated repetition events, showing why annotation interfaces must be checked before interpreting baseline failures. In a preliminary pilot, eight single 20-minute runs across three coding agents and eight models span label-aware F1 0.143 to 0.892: seven land far above every baseline, and one collapses below the naive diff from a missing normalization step. Across the six, 970 of 972 gold-event instances draw an overlapping prediction, so what remains is not detection but convention: span extent, and the labels whose boundary is stipulated by adjudication rather than visible in the text. Seven of 162 events defeat all six same-day runs, five of them one orthographic rule, and the strongest run still misses the same ones. No run annotated before building, so the pilot measures the algorithm half of the task only.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个用于评估《古兰经》诵读逐词纠错（区分未解决错误、重复、修正、开篇套语与可接受拼写差异）的人工标注集与可执行评测器，并通过多智能体/多模型试点比较基线与LLM标注表现。
AI.motivation: 从ASR转写中核查《古兰经》诵读，需要把真正的未解决错误与重复、自我修正、开篇套语以及被接受的拼写差异区分开来；现有基线（朴素diff、改造后的生产清洗/对齐组件）在标签与定位上的失败原因不明，且标注接口本身可能引入伪失败，因此需要一个同时评估标签与词位置的标注体系。
AI.method: 完成100个诵读录制案例的人工标注，得到348个评分单元与162个局部化事件，覆盖10个合并标签；设计可执行评测器，同时评分标签与词位置；对比朴素diff与适配的生产清洗/对齐组件两种基线，并核验适配器的词坐标；随后开展初步试点：3个编码智能体与8个模型各做一次20分钟单轮运行，与基线对照。
AI.result: 朴素diff取得标签感知F1 0.525、定位F1 0.826；适配的清洗/对齐组件为0.518与0.786，二者精确span F1均为0.505。修正适配器词坐标后恢复了全部5个标注重复事件。试点中8次运行标签感知F1从0.143到0.892：7次远高于所有基线，1次因缺少归一化步骤而低于朴素diff；六个同批运行中970/972个金标事件实例有重叠预测，剩余难点集中在约定层面（span范围及由裁定规定边界、文本中不可见的标签）。162个事件中有7个击败全部六个同日运行，其中5个源于同一条正字法规则，最强运行同样遗漏。
AI.conclusion: 核心瓶颈已从事件检测转向标注约定（span边界与裁定性标签），且正字法规则造成的残余失败高度集中。由于所有运行均在构建标注前完成，该试点只衡量任务的算法部分，未覆盖标注界面与人工流程。

title: Creating an Atomic User Model for Personality-Aware Large Language Model Interaction
summary: Assistants built on large language models are expected to write in their users' own voice. Most systems summarise the user's preferences and include the summary in the prompt. This is the wrong way round. Preferences are only the surface of a person and change with the task, while the underlying personality stays the same, so storing preferences alone means relearning the user afresh whenever the task changes. This paper makes four contributions. First, we describe an effect we call personality seepage: the wording of a prompt carries traces of the writer's personality, which the assistant copies without knowing the writer. Second, we propose the Atomic User Model (AUM), a readable profile with a stable identity core surrounded by four layers covering psychological, cognitive, experiential, behavioral, and social details, plus notes on inner conflict and authenticity. Third, instead of inserting the entire profile, we use AUM as a searchable index, in which a task classifier, a selection step, and a budgeted retriever pass along only a few relevant fields. Fourth, we test the pipeline with 16 simulated users, 6 style-sensitive tasks, and 3 seeds. Eight retrieved fields matched the writing quality of the whole profile, while using only 23 percent of the context (211 tokens instead of 915). They scored 0.24 points higher than a plain preference note on a five-point scale. Accuracy in picking a user's own writing from four samples rose from 14.9 to 42.7 percent, where guessing gives 25 percent. Four pre-registered controls showed no effect, so the gain comes from the profile's structure rather than the search method. Personalization helps most for the users for whom a generic assistant imitates them the worst.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"人格渗漏"效应与原子用户模型（AUM），通过检索式用户画像注入替代全量偏好摘要，实现更省上下文、更贴近用户文风的个性化写作。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大模型的写作助手多通过总结用户偏好并写入提示来实现"用户口吻"写作，但偏好只是人格表层且随任务变化，一旦任务切换就需重新学习用户，导致个性化不稳定、成本高。作者认为应从稳定的人格内核而非表层偏好建模用户。
AI.method: 提出原子用户模型（AUM）：一个可读画像，以稳定身份内核为中心，外加四层结构覆盖心理、认知、经验、行为与社会信息，并附内在冲突与真实性说明。使用时不整体插入，而是将AUM作为可检索索引，经任务分类器、字段选择与预算受限检索器，仅传递少量相关字段。实验采用16个模拟用户、6个风格敏感任务、3个随机种子进行评估，并设置4项预注册对照。
AI.result: 检索8个字段的写作质量与使用完整画像相当，但仅消耗23%上下文（211 vs 915 tokens）；相较普通偏好笔记在5分制上高0.24分。从4个样本中识别用户本人写作的准确率由14.9%升至42.7%（随机猜测为25%）。4项预注册对照均无显著效应，说明增益来自画像结构而非检索方法。对通用助手模仿最差的用户，个性化收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 个性化写作助手应以稳定人格内核而非易变偏好为核心建模对象；AUM的层次化结构本身带来主要收益，检索机制可在不牺牲质量的前提下大幅降低上下文开销，并为最难被通用模型模仿的用户带来最大提升。

title: Does Video Memory Use What It Retrieves? A Causal Audit of Memory Specificity
summary: Video models increasingly use memory to preserve information over long sequences, with the assumption that gains come from retrieving and using the correct past content. Standard memory ablations test whether memory helps, but not whether the retrieved content is responsible. We test this directly with read-time memory substitution, which replaces the consumed memory value while leaving the rest of the computation unchanged. This separates memory benefit from memory specificity, the extent to which the gain depends on retrieved content. Across frozen video world models, identity-free controls containing no evaluation-specific content recover essentially the full benefit on Ego-Exo4D and 7-Scenes and about 70% on TUM. In the Ego-Exo4D dose response, recovery falls from 102% to 1% as these values move away from observed training-memory representations, supporting representation repair as the best-supported explanation in this setting. WorldMem shows graded dependence. A wrong memory from the same trajectory recovers 94.1% of the PSNR benefit relative to zero content, while a donor from a disjoint trajectory and biome recovers 43.7%. SAM 2 shows strong content dependence. On DAVIS, replacing the correct spatial memory with a valid wrong memory reduces mean region and boundary score from 0.926 to 0.182. At MOSEv2 reappearance, it falls from 0.459 to 0.000. These results show that memory gains can depend on generic representation support, broader context, or exact episodic content. Read-time substitution provides a direct way to distinguish them.

AI.tldr: 提出"读取时记忆替换"(read-time memory substitution)方法，通过在读取时替换被消费的记忆值、保持其余计算不变，将"记忆收益"与"记忆特异性"（收益对检索内容的依赖程度）分离，并在多个冻结视频世界模型和视频分割模型上验证。
AI.motivation: 视频模型日益依赖记忆来在长序列中保存信息，普遍假设收益来自检索并使用正确的过去内容。但传统记忆消融只能检验记忆是否有帮助，无法检验被检索内容本身是否真正起作用，即收益究竟依赖的是具体检索内容还是通用表征支持。
AI.method: 采用读取时记忆替换：把读取时被消费的记忆值替换为其他值，其余计算流程不动，从而区分记忆收益与记忆特异性。设计无身份控制（不含评估相关内容的记忆值）及剂量响应实验，考察恢复率随替换值远离训练记忆表征的变化；在不同模型（视频世界模型、WorldMem、SAM 2）上比较：同轨迹错误记忆、无交集轨迹/生物群系供体、正确空间记忆替换为有效错误记忆等情形。
AI.result: 在冻结视频世界模型上，无身份控制可恢复 Ego-Exo4D 与 7-Scenes 几乎全部收益、TUM 约 70%；Ego-Exo4D 剂量响应中恢复率从 102% 降至 1%，支持"表征修复"解释。WorldMem 呈梯度依赖：同轨迹错误记忆恢复 94.1% PSNR 收益，异轨迹供体恢复 43.7%。SAM 2 呈强内容依赖：DAVIS 上以有效错误记忆替换正确空间记忆使区域与边界均值从 0.926 降至 0.182，MOSEv2 重现阶段从 0.459 降至 0.000。
AI.conclusion: 记忆收益可能依赖通用表征支持、更广泛的上下文或精确的情景内容三类来源；读取时记忆替换为直接区分这三者提供了有效手段。

title: Beyond Argmax: A Mechanistic Study of Semantic Retention in Frozen Foundation-Model Composition for Generalized Few-Shot 3D Segmentation
summary: Classical classifier-combination work distinguishes score-level fusion from hard decision-level voting. We revisit this distinction where independently pretrained, frozen foundation models are composed at inference time for generalized few-shot 3D segmentation. We ask: how much useful semantic information is lost when heterogeneous sources are collapsed to a single class before they can interact? We answer with a same-input semantic-retention intervention. Dense RegionPLC and sparse cross-view SAM3 evidence, model weights, masks, geometry, vocabularies, and fusion rules are frozen; only the number of semantic alternatives retained before interaction is varied via a matched top-k ladder. On 156 held-out ScanNet200 scenes, top-1 reaches 28.47 harmonic-mean (HM) IoU while full distribution fusion reaches 34.87 HM (+6.40, 95% CI [+5.24,+7.64]). The pattern replicates on 50 ScanNet++ scenes: 23.02 vs. 26.50 HM (+3.48, 95% CI [+1.64,+5.93]). The conclusion is robust: full-distribution HM is stable across sparse-source weights 0.3--0.7; alternative operators (max, geometric pooling) also outperform top-1; and a GroundingDINO--SAM2.1 source-replacement diagnostic shows monotonic HM increase from 14.77 to 18.75 with full retention. Calibration diagnostics reveal opposite miscalibration of the two sources, yet correcting calibration does not eliminate the retention advantage. Across datasets and source stacks, most information is recovered by retaining a compact set of plausible alternatives. The contribution is a controlled diagnosis of premature semantic collapse as a repeatable information bottleneck in heterogeneous frozen-model composition.

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，在异构冻结基础模型组合用于广义少样本3D分割时，将多源证据过早坍缩为单一类别（top-1）会造成显著的语义信息瓶颈；实验通过"同输入语义保留干预"，仅改变交互前保留的语义候选数量（top-k阶梯），在ScanNet200与ScanNet++上均验证了全分布融合显著优于top-1。
AI.motivation: 经典分类器组合研究区分了分数级融合与硬决策级投票，但本文重新审视这一区分的意义：当多个独立预训练、冻结的基础模型在推理阶段进行组合时，若在异构来源交互之前就将其坍缩为单一类别，会丢失多少有用的语义信息？作者将"过早语义坍缩"视为异构冻结模型组合中一个可复现的信息瓶颈，并希望对其进行受控诊断。
AI.method: 采用"同输入语义保留干预"（same-input semantic-retention intervention）的受控实验设计。冻结模型权重、掩码、几何、词表与融合规则：密集证据来自RegionPLC，稀疏跨视角证据来自SAM3。唯一的自变量是"交互前保留的语义候选数量"，通过匹配的top-k阶梯进行调节。在156个ScanNet200留出场景上进行主实验，并在50个ScanNet++场景上验证可复制性；同时开展稳健性检验（稀疏源权重0.3–0.7）、替代算子测试（max、几何池化），以及GroundingDINO–SAM2.1的来源替换诊断和校准诊断。
AI.result: 在156个ScanNet200留出场景上，top-1取得28.47 HM IoU，而全分布融合达到34.87 HM（+6.40，95% CI [+5.24, +7.64]）。在50个ScanNet++场景上模式复现：23.02对26.50 HM（+3.48，95% CI [+1.64, +5.93]）。结论稳健：全分布HM在稀疏源权重0.3–0.7范围内保持稳定；替代算子（max、几何池化）同样优于top-1；GroundingDINO–SAM2.1来源替换诊断显示HM随全量保留从14.77单调升至18.75。校准诊断揭示两个来源存在方向相反的误校准，但校正校准并不能消除保留优势。
AI.conclusion: 跨数据集与来源栈的结果表明，大部分语义信息可通过保留一小组紧凑但合理的候选类别来恢复。本文的核心贡献在于：对异构冻结模型组合中"过早语义坍缩"这一可复现信息瓶颈进行了受控诊断，强调了在交互前保留多语义备选的重要性。

title: Grounding Vision-Language Models in Driving Semantics: A Multi-Dataset Predicate Framework for Explainable Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used for driving-scene understanding, yet the semantic relations expressed in their outputs are often difficult to verify against the underlying traffic situation. This paper introduces a deterministic multi-dataset predicate framework that derives driving-scene semantics from measurable geometric, kinematic, temporal, map, and traffic-control evidence. Dataset-specific interfaces are used only to recover the required scene information, while predicate definitions remain unchanged across nuPlan and nuScenes and are materialised in a common Predicate Knowledge Graph. Quantitative semantic validation against manually annotated predicate relations on 200 scenarios from each dataset yields macro F1 scores of 0.94 on nuPlan and 0.93 on nuScenes, with an average cross-dataset difference of 0.02 across the shared predicates. The Predicate KG is further evaluated using a frozen LLaVA-OneVision-7B model on the nine NuPlanQA subtasks. Predicate grounding achieves the highest accuracy among the evaluated visual-input conditions in seven of nine NuPlanQA subtasks, including Traffic Light (53.2% to 71.5%), Situation Assessment (76.2% to 86.1%), and Action Recommendation (82.9% to 89.0%). Weather/Lighting remains essentially unchanged (89.4% vs. 88.8%), consistent with the absence of corresponding predicates, while Predicate KG only input outperforms metadata-only input in eight of nine subtasks. The results show that deterministic predicates provide a consistent and traceable semantic representation and, under oracle grounding, can reduce visual dependence for reasoning tasks covered by the predicate vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个确定性多数据集谓词框架，从可测量的几何、运动学、时序、地图与交通控制证据推导驾驶场景语义，并在nuPlan和nuScenes上以统一谓词定义构建谓词知识图谱（Predicate KG）。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多用于驾驶场景理解，但其输出所表达的语义关系往往难以与底层交通状况进行核验，缺乏可验证性和可追溯性。
AI.method: 采用确定性多数据集谓词框架，仅用数据集特定接口恢复所需场景信息，谓词定义在nuPlan与nuScenes间保持不变，并统一物化为Predicate Knowledge Graph；用每数据集200个场景的人工标注谓词关系做语义验证，并以冻结的LLaVA-OneVision-7B在九个NuPlanQA子任务上评估谓词接地效果。
AI.result: 语义验证宏F1为nuPlan 0.94、nuScenes 0.93，共享谓词跨数据集平均差异0.02；谓词接地在九个NuPlanQA子任务中的七个取得最高准确率，如Traffic Light从53.2%升至71.5%、Situation Assessment从76.2%升至86.1%、Action Recommendation从82.9%升至89.0%；Weather/Lighting基本不变（89.4% vs. 88.8%），与缺少对应谓词一致；仅Predicate KG输入在九个中的八个优于仅元数据输入。
AI.conclusion: 确定性谓词提供了一致且可追溯的语义表示，在oracle grounding下可降低谓词词汇表所覆盖推理任务对视觉输入的依赖。

title: Extracting Dataset Mentions in Forced Displacement and FCV Documents: A Weakly Supervised Framework with LLM-Based Label Refinement
summary: Development and humanitarian organizations produce and support surveys, administrative registries, and other data resources to inform research, policy, and operations, yet systematically identifying where these datasets are referenced remains difficult. Such references are dispersed across research papers, project documents, humanitarian reports, and other unstructured text, limiting both the ability to trace data use and to identify potential gaps in data availability or dissemination. We present a weakly supervised framework for adapting dataset extraction to forced displacement and Fragile, Conflict, and Violence (FCV) documents without first constructing a large manually labeled training corpus. A lightweight model trained on general research literature generates candidate dataset mentions from unlabeled domain documents, which a frontier large language model (LLM) reviews in context, validating or rejecting candidates and correcting their extraction boundaries. The resulting annotations are supplemented with targeted synthetic and contrastive examples and used to fine-tune the lightweight model for large-scale extraction. We evaluate the resulting model on an independent gold-standard benchmark of 1,706 text passages spanning research, humanitarian, and operational documents. Across the full benchmark, the model achieves 74.1\% precision and 70.5\% recall at the mention level; among passages containing dataset references, precision reaches 89.5\%. At the passage level, the model achieves 88.2\% accuracy and 88.6\% specificity in distinguishing passages with dataset references from those without them. These results demonstrate a practical approach for constructing domain-specific supervision when labeled data are limited, and provide a technical foundation for larger-scale analysis of data use and potential gaps in the displacement data landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种弱监督框架，用于在强制 displacement 与 FCV（脆弱、冲突与暴力）领域文档中抽取数据集引用，无需先构建大规模人工标注语料，并在1,706段独立基准上取得74.1%精确率与70.5%召回率。
AI.motivation: 发展与 humanitarian 组织产出大量调查、行政登记等数据资源，但数据集被引用之处分散于研究论文、项目文档、人道报告等非结构化文本中，难以系统识别。这既阻碍了数据使用溯源，也不利于发现数据可得性或传播方面的缺口。同时，领域标注数据稀缺，人工构建大规模训练语料成本高。
AI.method: 采用弱监督框架：先用通用研究文献训练的轻量模型在无标注领域文档中生成候选数据集提及；再由前沿大语言模型（LLM）结合上下文进行审核，确认或拒绝候选，并修正抽取边界；随后补充针对性的合成样本与对比样本，用于微调轻量模型，实现大规模抽取。
AI.result: 在覆盖研究、人道与 operational 文档的1,706段独立金标准基准上：提及层面精确率74.1%、召回率70.5%；在含数据集引用的段落中精确率达89.5%；段落层面区分是否含数据集引用的准确率为88.2%，特异度为88.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在标注数据有限时构建领域特定监督具有实用价值，为更大规模分析 displacement 数据生态中的数据使用及潜在缺口提供了技术基础。

title: The Cost of Compression: A Rate-Distortion Limit on Factual Hallucination
summary: Factual hallucination in closed-book question answering is often treated as a coverage problem: a model fails because the relevant fact is absent from its internal memory. This view misses a second source of error. Even when a fact has been observed, finite memory may force it to be stored only approximately. We study this effect through a simple coverage--compression model of factual recall. We consider an unstructured question-answering task with $N$ possible queries and $K$ possible answers. A learner observes $M$ training facts, compresses them into at most $B$ bits, and answers uniformly drawn test queries without retrieval. For a uniformly random ground-truth mapping, we prove $\mathcal{E} \geq \frac{M}{N}δ^\star\!\left(\frac{B}{M}\right) + \left(1-\frac{M}{N}\right)\left(1-\frac{1}{K}\right)$, where $δ^\star(r)$ is the inverse rate-distortion function of a uniform $K$-ary source under zero-one loss. The two terms separate compression distortion on observed facts from missing coverage on unobserved facts. The bound gives a compact way to reason about selective memory, forced compression, structure, retrieval, abstention, and long-context organization. We study the predicted signatures with theory-implied simulations and controlled fact-injection probes in modern language models that vary fact load and effective trainable memory. The result is not a complete theory of hallucination, but an information-theoretic account of a separable failure mode: lossy recall of observed facts under finite memory.

AI.tldr: 本文将闭卷问答中的事实幻觉部分归因于有限记忆下的有损编码，提出覆盖—压缩模型，并证明误差下界将压缩失真与覆盖缺失两个来源分离。
AI.motivation: 主流观点将事实幻觉视为覆盖率问题（事实未被记忆），但忽略了另一误差来源：即使事实被观察到，有限记忆也迫使其仅被近似存储。作者希望刻画这一可分离的失效模式。
AI.method: 构建简单的覆盖—压缩事实回忆模型：无结构问答任务含N个查询与K个答案；学习器观察M个训练事实，压缩至至多B比特，并在无检索条件下回答均匀抽取的测试查询。针对均匀随机真值映射证明误差下界，其中δ*(r)为均匀K元源在0-1损失下的逆率失真函数。
AI.result: 证明下界 E ≥ (M/N)δ*(B/M) + (1−M/N)(1−1/K)，两项分别对应已观察事实的压缩失真与未观察事实的覆盖缺失。通过理论驱动的模拟以及在现代语言模型上控制事实注入的探针实验（变化事实负载与有效可训练记忆），验证了预测特征。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为幻觉提供了一个信息论视角下的可分离失效模式解释——有限记忆下已观察事实的有损回忆，而非完整的幻觉理论；该下界也可用于简洁地讨论选择性记忆、强制压缩、结构、检索、弃答与长上下文组织等问题。

title: Quantifying Consonant Contributions to Word Intelligibility via Acoustic Masking
summary: Consonants contribute unequally to whether a word is understood. Given the limited time available for therapy, ranking consonants by contribution to intelligibility helps prioritize intervention targets in motor speech disorders. However, measuring this contribution relies on perceptual studies that are difficult to scale. This paper presents a scalable method that measures consonant contribution using acoustic masking. We silence one consonant at a time in an isolated word and test whether an automatic speech recognition (ASR) model still recognizes the word. We define a consonant's contribution score as the proportion of its masked instances for which the word becomes misrecognized, which we refer to as the mask-induced misrecognition rate (MMR). We relate MMR to two linguistic factors previously reported to correlate with consonant contribution, namely phoneme frequency and functional load. We apply this analysis across four languages, English, Spanish, German, and Czech, using three ASR architectures, MMS (encoder-only), Whisper (encoder-decoder), and Qwen3-ASR (LLM-based). Using partial Spearman correlations, we find that phoneme frequency correlates negatively with MMR while functional load correlates positively. In other words, more frequent consonants are less disruptive when masked, whereas consonants carrying more lexical contrast are more disruptive. Further cross-language analysis shows that consonant rankings agree only partially across languages, indicating that consonant contribution is language-dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用声学掩蔽与ASR模型衡量辅音对词识别贡献的可扩展方法（MMR），并在四种语言、三种架构上验证其与音素频率、功能负荷的关系。
AI.motivation: 辅音对词可理解性的贡献不均等，而治疗时间有限，因此需要按贡献排序辅音以优先干预运动性言语障碍。但传统上测量该贡献依赖难以规模化的感知实验，故需一种可扩展的替代方法。
AI.method: 在孤立词中逐次静音一个辅音，测试ASR模型是否仍能识别该词；将辅音的贡献分数定义为被掩蔽后词被误识别的比例，即掩蔽诱发误识别率（MMR）。使用MMS（仅编码器）、Whisper（编码器-解码器）与Qwen3-ASR（基于LLM）三种架构，在英语、西班牙语、德语、捷克语四种语言上分析MMR与音素频率、功能负荷的关系，采用偏Spearman相关。
AI.result: 音素频率与MMR呈负相关，功能负荷与MMR呈正相关：高频辅音被掩蔽时破坏性较小，而承载更多词汇对立的辅音破坏性更大。跨语言分析显示，各语言的辅音排序仅部分一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于声学掩蔽与ASR的MMR可作为衡量辅音贡献的可扩展指标，其与语言因素的关系得到验证；辅音贡献具有语言依赖性，提示干预目标排序需按语言分别确定。

title: Local Edits, Global Ripples: Replay-Informed Policy Adaptation for Workflow Synthesis
summary: Prompt-policy editing offers a practical way to improve agents that synthesize executable workflows without updating the underlying model. However, persistent prompt editing has two coupled properties. First, edit locality does not imply effect locality: an edit confined to one policy segment can ripple through downstream execution, altering behavior beyond the edited segment. Second, edit effects are composition-sensitive: edits that work in isolation can interfere after composition, causing one or both to lose their benefit or become harmful. Persistent adaptation must therefore support two distinct decisions: identifying where the policy should change from execution feedback, and determining whether the resulting edit remains safe to persist after composition. To address these challenges, we introduce RIPPLE (Replay-Informed Persistent Policy Localization and Editing), which separates where an edit is made from whether it remains safe after composition. It diagnoses failed trajectories, maps each actionable failure to a predefined policy segment, and restricts the correction to that part of the policy. RIPPLE then evaluates candidates against the same iteration-start policy to compare their isolated gains, before replaying promising edits after previously accepted updates to expose downstream effects and interactions. Only edits that remain safe under composition are retained. We evaluate RIPPLE on Flow-HO, a synthetic held-out benchmark for executable workflow synthesis. RIPPLE improves validation success by up to 23.1% and yields positive gains on two additional frozen language-model backbones, while maintaining edit efficiency and low execution cost. Targeted interaction analysis further demonstrates both properties: a segment-local tool-use edit changes downstream resource resolution and validation, while an edit beneficial in isolation becomes harmful after composition.

AI.tldr: 提出RIPPLE方法，通过分离"编辑位置定位"与"组合后安全性判定"两个决策，解决持久化提示编辑中效应非局部性与组合敏感性问题，在Flow-HO基准上验证成功率最高提升23.1%。
AI.motivation: 持久化提示编辑（prompt-policy editing）可在不更新底层模型的前提下改进可执行工作流合成智能体，但存在两个耦合难题：一是编辑局部性不等于效应局部性，局限于某一策略片段的编辑会向下游执行传播、影响编辑段之外的behavior；二是编辑效应具有组合敏感性，单独有效的编辑在组合后可能相互干扰，导致收益消失甚至有害。因此持久化适配必须同时回答"策略应从哪里改"和"编辑组合后是否仍可安全持久化"两个不同决策。
AI.method: RIPPLE（Replay-Informed Persistent Policy Localization and Editing）将"编辑位置"与"组合后安全性"分离：首先诊断失败轨迹，将每个可操作的失败映射到预定义的策略片段（policy segment），并将修正限制在该片段内（定位）；随后让候选编辑与同一迭代起始策略进行对比以评估其孤立增益；再将有前景的编辑在已接受更新之后重放（replay），以暴露下游效应与编辑间交互；仅保留在组合条件下仍安全的编辑。
AI.result: 在合成留出基准Flow-HO上评估：验证成功率最高提升23.1%，并在两个额外冻结语言模型骨干上均取得正向增益，同时保持编辑效率与低执行成本。定向交互分析进一步验证了两种性质：一个片段局部化的工具使用编辑改变了下游资源解析与验证结果；一个在孤立情况下有益的编辑在组合后变得有害。
AI.conclusion: 持久化策略编辑需将"改哪里"与"改动是否可组合持久化"作为两个独立决策处理；RIPPLE通过失败诊断定位、片段约束修正与组合重放验证，有效缓解效应非局部性与组合敏感性问题，在提升工作流合成成功率的同时保持效率与低成本。

title: Population-level measures of perceived food access reveal barriers beyond geographic proximity
summary: Food access is multidimensional, but population-level measurement still relies heavily on geography because perceived dimensions of access are difficult to measure at scale. Here, we use 25,125 Google Maps reviews from 49 grocery stores in Raleigh, North Carolina, to measure five dimensions of food access: availability, accessibility, affordability, accommodation, and acceptability. We identify review topics with unsupervised topic modeling and assign them to access dimensions using zero-shot classification, with 85.4% agreement against manual coding. The resulting store-level measures capture distinct aspects of food access and reveal barriers that geographic proximity alone does not capture. Comparisons between nearby stores in the same chain further show that identical store policies can be perceived very differently across locations, consistent with food access reflecting the fit between residents and their food environment. Perceived food access also follows systematic socioeconomic and demographic patterns that broadly parallel, but do not replicate, those observed for geographic access. These results show that online grocery reviews can provide a scalable complement to geographic measures of food access.

AI.tldr: 利用25,125条Google Maps杂货店评论，通过无监督主题建模与零样本分类测量食品可及性的五个维度，发现感知可及性可揭示地理邻近性无法捕捉的障碍。
AI.motivation: 食品可及性是多维度的，但人口层面的测量仍高度依赖地理指标；感知维度的可及性难以大规模测量，导致现有度量不完整。
AI.method: 采集北卡罗来纳州罗利市49家杂货店的25,125条Google Maps评论；用无监督主题建模识别评论文题，再用零样本分类将其归入五个可及性维度（可得性、可达性、可负担性、适应性、可接受性），与人工编码一致性达85.4%。
AI.result: 店铺层面的度量捕捉到食品可及性的不同方面，揭示地理邻近性单独无法反映的障碍；同链邻近店铺比较显示相同店铺政策在不同地点被感知差异很大；感知可及性呈现系统性社会经济与人口模式，与地理可及性模式大体平行但不完全重合。
AI.conclusion: 在线杂货评论可作为地理式食品可及性度量的可扩展补充，支持从"居民—食品环境匹配"角度理解可及性。

title: Attention-DP3: Spatially Object-aware 3D Diffusion Policy via Geometry-aligned Attentional Conditioning
summary: 3D point-cloud observations are inherently ambiguous in complex, cluttered manipulation scenes, where target objects may be partially occluded or tightly intermingled with visually similar distractors. As a result, standard 3D diffusion policies often struggle to localize and exploit task-relevant geometry as scene complexity grows. We propose \textbf{Attention-DP3}, a spatially object-aware 3D diffusion policy that injects object-level geometric cues via attention while keeping the DP3 diffusion backbone unchanged. Our pipeline performs open-vocabulary 2D segmentation on RGB images, then lifts predicted target masks into 3D using calibrated camera geometry to obtain object-centric geometric priors. We incorporate these cues through Tri-field Attentional Conditioning, which constructs three complementary fields: (i) a targetness field to anchor the target object, (ii) an intra-target saliency field to emphasize task-relevant geometry within the target, and (iii) a backgroundness field to suppress distractors and clutter. Experiments on Adroit, DexArt, MetaWorld, and the real-world SO101 platform show consistent improvements over DP3, achieving state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks. Notably, as distractor objects increase, DP3 drops sharply, whereas Attention-DP3 remains stable and outperforms DP3 by up to 31\% under heavy clutter. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/zhangzhongbo2213/Attention-DP3.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attention-DP3，一种空间物体感知的 3D 扩散策略，通过注意力机制注入物体级几何线索，在保持 DP3 主干不变的前提下显著提升复杂杂乱场景下的操作性能。
AI.motivation: 3D 点云观测在复杂、杂乱的机器人操作场景中天然存在歧义：目标物体可能被部分遮挡，或与外观相似的干扰物紧密混杂。标准 3D 扩散策略（如 DP3）随场景复杂度增加，难以定位并利用与任务相关的几何信息，性能急剧下降。
AI.method: 1) 在 RGB 图像上进行开放词汇 2D 分割；2) 利用已标定的相机几何将预测的目标掩码提升（lift）到 3D，获得以物体为中心的几何先验；3) 通过 Tri-field Attentional Conditioning 注入线索，构建三个互补场：目标性场（targetness，锚定目标物体）、目标内显著性场（intra-target saliency，强调目标内部任务相关几何）、背景性场（backgroundness，抑制干扰物与杂乱）。整个流程保持 DP3 扩散主干不变。
AI.result: 在 Adroit、DexArt、MetaWorld 以及真实世界 SO101 平台上均一致优于 DP3，取得各基准的 SOTA 性能。随干扰物数量增加，DP3 性能急剧下降，而 Attention-DP3 保持稳定，在重度杂乱场景下最高领先 DP3 达 31%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将开放词汇 2D 分割与 3D 几何先验相结合，并以注意力方式注入物体级线索，Attention-DP3 有效缓解了杂乱场景下的点云歧义问题，在不改动扩散主干的情况下实现了更强的鲁棒性与泛化能力，代码已开源。

title: HSI-Road Relabeled: Surface-Aware Road-Scene Segmentation
summary: The HSI-Road dataset provides paired RGB and 25-channel NIR (680-960nm) images with binary masks but no surface-level labels. This paper introduces a manually labeled six-class taxonomy: Background, Asphalt, Concrete, Dirt, Water, and Grass, and an RGB-to-NIR registration pipeline with corresponding annotations. Six semantic-segmentation models are evaluated under four input configurations: original-resolution RGB, registered low-resolution RGB (RGB$_{\text{reg}}$), NIR, and channel-stacked RGB$_{\text{reg}}$-NIR (RGBN$_{\text{stk}}$). The comparison quantifies the effect of spatial-resolution reduction on RGB, along with evaluation of NIR and RGBN$_{\text{stk}}$, with results reported using per-class and mean IoU and F1 scores. The original-resolution RGB achieves the highest overall performance but contains 12$\times$ more pixels and incurs a 15.5-20.6$\%$ latency penalty compared to the reduced-resolution inputs. At the common 192$\times$384 resolution, RGBN$_{\text{stk}}$ outperforms NIR for all six models and RGB$_{\text{reg}}$ for five of six, with the most consistent gains for the Water class. These results highlight the importance of spatial resolution while showing that NIR provides complementary information to RGB.

AI.tldr: 该论文在HSI-Road数据集上构建了六类道路表面标注与RGB-NIR配准流程，并系统评估了六种分割模型在四种输入配置下的性能。
AI.motivation: HSI-Road数据集仅提供成对的RGB与25通道NIR图像及二值掩码，缺乏表面级语义标签，限制了细粒度道路表面分割研究；同时需要量化空间分辨率降低、NIR引入以及RGB-NIR融合对分割性能的影响。
AI.method: 构建人工标注的六类分类体系（Background、Asphalt、Concrete、Dirt、Water、Grass），并设计RGB-to-NIR配准流程及相应标注；采用六种语义分割模型，在四种输入配置下评估：原始分辨率RGB、配准后的低分辨率RGB（RGB_reg）、NIR、以及通道堆叠的RGB_reg-NIR（RGBN_stk），使用逐类与平均IoU及F1分数报告结果。
AI.result: 原始分辨率RGB整体性能最佳，但像素数为低分辨率输入的12倍，并带来15.5-20.6%的延迟开销；在192×384的公共分辨率下，RGBN_stk对全部六种模型均优于NIR，对六种中的五种优于RGB_reg，其中Water类增益最稳定。
AI.conclusion: 空间分辨率对分割性能具有重要影响，同时NIR能为RGB提供互补信息，RGB与NIR的通道堆叠融合在统一分辨率下通常带来更优且更稳定的分割效果。

title: Single-Query Person-Centric Bimanual Hand-Object Interaction Detection
summary: Understanding person-level bi-manual interactions requires not only detecting hands, but also identifying which two hands belong to the same person and what each hand interacts with. Existing hand--object interaction methods are mostly hand-centric: they treat each hand as an independent instance, which can lead to ambiguous ownership in multi-person scenes. We propose a person-centric formulation in which a single query predicts a structured output for one person, including the human box, body pose, hand boxes and states, and interaction targets. We introduce part-aware deformable attention to allocate attention across human, hand, and pose-specific reference regions, enabling one query to capture the full person structure. We further unify detection and interaction reasoning with a hand-to-query relationship matrix, where each hand selects its interaction target from the detected query set plus a learnable off token, directly recovering the target's box and class without separate object regression. We build a COCO-based dataset with person-centric bi-manual interaction annotations and define structured metrics for evaluating hand states and complete hand--object tuples. Experiments with a transformer-based detector show that our formulation improves person-level bi-manual interaction parsing and provides an effective unified framework for joint detection, pose estimation, and hand reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出以人为中心的双手交互解析框架，用单个查询预测人体框、姿态、双手框/状态及交互目标，并通过部分感知可变形注意力和手-查询关系矩阵统一检测与交互推理。
AI.motivation: 现有手-物交互方法多为以手为中心，将每只手视为独立实例，在多人的场景中会导致归属模糊（手属于谁、交互对象是谁不明确）。因此需要以人为中心的表述来解析人级别的双手交互。
AI.method: 1) 以人为中心的形式化：单个查询输出一个人的结构化结果，含人体框、身体姿态、双手框与状态、交互目标。2) 部分感知可变形注意力：在人体、手、姿态特定参考区域上分配注意力，使一个查询捕获完整人体结构。3) 统一检测与交互推理：用手-查询关系矩阵，每只手从检测查询集加一个可学习的 off token 中选择交互目标，直接恢复目标框与类别，无需独立物体回归。4) 构建基于 COCO 的以人为中心双手交互标注数据集，并定义结构化指标评估手状态与完整手-物元组。
AI.result: 基于 transformer 检测器的实验表明，该表述提升了人级别双手交互解析，并为联合检测、姿态估计与手部推理提供了有效的统一框架。
AI.conclusion: 以人为中心的结构化查询与关系矩阵设计能有效解决多人的手部归属模糊问题，统一检测、姿态与手部交互推理。

title: Can LLMs in Draft-Verify-Revise Pipelines Resolve Deictic Ambiguity?
comment: 86 pages including supplementary materials, 4 figures, 10 supplementary figures, 17 supplementary tables, 11 supplementary exemplars. Code and data: https://github.com/oekekezie/deictic-ambiguity-companion
summary: Draft-verify-revise is a common LLM orchestration pattern for scaling inference-time compute. One LLM drafts, a second critiques the draft and provides feedback, and a third uses that feedback to revise the draft into the final output. As context cascades between stages, LLMs at different stages can resolve a context-dependent expression such as "previous" differently. When that happens, the expression undergoes a deictic shift, a change in what it refers to. This phenomenon was studied with a synthetic dataset of 10 base examples, each rendered in three conditions. Holding the shared components constant, the conditions varied whether the draft stage LLM (the assistant) or the verify stage LLM (the grader) resolved the expression correctly, and how much independent reasoning the revise stage LLM (the meta-evaluator) needed to determine which reading was correct. Six models from three providers were tested across 21 reasoning effort configurations using e-values for sequential testing, in a primary experiment and an ablation experiment that removed error classification labels from the grader's feedback. A separate LLM analyzed the meta-evaluator's stated rationale for each wrong verdict. Balanced accuracy (the unweighted mean of sensitivity and specificity) ranged from 0.156, below chance, to near-perfect. GPT-5.2 rose from 0.156 without reasoning to 0.942 at its highest reasoning effort level, while Gemini 3 Pro stayed above 0.94 at every level. Gemini 3 Pro at low reasoning effort outscored GPT-5.2 at xhigh reasoning effort for roughly 5% of the cost per trial. When the meta-evaluator erred, it tended to rely on surface cues rather than operational reasoning. Context engineers implementing draft-verify-revise pipelines should be wary of deictic shifts and make the intended referent explicit at each stage.

AI.tldr: 在draft-verify-revise流水线中，跨阶段上下文传递可导致指示语位移（deictic shift），使"previous"等上下文依赖表达的指代发生变化；通过合成数据集与e-value序贯检验评估6个模型21种推理配置，发现平衡准确率从低于随机的0.156到接近完美的0.94以上，Gemini 3 Pro低推理强度即以约5%成本超越GPT-5.2最高推理强度，且元评估器出错时倾向依赖表层线索。
AI.motivation: draft-verify-revise是扩展推理时计算的常见LLM编排模式，但上下文在草稿、验证、修订三阶段间级联传递时，不同阶段的LLM可能对"previous"这类上下文依赖表达产生不同解析，从而发生指示语位移。该现象此前缺乏系统研究，而理解它对流水线可靠性至关重要。
AI.method: 构建含10个基础示例、每个示例三种条件的合成数据集，在保持共享组件不变的前提下，改变是草稿阶段LLM（assistant）还是验证阶段LLM（grader）正确解析表达，以及修订阶段LLM（meta-evaluator）判定正确读法所需的独立推理量。测试来自3个提供商的6个模型、21种推理强度配置，采用e-values进行序贯检验，包括主实验与去除grader反馈中错误分类标签的消融实验，并另用LLM分析元评估器每次错误裁决的陈述理由。
AI.result: 平衡准确率（敏感度与特异度的非加权均值）从低于随机的0.156到接近完美不等。GPT-5.2从无推理时的0.156升至最高推理强度下的0.942，而Gemini 3 Pro在所有强度级别均保持在0.94以上。Gemini 3 Pro在低推理强度下的表现超过GPT-5.2的xhigh强度，且每次试验成本约为其5%。元评估器出错时，倾向依赖表层线索而非操作性推理。
AI.conclusion: 实施draft-verify-revise流水线的上下文工程师应警惕指示语位移，并在每个阶段明确表达预期指代对象，以避免跨阶段指代解析不一致带来的错误。

title: USPLIT-VQA: U-Shaped Split Learning for Visual Question Answering with Contribution-Aware Weighted Aggregation
summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) systems, jointly interpreting images and natural language queries, hold significant promise across many domains, yet the privacy-sensitive nature of user data creates a fundamental barrier. Centralized training requires access to all data, while federated learning requires each client to host the full model. We propose USPLIT-VQA, a U-shaped split learning framework for privacy-preserving VQA in which each client retains the initial layers and the classification head while the server hosts the computationally heavy intermediate layers, keeping raw inputs and labels on the client device. We further introduce Contribution-Aware Weighted Aggregation (CAWA), a gradientsimilarity-based client scoring mechanism designed to reduce the influence of malicious updates. Experiments on four VQA datasets (VQA-RAD, SLAKE, PathVQA, and VizWiz) with two backbones show accuracy gains over Federated Learning for the Custom model and reduced accuracy for BiomedCLIP under the evaluated fixed split, alongside client memory reductions of up to 5.8X and communication reductions of up to 10.8X. With one malicious client, CAWA reduces the attacker's influence by over 98%, while experiments at higher corruption levels identify its limitations. Reconstruction experiments further show lower inversion quality under the evaluated attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出USPLIT-VQA——一种U型拆分学习框架，实现隐私保护VQA；并引入CAWA基于梯度相似度的客户端评分聚合机制以抑制恶意更新。在四个VQA数据集、两种骨干网络上评测，实现最高5.8倍客户端内存降低与10.8倍通信降低，单个恶意客户端下攻击影响降低超98%。
AI.motivation: VQA系统需联合理解图像与自然语言查询，应用前景广，但用户数据隐私敏感构成根本障碍：集中式训练需访问全部数据，联邦学习又要求每个客户端托管完整模型。
AI.method: 提出USPLIT-VQA：一种U型拆分学习框架，客户端保留初始层与分类头，服务器承载计算量大的中间层，原始输入与标签保留在客户端。进一步提出Contribution-Aware Weighted Aggregation（CAWA），一种基于梯度相似度的客户端评分机制，用于降低恶意更新的影响。
AI.result: 在VQA-RAD、SLAKE、PathVQA、VizWiz四个数据集与两种骨干网络上，Custom模型较联邦学习取得准确率提升，BiomedCLIP在所评估的固定拆分下准确率下降；客户端内存降低最高5.8倍，通信降低最高10.8倍。存在一个恶意客户端时，CAWA将攻击者影响降低逾98%，而更高污染水平下的实验揭示了其局限。重构实验显示在所评估攻击下反演质量更低。
AI.conclusion: USPLIT-VQA在保护原始输入与标签的前提下显著降低客户端内存与通信开销，并借助CAWA有效削弱单恶意客户端影响；但对BiomedCLIP的准确率与更高污染水平、更强攻击场景仍存在局限。

title: When Ground-Truth Fidelity Matters: An Orchestrated UAS Framework for Wheat Streak Mosaic Virus Detection Using Vision Transformers and Machine Learning
comment: 29 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to Computers and Electronics in Agriculture
summary: Wheat streak mosaic virus (WSMV) is a destructive pathogen of sweet corn and other cereal crops, causing yield losses and complicating early detection because symptoms are spatially variable and subtle. In sweet corn seed production, WSMV also has regulatory importance, as phytosanitary regulations from countries such as New Zealand and Chile require seed lots to be certified virus-free. Visual scouting is unreliable because symptoms can resemble abiotic stress, while enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) is accurate but expensive, labor-intensive, and difficult to scale. We present an automated pipeline for plant-level WSMV detection using unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) multispectral imagery. The framework integrates orthomosaic reconstruction, geospatial alignment, plant extraction, and classification using a Vision Transformer with seven-channel inputs (five spectral bands, NDVI, and NDRE). Using treatment-based labels, the model achieved 89% accuracy on over 6,500 test patches across multiple growth stages. However, ELISA-based ground truth revealed substantial label noise: only a small fraction of sampled plants in inoculated plots were infected. Treatment labels therefore did not reliably represent infection status, and the high accuracy was largely driven by label bias rather than disease detection. Performance decreased markedly against row-level symptom severity and plant-level ELISA labels. Under these higher-fidelity but smaller-sample conditions, both deep learning and classical machine learning showed limited generalization and weak separability between ELISA-confirmed mock-inoculated and infected plants. These results show that UAS-based disease detection is constrained by label fidelity and data availability, emphasizing biologically grounded labels and models aligned with real-world conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于无人机多光谱影像与Vision Transformer的玉米小麦条纹花叶病毒(WSMV)植株级检测流程，在高准确率背后发现标签噪声问题：以处理组作标签可得89%准确率，但ELISA验证显示标签偏差主导，改用高保真标签后模型泛化能力显著下降。
AI.motivation: WSMV是甜玉米等谷物的破坏性病原，症状空间变异大且隐蔽，早期检测困难；甜玉米制种中受新西兰、智利等国检疫法规约束，需保证种子批无病毒。人工田间调查不可靠（症状易与非生物胁迫混淆），ELISA准确但昂贵、费工、难以规模化，因此亟需自动化的植株级检测手段。
AI.method: 构建无人机系统(UAS)多光谱影像自动化检测流程，整合正射影像重建、地理空间配准、植株提取与分类；分类器采用七通道输入的Vision Transformer（五个光谱波段加NDVI和NDRE）。首先使用基于处理组的标签进行训练与评估，随后以ELISA作为地面真值检验标签质量，并用行级症状严重度和植株级ELISA标签重新评估深度学习与经典机器学习模型的表现。
AI.result: 在6,500余个测试样块（覆盖多个生育期）上，处理组标签模型达到89%准确率；但ELISA地面真值显示存在显著标签噪声，接种小区中仅小部分采样植株实际感染，说明高准确率主要由标签偏差驱动而非真实病害识别。改用行级症状严重度与植株级ELISA标签后性能显著下降，在样本量较小的高保真条件下，深度学习与经典机器学习均泛化能力有限，ELISA确诊的模拟接种与感染植株间可分性弱。
AI.conclusion: 基于无人机的病害检测受标签保真度与数据可得性制约；高报告准确率可能掩盖标签偏差。研究强调应采用生物学意义明确的标签，并开发与真实田间条件相契合的模型，而非依赖处理组等代理标签。

title: Physics as the label for measuring and correcting materials reasoning in multimodal models
summary: Vision-language and language models increasingly interpret materials data, yet benchmarks report that they hallucinate invalid properties and violate physical law. Evaluation matches final answers to scarce human labels, while discovery agents verify final proposals or density functional theory (DFT) execution. Neither measures the physical consistency of a model's reasoning chain. Materials data carries its own physics, making a large class of materials reasoning verifiable without annotation. We introduce MatPCR, a label-free benchmark whose programmatic oracles check diffraction geometry through Bragg's law, scale bars, spectral peaks, and Materials Project-grounded checks of near-hull stability, computed band-gap class, and net magnetization. We define the Physical-Consistency Rate over image and structure inputs; introduce Constraint-Grounded Self-Verification, an agentic loop whose gain survives self-refinement and equal-compute re-prompting controls; release an open verifier useful in distribution but near chance on all six held-out constraint types; and derive an exact identity for how oracle error displaces the reported rate.

AI.tldr: 提出 MatPCR——一个无需人工标注的材料推理基准，用程序化 oracle 依据物理定律（布拉格定律、比例尺、谱峰、Materials Project 稳定性/带隙/磁矩）检验推理链的物理一致性，并引入自验证环路与开放验证器。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言/语言模型在解读材料数据时常产生无效性质或违反物理定律的幻觉；而评测多依赖稀缺人工标签或仅核验最终答案（如 DFT 执行），无法度量推理链本身的物理一致性。材料数据自带物理约束，使大量推理可无需标注即被验证。
AI.method: 1) 构建 MatPCR 基准：使用程序化 oracle 检验衍射几何（布拉格定律）、比例尺、谱峰，以及基于 Materials Project 的近凸包稳定性、计算带隙类别、净磁化检查；2) 定义在图像与结构输入上的物理一致性率（Physical-Consistency Rate）；3) 提出约束锚定自验证（Constraint-Grounded Self-Verification）智能体环路，并与自精炼、等计算量重提示对照；4) 发布开放验证器；5) 推导 oracle 误差对报告率的精确位移恒等式。
AI.result: 自验证环路带来的增益在自精炼与等计算量重提示控制下依然成立；发布的开放验证器在分布内有效，但在全部六类留出约束上接近随机水平；给出了 oracle 误差如何偏移报告一致性率的精确恒等式。
AI.conclusion: MatPCR 提供了标签免费、可程序化核验的物理一致性评测范式，把评价从最终答案匹配推进到推理链的物理约束检验，并揭示了当前验证器的泛化缺陷与 oracle 误差对指标的影响机制。

title: GAUGE: When Not to Trust LLM-as-a-Judge in User-Simulated Evaluation of Task-Oriented Agents
summary: Comparing and selecting task-oriented LLM agents increasingly relies on a low-cost offline evaluation gate: persona-driven LLM user-simulators converse with each candidate, an LLM-as-a-judge scores the transcripts, and the higher-scoring agent is promoted. We introduce GAUGE, a reusable offline protocol that measures whether this gate's ranking matches a grounded verifiable reward across 25 agents from six providers on the $τ^2$-bench and SimulatorArena benchmarks, separating two kinds of evaluation validity that release practices conflate: ranking validity and construct validity. First, a satisfaction-success gap: satisfaction carries essentially no information about task success, as conversations rated satisfied by our blind panel are decorrelated from actual success, with 57.5% of them failing the customer's task, a pattern consistent across five rater populations, both benchmarks, and every subjective dimension we rated. Second, while the gate's ranking is robust across the broad capability span, it loses resolution among the near-equal strong agents: this decision-disagreement rate jumps from $<$1% on wide-reward pairs to 31% on close pairs. The gate is thus human-validated yet mis-anchored. As a remedy, we propose a calibrate-then-trust cadence in which a judge-free completion bit is a zero-cost tripwire for truncation regressions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAUGE离线协议，检验persona驱动LLM用户模拟器+LLM评判的低成本评估门控能否与可验证奖励的排序一致，发现其排序效度在大能力跨度上稳健，但在强agent间分辨率不足，且评判满意度与任务成功几乎无关。
AI.motivation: 任务导向LLM agent的选型日益依赖低成本离线评估门控（user-simulator对话+LLM-as-a-judge打分），但该门控的排序是否与真实可验证奖励一致尚不明确；现有发布实践混淆了排序效度（ranking validity）与构念效度（construct validity）两类评估有效性。
AI.method: 提出可复用的GAUGE离线评估协议：在τ²-bench与SimulatorArena两个基准上，对来自六家提供商的25个agent，将门控排名与grounded verifiable reward对比，并分离排序效度与构念效度；采用盲评小组（blind panel）评定满意度，覆盖五种评分者群体与多个主观维度。
AI.result: 1）满意度-成功鸿沟：满意度几乎不携带任务成功信息，被判“满意”的对话与实际成功去相关，其中57.5%未完成用户任务，该模式在五种评分者、两个基准及所有主观维度上一致；2）门控排名在宽能力跨度上稳健，但在强agent间失去分辨率，决策不一致率从宽奖励配对的<1%升至接近配对的31%。
AI.conclusion: 该低成本评估门控虽经人类验证但“锚点错位”（human-validated yet mis-anchored）；作为补救，提出calibrate-then-trust流程，以无需评判者的完成位（judge-free completion bit）作为零成本的截断回归触发器。

title: QuPAINT: Physics-Aware Multimodal Reasoning for Quantum Material Characterization
summary: Characterizing two-dimensional (2D) quantum materials by optical microscopy requires localizing exfoliated flakes and determining their layer thickness from subtle optical contrast and interference color to select suitable flakes for device fabrication. However, models face synthetic-to-real domain shifts and variation across materials, substrates, laboratories, and imaging conditions. We present QuPAINT, a physics-aware multimodal framework for transferable quantum flake characterization. The Synthetic Materials Framework (Synthia) generates diverse synthetic microscopy images while preserving layer-dependent optical behavior. Using these images, we construct QMat-Instruct, a multimodal instruction dataset with image-specific reasoning traces generated from verified annotations and constrained to observable optical cues. QuPAINT integrates these signals through Physics-Informed Attention (PIA), which injects substrate-relative optical priors into the visual representation to support grounded multimodal reasoning. For evaluation, we introduce QF-Bench, to our knowledge, the largest real-world benchmark for this problem, spanning diverse microscopy and substrate conditions. Using its verified annotations, we study counting, visual grounding, reasoning quality, confidence calibration, and transfer to an unseen material. QuPAINT-8B substantially outperforms prior methods and establishes state-of-the-art performance for both general and monolayer flake detection. Additional experiments show that image-grounded supervision improves strict spatial grounding and confidence calibration while preserving robust general flake detection on the unseen material.

AI.tldr: 提出QuPAINT物理感知多模态框架，用于可迁移的二维量子薄片表征，含Synthia合成数据、QMat-Instruct指令数据集、Physics-Informed Attention与QF-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 光学显微表征二维量子材料需定位剥离薄片并从微弱光学对比与干涉色中判定层数，但现有模型存在合成到真实的域偏移，且跨材料、衬底、实验室与成像条件泛化差。
AI.method: 1) Synthia合成材料框架生成多样且保持层数依赖光学行为的合成显微图像；2) 基于验证标注构建QMat-Instruct多模态指令数据集，含受限可观测光学线索的推理轨迹；3) Physics-Informed Attention将衬底相对光学先验注入视觉表征；4) 构建QF-Bench真实世界基准。
AI.result: QF-Bench为目前该问题最大真实基准，覆盖多样显微与衬底条件；QuPAINT-8B显著优于先前方法，在通用与单层薄片检测上均达SOTA；图像接地监督提升严格空间定位与置信度校准，并在未见过材料上保持稳健检测。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知多模态框架结合合成数据与指令微调可有效缓解域偏移，实现可迁移的量子薄片表征，并验证图像接地监督对定位、校准与跨材料泛化的价值。

title: PLSP (Pre-hoc Liminal Space Profiling): OOD Prediction over Detection -- An Anticipatory Approach for Machine Learning Model Reliability
summary: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) data poses a significant threat to machine learning models, often leading to model failure during deployment. All existing OOD detection methods are post-hoc, relying on evaluation metrics such as accuracy and AUC-ROC during inference to indirectly assess the model's response to OOD data by measuring deviations. In contrast to existing approaches, the proposed work shifts the paradigm from OOD detection to OOD prediction by proposing a pre-hoc anticipatory framework called PLSP for OOD prediction. We make several key contributions: (a) a dataset-independent metric called the CREDibility Score (CREDS) is proposed for OOD prediction; (b) credibility curves are introduced to study the maximum credibility a model can attain; and (c) credibility heat maps (and volume under surface) are introduced to characterize pre-hoc model behavior across different datasets. This work provides a novel perspective on signal processing under distributional shifts. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that the proposed metric serves as a valuable measure for improving the robustness of machine learning models toward OOD prediction.

AI.tldr: 该工作将OOD问题从"检测"转向"预测"，提出pre-hoc预期框架PLSP，并引入CREDS指标、可信度曲线与可信度热图（含曲面下体积）来刻画模型在分布偏移下的先验行为。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测方法均为post-hoc，依赖推理阶段的accuracy、AUC-ROC等评估指标，通过衡量偏差间接评估模型对OOD数据的响应，缺乏在推理前对模型OOD行为的预判能力。
AI.method: 提出pre-hoc预期框架PLSP用于OOD预测，具体贡献包括：(a) 与数据集无关的CREDibility Score (CREDS)指标；(b) 用于研究模型可达到的最大可信度的可信度曲线；(c) 用于刻画模型在不同数据集上pre-hoc行为的可信度热图（及曲面下体积）。从信号处理视角处理分布偏移问题。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，所提指标是提升机器学习模型面向OOD预测鲁棒性的有价值的度量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为分布偏移下的信号处理提供了新视角，将OOD研究从检测范式推进到预测范式。

title: Repair Before Reinforce: Context-Augmented Knowledge Graph Reasoning for Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Question-answering often requires reasoning across multiple connected facts rather than retrieving a single isolated relation. Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide a structured way to represent such facts, but training large language models (LLMs) only on isolated KG head-relation-tail triples may limit their ability to learn the surrounding context needed for multi-hop reasoning. In this work, we propose a context-augmented training framework for multi-hop question-answering. Although generally applicable, we validate the framework in the context of disease-specific KGs, extracted using a reliable KG extraction framework called GraphMERT, for Gastroparesis and Diabetes. For each primary KG triple, we attach supporting triples extracted from the same source text chunk to form a context graph (CG). This creates two supervision settings: KG-grounded supervision, which uses only the target KG triple or path, and CG-grounded supervision, which uses the target KG triple or path together with supporting context triples. We train the Qwen3-14B model using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) under both settings, producing KGModel and CGModel variants. To strengthen the lower-hop factual foundation of the models, we introduce an LLM-judged, history-aware adaptive repair pipeline that identifies unresolved one-hop failures, continually fine-tunes on targeted repair examples, and removes or quarantines problematic noisy triples. This repair stage enables the models to reach 100% accuracy on the cleaned retained one-hop validation sets. Finally, we employ reinforcement learning (RL) using lower-hop question-answer items and evaluate generalization on harder 3-hop, 4-hop, and 5-hop tasks. Across both diseases, context-augmented supervision consistently improves multi-hop performance over KG-only supervision. RL initialized from repaired SFT checkpoints yields larger and more stable gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种上下文增强训练框架，用支持三元组构建上下文图，在疾病KG上验证其在多跳问答中优于仅KG监督，并配合自适应修复与RL获得更稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 仅用孤立的KG头-关系-尾三元组训练LLM，缺乏多跳推理所需的上下文信息，限制了模型学习可支撑多跳问答的周边知识。
AI.method: 用GraphMERT为Gastroparesis与Diabetes抽取疾病KG；为每个主三元组附加同一文本块的支持三元组形成上下文图；设KG-grounded与CG-grounded两种监督，对Qwen3-14B做SFT得到KGModel与CGModel；引入LLM评判、历史感知的自适应修复流程处理一跳失败与噪声三元组；再用低跳问答项做RL并在3/4/5跳任务上评估泛化。
AI.result: 两种疾病上，上下文增强监督一致优于仅KG监督；修复后模型在清洗保留的一跳验证集达100%准确率；从修复SFT检查点初始化RL带来更大且更稳定的多跳性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 上下文增强监督可有效改善多跳问答，低跳修复能夯实事实基础，并作为RL初始化为高跳任务提供更佳、更稳定的泛化。

title: Chopthin-Consensus Power Sampling: A Diversity-Preserving Approach to LLM Decoding
comment: Accepted at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
summary: Inference-time power sampling via Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) can substantially improve large language model (LLM) reasoning without requiring post-training. However, many existing SMC approaches rely on equal-weight resampling, which can aggressively prune low-weight trajectories, discarding potentially correct reasoning paths and degrading the genealogical diversity of the search space. To address this, we introduce Chopthin-Consensus Power Sampling (CCPS). Our method applies the Chopthin resampler to LLM decoding: rather than equalizing weights and forcing unnecessary particle duplication, it enforces an upper bound on the ratio between the largest and smallest weights and carries the unequal weights forward. This targeted intervention preserves a richer set of distinct reasoning paths, keeps the weighted SMC approximation unchanged in conditional expectation, and guarantees a lower bound on the post-resampling effective sample size (ESS). To fully exploit this enriched population, we employ a semantic-majority selection mechanism that merges token-identical final trajectories, clusters semantically equivalent answers, and returns the answer supported by the largest number of distinct trajectories. Evaluating across three open-weight models and five reasoning benchmarks, we show that Chopthin increases oracle coverage in 13 of 15 settings. Combined with semantic-majority selection, CCPS matches or exceeds the final-answer accuracy of the Power-SMC baseline in 14 of 15 settings, delivering absolute gains of up to 10.6 percentage points. These findings demonstrate that diversity-preserving resampling and diversity-aware selection are complementary mechanisms for training-free LLM reasoning. Code is available at github.com/MinooAhmadii/chopthin-consensus-power-sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出Chopthin-Consensus Power Sampling (CCPS)，用Chopthin重采样替代等权重重采样以保留推理路径多样性，并结合语义多数选择机制，在免训练LLM推理上最多提升10.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有基于SMC的推理时幂采样多采用等权重重采样，会激进剪除低权重轨迹，丢弃可能正确的推理路径并降低搜索空间的谱系多样性。因此需要一种既能保持SMC加权近似性质、又能保留多样性的重采样与选择方案。
AI.method: 将Chopthin重采样器引入LLM解码：不将权重等量化、不强制粒子重复，而是对最大与最小权重之比施加上界，并保留不等权重向前传播；同时采用语义多数选择机制，合并token完全相同的最终轨迹、聚类语义等价的答案，返回被最多不同轨迹支持的答案。
AI.result: 在3个开放权重模型和5个推理基准上评估，Chopthin在15个设置中的13个提升了oracle覆盖率；与语义多数选择结合后，CCPS在15个设置中的14个匹配或超过Power-SMC基线的最终答案准确率，绝对增益最高达10.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 保多样性的重采样与多样性感知的选择是互补机制，可共同提升免训练LLM推理性能；Chopthin在条件期望上不改变加权SMC近似，并保证重采样后有效样本量(ESS)的下界。

title: Automated Detection and Structuring of Social Tipping Point Evidence in Climate related Documents: A Modular AI Framework
summary: The climate literature has grown faster than review teams can read it. That gap matters most for a concept like the environmental social tipping point, the threshold at which a small change triggers rapid, self-reinforcing change in a social system. Evidence of this kind of shift is usually contained in one or two paragraphs within a longer document. As a result, existing text mining tools-which categorize entire documents by topic or highlight isolated claims-leave an expanding set of important evidence without any systematic method for discovery or organization. This paper presents an open and modular transformer-based framework that detects and structures social tipping point evidence at the passage level. The framework joins five components into a single deployable workflow: a DistilBERT boundary splitter for segmentation, an iteratively augmented RoBERTa classifier for detection, a Mistral 7B model that rewrites each detected passage for clarity, a LLaMA 3.2 3B model that rates the passage against five published social tipping point criteria, and a Milvus vector store for semantic retrieval. The system is wrapped in a Streamlit interface backed by MinIO object storage. Evaluated on a 163-passage benchmark labelled by GPT-4.1 and a 51-passage set reviewed by experts, the splitter surpassed three competing methods on a nine-metric composite score (6.137). The tuned RoBERTa model achieved 71.4 percent accuracy with a Cohen's kappa of 0.337 on the full benchmark, and 87.5 percent accuracy with a kappa of 0.742 on passages with labels, outperforming both a climate-focused model and untuned language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于Transformer的开放模块化框架，在段落级别检测并结构化"环境社会临界点"证据，整合分割、检测、改写、评级与语义检索五个组件，并在163段GPT-4.1标注基准和51段专家评审集上评估，分割器与检测模型均优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 气候文献增长速度快于评审团队的阅读能力，而"环境社会临界点"这类概念的证据通常仅散落在长文档的一两段中；现有文本挖掘工具只能按主题对整篇文档分类或高亮孤立论断，缺乏系统性发现与组织此类证据的方法。
AI.method: 提出一个模块化的Transformer框架，在段落级别检测和结构化社会临界点证据，包含五个组件：DistilBERT边界分割器、迭代增强的RoBERTa分类器、Mistral 7B改写模型、LLaMA 3.2 3B五准则评级模型，以及Milvus向量库用于语义检索；系统以Streamlit界面封装，底层由MinIO对象存储支持。
AI.result: 在163段由GPT-4.1标注的基准和51段专家评审集上评估：分割器在九指标综合得分（6.137）上超过三种对比方法；调优后的RoBERTa在全量基准上准确率71.4%、Cohen's kappa 0.337，在含标签段落上准确率87.5%、kappa 0.742，优于气候领域专用模型和未调优语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为段落级社会临界点证据的自动发现与组织提供了可部署的系统方案，所提分割与检测组件在量化指标上优于现有方法，表明基于Transformer的多组件流水线可有效弥补气候文献评审能力与文献增长速度之间的差距。

title: FIDAL: Diversity-Aware Federated Active Learning Under Real-World Distribution Shifts
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across institutions without centralizing data, yet high annotation costs, domain shifts, and class imbalance remain major obstacles, especially when irrelevant out-of-distribution (OOD) samples dilute the labeled data. Existing active learning methods target uncertainty or diversity within in-distribution (ID) data and overlook unknown samples in federated clinical settings. We propose FIDAL, an open-set federated active learning framework that combines calibrated global-local evidential uncertainty, support-set diversity weighting, and adaptive OOD rejection. The rejection gate thresholds a foundation-model Gaussian-coverage signal per client and per round with Otsu's criterion, so that highly informative ID samples are queried while irrelevant outliers are excluded without any hand-tuned threshold. Evaluated on three multi-center medical imaging benchmarks (dermatology, histopathology, and mammography with organically occurring artifacts) in realistic open-set scenarios, FIDAL outperforms detector-based open-set methods by up to about 12 percentage points of balanced accuracy and is the only method on the accuracy-ID purity Pareto front of all three benchmarks. At an equal query budget it spends at least 1.3 times fewer annotations on OOD samples than every accuracy-matched baseline, saving an estimated 7-29 hours of expert reading on the mammography benchmark. By labeling only a fraction of the data pool, it matches or exceeds fully supervised performance across modalities. These results highlight the value of integrating uncertainty, diversity, and OOD rejection in open-set federated active learning for medicine.

AI.tldr: 提出FIDAL，一种面向开放集联邦主动学习的框架，融合证据不确定性、支持集多样性加权与自适应OOD拒绝，在三大多中心医学影像基准上显著优于检测器类方法。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可跨机构协同训练而无需集中数据，但标注成本高、域偏移和类别不平衡仍是主要障碍，尤其当无关的分布外（OOD）样本稀释标注数据时。现有主动学习方法仅关注分布内（ID）数据的不确定性或多样性，忽略了联邦临床场景中的未知样本。
AI.method: FIDAL包含三个组件：（1）校准的全局-局部证据不确定性；（2）支持集多样性加权；（3）自适应OOD拒绝。拒绝门控基于基础模型的高斯覆盖信号，按客户端和轮次采用Otsu准则确定阈值，无需手工调参，从而在查询高信息量ID样本的同时排除无关离群点。
AI.result: 在三个多中心医学影像基准（皮肤科、组织病理学、含天然伪影的乳腺钼靶）的开放集场景中，FIDAL在平衡准确率上比基于检测器的开放集方法高出最多约12个百分点，且是唯一同时位于三个基准准确率-ID纯度Pareto前沿的方法。同等查询预算下，其用于OOD样本的标注量比所有准确率相当的基线至少少1.3倍，在乳腺钼靶基准上估计节省7-29小时专家阅片时间。仅标注部分数据池即可匹配或超越全监督性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了在面向医学的开放集联邦主动学习中融合不确定性、多样性与OOD拒绝的价值。

title: HypoKG: Evidence-Disciplined Biomedical Hypothesis Generation Beyond Endpoint Knowledge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate biomedical hypotheses, but it remains unclear whether they truly reason from scientific evidence or simply produce convincing-sounding ideas. To study this, we combine three major biological databases: the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), Rhea, and UniProt, into a unified biochemical knowledge graph and construct a benchmark of 550 paths connecting enzyme sources to rare disease endpoints, yielding 13,200 hypotheses from six LLMs under four conditions varying the biological information each model receives: source enzyme only, full biological path, or source and disease endpoint only. Hypotheses are scored using an expert-derived five-criterion rubric on a 1-5 scale per criterion. We find that models given both the source and disease endpoint often produce the highest-scoring hypotheses, showing that LLMs can generate compelling ideas from minimal information. However, these hypotheses are less grounded in the evidence. In contrast, models given the full biological path generate hypotheses more consistent with known mechanistic relationships. We call this evidence-disciplined reasoning. To confirm this effect, we shuffled intermediate path steps while keeping endpoints fixed. Evidence grounding dropped significantly (delta = -0.793, p < 0.001), confirming models genuinely used path structure during reasoning. Our findings show that knowledge graphs support hypothesis generation in two ways: they identify biological endpoint pairs absent from the literature, and their mechanistic paths guide how LLMs reason between them.

AI.tldr: 本文构建统一生化知识图谱与550条"酶源-罕见病终点"路径基准，用六种LLM在四种信息条件下生成13,200条假设，经专家五维评分发现：仅给源与终点时假设得分高但证据支撑弱；给完整路径时假设更符合已知机制（"证据约束推理"），打乱中间步骤后证据支撑显著下降（Δ=-0.793, p<0.001）。
AI.motivation: LLM能生成生物医学假设，但其究竟是"真正从科学证据推理"还是"只是产出听起来可信的说法"尚不清楚，因此需要一个可量化评估证据依赖度的实验框架。
AI.method: 整合KEGG、Rhea、UniProt为统一生化知识图谱；构建550条连接酶源与罕见病终点的路径基准，在四种信息条件下由六个LLM生成13,200条假设（仅源酶、完整生物路径、仅源与疾病终点等）；用专家制定的五准则1-5分评分表打分；并通过打乱中间路径步骤、固定端点做对照验证。
AI.result: 同时获得源与疾病终点的模型常产出最高分假设，说明LLM可由极少信息生成有吸引力的想法，但其证据支撑较弱；获得完整生物路径的模型生成的假设与已知机制关系更一致（证据约束推理）。打乱中间步骤后证据支撑显著下降（Δ=-0.793, p<0.001），证明模型确实利用了路径结构进行推理。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱以两种方式支持假设生成：一是识别文献中缺失的生物学终点配对，二是其机制路径引导LLM在两端点之间如何推理；提示应关注证据约束推理而非仅追求假设的表面说服力。

title: Revisiting Multi-Object Tracking Baselines: Hyperparameter Optimization with Multi-Fidelity Greedy Coordinate Search
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) is dominated by the tracking-by-detection paradigm, whose methods typically rely on a small set of hyperparameters that are conventionally chosen by hand. Tuning them requires repeated expert-guided experimentation, while the procedures used to select reported values are often not systematically evaluated or fully documented. Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) automates this process, yet it remains rarely used in MOT, and existing studies applying HPO to MOT predate modern deep-detector-based trackers and HOTA evaluation. We systematically apply HPO across two datasets and four tracking-by-detection methods. We also propose Multi-Fidelity Greedy Coordinate Search (MFGCS), which optimizes one hyperparameter at a time by first evaluating candidate values on a small subset of scenes and re-evaluating only promising candidates on the full dataset. Across all eight tracker-dataset combinations, the Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) and MFGCS outperform both our hand-tuned configurations and the corresponding published results, with improvements of up to 4.38 and 16.05 HOTA points, respectively. MFGCS also reaches a predefined HOTA target faster than TPE in seven of the eight combinations. Within each tracker-dataset pair, all optimizers share the same search space and evaluation pipeline, isolating the effect of the search strategy. We release the code and tuned configurations to enable future work to compare against systematically optimized rather than default or manually tuned baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统性地将超参数优化（HPO）应用于多目标跟踪（MOT），并提出多保真贪心坐标搜索（MFGCS），在八个跟踪器-数据集组合上超越手工调参与已发表结果。
AI.motivation: tracking-by-detection范式的MOT方法依赖少量需人工选取的超参数，调参需反复专家实验，且报告值的选取过程常缺乏系统评估与完整记录。HPO虽可自动化此过程，但在MOT中应用稀少，且既有相关研究早于现代深度检测器与HOTA评估，已过时。
AI.method: 在两个数据集与四种tracking-by-detection方法上系统应用HPO；提出MFGCS，逐个优化单一超参数，先在小场景子集上评估候选值，仅对表现有前景的候选在全数据集上重评估；各跟踪器-数据集对内所有优化器共享相同搜索空间与评估流程，以分离搜索策略的影响。
AI.result: 在全部八个跟踪器-数据集组合上，TPE与MFGCS均优于手工调参配置及对应已发表结果，HOTA提升分别最高达4.38与16.05分；MFGCS在八个组合中的七个比TPE更快达到预设HOTA目标。
AI.conclusion: HPO可显著提升MOT性能，MFGCS在效率与效果上具优势；作者公开代码与调参配置，推动未来工作以系统优化基线而非默认或手工调参基线进行对比。

title: EAR: Entity-Aware Partitioning Approach for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Development
comment: 6 pages. Accepted and presented at the 2026 Innovations in Intelligent Systems and Applications Conference (ASYU 2026). To appear in the conference proceedings and IEEE Xplore
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve knowledge-intensive question answering, but the first design choice is easy to overlook: how should the source corpus be partitioned into retrievable units? Fixed-size chunks often return long passages whose relation to the question is only implicit. We introduce EAR, an Entity-Aware Partitioning approach for multiple-choice question answering (MCQA). EAR extracts normalized surface anchors from the question, answer options, and corpus; retrieves local windows around matching corpus anchors; and can attach a larger parent passage through an extractive summary. We evaluate EAR on a cleaned Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU)-style subset of 153 questions selected by an automatic corpus-support heuristic and using decontaminated public textbook text. Across same-protocol top-k = 3 and top-k = 8 sweeps with Mistral, Gemma, and DeepSeek, EAR entity-window reduces retrieved words by 37.5-40.2% relative to chunks. Observed accuracy changes are +5.2, +1.3, and -3.9 points at top-k = 3, and +5.9, -3.3, and -4.6 points at top-k = 8; none of the entity-window differences is statistically significant. The scoped contribution is methodological: EAR provides a compact and inspectable retrieval unit, while its rule-based anchor extractor remains domain-specific and requires separate validation before transfer.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EAR（实体感知分区）方法，用实体锚点窗口替代固定长度分块作为RAG检索单元，在MMLU式多选问答上减少约37.5–40.2%检索词量，但准确率变化不显著。
AI.motivation: RAG中"如何将语料切分为可检索单元"这一首要设计选择常被忽视；固定长度分块常返回与问题只有隐含关系的长段落，噪声大、可解释性差。
AI.method: EAR从问题、选项和语料中抽取归一化的表层实体锚点，检索语料中匹配锚点周围的局部窗口，并可通过抽取式摘要附着更大的父段落。在153题、经自动语料支持启发式筛选的清洗版MMLU式子集上评测，使用去污染公开教材文本，在top-k=3与top-k=8下以Mistral、Gemma、DeepSeek进行同协议对比。
AI.result: 实体窗口相比分块减少检索词量37.5–40.2%。准确率变化：top-k=3时为+5.2、+1.3、-3.9分，top-k=8时为+5.9、-3.3、-4.6分，所有实体窗口差异均不具统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 贡献定位于方法层面：EAR提供了紧凑、可检视的检索单元，但基于规则的锚点抽取器仍具领域特定性，迁移前需单独验证。

title: AnchorVLN: Geometry-Anchored Vision-Language Grounding Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) in unseen indoor environments is useful in real-world robotics, where an agent must follow natural-language instructions, locate objects, and answer spatial questions without a pre-built map or fixed object vocabulary. Multimodal vision-language models (VLMs) provide strong open-vocabulary grounding and zero-shot reasoning, but struggle to emit reliable metric quantities such as range, bearing, and comparative spatial relations directly from images. Existing approaches address this by folding geometry into hand-engineered pipelines or asking models to output waypoints, requiring changes to the control stack for different robots, tasks, or vocabularies. We introduce AnchorVLN, an open-vocabulary VLN system built on a simple rule: the VLM proposes semantics; geometry decides metrics. It is realised as EMBODIED-NAV-MCP, a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server driven by a VLM agent through a compact set of callable tools. Since no tool accepts distance in metres or bearing in radians, the schema enforces the semantic-geometry boundary without modifying the downstream autonomy stack. We benchmark both tasks of the CMU Vision-Language Navigation Challenge 2026: 30 instruction-following questions over 15 scenes and a frozen 45-question object-reference set. The full system achieves 64.4 percent on instruction following, dropping by 13.3 percentage points without controller modeling (t = 2.77). On object reference, geometric anchoring clears the challenge overlap threshold on 10 of 45 questions, versus 0 of 45 for direct coordinate estimation, reducing median center error from 3.37 m to 2.48 m.

AI.tldr: 提出AnchorVLN，基于"VLM提议语义、几何决定度量"原则，通过MCP服务器实现开放词汇视觉语言导航，在CMU VLN 2026挑战赛中指令跟随达64.4%，几何锚定将目标指代中位中心误差从3.37m降至2.48m。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人室内VLN需要无预建地图和固定词汇下跟随指令、定位物体并回答空间问题。多模态VLM虽具开放词汇grounding和零样本推理能力，但直接输出距离、方位等度量量不可靠；现有方案需将几何硬编码进流程或依赖航点输出，导致控制栈需随机器人、任务和词汇变化而改动。
AI.method: AnchorVLN遵循"VLM提议语义、几何决定度量"的简洁规则，实现为EMBODIED-NAV-MCP——由VLM agent通过紧凑工具集驱动的MCP服务器。工具schema不接受米制距离或弧度方位，从而在不修改下游自主栈的前提下强制执行语义-几何边界。
AI.result: 在CMU VLN 2026挑战赛两个任务上评测：15个场景的30道指令跟随题和固定的45题目标指代集。完整系统指令跟随达64.4%，去除控制器建模后下降13.3个百分点（t=2.77）；目标指代上几何锚定在45题中的10题超过挑战重叠阈值，而坐标直接估计为0/45，中位中心误差从3.37m降至2.48m。
AI.conclusion: 通过工具schema将语义与几何解耦，可在不改动下游自主栈的情况下显著提升开放词汇VLN的度量可靠性，验证了该设计在指令跟随和目标指代任务上的有效性。
